sql_infos.sql: SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m12.refid) AS mailings_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1 FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m12 ON c.id = m12.refid AND m12.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 56 AND 51 AND d.income_k > 152.69 GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) > 12 AND SUM(s.amount) < '1000' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s.amount) AS median_sale_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS total_mailings, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid WHERE c.age >= 27 AND c.educationnum >= 18 AND d.income_k >= 267.99 GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING AVG(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 689 ORDER BY median_sale_amount DESC, total_sales DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2, AVG(d.a_var3) AS avg_a_var3, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings1_2_yes_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings3_yes_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS distinct_sales_events, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, MAX(s.event_date) AS last_sale_date, MIN(m1.ref_date) AS first_mailing1_2_date, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.marital_status ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_marital, LAG(SUM(s.amount), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.id ORDER BY MAX(s.event_date)) AS prev_total_sales FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE ( (c.age BETWEEN 87 AND 71) OR (c.educationnum > 12 AND c.sex = 'Male') OR (c.marital_status IN ('Married-civ-spouse', 'Married-civ-spouse') AND c.occupation = 'Adm-clerical') ) AND d.income_k >= 777.44 AND ( (m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m1.response IS NOT NULL) OR (m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m3.response IS NOT NULL) OR (s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.amount > '0') ) AND NOT (d.a_var1 < '-100' AND d.a_var2 > '-100') GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 8 AND (AVG(d.a_var3) < '-100' OR AVG(d.a_var4) > '-100') ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, last_sale_date ASC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_demog_var FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 83 AND 99 GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) >= 26 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(s.amount) FILTER (WHERE s.amount IS NOT NULL) AS avg_sale_amount, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC NULLS LAST) AS sales_rank FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND '2020-01-01 00:00:00' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 18 AND 53 AND d.income_k > 998.37 GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.income_k HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 69 AND SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC LIMIT 468;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE c.age >= 39 AND c.age <= 35 AND d.income_k >= 72.3 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.income_k HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) > 4 AND SUM(s.amount) > '1000' ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m12.refid) AS mailing_count, SUM(CASE WHEN s.eventid IS NOT NULL THEN s.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(d.a_var1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status) AS avg_a_var1_by_demo FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m12 ON c.id = m12.refid AND m12.response = 'YES' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE c.age BETWEEN 83 AND 53 AND d.income_k > 314.76 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM mailings3 m3 WHERE m3.refid = c.id AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' ) GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, c.marital_status HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m12.refid) > 76 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC NULLS LAST;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date) AS sale_year, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM s.event_date) AS sale_quarter, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS total_sales, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_geoid_income, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date), c.sex ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS spending_rank_by_year_sex FROM customers c JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid WHERE s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.amount > '0' AND d.income_k BETWEEN 497.44 AND 405.91 GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, sale_year, sale_quarter HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY sale_year DESC, sale_quarter, total_amount DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS total_mailings, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses_m1, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses_m3, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS unique_sales_events, AVG(CASE WHEN s.amount > '100' THEN s.amount ELSE NULL END) AS avg_large_sale_amount FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 66 AND 74 AND d.income_k >= 160.3 GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.income_k HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) > 300 AND SUM(s.amount) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2, AVG(d.a_var3) AS avg_a_var3, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS unique_sales_events, COUNT(DISTINCT m12.refid) AS mailings1_2_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailings3_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m12.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS m12_yes_responses, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS m3_yes_responses, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_demographic FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m12 ON c.id = m12.refid AND m12.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND '2020-01-01 00:00:00' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 100 AND 65 AND c.educationnum >= 1 AND d.income_k > 186.04 AND d.inhabitants_k < '0' GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 539 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, sales_rank_by_demographic;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS unique_sales_events, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings1_2_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailings3_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_demographic, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(d.a_var2) DESC) AS a_var2_row_num FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND '2020-01-01 00:00:00' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 51 AND 37 AND c.educationnum > 1 AND d.income_k >= 867.61 AND d.a_var3 < '-1000' GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 38 AND AVG(d.a_var4) BETWEEN '-1000' AND '-1000' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, sales_rank_by_demographic;

SELECT c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS unique_sales_events, AVG(m1.kxindex) AS avg_mailing_index, COUNT(m3.refid) FILTER (WHERE m3.response = 'YES') AS mailings3_yes_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_sex, LAG(SUM(s.amount), 1) OVER (ORDER BY d.geoid, c.id) AS prev_customer_sales FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date >= s.event_date WHERE ( s.amount > '0' OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM mailings1_2 m2 WHERE m2.refid = c.id AND m2.kxindex > 6 ) OR d.income_k BETWEEN 342.17 AND 378.74 ) AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND c.age >= 91 GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 54 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, d.geoid, c.id;

SELECT d.geoid, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(c.educationnum) AS total_education FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid WHERE d.inhabitants_k > '0' GROUP BY d.geoid HAVING AVG(d.income_k) < 464.55 EXCEPT SELECT d.geoid, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(c.educationnum) AS total_education FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN mailings1_2 m ON c.id = m.refid WHERE m.response = 'Yes' AND m.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY d.geoid ORDER BY avg_income DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS total_sales, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, COUNT(m1.response) FILTER (WHERE m1.response = 'YES') AS mailings1_yes_count, COUNT(m3.response) FILTER (WHERE m3.response = 'YES') AS mailings3_yes_count FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE c.occupation LIKE '%' AND c.marital_status LIKE '%' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND d.income_k BETWEEN 186.95 AND 473.12 GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_amount DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.income_k, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date) AS sale_year, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM s.event_date) AS sale_quarter, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS total_sales, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings1_2_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailings3_count, SUM(d.a_var1 + d.a_var2 + d.a_var3) AS demographic_score FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date BETWEEN s.event_date - INTERVAL '30 days' AND s.event_date LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date BETWEEN s.event_date - INTERVAL '30 days' AND s.event_date WHERE s.amount > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND c.age BETWEEN 56 AND 73 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.income_k, sale_year, sale_quarter), (c.sex, c.marital_status, sale_year, sale_quarter), (d.geoid, sale_year), (sale_year, sale_quarter), () ) HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_amount DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m.refid) AS mailings_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m.response = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN mailings1_2 m ON c.id = m.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date >= m.ref_date WHERE c.occupation LIKE '%' AND c.marital_status LIKE '%' AND m.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m.refid) > 49 ORDER BY avg_sale_amount DESC NULLS LAST;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS unique_sales_events, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings1_2_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailings3_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings1_2_yes_responses, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings3_yes_responses, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_demographic, LAG(SUM(s.amount), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.id ORDER BY DATE_TRUNC('month', s.event_date)) AS prev_month_sales FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND s.event_date >= m1.ref_date JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND s.event_date >= m3.ref_date WHERE s.amount > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.event_date <= '2020-01-01' AND d.income_k BETWEEN 299.46 AND 409.44 AND c.age >= 61 GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, DATE_TRUNC('month', s.event_date) HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 63 AND AVG(d.a_var1) < '-100' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, sales_rank_by_demographic;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) OVER(PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid) AS avg_a_var1_by_demo, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings1_2_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailings3_count, (SELECT MAX(m2.ref_date) FROM mailings1_2 m2 WHERE m2.refid = c.id AND m2.response = 'YES') AS last_positive_mailing_date FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 33 AND 37 AND c.educationnum > 19 AND d.income_k >= 462.38 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sales s2 WHERE s2.refid = c.id AND s2.amount > '0') GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) + COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) >= 26 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, avg_a_var1_by_demo ASC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) OVER(PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid) AS avg_a_var1_by_demo, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings1_2_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailings3_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN m1.refid END) AS mailings1_2_yes_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN m3.refid END) AS mailings3_yes_count, (COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN m1.refid END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid), 0)) AS mailings1_2_response_rate, (COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN m3.refid END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid), 0)) AS mailings3_response_rate, MAX(s.event_date) AS latest_sale_date, MIN(m1.ref_date) AS first_mailing1_2_date FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.amount > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 61 AND 44 AND c.educationnum >= 8 AND d.income_k >= 53.49 AND (m1.refid IS NULL OR m3.refid IS NULL) GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' OR SUM(s.amount) IS NULL ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC NULLS LAST, mailings1_2_response_rate DESC LIMIT 108;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) OVER(PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid) AS avg_a_var1_by_demo, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings1_2_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailings3_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN m1.refid END) AS mailings1_2_yes_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN m3.refid END) AS mailings3_yes_count, (COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN m1.refid END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid), 0)) AS mailings1_2_response_rate, (COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN m3.refid END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid), 0)) AS mailings3_response_rate, MAX(s.event_date) AS latest_sale_date, MIN(m1.ref_date) AS first_mailing1_2_date FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.amount > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 66 AND 66 AND c.educationnum >= 16 AND d.income_k >= 50.86 AND (m1.refid IS NULL OR m3.refid IS NULL) GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' OR SUM(s.amount) IS NULL ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC NULLS LAST, mailings1_2_response_rate DESC LIMIT 514;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS distinct_mailings1_2_refs, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.kxindex) AS distinct_mailings1_2_kx, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS distinct_mailings3_refs, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS distinct_sales_events, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_demog_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_demog_var2, AVG(d.a_var3) AS avg_demog_var3, AVG(d.a_var4) AS avg_demog_var4, AVG(d.a_var5) AS avg_demog_var5, AVG(d.a_var6) AS avg_demog_var6, AVG(d.a_var7) AS avg_demog_var7, AVG(d.a_var8) AS avg_demog_var8, AVG(d.a_var9) AS avg_demog_var9, AVG(d.a_var10) AS avg_demog_var10, AVG(d.a_var11) AS avg_demog_var11, AVG(d.a_var12) AS avg_demog_var12, AVG(d.a_var13) AS avg_demog_var13, AVG(d.a_var14) AS avg_demog_var14, AVG(d.a_var15) AS avg_demog_var15, AVG(d.a_var16) AS avg_demog_var16, AVG(d.a_var17) AS avg_demog_var17, AVG(d.a_var18) AS avg_demog_var18, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_demo FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.response = 'YES' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.response = 'YES' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE c.age >= 68 AND c.age <= 63 AND c.educationnum >= 15 AND d.income_k >= 527.82 AND (m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' OR m1.ref_date IS NULL) AND (m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' OR m3.ref_date IS NULL) AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) > 88 AND COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) > 14 AND SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, sales_rank_by_demo;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS distinct_mailings1_2_refs, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS distinct_mailings3_refs, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS distinct_sales_events, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_demog_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_demog_var2, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC NULLS LAST) AS sales_rank_by_demo, LAG(SUM(s.amount), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.geoid ORDER BY d.income_k DESC) AS prev_total_sales_in_geo FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.response = 'YES' AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.response = 'YES' AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND s.amount > '0.0' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 99 AND 51 AND d.income_k > 322.14 AND d.inhabitants_k < '0.0' GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) > 75 AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 15 AND SUM(s.amount) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, d.income_k DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses_m1, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses_m3, AVG(CASE WHEN s.amount > '500' THEN s.amount ELSE NULL END) AS avg_large_sale, COUNT(CASE WHEN c.age BETWEEN 25 AND 46 THEN 1 END) AS customers_in_age_range, SUM(d.a_var1 * d.a_var2) AS demographic_interaction, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_sex, LAG(SUM(s.amount), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.geoid ORDER BY MAX(s.event_date)) AS prev_total_sales_in_area FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2024-01-01' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' WHERE c.educationnum > 13 AND d.income_k BETWEEN 38.72 AND 154.69 AND (c.nom1 = 'ValueA' OR c.nom2 = 'ValueA') GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '1000' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 8 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, sales_count ASC LIMIT 398;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings_yes_count, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2 FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid WHERE c.age >= 82 AND c.age <= 80 AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) > 76 UNION ALL SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailings_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings_yes_count, AVG(d.a_var3) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var4) AS avg_a_var2 FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE c.age >= 85 AND c.age <= 93 AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) > 51 ORDER BY mailings_count DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m12.refid) AS mailings_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC NULLS LAST) AS sales_rank_by_sex FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m12 ON c.id = m12.refid AND m12.response = 'YES' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE c.age >= 34 AND c.age <= 66 AND d.income_k > 81.01 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) > 28 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC NULLS LAST;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS total_sales, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS spending_rank_by_sex FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid WHERE s.amount > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND c.age BETWEEN 61 AND 40 GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_amount DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT m1.response, ', ' ORDER BY m1.response) AS mailing_responses, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sales_amount FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE c.age >= 98 AND c.age <= 26 AND d.income_k >= 270.65 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) > 25 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT m1.response, ', ' ORDER BY m1.response) AS mailing_responses, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, MAX(s.event_date) AS last_sale_date FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE c.age >= 40 AND c.educationnum >= 20 AND d.income_k >= 278.55 AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND (s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' OR s.event_date IS NULL) GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) > 27 AND SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, mailings_count DESC;
SELECT c.id, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales FROM customers c JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE s.amount > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT c.id, c.age, COUNT(DISTINCT m.refid) AS mailing_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount FROM customers c JOIN mailings1_2 m ON c.id = m.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE c.age BETWEEN 37 AND 72 AND m.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.age HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

SELECT c.id, c.age, COUNT(DISTINCT m.refid) AS mailing_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount FROM customers c JOIN mailings1_2 m ON c.id = m.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE c.age BETWEEN 43 AND 94 AND m.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.age HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

SELECT c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.income_k, d.inhabitants_k, AVG(s.amount) OVER(PARTITION BY c.geoid) AS avg_sale_amount_by_geoid, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mailings1_2 m WHERE m.refid = c.id AND m.response = 'YES' AND m.ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00') AS recent_yes_mailings FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE c.age BETWEEN 55 AND 54 AND d.income_k > 79.07 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.income_k, d.inhabitants_k, s.amount HAVING COUNT(s.eventid) > 24 ORDER BY d.income_k DESC, avg_sale_amount_by_geoid DESC;

SELECT c.id, c.age, d.geoid, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.amount > '0' GROUP BY c.id, c.age, d.geoid INTERSECT SELECT c.id, c.age, d.geoid, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m ON c.id = m.refid WHERE m.response = 'Yes' AND m.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.age, d.geoid ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, AVG(c.age) AS avg_age, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE s.amount > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY d.geoid HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '1000' UNION ALL SELECT d.geoid, AVG(c.age) AS avg_age, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN mailings1_2 m ON c.id = m.refid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE m.response = 'Yes' AND s.amount > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY d.geoid HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '1000' ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS customer_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses, (SELECT AVG(s.amount) FROM sales s WHERE s.refid IN (SELECT m3.refid FROM mailings3 m3 WHERE m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01')) AS avg_sales_after_mailing FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid WHERE d.inhabitants_k > '0' GROUP BY d.geoid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 78 ORDER BY avg_income DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS customer_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE d.inhabitants_k > '0' AND c.age BETWEEN 54 AND 19 AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY d.geoid HAVING AVG(d.income_k) > 274.17 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) >= 447 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC NULLS LAST;

SELECT d.geoid, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS customer_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, AVG(SUM(s.amount)) OVER (PARTITION BY d.geoid) AS avg_sales_per_customer_in_geoid FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE d.income_k > 909089.59 AND s.event_date >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY d.geoid, c.id HAVING SUM(s.amount) > 385711.57 ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS distinct_mailings1_2_refid, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS distinct_mailings3_refid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS distinct_sales_eventid, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(d.inhabitants_k) AS total_inhabitants, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank, LAG(SUM(s.amount), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY d.geoid) AS prev_geoid_sales FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE d.income_k > 952.02 AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND c.age BETWEEN 20 AND 80 GROUP BY d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) > 432 AND COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) > 662 AND SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS total_sales_events, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_geoid_income, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT m1.response, ', ' ORDER BY m1.response) AS mailing_responses_1_2, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT m3.response, ', ' ORDER BY m3.response) AS mailing_responses_3, SUM(d.a_var1 * d.a_var2) / NULLIF(SUM(d.a_var3), 0) AS computed_demog_ratio, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_amount_percentile FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON s.refid = m1.refid AND s.event_date >= m1.ref_date JOIN mailings3 m3 ON s.refid = m3.refid AND s.event_date >= m3.ref_date WHERE s.amount > '0' AND d.income_k BETWEEN 75.48 AND 19.01 AND c.age >= 35 GROUP BY d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) > 66 AND AVG(d.income_k) < 221.65 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, d.geoid;

SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS unique_events, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses_m1, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses_m3, (SELECT AVG(data1) FROM customers c2 WHERE c2.geoid = d.geoid AND c2.age > 53) AS avg_data1_for_older_in_geo, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_sex FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE d.inhabitants_k > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2000-01-01' AND m1.ref_date BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2000-01-01' AND c.age BETWEEN 99 AND 98 AND s.amount > '0' GROUP BY d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 429 ORDER BY total_sales DESC, avg_income DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, AVG(d.inhabitants_k) AS avg_inhabitants, SUM(d.income_k) AS total_income, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS total_sales_events, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS total_mailings1_2, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS total_mailings3, AVG(c.educationnum) AS avg_education, SUM(d.a_var1 + d.a_var2 + d.a_var3 + d.a_var4 + d.a_var5 + d.a_var6 + d.a_var7 + d.a_var8 + d.a_var9 + d.a_var10 + d.a_var11 + d.a_var12 + d.a_var13 + d.a_var14 + d.a_var15 + d.a_var16 + d.a_var17 + d.a_var18) AS sum_all_a_vars, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_demographic FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND '2020-01-01 00:00:00' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 51 AND 74 AND d.income_k > 611823.95 AND (c.nom1 = 'A' OR c.nom2 = 'A' OR c.nom3 = 'A') GROUP BY d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) > 55796 AND SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND AVG(c.educationnum) BETWEEN 2 AND 8 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, avg_inhabitants ASC;

SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailings3_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, AVG(d.inhabitants_k) AS avg_inhabitants, SUM(d.a_var1 + d.a_var2 + d.a_var3 + d.a_var4 + d.a_var5 + d.a_var6 + d.a_var7 + d.a_var8 + d.a_var9 + d.a_var10 + d.a_var11 + d.a_var12 + d.a_var13 + d.a_var14 + d.a_var15 + d.a_var16 + d.a_var17 + d.a_var18) AS sum_all_a_vars, AVG(c.data1) AS avg_data1, AVG(c.data2) AS avg_data2, AVG(c.data3) AS avg_data3, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank, LAG(SUM(s.amount), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY d.geoid) AS prev_geoid_sales FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.response = 'YES' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.response = 'YES' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE d.income_k > 543.59 AND d.inhabitants_k BETWEEN '0' AND '0' AND c.age >= 64 AND c.educationnum >= 18 AND (m1.ref_date >= '2000-01-01' OR m1.ref_date IS NULL) AND (m3.ref_date >= '2000-01-01' OR m3.ref_date IS NULL) AND (s.event_date >= '2000-01-01' OR s.event_date IS NULL) GROUP BY d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) > 755 AND SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND AVG(d.income_k) < 225.31 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, d.geoid, c.sex;

SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailings3_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(d.inhabitants_k) AS avg_inhabitants, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(d.a_var1 + d.a_var2 + d.a_var3 + d.a_var4 + d.a_var5 + d.a_var6 + d.a_var7 + d.a_var8 + d.a_var9 + d.a_var10 + d.a_var11 + d.a_var12 + d.a_var13 + d.a_var14 + d.a_var15 + d.a_var16 + d.a_var17 + d.a_var18) AS sum_all_a_vars, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY d.geoid) AS prev_sales_count_by_demo FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.response = 'YES' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.response = 'YES' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE c.age >= 75 AND c.educationnum >= 1 AND d.income_k >= 439.98 AND (m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' OR m1.ref_date IS NULL) AND (m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' OR m3.ref_date IS NULL) AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) > 383 AND SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND AVG(d.inhabitants_k) < '0' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, sales_count DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailings3_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(d.inhabitants_k) AS avg_inhabitants, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(d.a_var1 + d.a_var2 + d.a_var3 + d.a_var4 + d.a_var5 + d.a_var6 + d.a_var7 + d.a_var8 + d.a_var9 + d.a_var10 + d.a_var11 + d.a_var12 + d.a_var13 + d.a_var14 + d.a_var15 + d.a_var16 + d.a_var17 + d.a_var18) AS sum_all_a_vars, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC NULLS LAST) AS sales_rank_by_demographic FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.response = 'YES' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.response = 'YES' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE c.age BETWEEN 68 AND 26 AND d.income_k >= 346.97 AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND c.educationnum > 3 GROUP BY d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) > 177 AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 237 AND SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND AVG(d.inhabitants_k) < '0' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, mailings_count DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(d.a_var1 + d.a_var2 + d.a_var3 + d.a_var4 + d.a_var5 + d.a_var6 + d.a_var7 + d.a_var8 + d.a_var9 + d.a_var10 + d.a_var11 + d.a_var12 + d.a_var13 + d.a_var14 + d.a_var15 + d.a_var16 + d.a_var17 + d.a_var18) AS sum_all_vars, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY d.geoid, c.sex ORDER BY c.marital_status) AS prev_mailing_count FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE c.age >= 24 AND c.educationnum >= 17 AND d.income_k >= 970.15 AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.amount > '0' GROUP BY d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) > 31 AND SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND AVG(d.income_k) BETWEEN 107.26 AND 924.2 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, mailings_count DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(d.inhabitants_k) AS total_inhabitants, SUM(d.a_var1 + d.a_var2 + d.a_var3 + d.a_var4 + d.a_var5 + d.a_var6 + d.a_var7 + d.a_var8 + d.a_var9 + d.a_var10 + d.a_var11 + d.a_var12 + d.a_var13 + d.a_var14 + d.a_var15 + d.a_var16 + d.a_var17 + d.a_var18) AS sum_all_vars, (SELECT AVG(age) FROM customers WHERE geoid = d.geoid AND age > 55) AS avg_age_above_threshold, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_demographic FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND m1.ref_date <= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND s.event_date <= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND m3.ref_date <= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' WHERE d.income_k > 204.19 AND d.inhabitants_k < '0' AND c.age BETWEEN 66 AND 75 GROUP BY d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) > 522 AND SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, avg_income DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, COUNT(DISTINCT m12.refid) AS mailings_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC NULLS LAST) AS sales_rank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) DESC) AS sales_count_rank_by_demo FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m12 ON c.id = m12.refid AND m12.ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND '2020-01-01 00:00:00' WHERE d.inhabitants_k > '0.0' AND d.income_k BETWEEN 470.34 AND 235.86 AND c.age >= 31 GROUP BY d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) > 269 AND SUM(s.amount) > '0.0' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

WITH customer_agg AS ( SELECT c.id AS c_id, c.geoid AS c_geoid, c.age AS c_age, c.educationnum AS c_educationnum, c.sex AS c_sex, c.marital_status AS c_marital_status, c.occupation AS c_occupation, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS m1_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS m3_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS m1_yes, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS m3_yes, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2, AVG(d.a_var3) AS avg_a_var3 FROM customers c LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' INNER JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid WHERE c.age BETWEEN 35 AND 50 GROUP BY c.id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation ), sales_agg AS ( SELECT s.refid AS s_refid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_amount, MIN(s.event_date) AS first_sale, MAX(s.event_date) AS last_sale FROM sales s WHERE s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY s.refid ), self_joined_sales AS ( SELECT s1.s_refid AS s1_refid, s2.s_refid AS s2_refid, s1.total_amount AS s1_total, s2.total_amount AS s2_total, s1.avg_amount AS s1_avg, s2.avg_amount AS s2_avg, ABS(s1.total_amount - s2.total_amount) AS total_diff FROM sales_agg s1 INNER JOIN sales_agg s2 ON s1.s_refid < s2.s_refid AND s1.total_amount > '1000' AND s2.total_amount > '1000' WHERE s1.total_amount + s2.total_amount > '5000' ) SELECT ca.c_id, ca.c_age, ca.c_sex, ca.c_occupation, ca.m1_count, ca.m3_count, ca.m1_yes, ca.m3_yes, ca.avg_a_var1, ca.avg_a_var2, ca.avg_a_var3, COALESCE(sa.sales_count, 0) AS sales_count, COALESCE(sa.total_amount, 0) AS total_amount, COALESCE(sa.avg_amount, 0) AS avg_amount, COUNT(sjs.s1_refid) AS comparable_customers_count, AVG(sjs.total_diff) AS avg_total_diff_vs_others FROM customer_agg ca LEFT JOIN sales_agg sa ON ca.c_id = sa.s_refid LEFT JOIN self_joined_sales sjs ON ca.c_id = sjs.s1_refid OR ca.c_id = sjs.s2_refid WHERE ca.c_educationnum > 11 AND ca.avg_a_var1 < '0.0' GROUP BY ca.c_id, ca.c_age, ca.c_sex, ca.c_occupation, ca.m1_count, ca.m3_count, ca.m1_yes, ca.m3_yes, ca.avg_a_var1, ca.avg_a_var2, ca.avg_a_var3, sa.sales_count, sa.total_amount, sa.avg_amount HAVING COUNT(sjs.s1_refid) > 50 AND COALESCE(sa.total_amount, 0) > '0' ORDER BY avg_total_diff_vs_others DESC, total_amount DESC LIMIT 1000;

WITH customer_agg AS ( SELECT c.id AS c_id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2 FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid WHERE c.age BETWEEN 63 AND 66 AND d.income_k > 255.64 GROUP BY c.id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) > 48 ), sales_agg AS ( SELECT s.refid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_amount, MIN(s.event_date) AS first_sale_date, MAX(s.event_date) AS last_sale_date FROM sales s WHERE s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.amount > '0' GROUP BY s.refid ), mailings3_agg AS ( SELECT m3.refid, COUNT(*) AS m3_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS m3_positive FROM mailings3 m3 WHERE m3.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' GROUP BY m3.refid ) SELECT ca.c_id, ca.age, ca.educationnum, ca.sex, ca.marital_status, ca.mailings_count, ca.positive_responses, ca.avg_a_var1, ca.avg_a_var2, COALESCE(sa.sales_count, 0) AS sales_count, COALESCE(sa.total_amount, 0) AS total_sales_amount, COALESCE(sa.avg_amount, 0) AS avg_sale_amount, sa.first_sale_date, sa.last_sale_date, COALESCE(ma.m3_count, 0) AS m3_mailings_count, COALESCE(ma.m3_positive, 0) AS m3_positive_responses, (ca.positive_responses * 1.0 / NULLIF(ca.mailings_count, 0)) AS response_rate, (COALESCE(sa.total_amount, 0) * 1.0 / NULLIF(ca.mailings_count, 0)) AS revenue_per_mailing FROM customer_agg ca LEFT JOIN sales_agg sa ON ca.c_id = sa.refid LEFT JOIN mailings3_agg ma ON ca.c_id = ma.refid WHERE ca.avg_a_var1 > '0' AND (sa.total_amount > '0' OR sa.total_amount IS NULL) ORDER BY ca.age DESC, total_sales_amount DESC LIMIT 636;

sa.refid LEFT JOIN demog d ON ca.geoid = d.geoid WHERE d.income_k > 61.58 AND (d.a_var3 < '-100' OR d.a_var4 > '-100') AND NOT (d.inhabitants_k < '0' AND d.a_var5 BETWEEN '-100' AND '-100') ) SELECT c_id, age, educationnum, sex, marital_status, m12_count, m3_count, m12_yes, m3_yes, avg_a_var1, avg_a_var2, sales_days, total_amount, avg_amount, max_amount, min_amount, inhabitants_k, income_k, avg_a_var16, SUM(d.a_var17) AS sum_a_var17, AVG(d.a_var18) AS avg_a_var18 FROM demog d WHERE d.income_k >= 252.67 AND d.inhabitants_k <= '0' GROUP BY d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k ), windowed_customers AS ( SELECT ca.*, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, d.avg_a_var1, d.sum_a_var2, d.sum_a_var3, d.avg_a_var4, d.sum_a_var5, d.avg_a_var6, d.sum_a_var7, d.avg_a_var8, d.sum_a_var9, SELECT c1.id AS customer1_id, c2.id AS customer2_id, d1.geoid AS demog1_geoid, d2.geoid AS demog2_geoid, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings1_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailings3_count, SUM(s1.amount) AS total_sales_amount_customer1, SUM(s2.amount) AS total_sales_amount_customer2, AVG(d1.a_var1 * d2.a_var2) AS avg_interaction_var, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (SUM(s1.amount) + SUM(s2.amount)) DESC) AS combined_sales_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(d1.income_k) DESC) AS income_percentile_rank FROM customers c1 JOIN customers c2 ON c1.geoid = c2.geoid AND c1.id < c2.id JOIN demog d1 ON c1.geoid = d1.geoid JOIN demog d2 ON c2.geoid = d2.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c1.id = m1.refid AND m1.response = 'YES' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c2.id = m3.refid AND m3.response = 'YES' LEFT JOIN sales s1 ON c1.id = s1.refid AND s1.event_date >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN sales s2 ON c2.id = s2.refid AND s2.event_date >= '2020-01-01' WHERE c1.age BETWEEN 26 AND 48 AND c2.age BETWEEN 61 AND 65 AND d1.inhabitants_k > '0.0' AND d2.inhabitants_k > '0.0' AND (d1.a_var3 + d2.a_var4) > '0.0' GROUP BY c1.id, c2.id, d1.geoid, d2.geoid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) > 6 AND COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) > 96 AND SUM(s1.amount) + SUM(s2.amount) > '0.0' ORDER BY combined_sales_rank, income_percentile_rank DESC;

mailing_response_rate, NULL AS avg_sale_per_event, NULL AS sales_rank, NULL AS sales_rank_by_sex FROM customer_agg ca JOIN demog d ON ca.geoid = d.geoid WHERE ca.customer_id NOT IN (SELECT customer_id FROM sales_agg) AND ca.customer_id NOT IN (SELECT customer_id FROM mailings3_agg) AND ca.mailings_response_count > 38 AND d.income_k < 83.43 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC NULLS LAST, customer_id;

WITH customer_agg AS ( SELECT c.id, c.age, c.geoid, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_amount FROM customers c LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.geoid, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation ), demog_stats AS ( SELECT d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_var2 FROM demog d GROUP BY d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k ), mailing_response AS ( SELECT m.refid, COUNT(*) AS mailing_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m.response = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses FROM mailings1_2 m WHERE m.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' GROUP BY m.refid ) SELECT ca.id, ca.age, ca.sex, ca.marital_status, ca.occupation, ca.sales_count, ca.total_amount, ca.avg_amount, ds.inhabitants_k, ds.income_k, ds.avg_var1, ds.avg_var2, mr.mailing_count, mr.positive_responses, (SELECT AVG(s2.amount) FROM sales s2 WHERE s2.refid = ca.id AND s2.event_date >= '2023-01-01') AS recent_avg_amount FROM customer_agg ca LEFT JOIN demog_stats ds ON ca.geoid = ds.geoid LEFT JOIN mailing_response mr ON ca.id = mr.refid WHERE ca.total_amount > '1000' AND ca.sales_count >= 76 AND (ds.income_k IS NULL OR ds.income_k > 172.6) ORDER BY ca.total_amount DESC, ca.sales_count DESC LIMIT 281;

WITH customer_aggregates AS ( SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, MAX(m3.ref_date) AS last_mailing_date FROM customers c LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE c.age BETWEEN 61 AND 39 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '1000' ), demographic_analysis AS ( SELECT d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_var2, SUM(d.a_var3) AS sum_var3, CORR(d.a_var4, d.a_var5) AS corr_var4_var5 FROM demog d WHERE d.income_k >= 55.32 AND d.inhabitants_k <= '1' GROUP BY d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING AVG(d.a_var1) > '0' ), joined_analysis AS ( SELECT ca.customer_id, ca.age, ca.educationnum, ca.mailings_count, ca.positive_responses, ca.avg_sale_amount, ca.total_sales, ca.last_mailing_date, da.inhabitants_k, da.income_k, da.avg_var1, da.avg_var2, da.sum_var3, da.corr_var4_var5, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY da.geoid ORDER BY ca.total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank_in_geoid, LAG(ca.total_sales, 1) OVER (ORDER BY ca.customer_id) AS prev_customer_sales, LEAD(ca.avg_sale_amount, 1) OVER (ORDER BY ca.customer_id) AS next_customer_avg_sale FROM customer_aggregates ca INNER JOIN demographic_analysis da ON ca.geoid = da.geoid WHERE ca.total_sales > da.income_k * 1.75 ) SELECT ja.customer_id, ja.age, ja.educationnum, ja.mailings_count, ja.positive_responses, ja.avg_sale_amount, ja.total_sales, ja.last_mailing_date, ja.inhabitants_k, ja.income_k, ja.avg_var1, ja.avg_var2, ja.sum_var3, ja.corr_var4_var5, ja.sales_rank_in_geoid, ja.prev_customer_sales, ja.next_customer_avg_sale, (ja.total_sales - ja.prev_customer_sales) / NULLIF(ja.prev_customer_sales, 0) AS sales_growth_rate, CASE WHEN ja.sales_rank_in_geoid = 1 THEN 'TOP' WHEN ja.sales_rank_in_geoid <= 5 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'OTHER' END AS sales_performance_category FROM joined_analysis ja WHERE ja.sales_rank_in_geoid <= 20 AND ja.avg_sale_amount > '50' ORDER BY ja.total_sales DESC, ja.sales_rank_in_geoid ASC LIMIT 7777;

WITH customer_aggregates AS ( SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS total_sales_events, SUM(s.amount) AS total_spent, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT m12.ref_date) AS mailings1_2_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.ref_date) AS mailings3_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m12.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS m12_yes_responses, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS m3_yes_responses FROM customers c LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m12 ON c.id = m12.refid LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE c.age BETWEEN 100 AND 70 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND (m12.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' OR m12.ref_date IS NULL) AND (m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' OR m3.ref_date IS NULL) GROUP BY c.id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '1000' ), demographic_analysis AS ( SELECT ca.customer_id, ca.total_spent, ca.avg_sale_amount, ca.mailings1_2_count, ca.mailings3_count, ca.m12_yes_responses, ca.m3_yes_responses, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, d.a_var1, d.a_var2, d.a_var3, d.a_var4, d.a_var5, d.a_var6, d.a_var7, d.a_var8, d.a_var9, d.a_var10, d.a_var11, d.a_var12, d.a_var13, d.a_var14, d.a_var15, d.a_var16, d.a_var17, d.a_var18, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ca.geoid ORDER BY ca.total_spent DESC) AS spending_rank_in_geo, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ca.total_spent) AS spending_percentile_global FROM customer_aggregates ca INNER JOIN demog d ON ca.geoid = d.geoid WHERE d.income_k > 312.01 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sales s2 WHERE s2.refid = ca.customer_id AND s2.amount > ca.avg_sale_amount * '1.5' AND s2.event_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' ) ) SELECT da.customer_id, da.total_spent, da.avg_sale_amount, da.inhabitants_k, da.income_k, da.spending_rank_in_geo, da.spending_percentile_global, SUM(da.total_spent) OVER (PARTITION BY da.spending_rank_in_geo) AS total_spent_by_rank, AVG(da.income_k) OVER (ORDER BY da.total_spent ROWS BETWEEN 10 PRECEDING AND 10 FOLLOWING) AS smoothed_income_around_spending, CORR(da.total_spent, da.income_k) OVER (PARTITION BY da.spending_rank_in_geo) AS spending_income_correlation_by_rank FROM demographic_analysis da WHERE da.m12_yes_responses > 16 OR da.m3_yes_responses > 17 ORDER BY da.total_spent DESC, da.spending_rank_in_geo LIMIT 956;

WITH filtered_sales AS ( SELECT s.refid, s.amount, s.event_date FROM sales s WHERE s.amount > '10' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' ) SELECT c.id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT fs.refid) AS sales_count, SUM(fs.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(fs.amount) AS avg_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT m12.refid) AS mailings_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailings3_count FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN filtered_sales fs ON c.id = fs.refid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m12 ON c.id = m12.refid AND m12.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 42 AND 50 AND d.income_k > 141.89 GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(fs.amount) > '100' ORDER BY total_amount DESC;

WITH ranked_customers AS ( SELECT c.id, c.age, c.geoid, c.educationnum, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC NULLS LAST) AS sales_rank FROM customers c LEFT JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE c.age BETWEEN 64 AND 41 AND d.income_k >= 86.28 GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.geoid, c.educationnum, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k ) SELECT rc.id, rc.age, rc.geoid, rc.educationnum, rc.inhabitants_k, rc.income_k, rc.mailings_count, rc.total_sales_amount, rc.sales_rank FROM ranked_customers rc WHERE rc.sales_rank <= 654 AND rc.mailings_count > 31 ORDER BY rc.sales_rank, rc.total_sales_amount DESC;

WITH ranked_sales AS ( SELECT s.refid, s.event_date, s.amount, c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, d.a_var1, d.a_var2, d.a_var3, m1.ref_date AS mailing1_date, m1.response AS mailing1_response, m3.ref_date AS mailing3_date, m3.response AS mailing3_response, SUM(s.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY c.id ORDER BY s.event_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_total, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM s.event_date) ORDER BY s.amount DESC) AS monthly_sale_rank FROM sales s JOIN customers c ON s.refid = c.id JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON s.refid = m1.refid AND s.event_date >= m1.ref_date LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON s.refid = m3.refid AND s.event_date >= m3.ref_date WHERE s.amount > '10' AND s.event_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2024-01-01' AND c.age BETWEEN 28 AND 64 AND d.income_k > 259.06 ), aggregated AS ( SELECT customer_id, age, educationnum, sex, marital_status, geoid, inhabitants_k, income_k, a_var1, a_var2, a_var3, COUNT(DISTINCT mailing1_date) AS mailings1_count, COUNT(DISTINCT mailing3_date) AS mailings3_count, SUM(amount) AS total_sales, AVG(amount) AS avg_sale_amount, MAX(running_total) AS max_running_total, COUNT(CASE WHEN monthly_sale_rank = 1 THEN 1 END) AS top_monthly_sales_count FROM ranked_sales GROUP BY customer_id, age, educationnum, sex, marital_status, geoid, inhabitants_k, income_k, a_var1, a_var2, a_var3 HAVING SUM(amount) > '1000' AND AVG(amount) < '100' ) SELECT geoid, sex, marital_status, COUNT(customer_id) AS customer_count, AVG(total_sales) AS avg_total_sales_per_customer, SUM(total_sales) AS region_total_sales, AVG(income_k) AS avg_income, AVG(inhabitants_k) AS avg_inhabitants, CORR(total_sales, income_k) AS sales_income_correlation, CORR(total_sales, a_var1) AS sales_var1_correlation FROM aggregated GROUP BY geoid, sex, marital_status ORDER BY region_total_sales DESC, avg_total_sales_per_customer DESC LIMIT 262;

SELECT c.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date) AS sale_year, COUNT(DISTINCT s.refid) AS unique_customers, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, SUM(d.income_k) AS total_income_in_area FROM customers c JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid WHERE s.amount > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND c.age BETWEEN 86 AND 28 GROUP BY CUBE(c.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date)) HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '1000' ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_demog_var FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE c.age BETWEEN 30 AND 73 AND d.income_k > 413.68 AND (m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' OR m1.ref_date IS NULL) GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.income_k HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) > 19 AND SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_amount DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.income_k, d.inhabitants_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m12.refid) AS mailings_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailings3_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN m12.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses3 FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m12 ON c.id = m12.refid LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE c.age BETWEEN 82 AND 45 AND d.income_k >= 196.96 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.income_k, d.inhabitants_k HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) > 13 AND SUM(s.amount) >= '0' AND AVG(d.a_var1) > '0' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, customer_id;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.income_k, d.inhabitants_k, m1.ref_date AS mailing_date, m1.response AS mailing_response, COUNT(s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(SUM(s.amount)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.id ORDER BY m1.ref_date ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_amount FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date BETWEEN m1.ref_date - INTERVAL '30 days' AND m1.ref_date + INTERVAL '30 days' WHERE c.age >= 68 AND c.educationnum >= 10 AND d.income_k >= 13.96 AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.income_k, d.inhabitants_k, m1.ref_date, m1.response HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY m1.ref_date DESC, total_amount DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT m12.kxindex) AS distinct_mailings_count, COUNT(m3.refid) AS mailings3_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.marital_status ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_marital FROM customers c INNER JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m12 ON c.id = m12.refid AND m12.response = 'YES' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.response = 'YES' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 68 AND 89 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND c.id IN ( SELECT s2.refid FROM sales s2 WHERE s2.amount > '100.0' GROUP BY s2.refid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s2.eventid) >= 3 ) GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, c.marital_status HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '5000.0' AND AVG(d.a_var1) < '0.0' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, avg_a_var1 ASC LIMIT 704;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) OVER(PARTITION BY d.geoid) AS avg_a_var1_by_geoid, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS unique_sales_events, COUNT(DISTINCT m12.refid) AS mailings1_2_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailings3_count FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m12 ON c.id = m12.refid LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE ( c.age > 84 OR c.educationnum < 7 OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sales s2 WHERE s2.refid = c.id AND s2.amount > '0' AND s2.event_date >= '2020-01-01' ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM mailings1_2 m12_2 WHERE m12_2.refid = c.id AND m12_2.response = 'Yes' AND m12_2.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' ) ) AND d.income_k BETWEEN 355.85 AND 136.38 GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' OR COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) < 612 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, c.id;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m12.refid) AS mailings_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2 FROM customers c INNER JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m12 ON c.id = m12.refid AND m12.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 41 AND 53 AND d.income_k > 50.02 GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) > 8 AND SUM(s.amount) < '1000' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m12.refid) AS mailings_count_12, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailings_count_3, SUM(CASE WHEN m12.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS responses_12, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS responses_3, COUNT(s.eventid) AS sales_count, COALESCE(SUM(s.amount), 0) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2 FROM customers c INNER JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m12 ON c.id = m12.refid AND m12.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date BETWEEN '2021-01-01' AND '2021-01-01' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 92 AND 82 AND d.income_k > 241.87 AND c.educationnum >= 2 GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING COUNT(s.eventid) > 28 AND COALESCE(SUM(s.amount), 0) < '1000' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, mailings_count_12 DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m.refid) AS mailing_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m ON c.id = m.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE c.age >= 82 AND c.age <= 91 AND d.income_k > 425.21 AND (m.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' OR m.ref_date IS NULL) AND (s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' OR s.event_date IS NULL) GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.income_k HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m.refid) > 85 AND SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_sales DESC, avg_sale_amount DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings_yes_count, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sale_amount, COUNT(s.eventid) AS sales_count FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND '2020-01-01 00:00:00' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 75 AND 54 AND d.income_k >= 560.67 GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.income_k HAVING COUNT(s.eventid) > 620 ORDER BY total_sale_amount DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS unique_sales_events, COUNT(m1.response) FILTER (WHERE m1.response = 'YES') AS mailings1_yes_responses, COUNT(m3.response) FILTER (WHERE m3.response = 'YES') AS mailings3_yes_responses, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_sex, LAG(SUM(s.amount), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.id ORDER BY MIN(s.event_date)) AS prev_sales_amount FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE s.amount > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.event_date <= '2020-01-01' AND d.income_k BETWEEN 70.46 AND 468.22 AND c.age >= 76 GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 72 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, c.id;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings_yes_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sales_amount FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE c.age >= 53 AND c.age <= 84 AND d.income_k >= 317.64 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) > 39 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sale_amount, MAX(s.event_date) AS last_sale_date FROM customers c INNER JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE c.age >= 27 AND c.age <= 70 AND d.income_k > 175.07 AND (s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' OR s.event_date IS NULL) GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) > 25 AND SUM(s.amount) > '100' ORDER BY total_sale_amount DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS total_mailings, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses_m1, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses_m3, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS unique_sales_events, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' WHERE c.age >= 31 AND c.age <= 29 AND d.income_k >= 489.33 GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS total_sales, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS total_mailings, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid WHERE s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND c.age BETWEEN 54 AND 54 GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '1000' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 35 ORDER BY total_amount DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.income_k, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date) AS sale_year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM s.event_date) AS sale_month, m1.response AS mailing1_response, m3.response AS mailing3_response, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS total_sales, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.ref_date) AS mailing1_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.ref_date) AS mailing3_count, SUM(d.a_var1 + d.a_var2 + d.a_var3 + d.a_var4 + d.a_var5 + d.a_var6 + d.a_var7 + d.a_var8 + d.a_var9 + d.a_var10 + d.a_var11 + d.a_var12 + d.a_var13 + d.a_var14 + d.a_var15 + d.a_var16 + d.a_var17 + d.a_var18) AS demographic_sum, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS spending_rank FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND s.event_date >= m1.ref_date JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND s.event_date >= m3.ref_date WHERE s.amount > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.event_date <= '2020-01-01' AND c.age BETWEEN 85 AND 21 AND d.income_k > '0' AND d.inhabitants_k < '0' AND (m1.response = 'Yes' OR m3.response = 'Yes') GROUP BY CUBE ( c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.income_k, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM s.event_date), m1.response, m3.response ) HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 97 ORDER BY total_amount DESC, sale_year, sale_month;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, SUM(d.a_var2) AS sum_a_var2, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS distinct_mailings1_2_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS distinct_mailings3_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(s.eventid) AS sales_event_count, AVG(SUM(s.amount)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY d.income_k ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_avg_sales_by_demo, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank FROM customers c INNER JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.response = 'YES' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.response = 'YES' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE c.age >= 98 AND c.educationnum >= 16 AND d.income_k >= 810.05 AND (s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' OR s.event_date IS NULL) AND (m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' OR m1.ref_date IS NULL) GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(s.eventid) >= 205 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, sales_rank ASC;
