SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS unique_sales_events, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings1_2_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailings3_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings1_2_yes_responses, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings3_yes_responses, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_demographic FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - 1 AND s.amount > '0' LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' AND m1.kxindex BETWEEN 60 AND 37 LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 29 AND 30 AND c.educationnum > 8 AND d.income_k BETWEEN 17.14 AND 115.81 AND (d.a_var2 > '0' OR d.a_var3 < '0') AND (s.event_date IS NULL OR s.event_date >= DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '10 months') GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 32 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, avg_a_var1 ASC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS unique_sales_events, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings1_2_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailings3_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings1_2_yes_responses, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings3_yes_responses, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_demographic, AVG(SUM(s.amount)) OVER (PARTITION BY d.geoid) AS avg_sales_per_geoid FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE (c.age BETWEEN 74 AND 48 OR c.educationnum > 9) AND (s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.event_date < '2020-01-01') AND (m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' OR m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01') AND NOT (c.nom1 = 'Unknown' AND c.occupation IS NULL) AND d.income_k > 668.07 AND (d.a_var2 > '0' OR d.a_var3 < '0') AND s.amount > '0' GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 80 AND (AVG(d.a_var1) < '0' OR AVG(d.a_var1) > '0') ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, avg_a_var1 ASC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS unique_sales_events, COUNT(m1.response) FILTER (WHERE m1.response = 'YES') AS mailings1_2_yes_count, COUNT(m3.response) FILTER (WHERE m3.response = 'YES') AS mailings3_yes_count, SUM(s2.amount) AS total_secondary_sales_amount, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_demographic FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid JOIN sales s2 ON s.eventid = s2.eventid AND s.refid <> s2.refid WHERE c.age >= 69 AND c.educationnum >= 19 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.amount > '0.0' AND d.income_k BETWEEN 443.9 AND 89.47 AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0.0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 7 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, sales_rank_by_demographic;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date) AS sale_year, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM s.event_date) AS sale_quarter, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS total_sales, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings1_2_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailings3_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings1_2_yes, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings3_yes, SUM(d.a_var1 + d.a_var2 + d.a_var3 + d.a_var4 + d.a_var5 + d.a_var6 + d.a_var7 + d.a_var8 + d.a_var9 + d.a_var10 + d.a_var11 + d.a_var12 + d.a_var13 + d.a_var14 + d.a_var15 + d.a_var16 + d.a_var17 + d.a_var18) AS sum_demog_vars, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM s.event_date) ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS quarter_amount_rank, LAG(SUM(s.amount), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.id ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM s.event_date)) AS prev_quarter_amount FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND s.event_date >= m1.ref_date AND m1.ref_date >= s.event_date - INTERVAL '30 days' JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND s.event_date >= m3.ref_date AND m3.ref_date >= s.event_date - INTERVAL '30 days' WHERE s.amount > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.event_date <= '2020-01-01' AND c.age BETWEEN 78 AND 25 AND d.income_k > 374.1 AND (EXTRACT(DOW FROM s.event_date) IN (1, 2, 3, 4, 5) OR EXTRACT(DOW FROM s.event_date) = 0) GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM s.event_date) HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 84 ORDER BY sale_year DESC, sale_quarter DESC, total_amount DESC;

SELECT c.id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.income_k, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.ref_date) AS mailing_count FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid WHERE c.id IN ( SELECT refid FROM mailings3 WHERE ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND ref_date <= '2020-01-01' ) GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '1000' ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings_yes, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sale_amount FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE ( c.age > 97 OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM mailings3 m3 WHERE m3.refid = c.id AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' ) ) AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_sale_amount DESC;

SELECT c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS unique_sales_events, (SELECT AVG(m3.response::integer) FROM mailings3 m3 WHERE m3.refid = c.id AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01') AS avg_mailing3_response_rate FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.amount > '0' GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '100' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

SELECT c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS unique_sales_events, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mailings1_2 m WHERE m.refid = c.id AND m.response = 'YES' AND m.ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00') AS recent_positive_mailings FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE s.event_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND s.amount > '0' GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '100' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

SELECT c1.id AS cust_id1, c2.id AS cust_id2, d1.geoid AS geo1, d2.geoid AS geo2, AVG(d1.a_var1) AS avg_var1_geo1, AVG(d2.a_var2) AS avg_var2_geo2, SUM(s1.amount) AS total_sales_cust1, SUM(s2.amount) AS total_sales_cust2, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count_cust1, COUNT(DISTINCT m2.refid) AS mailings_count_cust2, CORR(d1.a_var3, d2.a_var4) OVER (PARTITION BY c1.educationnum, c2.educationnum) AS correlation_var3_var4_by_edu, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (SUM(s1.amount) + SUM(s2.amount)) DESC) AS combined_sales_rank FROM customers c1 JOIN customers c2 ON c1.age = c2.age AND c1.id < c2.id JOIN demog d1 ON c1.geoid = d1.geoid JOIN demog d2 ON c2.geoid = d2.geoid LEFT JOIN sales s1 ON c1.id = s1.refid AND s1.event_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN sales s2 ON c2.id = s2.refid AND s2.event_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c1.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m2 ON c2.id = m2.refid AND m2.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND '2020-01-01 00:00:00' WHERE c1.educationnum > 19 AND c2.educationnum > 17 AND d1.income_k BETWEEN 277.43 AND 939.14 AND d2.income_k BETWEEN 272.3 AND 584.66 GROUP BY c1.id, c2.id, d1.geoid, d2.geoid, c1.educationnum, c2.educationnum HAVING SUM(s1.amount) > '0' AND SUM(s2.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) >= 885 AND COUNT(DISTINCT m2.refid) >= 74 ORDER BY combined_sales_rank;

SELECT c1.id AS customer_id1, c2.id AS customer_id2, AVG(d1.a_var1) AS avg_demog_var1, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailing_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount FROM customers c1 JOIN customers c2 ON c1.geoid = c2.geoid AND c1.id < c2.id JOIN demog d1 ON c1.geoid = d1.geoid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c1.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c1.id = s.refid WHERE c1.age > 56 AND d1.income_k BETWEEN 155.11 AND 219.84 AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c1.id, c2.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) > 7 AND SUM(s.amount) < '1000' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT d.geoid, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2, SUM(d.a_var3) AS sum_a_var3, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS unique_customers, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses_m1, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses_m3, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(d.income_k)) AS income_percentile FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE d.inhabitants_k > '0' AND c.age BETWEEN 18 AND 63 AND s.event_date >= '2000-01-01' AND m1.ref_date >= '2000-01-01' AND m3.ref_date >= '2000-01-01' AND d.a_var4 > '0' GROUP BY d.geoid HAVING AVG(d.income_k) > 937.88 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 2154 AND SUM(s.amount) > '0' INTERSECT SELECT d.geoid, AVG(d.a_var5) AS avg_a_var5, AVG(d.a_var6) AS avg_a_var6, SUM(d.a_var7) AS sum_a_var7, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS unique_customers, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'NO' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS negative_responses_m1, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'NO' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS negative_responses_m3, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(d.income_k)) AS income_percentile FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE d.inhabitants_k < '0' AND c.age BETWEEN 28 AND 67 AND s.event_date <= '2000-01-01' AND m1.ref_date <= '2000-01-01' AND m3.ref_date <= '2000-01-01' AND d.a_var8 < '0' GROUP BY d.geoid HAVING AVG(d.income_k) < 143.25 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) < 6853 AND SUM(s.amount) < '0' ORDER BY geoid;

SELECT d.geoid, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS customer_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE d.inhabitants_k > '0' AND c.age BETWEEN 49 AND 73 AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY d.geoid HAVING AVG(d.income_k) > 280.72 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) >= 861 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC NULLS LAST;

SELECT d.geoid, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS customer_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE s.event_date >= ( SELECT MIN(ref_date) FROM mailings1_2 m12 WHERE m12.response = 'Y' AND m12.ref_date <= ( SELECT MAX(ref_date) FROM mailings3 m3 WHERE m3.response = 'Y' ) ) AND s.amount > '0' AND d.inhabitants_k > '0' GROUP BY d.geoid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 26 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS customer_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE s.event_date >= (SELECT MIN(ref_date) FROM mailings3 WHERE response = (SELECT response FROM mailings1_2 WHERE refid = 65658 LIMIT 1)) AND d.inhabitants_k > '0.0' GROUP BY d.geoid HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0.0' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(c.age) AS total_age_sum, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS customer_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m ON s.refid = m.refid WHERE d.inhabitants_k > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m.response = 'Yes' GROUP BY d.geoid HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '1000' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(c.educationnum) AS total_education FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid WHERE c.id IN (SELECT s.refid FROM sales s WHERE s.amount > '0') GROUP BY d.geoid HAVING AVG(d.income_k) > 15.29 ORDER BY total_education DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT c.nom1, ', ' ORDER BY c.nom1) AS aggregated_nom1, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailing_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses, AVG(c.data1) OVER (PARTITION BY d.geoid) AS avg_data1_by_geoid, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE d.income_k > 540.65 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.amount BETWEEN '0' AND '10000' AND c.age >= 74 GROUP BY d.geoid, c.data1 HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '1000' ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS unique_customers, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS unique_sales_events, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m ON c.id = m.refid WHERE d.income_k > 491.2 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY d.geoid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 332 AND SUM(s.amount) < '1000' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date) AS sale_year, COUNT(DISTINCT s.refid) AS unique_customers, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, SUM(SUM(s.amount)) OVER (PARTITION BY d.geoid, c.sex ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date)) AS cumulative_sales_by_demo FROM sales s JOIN customers c ON s.refid = c.id JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON s.refid = m1.refid AND s.event_date >= m1.ref_date LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON s.refid = m3.refid AND s.event_date >= m3.ref_date WHERE s.amount > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND d.income_k BETWEEN 22.18 AND 413.97 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, sale_year), (d.geoid, c.sex, sale_year), (d.geoid, sale_year), (sale_year), () ) HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY d.geoid, c.sex, sale_year;

SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, MAX(m3.ref_date) AS latest_mailing_date, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_sex, LAG(SUM(s.amount), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY d.geoid ORDER BY MAX(s.event_date)) AS prev_geoid_sales FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE d.income_k > 427.67 AND d.inhabitants_k BETWEEN '0' AND '10' AND s.amount >= '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m1.ref_date <= '2019-01-01' AND (c.age > 36 OR c.educationnum < 20) AND (d.a_var1 + d.a_var2 + d.a_var3) / 3.0 > '-100' GROUP BY d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) > 32 AND AVG(d.income_k) < 644.92 ORDER BY total_sales DESC, avg_income ASC;

SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_sex, LAG(SUM(s.amount), 1) OVER (ORDER BY d.geoid, c.sex) AS prev_total_sales FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE d.income_k > 161.42 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.event_date <= '2020-01-01' AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND c.age BETWEEN 87 AND 56 GROUP BY d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) >= 74 AND AVG(d.income_k) < 285.21 ORDER BY total_sales DESC, avg_income ASC;

SELECT c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings_yes, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sale_amount FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE (c.age > 76 AND c.educationnum < 13) OR (c.marital_status = 'Married-civ-spouse' AND c.occupation != 'Adm-clerical') AND NOT (d.income_k IS NULL OR d.inhabitants_k < 249.64) AND (m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' OR m1.ref_date IS NULL) GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) >= 62 AND SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_sale_amount DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS customer_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses, (SELECT AVG(s.amount) FROM sales s WHERE s.refid IN (SELECT m3.refid FROM mailings3 m3 WHERE m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01')) AS avg_sales_amount_recent FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid WHERE d.inhabitants_k > '1' GROUP BY d.geoid HAVING AVG(d.income_k) > 22.62 ORDER BY avg_income DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS customer_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE s.event_date >= ( SELECT MIN(ref_date) FROM mailings1_2 m12 WHERE m12.response = 'Y' AND m12.ref_date <= ( SELECT MAX(ref_date) FROM mailings3 m3 WHERE m3.response = 'Y' ) ) AND s.amount > '0' AND d.inhabitants_k > '0' GROUP BY d.geoid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 56 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS customer_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, (SELECT AVG(sub.avg_amount) FROM (SELECT m.refid, AVG(s2.amount) AS avg_amount FROM mailings1_2 m JOIN sales s2 ON m.refid = s2.refid WHERE m.response = 'Yes' GROUP BY m.refid) sub WHERE sub.avg_amount > '0') AS avg_high_response_sale FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE d.inhabitants_k > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY d.geoid HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_events, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, (SELECT AVG(sub_avg) FROM (SELECT AVG(c.data1) AS sub_avg FROM customers c WHERE c.geoid = d.geoid AND c.age > 51 GROUP BY c.nom1) AS inner_sub) AS avg_data1_by_nom1 FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid JOIN sales s ON m1.refid = s.refid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON s.refid = m3.refid WHERE d.inhabitants_k >= '1' AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY d.geoid HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '1000' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 64 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS unique_customers, MAX(m1.ref_date) AS latest_mailing_date, SUM(d.a_var1 + d.a_var2 + d.a_var3 + d.a_var4 + d.a_var5 + d.a_var6 + d.a_var7 + d.a_var8 + d.a_var9 + d.a_var10 + d.a_var11 + d.a_var12 + d.a_var13 + d.a_var14 + d.a_var15 + d.a_var16 + d.a_var17 + d.a_var18) AS total_a_vars, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON s.refid = m1.refid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON s.refid = m3.refid WHERE d.inhabitants_k > '0' AND c.age BETWEEN 56 AND 51 AND s.event_date >= '2000-01-01' AND m1.ref_date <= '2000-01-01' AND m3.ref_date <= '2000-01-01' AND s.amount > '0' GROUP BY d.geoid HAVING AVG(d.income_k) > 416.15 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 792 INTERSECT SELECT d.geoid, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS unique_customers, MAX(m1.ref_date) AS latest_mailing_date, SUM(d.a_var1 + d.a_var2 + d.a_var3 + d.a_var4 + d.a_var5 + d.a_var6 + d.a_var7 + d.a_var8 + d.a_var9 + d.a_var10 + d.a_var11 + d.a_var12 + d.a_var13 + d.a_var14 + d.a_var15 + d.a_var16 + d.a_var17 + d.a_var18) AS total_a_vars, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON s.refid = m1.refid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON s.refid = m3.refid WHERE d.inhabitants_k > '0' AND c.age BETWEEN 82 AND 53 AND s.event_date >= '2000-01-01' AND m1.ref_date <= '2000-01-01' AND m3.ref_date <= '2000-01-01' AND s.amount > '0' GROUP BY d.geoid HAVING AVG(d.income_k) > 182.75 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 503 ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date) AS fiscal_year, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM s.event_date) AS fiscal_quarter, COUNT(DISTINCT s.refid) AS unique_customers, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(d.inhabitants_k) AS total_inhabitants, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date) ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank FROM sales s JOIN customers c ON s.refid = c.id JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid WHERE s.amount > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.event_date < '2020-01-01' AND d.income_k BETWEEN 13.38 AND 7.21 GROUP BY d.geoid, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM s.event_date) HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY fiscal_year, fiscal_quarter, sales_rank;

SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date) AS sale_year, COUNT(DISTINCT s.refid) AS unique_customers, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE m1.response = 'YES') AS mailings1_yes_responses, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE m3.response = 'YES') AS mailings3_yes_responses FROM sales s JOIN customers c ON s.refid = c.id JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON s.refid = m1.refid AND DATE_TRUNC('month', s.event_date) = DATE_TRUNC('month', m1.ref_date) LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON s.refid = m3.refid AND DATE_TRUNC('month', s.event_date) = DATE_TRUNC('month', m3.ref_date) WHERE s.amount > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND d.income_k BETWEEN 119.04 AND 198.44 GROUP BY CUBE(d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date)) HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses, AVG(d.a_var1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY d.geoid) AS rolling_var1_avg, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE d.income_k > 246.11 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.event_date <= '2020-01-01' AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND c.age BETWEEN 88 AND 26 AND d.inhabitants_k > '0' GROUP BY d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) >= 46 ORDER BY total_sales DESC, avg_income DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS total_sales_events, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS total_mailings1_2, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS total_mailings3, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, AVG(d.inhabitants_k) AS avg_inhabitants, SUM(d.a_var1 + d.a_var2 + d.a_var3 + d.a_var4 + d.a_var5 + d.a_var6 + d.a_var7 + d.a_var8 + d.a_var9 + d.a_var10 + d.a_var11 + d.a_var12 + d.a_var13 + d.a_var14 + d.a_var15 + d.a_var16 + d.a_var17 + d.a_var18) AS sum_all_a_vars, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank, LAG(SUM(s.amount), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY d.geoid) AS prev_sales_amount_by_demo FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND '2020-01-01 00:00:00' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 84 AND 98 AND c.educationnum >= 9 AND d.income_k > 55.08 AND d.inhabitants_k < '0' GROUP BY d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) > 175 AND SUM(s.amount) >= '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) + COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) > 6378 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, d.geoid, c.sex;

SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM m1.ref_date) AS mailing_year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM m1.ref_date) AS mailing_month, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS unique_mailings, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS unique_sales, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(d.inhabitants_k) AS total_inhabitants, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2, AVG(d.a_var3) AS avg_a_var3, AVG(d.a_var4) AS avg_a_var4, AVG(d.a_var5) AS avg_a_var5, AVG(d.a_var6) AS avg_a_var6, AVG(d.a_var7) AS avg_a_var7, AVG(d.a_var8) AS avg_a_var8, AVG(d.a_var9) AS avg_a_var9, AVG(d.a_var10) AS avg_a_var10, AVG(d.a_var11) AS avg_a_var11, AVG(d.a_var12) AS avg_a_var12, AVG(d.a_var13) AS avg_a_var13, AVG(d.a_var14) AS avg_a_var14, AVG(d.a_var15) AS avg_a_var15, AVG(d.a_var16) AS avg_a_var16, AVG(d.a_var17) AS avg_a_var17, AVG(d.a_var18) AS avg_a_var18, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM m1.ref_date), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM m1.ref_date) ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_mailing_months FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON m1.refid = s.refid AND m1.ref_date <= s.event_date AND s.event_date < m1.ref_date + INTERVAL '30 days' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date BETWEEN m1.ref_date - INTERVAL '7 days' AND m1.ref_date + INTERVAL '7 days' WHERE d.income_k > 136.58 AND c.age BETWEEN 100 AND 93 AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND (c.educationnum > 8 OR c.nom1 = 'A') AND (s.amount > '0' OR s.amount IS NULL) GROUP BY CUBE(d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM m1.ref_date), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM m1.ref_date)) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) > 741 AND SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY mailing_year, mailing_month, total_sales_amount DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(c.age) AS avg_age, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailing_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mailings3 m3 WHERE m3.response = 'YES' AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND m3.ref_date <= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND m3.refid IN (SELECT s2.refid FROM sales s2 WHERE s2.event_date >= '2019-01-01 00:00:00' AND s2.amount > '0')) AS recent_positive_mailings, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(d.income_k) ASC) AS income_percentile FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON s.refid = m1.refid AND s.event_date BETWEEN m1.ref_date AND m1.ref_date + INTERVAL '30 days' WHERE d.inhabitants_k > '0' AND d.income_k BETWEEN 124.41 AND 278.91 AND c.age >= 96 AND s.event_date >= '2018-01-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT m1.kxindex) >= 54 ORDER BY total_sales DESC, avg_age ASC;

SELECT d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(c.age) AS avg_age, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS unique_mailings, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank, AVG(d.a_var1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.educationnum) AS avg_a_var1_by_edu FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.amount > '0' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM mailings1_2 m2 WHERE m2.refid = c.id AND m2.response = 'Yes' AND m2.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' LIMIT 1 OFFSET 856 ) GROUP BY d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, c.educationnum HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 49 ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(c.age) AS avg_age, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS unique_sales_events, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings1_2_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailings3_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses_m1, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses_m3, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY c.educationnum) AS median_education, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_geoid FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE d.income_k > 72.6 AND s.event_date >= '2000-01-01' AND s.event_date <= '2000-01-01' AND m1.ref_date >= '2000-01-01' AND m3.ref_date >= '2000-01-01' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM mailings1_2 m1_sub WHERE m1_sub.refid = c.id AND m1_sub.response = 'YES' AND m1_sub.ref_date >= '2000-01-01' ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM mailings3 m3_sub WHERE m3_sub.refid = c.id AND m3_sub.response = 'YES' AND m3_sub.ref_date >= '2000-01-01' ) GROUP BY d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 566 AND AVG(c.age) BETWEEN 19 AND 70 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, d.geoid ASC;

SELECT d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2, AVG(d.a_var3) AS avg_a_var3, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.refid) AS unique_sales_customers, COUNT(DISTINCT m12.refid) AS unique_mailings12_customers, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS unique_mailings3_customers, SUM(CASE WHEN c.sex = 'Male' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_count, SUM(CASE WHEN c.sex = 'Female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS female_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank, LAG(SUM(s.amount), 1) OVER (ORDER BY d.geoid) AS prev_geoid_sales FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m12 ON c.id = m12.refid AND m12.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' WHERE d.income_k > 568.98 AND d.inhabitants_k BETWEEN '0' AND '0' GROUP BY d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.refid) >= 442 UNION SELECT d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var4) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var5) AS avg_a_var2, AVG(d.a_var6) AS avg_a_var3, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.refid) AS unique_sales_customers, COUNT(DISTINCT m12.refid) AS unique_mailings12_customers, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS unique_mailings3_customers, SUM(CASE WHEN c.sex = 'Male' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_count, SUM(CASE WHEN c.sex = 'Female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS female_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank, LAG(SUM(s.amount), 1) OVER (ORDER BY d.geoid) AS prev_geoid_sales FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' WHERE d.income_k > 957.33 AND d.inhabitants_k BETWEEN '0' AND '0' GROUP BY d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.refid) >= 734 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

WITH customer_agg AS ( SELECT c.id AS c_id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2 FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid WHERE c.age BETWEEN 59 AND 73 AND d.income_k > 442.71 GROUP BY c.id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) > 17 ), sales_agg AS ( SELECT s.refid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_amount, MIN(s.event_date) AS first_sale_date, MAX(s.event_date) AS last_sale_date FROM sales s WHERE s.amount > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY s.refid ), mailings3_agg AS ( SELECT m3.refid, COUNT(*) AS m3_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS m3_positive FROM mailings3 m3 WHERE m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY m3.refid ) SELECT ca.c_id, ca.age, ca.educationnum, ca.mailings_count, ca.positive_responses, ca.avg_a_var1, ca.avg_a_var2, COALESCE(sa.sales_count, 0) AS sales_count, COALESCE(sa.total_amount, 0) AS total_sales_amount, COALESCE(sa.avg_amount, 0) AS avg_sale_amount, COALESCE(ma.m3_count, 0) AS m3_mailings_count, COALESCE(ma.m3_positive, 0) AS m3_positive_responses, (ca.positive_responses * 1.0 / NULLIF(ca.mailings_count, 0)) AS response_rate, (COALESCE(sa.total_amount, 0) * 1.0 / NULLIF(ca.mailings_count, 0)) AS revenue_per_mailing FROM customer_agg ca LEFT JOIN sales_agg sa ON ca.c_id = sa.refid LEFT JOIN mailings3_agg ma ON ca.c_id = ma.refid WHERE COALESCE(sa.total_amount, 0) > '0' OR COALESCE(ma.m3_count, 0) > 31 ORDER BY ca.age DESC, total_sales_amount DESC LIMIT 885;

WITH customer_agg AS ( SELECT c.id AS c_id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status, COUNT(DISTINCT m12.ref_date) AS m12_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.ref_date) AS m3_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m12.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS m12_yes, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS m3_yes, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2, AVG(d.a_var3) AS avg_a_var3 FROM customers c LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m12 ON c.id = m12.refid LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid LEFT JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid WHERE c.age BETWEEN 59 AND 38 AND c.educationnum >= 18 AND d.income_k > 185.77 GROUP BY c.id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m12.ref_date) > 47 AND COUNT(DISTINCT m3.ref_date) > 8 ), sales_agg AS ( SELECT s.refid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_amount, MIN(s.event_date) AS first_sale, MAX(s.event_date) AS last_sale FROM sales s WHERE s.amount > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY s.refid HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '100' ) SELECT ca.c_id, ca.age, ca.educationnum, ca.sex, ca.marital_status, ca.m12_count, ca.m12_yes, ca.m3_count, ca.m3_yes, ca.avg_a_var1, ca.avg_a_var2, ca.avg_a_var3, sa.sales_count, sa.total_amount, sa.avg_amount, sa.first_sale, sa.last_sale, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, d.a_var4, d.a_var5, d.a_var6, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sa.total_amount DESC NULLS LAST) AS sales_rank, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ca.sex ORDER BY ca.age DESC) AS age_rank_by_sex, SUM(sa.total_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY ca.geoid) AS geoid_total_sales, AVG(ca.age) OVER (PARTITION BY ca.marital_status) AS avg_age_by_status FROM customer_agg ca LEFT JOIN sales_agg sa ON ca.c_id = sa.refid LEFT JOIN demog d ON ca.geoid = d.geoid WHERE ca.m12_yes > 35 AND ca.m3_yes > 47 AND (sa.total_amount > '0' OR sa.total_amount IS NULL) AND d.a_var4 BETWEEN '0' AND '0' ORDER BY sa.total_amount DESC NULLS LAST, ca.c_id LIMIT 6865;

WITH customer_agg AS ( SELECT c.id AS c_id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status, COUNT(DISTINCT m12.ref_date) AS m12_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.ref_date) AS m3_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m12.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS m12_yes, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS m3_yes, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2, AVG(d.a_var3) AS avg_a_var3 FROM customers c LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m12 ON c.id = m12.refid LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid LEFT JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid WHERE c.age BETWEEN 66 AND 23 AND c.educationnum >= 6 AND d.income_k > 410.87 GROUP BY c.id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m12.ref_date) > 20 AND COUNT(DISTINCT m3.ref_date) > 23 ), sales_agg AS ( SELECT s.refid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_amount, MIN(s.event_date) AS first_sale, MAX(s.event_date) AS last_sale FROM sales s WHERE s.amount > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY s.refid HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '100' ) SELECT ca.c_id, ca.age, ca.educationnum, ca.sex, ca.marital_status, ca.m12_count, ca.m12_yes, ca.m3_count, ca.m3_yes, ca.avg_a_var1, ca.avg_a_var2, ca.avg_a_var3, sa.sales_count, sa.total_amount, sa.avg_amount, sa.first_sale, sa.last_sale, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, d.a_var4, d.a_var5, d.a_var6, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sa.total_amount DESC NULLS LAST) AS sales_rank, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ca.sex ORDER BY ca.age DESC) AS age_rank_by_sex, SUM(sa.total_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY ca.geoid) AS geoid_total_sales, AVG(ca.age) OVER (PARTITION BY ca.marital_status) AS avg_age_by_status FROM customer_agg ca LEFT JOIN sales_agg sa ON ca.c_id = sa.refid LEFT JOIN demog d ON ca.geoid = d.geoid WHERE ca.m12_yes > 31 AND ca.m3_yes > 2 AND (sa.total_amount > '0' OR sa.total_amount IS NULL) AND d.a_var4 BETWEEN '0' AND '0' ORDER BY sa.total_amount DESC NULLS LAST, ca.c_id LIMIT 9087;

WITH customer_agg AS ( SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS total_sales, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount FROM customers c LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum ), demog_stats AS ( SELECT d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, SUM(d.a_var2) AS sum_a_var2 FROM demog d WHERE d.income_k >= 76.34 GROUP BY d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k ), mailing_response AS ( SELECT m.refid, COUNT(*) AS total_mailings, SUM(CASE WHEN m.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses FROM mailings1_2 m WHERE m.ref_date BETWEEN '2022-01-01' AND '2023-01-01' GROUP BY m.refid ) SELECT ca.customer_id, ca.age, ca.educationnum, ca.total_sales, ca.total_amount, ca.avg_sale_amount, ds.inhabitants_k, ds.income_k, ds.avg_a_var1, ds.sum_a_var2, mr.total_mailings, mr.positive_responses, AVG(ca.total_amount) OVER ( PARTITION BY ca.geoid ORDER BY ca.customer_id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_amount_by_geoid FROM customer_agg ca JOIN demog_stats ds ON ca.geoid = ds.geoid LEFT JOIN mailing_response mr ON ca.customer_id = mr.refid WHERE ca.total_amount > '1000' ORDER BY ca.total_amount DESC LIMIT 100;

WITH customer_agg AS ( SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.ref_date) AS mailings_count, AVG(m1.kxindex) AS avg_kxindex, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses FROM customers c LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid WHERE m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m1.ref_date <= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m1.ref_date) >= 2 ) SELECT d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, ca.sex, ca.marital_status, COUNT(ca.customer_id) AS customer_count, AVG(ca.age) AS avg_age, AVG(ca.educationnum) AS avg_education, SUM(ca.mailings_count) AS total_mailings, AVG(ca.avg_kxindex) AS overall_avg_kxindex, SUM(ca.positive_responses) AS total_positive_responses, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_events, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.ref_date) AS mailings3_count FROM demog d INNER JOIN customer_agg ca ON d.geoid = ca.geoid LEFT JOIN sales s ON ca.customer_id = s.refid LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON ca.customer_id = m3.refid WHERE d.income_k >= 40.71 AND d.inhabitants_k <= '1' GROUP BY d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, ca.sex, ca.marital_status HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '1000' AND AVG(ca.avg_kxindex) BETWEEN '0' AND '0' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, customer_count DESC;

WITH customer_aggregates AS ( SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.ref_date) AS mailings_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings_yes_responses, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_demog_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_demog_var2 FROM customers c LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = mailings3_yes_responses, MAX(m3.ref_date) AS last_mailing3_date FROM mailings3 m3 WHERE m3.ref_date >= '2021-01-01' GROUP BY m3.refid ), combined_metrics AS ( SELECT ca.customer_id, ca.geoid, ca.age, ca.educationnum, ca.sex, ca.marital_status, ca.mailings_count, ca.mailings_yes_responses, ca.avg_demog_var1, ca.avg_demog_var2, COALESCE(sa.sales_days, 0) AS sales_days, COALESCE(sa.total_sales_amount, 0) AS total_sales_amount, COALESCE(sa.avg_sale_amount, 0) AS avg_sale_amount, sa.last_sale_date, sa.first_sale_date, COALESCE(ma.mailings3_count, 0) AS mailings3_count, COALESCE(ma.mailings3_yes_responses, 0) AS mailings3_yes_responses, ma.last_mailing3_date, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, d.a_var3, d.a_var4, d.a_var5, d.a_var6, d.a_var7, d.a_var8, d.a_var9, d.a_var10, d.a_var11, d.a_var12, d.a_var13, d.a_var14, d.a_var15, d.a_var16, d.a_var17, d.a_var18 FROM customer_aggregates ca LEFT JOIN sales_analysis sa ON ca.customer_id = sa.refid LEFT JOIN mailings3_analysis ma ON ca.customer_id = ma.refid LEFT JOIN demog d ON ca.geoid = d.geoid WHERE ca.age BETWEEN 22 AND 92 AND ca.educationnum >= 14 AND d.income_k > 159.07 ) SELECT geoid, sex, marital_status, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS customer_count, AVG(age) AS avg_age, AVG(educationnum) AS avg_education, SUM(mailings_count) AS total_mailings, SUM(mailings_yes_responses) AS total_mailings_yes, SUM(sales_days) AS total_sales_days, SUM(total_sales_amount) AS grand_total_sales, AVG(avg_sale_amount) AS overall_avg_sale_amount, SUM(mailings3_count) AS total_mailings3, SUM(mailings3_yes_responses) AS total_mailings3_yes, AVG(inhabitants_k) AS avg_inhabitants, AVG(income_k) AS avg_income, AVG(a_var3) AS avg_var3, AVG(a_var4) AS avg_var4, AVG(a_var5) AS avg_var5, AVG(a_var6) AS avg_var6, AVG(a_var7) AS avg_var7, AVG(a_var8) AS avg_var8, AVG(a_var9) AS avg_var9, AVG(a_var10) AS avg_var10, AVG(a_var11) AS avg_var11, AVG(a_var12) AS avg_var12, AVG(a_var13) AS avg_var13, AVG(a_var14) AS avg_var14, AVG(a_var15) AS avg_var15, AVG(a_var16) AS avg_var16, AVG(a_var17) AS avg_var17, AVG(a_var18) AS avg_var18, MAX(last_sale_date) AS latest_sale_date, MAX(last_mailing3_date) AS latest_mailing3_date, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY total_sales_amount) AS median_sales_amount, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY mailings_count) AS q3_mailings_count FROM combined_metrics WHERE total_sales_amount > '1000' AND mailings_count >= 24 AND mailings3_count <= 187 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM last_sale_date) >= 2022 AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM last_mailing3_date) IN (3, 6, 9) GROUP BY geoid, sex, marital_status HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) > 93 AND AVG(income_k) BETWEEN 53.15 AND 121.52 AND SUM(total_sales_amount) / NULLIF(SUM(mailings_count), 0) > '50' ORDER BY grand_total_sales DESC, customer_count DESC LIMIT 421;

WITH ranked_customers AS ( SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.ref_date) AS mailings_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid WHERE c.age BETWEEN 74 AND 30 AND d.income_k > 288.7 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k ) SELECT customer_id, age, educationnum, inhabitants_k, income_k, total_sales, mailings_count, sales_rank FROM ranked_customers WHERE sales_rank <= 528 AND total_sales > '0' ORDER BY sales_rank, total_sales DESC;

WITH ranked_sales AS ( SELECT s.eventid, s.refid, s.event_date, s.amount, c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, d.a_var1, d.a_var2, d.a_var3, d.a_var4, d.a_var5, d.a_var6, d.a_var7, d.a_var8, d.a_var9, d.a_var10, d.a_var11, d.a_var12, d.a_var13, d.a_var14, d.a_var15, d.a_var16, d.a_var17, d.a_var18, m1.ref_date SUM(s.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY c.id, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date)) AS yearly_spent, AVG(s.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY c.geoid, c.occupation) AS avg_occupation_area_amount FROM sales s JOIN customers c ON s.refid = c.id JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND s.event_date >= m1.ref_date LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND s.event_date >= m3.ref_date WHERE s.amount > '10' AND s.event_date >= '2010-01-01' AND c.age BETWEEN 28 AND 70 AND d.income_k > 117.97 ), aggregated_data AS ( SELECT customer_id, age, educationnum, sex, avg_area_occupation_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN mailing1_response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_mailing1_responses, SUM(CASE WHEN mailing3_response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_mailing3_responses, SUM(a_var1 + a_var2 + a_var3 + a_var4 + a_var5 + a_var6 + a_var7 + a_var8 + a_var9 + a_var10 + a_var11 + a_var12 + a_var13 + a_var14 + a_var15 + a_var16 + a_var17 + DESC) AS revenue_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY occupation ORDER BY AVG(total_amount) DESC) AS occupation_spend_rank FROM aggregated_data GROUP BY geoid, occupation, sex, marital_status ORDER SELECT c.geoid, c.sex, c.occupation, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date) AS sale_year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM s.event_date) AS sale_month, COUNT(DISTINCT s.refid) AS unique_customers, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_amount, GROUPING(c.geoid, c.sex, c.occupation, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM s.event_date)) AS grouping_id FROM sales s JOIN customers c ON s.refid = c.id JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid WHERE s.amount > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND d.income_k BETWEEN 64.72 AND 219.3 GROUP BY CUBE(c.geoid, c.sex, c.occupation, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM s.event_date)) HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY sale_year, sale_month, total_amount DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT m12.kxindex) AS distinct_mailings_count, COUNT(m3.refid) AS mailings3_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.marital_status ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_marital FROM customers c INNER JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m12 ON c.id = m12.refid AND m12.response = 'YES' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.response = 'YES' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 88 AND 84 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND c.id IN ( SELECT s2.refid FROM sales s2 WHERE s2.amount > '100.0' GROUP BY s2.refid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s2.eventid) >= 18 ) GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, c.marital_status HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '5000.0' AND AVG(d.a_var1) < '0.0' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, avg_a_var1 ASC LIMIT 370;

AS mailing1_date, m1.response AS mailing1_response, m3.ref_date AS mailing3_date, m3.response AS mailing3_response, SUM(s.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY c.id ORDER BY s.event_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_total, AVG(s.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY c.marital_status, c.occupation ORDER BY s.event_date RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '30 days' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS avg_amount_30d_group, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.geoid ORDER BY s.amount DESC) AS sales_rank_in_geo, LAG(s.amount, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY s.refid ORDER BY s.event_date) AS prev_sale_amount, LEAD(s.event_date, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY s.refid ORDER BY s.event_date) AS next_sale_date FROM sales s JOIN customers c ON s.refid = c.id JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON s.refid = m1.refid AND s.event_date >= m1.ref_date LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON s.refid = m3.refid AND s.event_date >= m3.ref_date WHERE s.amount > '10' AND s.event_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2023-01-01' AND c.age BETWEEN 30 AND 93 AND d.income_k > 91.62 AND (m1.response = 'Y' OR m1.response IS NULL) AND (m3.response = 'Y' OR m3.response IS NULL) ), aggregated AS ( SELECT customer_id, geoid, sex, marital_status, occupation, COUNT(DISTINCT eventid) AS total_sales, SUM(amount) AS total_amount, AVG(amount) AS avg_sale_amount, MAX(running_total) AS max_running_total, MIN(avg_amount_30d_group) AS min_30d_group_avg, MAX(sales_rank_in_geo) AS worst_geo_rank, AVG(prev_sale_amount) AS avg_prev_sale, COUNT(DISTINCT mailing1_date) AS mailings1_count, COUNT(DISTINCT mailing3_date) AS mailings3_count, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY amount) AS median_sale_amount FROM ranked_sales GROUP BY customer_id, geoid, sex, marital_status, occupation HAVING SUM(amount) > '1000' AND COUNT(DISTINCT eventid) >= 3 AND AVG(amount) < '50' ) SELECT a.*, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, d.a_var1, d.a_var2, d.a_var3, d.a_var4, d.a_var5, d.a_var6, d.a_var7, d.a_var8, d.a_var9, d.a_var10, d.a_var11, d.a_var12, d.a_var13, d.a_var14, d.a_var15, d.a_var16, d.a_var17, d.a_var18, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY a.total_amount DESC) AS overall_rank, SUM(a.total_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY a.geoid) AS geo_total_sales, AVG(a.avg_sale_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY a.sex, a.marital_status) AS demographic_avg_sale FROM aggregated a JOIN demog d ON a.geoid = d.geoid WHERE d.inhabitants_k > '1' AND d.a_var1 BETWEEN '0' AND '50' ORDER BY a.total_amount DESC, a.customer_id LIMIT 976;

WITH ranked_sales AS ( SELECT s.eventid, s.refid, s.event_date, s.amount, c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, d.a_var1, d.a_var2, d.a_var3, d.a_var4, d.a_var5, d.a_var6, d.a_var7, d.a_var8, d.a_var9, d.a_var10, d.a_var11, d.a_var12, d.a_var13, d.a_var14, d.a_var15, d.a_var16, d.a_var17, d.a_var18, m1.ref_date AS mailing1_date, m1.response AS mailing1_response, m3.ref_date AS mailing3_date, m3.response AS mailing3_response, SUM(s.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY c.id ORDER BY s.event_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_total, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.geoid, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date) ORDER BY s.amount DESC) AS sales_rank_in_geo_year, AVG(s.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY c.geoid, c.marital_status) AS avg_sale_by_geo_marital, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY d.geoid ORDER BY s.event_date RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '1 year' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS sales_count_last_year FROM sales s JOIN customers c ON s.refid = c.id JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND s.event_date >= m1.ref_date LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND s.event_date >= m3.ref_date WHERE s.amount > '10' AND s.event_date >= '2010-01-01' AND c.age BETWEEN 32 AND 86 AND d.income_k > 58.62 AND (m1.response = 'YES' OR m3.response = 'YES' OR (m1.response IS NULL AND m3.response IS NULL)) ), aggregated AS ( SELECT customer_id, geoid, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM event_date) AS sale_year, sex, marital_status, occupation, inhabitants_k, income_k, SUM(amount) AS total_sales, AVG(amount) AS avg_sale, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count, MAX(running_total) AS max_running_total, MAX(sales_rank_in_geo_year) AS max_sales_rank, AVG(avg_sale_by_geo_marital) AS avg_geo_marital_sale, SUM(sales_count_last_year) AS total_sales_last_year_window, SUM(a_var1 + a_var2 + a_var3 + a_var4 + a_var5 + a_var6 + a_var7 + a_var8 + a_var9 + a_var10 + a_var11 + a_var12 + a_var13 + a_var14 + a_var15 + a_var16 + a_var17 + a_var18) AS sum_all_demog_vars FROM ranked_sales GROUP BY customer_id, geoid, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM event_date), sex, marital_status, occupation, inhabitants_k, income_k HAVING SUM(amount) > '1000' AND COUNT(*) >= 3 ) SELECT geoid, sale_year, sex, marital_status, occupation, inhabitants_k, income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS unique_customers, SUM(total_sales) AS grand_total_sales, AVG(avg_sale) AS overall_avg_sale, SUM(transaction_count) AS total_transactions, MAX(max_running_total) AS peak_running_total, AVG(max_sales_rank) AS avg_sales_rank, SUM(avg_geo_marital_sale) AS sum_avg_geo_marital_sale, SUM(total_sales_last_year_window) AS total_sales_last_year_agg, SUM(sum_all_demog_vars) AS total_demog_vars_sum, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(total_sales) DESC) AS revenue_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY geoid ORDER BY AVG(income_k) DESC) AS income_rank_in_geo, SUM(total_sales) / NULLIF(SUM(inhabitants_k), 0) AS sales_per_capita_k FROM aggregated GROUP BY geoid, sale_year, sex, marital_status, occupation, inhabitants_k, income_k HAVING SUM(total_sales) > '50000' AND AVG(income_k) >= 111.97 ORDER BY grand_total_sales DESC, geoid, sale_year;

SELECT c.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) FILTER (WHERE s.amount > '100') AS high_value_sales, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_demog_var FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 92 AND 96 AND c.educationnum >= 3 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (c.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k), (c.sex, c.marital_status), (c.geoid), () ) HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' OR SUM(s.amount) IS NULL ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC NULLS LAST;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS unique_sales_events, COUNT(DISTINCT m12.refid) AS mailings1_2_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailings3_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m12.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings1_2_yes_responses, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings3_yes_responses, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank, LAG(SUM(s.amount), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.geoid ORDER BY c.age) AS prev_sales_in_geoid_age_group FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m12 ON c.id = m12.refid LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE (c.age > 39 AND c.educationnum < 15) OR (d.income_k > 367.78 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sales s2 WHERE s2.refid = c.id AND s2.amount > '0' AND s2.event_date >= '2020-01-01')) OR (d.a_var1 < '-100' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mailings1_2 m12sub WHERE m12sub.refid = c.id AND m12sub.response = 'YES' AND m12sub.ref_date <= '2020-01-01')) GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' OR COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) < 26 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, c.age ASC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.marital_status ORDER BY d.income_k DESC) AS avg_a_var1_by_marital_income, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.ref_date) AS distinct_mailing_dates, MAX(m3.ref_date) AS latest_mailing3_date, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE c.age > 32 AND d.income_k BETWEEN 87.1 AND 196.57 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m1.ref_date <= '2020-01-01' AND m3.response = 'Yes' GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, c.marital_status HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT m1.kxindex) >= 75 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, sales_rank;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) OVER(PARTITION BY c.geoid) AS avg_a_var1_by_geoid, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS unique_sales_events, COUNT(m1.response) FILTER (WHERE m1.response = 'YES') AS mailings1_yes_count, COUNT(m3.response) FILTER (WHERE m3.response = 'YES') AS mailings3_yes_count, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date) AS sales_year, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM s.event_date) AS sales_quarter FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date BETWEEN (s.event_date - INTERVAL '30 days') AND (s.event_date + INTERVAL '30 days') LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date BETWEEN (s.event_date - INTERVAL '30 days') AND (s.event_date + INTERVAL '30 days') WHERE s.amount > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.event_date < '2020-01-01' AND c.age BETWEEN 48 AND 53 AND d.income_k > 10.6 GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM s.event_date) HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 37 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, sales_year DESC, sales_quarter DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m12.refid) AS mailings_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_demog_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_demog_var2 FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m12 ON c.id = m12.refid AND m12.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 27 AND 32 AND d.income_k > 195.38 GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m12.refid) > 5 AND SUM(s.amount) > '1000' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m12.refid) AS mailings_count_12, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailings_count_3, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_demog_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_demog_var2 FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m12 ON c.id = m12.refid AND m12.ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND '2020-01-01 00:00:00' WHERE c.age >= 57 AND c.educationnum >= 11 GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '1000' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 36 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS total_sales, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, (SELECT AVG(m3.response::integer) FROM mailings3 m3 WHERE m3.refid = c.id AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01') AS avg_mailing3_response_rate FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m12 ON c.id = m12.refid WHERE s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.amount > '10' AND m12.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' AND c.age BETWEEN 38 AND 80 GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '100' ORDER BY total_amount DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings1_2_yes_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings3_yes_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS distinct_sales_events, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, MAX(s.event_date) AS last_sale_date, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.marital_status ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_marital, LAG(SUM(s.amount), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.id ORDER BY MAX(s.event_date)) AS prev_total_sales FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE c.age >= 44 AND c.educationnum <= 9 AND d.income_k > 198.44 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM mailings1_2 m1_sub WHERE m1_sub.refid = c.id AND m1_sub.response = 'YES' AND m1_sub.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' ORDER BY m1_sub.ref_date DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 64 ) GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 75 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, last_sale_date ASC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS unique_sales_events, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings1_2_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailings3_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mailings1_2 m1_sub WHERE m1_sub.refid = c.id AND m1_sub.response = 'YES' AND m1_sub.ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00') AS recent_mailing_responses, (SELECT AVG(d_sub.a_var1) FROM demog d_sub WHERE d_sub.geoid = d.geoid AND d_sub.a_var1 > '0.0') AS avg_a_var1_above_threshold, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank, LAG(SUM(s.amount), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY d.income_k DESC) AS prev_sales_by_demo FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.kxindex > 168 LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND '2020-01-01 00:00:00' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 97 AND 74 AND d.income_k >= 737.81 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND s.amount > '0.0' GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0.0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 77 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, d.income_k DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, d.a_var1, d.a_var2, d.a_var3, d.a_var4, d.a_var5, d.a_var6, d.a_var7, d.a_var8, d.a_var9, d.a_var10, d.a_var11, d.a_var12, d.a_var13, d.a_var14, d.a_var15, d.a_var16, d.a_var17, d.a_var18, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings_yes, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'NO' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings_no, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailings3_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings3_yes, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'NO' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings3_no, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sales_amount, MAX(s.event_date) AS last_sale_date, MIN(s.event_date) AS first_sale_date, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mailings1_2 m2 WHERE m2.refid = c.id AND m2.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND '2020-01-01 00:00:00') AS specific_mailings_count, (SELECT SUM(s2.amount) FROM sales s2 WHERE s2.refid = c.id AND s2.event_date >= '2022-01-01 00:00:00' AND s2.amount > '100') AS recent_high_sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.marital_status ORDER BY AVG(s.amount) DESC) AS marital_sales_rank, LAG(SUM(s.amount), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.geoid ORDER BY MAX(s.event_date)) AS prev_geoid_sales, LEAD(COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.occupation ORDER BY MIN(s.event_date)) AS next_occupation_sales_count FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.kxindex BETWEEN 553 AND 71 LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND s.amount >= '0' WHERE c.age >= 45 AND c.age <= 65 AND c.educationnum >= 10 AND d.income_k >= 331.2 AND d.inhabitants_k <= '0' GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, d.a_var1, d.a_var2, d.a_var3, d.a_var4, d.a_var5, d.a_var6, d.a_var7, d.a_var8, d.a_var9, d.a_var10, d.a_var11, d.a_var12, d.a_var13, d.a_var14, d.a_var15, d.a_var16, d.a_var17, d.a_var18 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) > 52 AND SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2, AVG(d.a_var3) AS avg_a_var3, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS unique_sales_events, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings1_2_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailings3_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings1_2_yes_responses, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings3_yes_responses, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s.amount) FILTER (WHERE s.amount IS NOT NULL) AS median_sale_amount, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_demographic FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND '2020-01-01 00:00:00' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 33 AND 49 AND c.educationnum >= 12 AND d.income_k > 813.93 AND d.inhabitants_k < '0' GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 57 AND AVG(d.a_var1) < '-100' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, sales_rank_by_demographic;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings1_2_yes_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings3_yes_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS distinct_sales_events, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, MAX(s.event_date) AS last_sale_date, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC NULLS LAST) AS sales_rank_by_demographic, AVG(SUM(s.amount)) OVER (PARTITION BY d.geoid) AS avg_sales_per_geoid FROM customers c INNER JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date BETWEEN '2019-01-01 00:00:00' AND '2019-01-01 00:00:00' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 58 AND 83 AND c.educationnum >= 13 AND d.income_k > 20.63 AND (m1.kxindex IS NULL OR m1.kxindex < 89) GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 611 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, last_sale_date DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings1_2_yes_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings3_yes_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS distinct_sales_events, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, MAX(s.event_date) AS last_sale_date, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_demographic FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM m1.ref_date) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - 1 AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM m1.ref_date) BETWEEN 10 AND 10 LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date BETWEEN (CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3 months') AND (CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '116 days') LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date >= DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '3 years' AND s.amount > '0' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 24 AND 85 AND d.income_k > 323.89 AND (m1.kxindex IS NULL OR m1.kxindex > 385) GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 41 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, sales_rank_by_demographic;
