SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM m1.ref_date) AS mailing_year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM m1.ref_date) AS mailing_month, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS total_mailings, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN m1.refid END) AS positive_responses, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS total_sales, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_geoid_income, SUM(d.a_var1 + d.a_var2 + d.a_var3 + d.a_var4 + d.a_var5 + d.a_var6 + d.a_var7 + d.a_var8 + d.a_var9 + d.a_var10 + d.a_var11 + d.a_var12 + d.a_var13 + d.a_var14 + d.a_var15 + d.a_var16 + d.a_var17 + d.a_var18) AS sum_all_a_vars, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_demographic FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date BETWEEN m1.ref_date AND m1.ref_date + INTERVAL '30 days' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date > m1.ref_date WHERE c.age >= 41 AND c.educationnum >= 7 AND d.income_k >= 219.39 AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND (s.amount >= '0' OR s.amount IS NULL) GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM m1.ref_date), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM m1.ref_date)), (c.sex, c.marital_status, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM m1.ref_date), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM m1.ref_date)), (d.geoid, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM m1.ref_date)), (c.sex, c.marital_status), (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM m1.ref_date)), () ) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) > 21 AND (SUM(s.amount) >= '0' OR SUM(s.amount) IS NULL) ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC NULLS LAST, mailing_year, mailing_month, customer_id;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date) AS sale_year, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS total_sales, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date), c.sex ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_year_sex FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date >= s.event_date - INTERVAL '30 days' WHERE s.amount > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND d.income_k BETWEEN 182.11 AND 233.68 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, sale_year), (c.sex, sale_year), (sale_year), () ) HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY sale_year DESC, total_amount DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.income_k, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date) AS sale_year, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM s.event_date) AS sale_quarter, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS total_sales, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings1_2_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailings3_count, SUM(d.a_var1 + d.a_var2 + d.a_var3) AS demographic_score FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date BETWEEN s.event_date - INTERVAL '30 days' AND s.event_date LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date BETWEEN s.event_date - INTERVAL '30 days' AND s.event_date WHERE s.amount > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND c.age BETWEEN 93 AND 97 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.income_k, sale_year, sale_quarter), (c.sex, c.marital_status, sale_year, sale_quarter), (d.geoid, sale_year), (sale_year, sale_quarter), () ) HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_amount DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, CASE WHEN c.age < 30 THEN 'Young' WHEN c.age BETWEEN 30 AND 50 THEN 'Middle' ELSE 'Senior' END AS age_group, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS unique_sales_events, AVG(m1.kxindex) AS avg_mailing_index, COUNT(m3.refid) FILTER (WHERE m3.response = 'Y') AS positive_mailings3_responses, SUM(d.a_var1 * d.a_var2) / NULLIF(SUM(d.a_var3), 0) AS computed_demographic_ratio, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.marital_status ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_marital, LAG(SUM(s.amount), 1) OVER (ORDER BY d.geoid, c.id) AS prev_customer_sales FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date BETWEEN s.event_date - INTERVAL '30 days' AND s.event_date + INTERVAL '30 days' WHERE c.age > 21 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.amount > '0' AND d.income_k BETWEEN 63.55 AND 409.2 AND m1.ref_date < '2019-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, c.age HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 56 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, d.geoid, c.id;

SELECT c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.amount > '10' GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '100' INTERSECT SELECT c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN mailings1_2 m ON c.id = m.refid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE m.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m.response = 'Yes' GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid HAVING COUNT(m.refid) >= 6 ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT c.id, c.age, d.geoid, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.amount > '10' GROUP BY c.id, c.age, d.geoid HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '100' INTERSECT SELECT c.id, c.age, d.geoid, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m ON c.id = m.refid WHERE m.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m.response = 'Yes' GROUP BY c.id, c.age, d.geoid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m.kxindex) >= 9 ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT c1.id AS cust_id1, c2.id AS cust_id2, d1.geoid AS geo1, d2.geoid AS geo2, AVG(d1.a_var1) AS avg_var1_geo1, AVG(d2.a_var2) AS avg_var2_geo2, SUM(s1.amount) AS total_sales_cust1, SUM(s2.amount) AS total_sales_cust2, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count_cust1, COUNT(DISTINCT m2.refid) AS mailings_count_cust2, CORR(d1.a_var3, d2.a_var4) OVER (PARTITION BY c1.educationnum, c2.educationnum) AS correlation_var3_var4_by_edu, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (SUM(s1.amount) + SUM(s2.amount)) DESC) AS combined_sales_rank FROM customers c1 JOIN customers c2 ON c1.age = c2.age AND c1.id < c2.id JOIN demog d1 ON c1.geoid = d1.geoid JOIN demog d2 ON c2.geoid = d2.geoid LEFT JOIN sales s1 ON c1.id = s1.refid AND s1.event_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN sales s2 ON c2.id = s2.refid AND s2.event_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c1.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m2 ON c2.id = m2.refid AND m2.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND '2020-01-01 00:00:00' WHERE c1.educationnum > 15 AND c2.educationnum > 14 AND d1.income_k BETWEEN 38.05 AND 961.05 AND d2.income_k BETWEEN 606.82 AND 779.93 GROUP BY c1.id, c2.id, d1.geoid, d2.geoid, c1.educationnum, c2.educationnum HAVING SUM(s1.amount) > '0' AND SUM(s2.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) >= 713 AND COUNT(DISTINCT m2.refid) >= 10 ORDER BY combined_sales_rank;

SELECT d.geoid, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS customer_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE s.event_date >= (SELECT MIN(ref_date) FROM mailings1_2 WHERE response = (SELECT MAX(response) FROM mailings3 WHERE ref_date < '2020-01-01')) AND c.age BETWEEN 46 AND 33 GROUP BY d.geoid HAVING AVG(d.income_k) > 128.34 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS unique_customers, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses_m1, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses_m3, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY d.a_var1) AS median_a_var1, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON s.refid = m1.refid AND s.event_date >= m1.ref_date JOIN mailings3 m3 ON s.refid = m3.refid AND s.event_date >= m3.ref_date WHERE d.inhabitants_k > '0' AND s.amount > '0' AND c.age BETWEEN 69 AND 47 GROUP BY d.geoid HAVING AVG(d.income_k) > 321.48 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 794 INTERSECT SELECT d.geoid, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS unique_customers, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses_m1, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses_m3, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY d.a_var1) AS median_a_var1, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON s.refid = m1.refid AND s.event_date <= m1.ref_date JOIN mailings3 m3 ON s.refid = m3.refid AND s.event_date <= m3.ref_date WHERE d.inhabitants_k < '0' AND s.amount < '0' AND c.age BETWEEN 33 AND 90 GROUP BY d.geoid HAVING AVG(d.income_k) < 4.33 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) < 922 ORDER BY sales_rank;

SELECT d.geoid, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS unique_customers, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses_m1, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses_m3, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank, LAG(SUM(s.amount), 1) OVER (ORDER BY d.geoid) AS prev_geoid_sales FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND s.event_date >= m1.ref_date JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND s.event_date >= m3.ref_date WHERE d.income_k > 368.23 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.amount > '0' AND c.age BETWEEN 34 AND 24 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM mailings1_2 m1_sub WHERE m1_sub.refid = c.id AND m1_sub.response = 'YES' AND m1_sub.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' ) GROUP BY d.geoid HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 517 ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS unique_customers, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM mailings1_2 m WHERE m.refid = c.id AND m.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' AND m.response = 'Y' ) GROUP BY d.geoid HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '1000' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS customer_count, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, MAX(s.event_date) AS latest_sale_date FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM mailings1_2 m WHERE m.refid = c.id AND m.response = 'YES' AND m.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' ) AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND d.income_k BETWEEN 327.91 AND 389.11 GROUP BY d.geoid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 970 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS unique_customers, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS unique_mailings1_2_refs, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS unique_mailings3_refs, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE d.income_k > 155.62 AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY d.geoid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 100 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS distinct_events, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS distinct_mailings1_2_refs, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS distinct_mailings3_refs, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(d.inhabitants_k) AS total_inhabitants, SUM(d.a_var1 + d.a_var2 + d.a_var3 + d.a_var4 + d.a_var5 + d.a_var6 + d.a_var7 + d.a_var8 + d.a_var9 + d.a_var10 + d.a_var11 + d.a_var12 + d.a_var13 + d.a_var14 + d.a_var15 + d.a_var16 + d.a_var17 + d.a_var18) AS sum_all_a_vars, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_demo FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE s.amount > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.event_date <= '2020-01-01' AND d.income_k BETWEEN 370.94 AND 408.48 AND c.age >= 71 AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) > 96 AND COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) > 90 AND COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) > 20 AND SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, d.geoid;

SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM m.ref_date) AS mailing_year, COUNT(DISTINCT m.refid) AS total_mailings, SUM(CASE WHEN m.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, SUM(d.inhabitants_k) AS total_inhabitants FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN mailings1_2 m ON c.id = m.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON m.refid = s.refid AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM m.ref_date) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date) WHERE m.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND c.age >= 63 GROUP BY CUBE(d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM m.ref_date)) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m.refid) > 920 ORDER BY total_mailings DESC, mailing_year;

SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, MAX(m3.ref_date) AS latest_mailing_date, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_sex, LAG(SUM(s.amount), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY d.geoid ORDER BY MAX(s.event_date)) AS prev_geoid_sales FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE d.income_k > 177.58 AND d.inhabitants_k BETWEEN '0' AND '10' AND s.amount >= '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m1.ref_date <= '2019-01-01' AND (c.age > 74 OR c.educationnum < 10) AND (d.a_var1 + d.a_var2 + d.a_var3) / 3.0 > '-100' GROUP BY d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) > 47 AND AVG(d.income_k) < 332.74 ORDER BY total_sales DESC, avg_income ASC;

SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_sex, AVG(d.a_var1 + d.a_var2 + d.a_var3 + d.a_var4 + d.a_var5 + d.a_var6 + d.a_var7 + d.a_var8 + d.a_var9 + d.a_var10 + d.a_var11 + d.a_var12 + d.a_var13 + d.a_var14 + d.a_var15 + d.a_var16 + d.a_var17 + d.a_var18) AS avg_demog_index FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE s.amount > 5320.37 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND d.income_k BETWEEN 94.23 AND 468.71 AND c.age >= 54 GROUP BY d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation HAVING SUM(s.amount) > 68414.74 AND COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) >= 9 ORDER BY total_sales DESC, avg_income DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS total_mailings, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS total_sales, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, AVG(d.inhabitants_k) AS avg_inhabitants, SUM(d.a_var1 + d.a_var2 + d.a_var3 + d.a_var4 + d.a_var5 + d.a_var6 + d.a_var7 + d.a_var8 + d.a_var9 + d.a_var10 + d.a_var11 + d.a_var12 + d.geoid ORDER BY c.sex, c.marital_status) AS prev_sales_count FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.response = 'YES' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date >= m1.ref_date WHERE d.income_k > 793.14 AND d.inhabitants_k BETWEEN '0' AND '0' AND c.age >= 81 GROUP BY d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) > 9 AND SUM(s.amount) >= '0' UNION ALL SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS total_mailings, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS total_sales, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, AVG(d.inhabitants_k) AS avg_inhabitants, SUM(d.a_var1 + d.a_var2 + d.a_var3 + d.a_var4 + d.a_var5 + d.a_var6 + d.a_var7 + amount_rank, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY d.geoid ORDER BY c.sex, c.marital_status) AS prev_sales_count FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.response = 'YES' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date >= m3.ref_date WHERE d.income_k > 768.64 AND d.inhabitants_k BETWEEN '0' AND '0' AND c.age >= 92 GROUP BY d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) > 641 AND SUM(s.amount) >= '0' ORDER BY amount_rank, total_amount DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM m1.ref_date) AS mailing_year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM m1.ref_date) AS mailing_month, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS total_mailings, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN m1.refid END) AS positive_responses, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS total_sales, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(d.inhabitants_k) AS total_inhabitants, AVG(d.a_var1 + d.a_var2 + d.a_var3 + d.a_var4 + d.a_var5 + d.a_var6 + d.a_var7 + d.a_var8 + d.a_var9 + d.a_var10 + d.a_var11 + d.a_var12 + d.a_var13 + d.a_var14 + d.a_var15 + d.a_var16 + d.a_var17 + d.a_var18) AS avg_demog_index, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_demographic FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON m1.refid = s.refid AND s.event_date BETWEEN m1.ref_date AND m1.ref_date + INTERVAL '30 days' JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date >= m1.ref_date - INTERVAL '90 days' AND m3.ref_date <= m1.ref_date WHERE c.age >= 19 AND c.age <= 67 AND d.income_k >= 784.8 AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m1.ref_date <= '2020-01-01' AND (s.amount >= '0' OR s.amount IS NULL) GROUP BY CUBE(d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM m1.ref_date), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM m1.ref_date)) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) > 80 AND (SUM(s.amount) >= '0' OR SUM(s.amount) IS NULL) ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC NULLS LAST, total_mailings DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM m1.ref_date) AS mailing_year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM m1.ref_date) AS mailing_month, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date) AS sales_year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM s.event_date) AS sales_month, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS total_mailings, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS total_sales, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, AVG(d.inhabitants_k) AS avg_inhabitants, SUM(d.a_var1 + d.a_var2 + d.a_var3 + d.a_var4 + d.a_var5 + d.a_var6 + d.a_var7 + d.a_var8 + d.a_var9 + d.a_var10 + d.a_var11 + d.a_var12 + d.a_var13 + d.a_var14 + d.a_var15 + d.a_var16 + d.a_var17 + d.a_var18) AS sum_all_a_vars, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_demog, LAG(SUM(s.amount), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY d.geoid, c.sex ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM s.event_date)) AS prev_month_sales FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON m1.refid = s.refid AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM m1.ref_date) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date) AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM m1.ref_date) = EXTRACT(MONTH FROM s.event_date) LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m1.ref_date < m3.ref_date WHERE d.income_k > 111.31 AND d.inhabitants_k BETWEEN '0' AND '10' AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND (s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' OR s.event_date IS NULL) AND c.age >= 76 AND c.educationnum >= 11 AND m1.response = 'YES' GROUP BY CUBE(d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM m1.ref_date), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM m1.ref_date), EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM s.event_date)) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) > 667 OR COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) = 0 ORDER BY total_amount DESC NULLS LAST, total_sales DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.occupation, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM m.ref_date) AS mailing_year, COUNT(DISTINCT m.refid) AS total_mailings, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) FILTER (WHERE s.amount IS NOT NULL) AS sales_events, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_geoid_income FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN mailings1_2 m ON c.id = m.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON m.refid = s.refid AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM m.ref_date) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date) WHERE d.income_k > 487.32 AND m.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND c.age BETWEEN 18 AND 33 GROUP BY CUBE(d.geoid, c.sex, c.occupation, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM m.ref_date)) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m.refid) > 103 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC NULLS LAST;

SELECT d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(c.age) AS avg_age, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS unique_mailings, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT refid FROM mailings3 WHERE ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND ref_date <= '2020-01-01 00:00:00') AS sub_sub) AS recent_mailings3_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE c.age >= 58 AND c.age <= 31 AND s.event_date >= '2019-01-01 00:00:00' AND s.event_date <= '2019-01-01 00:00:00' AND d.income_k >= 226.91 AND d.income_k <= 123.82 GROUP BY d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) >= 36 ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS unique_mailings1_2_refs, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS unique_mailings3_refs, (SELECT AVG(c2.age) FROM customers c2 WHERE c2.geoid = d.geoid AND c2.age > 85) AS avg_age_above_threshold, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE d.income_k >= 481.46 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND c.age BETWEEN 66 AND 55 GROUP BY d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) > 689 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status ), sales_analysis AS ( SELECT ca.customer_id, ca.geoid, ca.age, ca.educationnum, ca.sex, ca.marital_status, ca.mailings_count, ca.avg_kxindex, sales_analysis sa INNER JOIN demog d ON sa.geoid = d.geoid WHERE d.income_k > 84.14 ), mailings3_analysis AS ( SELECT de.*, COUNT(m3.ref_date) AS mailings3_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date) AS sale_year, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM s.event_date) AS sale_quarter, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS total_sales, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_geoid_income, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date), c.sex ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS spending_rank_by_sex_year FROM customers c JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid WHERE s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.amount > '0' AND d.income_k BETWEEN 22.59 AND 177.34 GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM s.event_date) HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY sale_year, sale_quarter, spending_rank_by_sex_year;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, COUNT(s.eventid) AS sales_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_sex FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.response = 'YES' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE c.age >= 47 AND c.age <= 73 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(s.eventid) >= 1 ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date) AS sale_year, COUNT(DISTINCT s.refid) AS unique_customers, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(d.inhabitants_k) AS total_inhabitants FROM sales s JOIN customers c ON s.refid = c.id JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid WHERE s.amount > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND d.income_k BETWEEN 73.63 AND 131.81 GROUP BY CUBE(c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date)) HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailings3_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, AVG(d.inhabitants_k) AS avg_inhabitants, SUM(d.a_var1 + d.a_var2 + d.a_var3 + d.a_var4 + d.a_var5 + d.a_var6 + d.a_var7 + d.a_var8 + d.a_var9 + d.a_var10 + d.a_var11 + d.a_var12 + d.a_var13 + d.a_var14 + d.a_var15 + d.a_var16 + d.a_var17 + d.a_var18) AS sum_all_vars, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC NULLS LAST) AS sales_rank_by_demog, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY d.geoid, c.sex ORDER BY c.marital_status, c.occupation) AS prev_sales_count FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.response = 'YES' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.response = 'YES' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE d.income_k > 254.45 AND d.inhabitants_k BETWEEN '0' AND '10' AND c.age >= 82 AND c.educationnum >= 16 AND (m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' OR m1.ref_date IS NULL) AND (m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' OR m3.ref_date IS NULL) AND (s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' OR s.event_date IS NULL) GROUP BY d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) > 33 AND SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND AVG(d.income_k) < 318.55 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, avg_income ASC LIMIT 876;

SELECT d1.geoid AS geoid1, d2.geoid AS geoid2, AVG(d1.a_var1) AS avg_var1_geoid1, AVG(d2.a_var2) AS avg_var2_geoid2, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings1_yes_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings3_yes_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS distinct_sales_events, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_amount_percentile, AVG(c.educationnum) FILTER (WHERE c.sex = 'Male') AS avg_education_male, AVG(c.educationnum) FILTER (WHERE c.sex = 'Female') AS avg_education_female FROM demog d1 JOIN demog d2 ON d1.geoid < d2.geoid AND d1.inhabitants_k > '0' AND d2.inhabitants_k > '0' JOIN customers c ON c.geoid = d1.geoid OR c.geoid = d2.geoid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON m1.refid = c.id AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON m3.refid = c.id AND m3.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN sales s ON s.refid = c.id AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' WHERE d1.income_k BETWEEN 64.76 AND 267.23 AND d2.income_k BETWEEN 85.79 AND 462.93 AND c.age >= 49 GROUP BY d1.geoid, d2.geoid HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 284 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

WITH customer_agg AS ( SELECT c.id AS c_id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2 FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid WHERE c.age BETWEEN 51 AND 73 AND d.income_k > 183.25 GROUP BY c.id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) > 3 ), sales_agg AS ( SELECT s.refid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_amount, MIN(s.event_date) AS first_sale_date, MAX(s.event_date) AS last_sale_date FROM sales s WHERE s.amount > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY s.refid ), mailings3_agg AS ( SELECT m3.refid, COUNT(*) AS m3_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS m3_positive FROM mailings3 m3 WHERE m3.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' GROUP BY m3.refid ) SELECT ca.c_id, ca.age, ca.educationnum, ca.sex, ca.marital_status, ca.mailings_count, ca.positive_responses, ca.avg_a_var1, ca.avg_a_var2, COALESCE(sa.sales_count, 0) AS sales_count, COALESCE(sa.total_amount, 0) AS total_sales_amount, COALESCE(sa.avg_amount, 0) AS avg_sale_amount, COALESCE(ma.m3_count, 0) AS m3_mailings_count, COALESCE(ma.m3_positive, 0) AS m3_positive_responses, (ca.positive_responses * 1.0 / NULLIF(ca.mailings_count, 0)) AS response_rate, (COALESCE(sa.total_amount, 0) * 1.0 / NULLIF(ca.mailings_count, 0)) AS revenue_per_mailing FROM customer_agg ca LEFT JOIN sales_agg sa ON ca.c_id = sa.refid LEFT JOIN mailings3_agg ma ON ca.c_id = ma.refid WHERE ca.avg_a_var1 > '0' AND (ca.avg_a_var2 < '0' OR ca.avg_a_var2 IS NULL) AND (COALESCE(sa.total_amount, 0) > '0' OR sa.total_amount IS NULL) ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, response_rate DESC LIMIT 224;

WITH customer_aggregates AS ( SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status, COUNT(DISTINCT m12.ref_date) AS mailings_count, AVG(m12.kxindex) AS avg_kxindex, SUM(CASE WHEN m12.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses FROM customers c LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m12 ON c.id = m12.refid WHERE c.age BETWEEN 30 AND 75 AND c.educationnum >= 4 GROUP BY c.id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status ), sales_analysis AS ( SELECT s.refid, COUNT(s.eventid) AS total_transactions, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_transaction, MIN(s.event_date) AS first_purchase, MAX(s.event_date) AS last_purchase FROM sales s WHERE s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.amount > '0' GROUP BY s.refid ), demographic_metrics AS ( SELECT d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_var2, AVG(d.a_var3) AS avg_var3, AVG(d.a_var4) AS avg_var4, AVG(d.a_var5) AS avg_var5, AVG(d.a_var6) AS avg_var6, AVG(d.a_var7) AS avg_var7, AVG(d.a_var8) AS avg_var8, AVG(d.a_var9) AS avg_var9, AVG(d.a_var10) AS avg_var10, AVG(d.a_var11) AS avg_var11, AVG(d.a_var12) AS avg_var12, AVG(d.a_var13) AS avg_var13, AVG(d.a_var14) AS avg_var14, AVG(d.a_var15) AS avg_var15, AVG(d.a_var16) AS avg_var16, AVG(d.a_var17) AS avg_var17, AVG(d.a_var18) AS avg_var18 FROM demog d WHERE d.income_k >= 182.57 AND d.inhabitants_k <= '0' GROUP BY d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k ), mailings3_summary AS ( SELECT m3.refid, COUNT(*) AS m3_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS m3_positive FROM mailings3 m3 WHERE m3.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' GROUP BY m3.refid ) SELECT ca.customer_id, ca.age, ca.educationnum, ca.sex, ca.marital_status, ca.mailings_count, ca.avg_kxindex, ca.positive_responses, COALESCE(sa.total_transactions, 0) AS total_transactions, COALESCE(sa.total_amount, 0) AS total_amount, COALESCE(sa.avg_transaction, 0) AS avg_transaction, sa.first_purchase, sa.last_purchase, dm.inhabitants_k, dm.income_k, dm.avg_var1, dm.avg_var2, dm.avg_var3, dm.avg_var4, dm.avg_var5, dm.avg_var6, dm.avg_var7, dm.avg_var8, dm.avg_var9, dm.avg_var10, dm.avg_var11, dm.avg_var12, dm.avg_var13, dm.avg_var14, dm.avg_var15, dm.avg_var16, dm.avg_var17, dm.avg_var18, COALESCE(m3s.m3_count, 0) AS m3_count, COALESCE(m3s.m3_positive, 0) AS m3_positive, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(sa.total_amount, 0) DESC) AS sales_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ca.sex ORDER BY ca.age DESC) AS age_rank_by_sex, AVG(COALESCE(sa.total_amount, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY ca.geoid) AS avg_sales_by_geoid, SUM(COALESCE(sa.total_amount, 0)) OVER (ORDER BY ca.customer_id) AS running_total_sales FROM customer_aggregates ca LEFT JOIN sales_analysis sa ON ca.customer_id = sa.refid LEFT JOIN demographic_metrics dm ON ca.geoid = dm.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings3_summary m3s ON ca.customer_id = m3s.refid WHERE COALESCE(sa.total_amount, 0) >= '0' AND dm.income_k <= 448.08 AND (ca.positive_responses > 40 OR COALESCE(m3s.m3_positive, 0) > 97) ORDER BY total_amount DESC, ca.customer_id LIMIT 3994;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_demog_var1 FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 56 AND 89 AND d.income_k > 255.12 GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.income_k HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 46 AND SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_amount DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS total_sales, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(SUM(s.amount)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.educationnum) AS avg_amount_by_education FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.amount > '0' AND c.age BETWEEN 55 AND 94 GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_amount DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, d.a_var1, d.a_var2, d.a_var3, d.a_var4, d.a_var5, d.a_var6, d.a_var7, d.a_var8, d.a_var9, d.a_var10, d.a_var11, d.a_var12, d.a_var13, d.a_var14, d.a_var15, d.a_var16, d.a_var17, d.a_var18, m1.ref_date AS first_mailing_date, m1.response AS first_response, m3.ref_date AS third_mailing_date, m3.response AS third_response, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS total_sales_events, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, MAX(s.amount) AS max_sale_amount, MIN(s.amount) AS min_sale_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.kxindex) AS distinct_mailings1_campaigns, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.geoid ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_in_geo, LAG(SUM(s.amount), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.geoid ORDER BY c.educationnum) AS prev_edu_total_sales, LEAD(AVG(s.amount), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.geoid, c.marital_status ORDER BY c.age) AS next_age_avg_sale FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date BETWEEN '2021-01-01 00:00:00' AND '2021-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date >= '2019-01-01 00:00:00' AND s.amount > '0.0' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 62 AND 50 AND c.educationnum >= 12 AND d.income_k > 392.31 AND d.inhabitants_k BETWEEN '0.0' AND '0.0' GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.educationnum, c.geoid, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, d.a_var1, d.a_var2, d.a_var3, d.a_var4, d.a_var5, d.a_var6, d.a_var7, d.a_var8, d.a_var9, d.a_var10, d.a_var11, d.a_var12, d.a_var13, d.a_var14, d.a_var15, d.a_var16, d.a_var17, d.a_var18, m1.ref_date, m1.response, m3.ref_date, m3.response HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0.0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 55 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, sales_rank_in_geo;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, d.a_var1, d.a_var2, d.a_var3, d.a_var4, d.a_var5, d.a_var6, d.a_var7, d.a_var8, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings1_2_yes, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings3_yes, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, MAX(s.event_date) AS last_sale_date, MIN(s.event_date) AS first_sale_date, SUM(SUM(s.amount)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.geoid, c.occupation ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS running_total_sales_by_geo_occupation, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_amount_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.marital_status ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) DESC) AS sales_count_rank_by_marital, LAG(SUM(s.amount), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.id ORDER BY MAX(s.event_date)) AS prev_sale_amount FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND s.amount > '0.0' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 22 AND 31 AND c.educationnum >= 17 AND d.income_k >= 158.72 AND d.a_var1 <= '0.0' AND d.a_var2 >= '0.0' GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, d.a_var1, d.a_var2, d.a_var3, d.a_var4, d.a_var5, d.a_var6, d.a_var7, d.a_var8, SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, d.a_var1, d.a_var2, d.a_var3, d.a_var4, d.a_var5, d.a_var6, d.a_var7, d.a_var8, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings1_2_yes, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings3_yes, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sales_amount, MAX(s.event_date) AS last_sale_date, MIN(s.event_date) AS first_sale_date, COUNT(DISTINCT s.event_date) AS unique_sale_days, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s.amount) AS median_sales_amount, STDDEV(s.amount) AS stddev_sales_amount, CORR(d.income_k, s.amount) AS income_sales_corr, CORR(d.inhabitants_k, s.amount) prev_geoid_sales_amount, LEAD(COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.occupation ORDER BY MIN(s.event_date)) AS next_occupation_sales_count FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m1.kxindex > 820 LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' AND s.amount > '0' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 96 AND 37 AND c.educationnum > 0 AND d.income_k >= 366.55 AND d.inhabitants_k <= '0' GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, d.a_var1, d.a_var2, d.a_var3, d.a_var4, d.a_var5, d.a_var6, d.a_var7, d.a_var8, d.a_var9, d.a_var10, SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS total_mailings, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses_m1, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses_m3, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS total_sales, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' WHERE c.age >= 91 AND c.educationnum >= 12 GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

SELECT c.id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.ref_date) AS distinct_mailings1_2_dates, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.ref_date) AS distinct_mailings3_dates, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'Yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses_m1, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'Yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses_m3, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s.amount) AS median_sale_amount, STDDEV(s.amount) AS stddev_sale_amount FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.kxindex > 35 LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 21 AND 96 AND d.income_k >= 72.81 AND d.inhabitants_k <= '1' GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '1000' AND COUNT(DISTINCT m1.ref_date) >= 7 AND AVG(d.a_var1) < '0' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, avg_a_var1 ASC LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS unique_sales_events, AVG(m1.kxindex) AS avg_mailing_index, COUNT(m3.refid) FILTER (WHERE m3.response = 'YES') AS mailings3_yes_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_sex, LAG(SUM(s.amount), 1) OVER (ORDER BY d.geoid, c.id) AS prev_customer_sales FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date >= s.event_date WHERE ( s.amount > '0' OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM mailings1_2 m2 WHERE m2.refid = c.id AND m2.kxindex > 40 ) OR d.income_k BETWEEN 198.34 AND 178.39 ) AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND c.age >= 28 GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 70 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, d.geoid, c.id;

SELECT c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date) AS sale_year, COUNT(DISTINCT s.refid) AS unique_customers, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, SUM(d.income_k) AS total_income_in_area FROM sales s JOIN customers c ON s.refid = c.id JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid WHERE s.amount > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND d.income_k BETWEEN 434.67 AND 406.81 GROUP BY CUBE(c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date)) HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS customer_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid WHERE d.geoid IN (SELECT geoid FROM customers WHERE age > 40) AND d.inhabitants_k > '0.0' GROUP BY d.geoid HAVING AVG(d.income_k) > 292.16 ORDER BY avg_income DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS customer_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(SUM(s.amount)) OVER (PARTITION BY d.geoid ORDER BY DATE_TRUNC('month', s.event_date) ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_sales FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE d.income_k > 396.08 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY d.geoid, DATE_TRUNC('month', s.event_date) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 21 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY d.a_var1) AS median_a_var1, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS customer_count FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN mailings1_2 m ON c.id = m.refid WHERE d.income_k > 494.04 AND m.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY d.geoid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 577 ORDER BY avg_income DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(c.data1) AS total_data1, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM mailings1_2 m WHERE m.refid = c.id AND m.response = 'Yes' AND m.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' ) AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.amount > '0' GROUP BY d.geoid HAVING AVG(d.income_k) > 453.48 ORDER BY avg_income DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(c.educationnum) AS total_education FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid WHERE c.id IN (SELECT s.refid FROM sales s WHERE s.amount > '0') GROUP BY d.geoid HAVING AVG(d.income_k) > 52.9 ORDER BY total_education DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS unique_customers FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.amount > '0' GROUP BY d.geoid HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '1000' AND AVG(d.income_k) < 120.32 ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS unique_customers, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mailings1_2 m WHERE m.refid = c.id AND m.response = 'YES') AS positive_responses FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid WHERE d.inhabitants_k > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.amount BETWEEN '0' AND '0' GROUP BY d.geoid, c.id HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailing_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) FILTER (WHERE s.amount > '100') AS high_value_sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(d.a_var1 * d.a_var2) / NULLIF(SUM(d.a_var3), 0) AS demographic_ratio, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_sex, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid), 1) OVER (ORDER BY d.geoid) AS prev_mailing3_count FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON m1.refid = s.refid AND s.event_date BETWEEN m1.ref_date AND m1.ref_date + INTERVAL '30 days' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' WHERE d.inhabitants_k > '1' AND c.age BETWEEN 26 AND 66 AND m1.response = 'YES' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sales s2 WHERE s2.refid = c.id AND s2.amount > (SELECT AVG(amount) * 1.5 FROM sales WHERE event_date >= '2019-01-01') ) GROUP BY d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m1.kxindex) > 43 AND SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(d.inhabitants_k) AS total_inhabitants, SUM(d.a_var1 + d.a_var2 + d.a_var3 + d.a_var4 + d.a_var5 + d.a_var6 + d.a_var7 + d.a_var8 + d.a_var9 + d.a_var10 + d.a_var11 + d.a_var12 + d.a_var13 + d.a_var14 + d.a_var15 + d.a_var16 + d.a_var17 + d.a_var18) AS sum_all_vars, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_demographic, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY d.geoid ORDER BY MIN(m1.ref_date)) AS prev_mailing_count_by_geoid FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid JOIN sales s ON m1.refid = s.refid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON s.refid = m3.refid WHERE d.income_k > 921.51 AND c.age BETWEEN 63 AND 85 AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.amount > '0' AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) > 858 AND AVG(d.income_k) < 559.72 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date) AS sale_year, COUNT(DISTINCT s.refid) AS unique_customers, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, SUM(d.inhabitants_k) AS total_inhabitants_k, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income_k FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m ON s.refid = m.refid WHERE s.amount > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.event_date <= '2020-01-01' AND d.income_k BETWEEN 37.98 AND 225.02 GROUP BY CUBE(d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date)) HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS unique_events, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses_m1, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses_m3, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY d.a_var1) AS median_a_var1, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY d.a_var2) AS median_a_var2, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY d.a_var3) AS median_a_var3 FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE s.amount > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.event_date <= '2020-01-01' AND d.inhabitants_k BETWEEN '0' AND '0' AND c.age >= 89 AND c.id IN ( SELECT s2.refid FROM sales s2 WHERE s2.amount > '0' AND s2.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY s2.refid HAVING COUNT(s2.eventid) > 14 ) GROUP BY d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND AVG(d.income_k) BETWEEN 322.88 AND 440.11 ORDER BY total_sales DESC, avg_income DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS unique_sales_events, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings1_2_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailings3_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings1_2_yes, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings3_yes, AVG(d.a_var1 + d.a_var2 + d.a_var3 + d.a_var4 + d.a_var5 + d.a_var6 + d.a_var7 + d.a_var8 + d.a_var9 + d.a_var10 + d.a_var11 + d.a_var12 + d.a_var13 + d.a_var14 + d.a_var15 + d.a_var16 + d.a_var17 + d.a_var18) AS avg_demog_sum, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_demog FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE s.event_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND s.event_date <= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND m1.ref_date <= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND m3.ref_date <= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND c.age BETWEEN 26 AND 86 AND d.income_k > 459.06 AND s.amount > '0' GROUP BY d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 7 AND AVG(d.income_k) > 683.95 ORDER BY total_sales DESC, avg_income DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS distinct_sales_events, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS distinct_mailings1_2_refs, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS distinct_mailings3_refs, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income_k, AVG(d.inhabitants_k) AS avg_inhabitants_k, SUM(d.a_var1 + d.a_var2 + d.a_var3 + d.a_var4 + d.a_var5 + d.a_var6 + d.a_var7 + d.a_var8 + d.a_var9 + d.a_var10 + d.a_var11 + d.a_var12 + d.a_var13 + d.a_var14 + d.a_var15 + d.a_var16 + d.a_var17 + d.a_var18) AS sum_all_a_vars, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank, LAG(SUM(s.amount), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY d.geoid) AS prev_geoid_sales FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND '2020-01-01 00:00:00' WHERE d.income_k > 915805.56 AND d.inhabitants_k BETWEEN '0' AND '0' AND c.age >= 118 GROUP BY d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) > 994848 AND SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, d.geoid ASC;

SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.occupation, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailing_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(d.a_var1 + d.a_var2 + d.a_var3 + d.a_var4 + d.a_var5 + d.a_var6 + d.a_var7 + d.a_var8 + d.a_var9 + d.a_var10 + d.a_var11 + d.a_var12 + d.a_var13 + d.a_var14 + d.a_var15 + d.a_var16 + d.a_var17 + d.a_var18) AS sum_all_vars, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_sex FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid JOIN sales s ON m1.refid = s.refid WHERE c.age > 63 AND d.income_k BETWEEN 883.76 AND 972.95 AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY d.geoid, c.sex, c.occupation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) > 14 AND SUM(s.amount) > '0' UNION ALL SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.occupation, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailing_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(d.a_var1 + d.a_var2 + d.a_var3 + d.a_var4 + d.a_var5 + d.a_var6 + d.a_var7 + d.a_var8 + d.a_var9 + d.a_var10 + d.a_var11 + d.a_var12 + d.a_var13 + d.a_var14 + d.a_var15 + d.a_var16 + d.a_var17 + d.a_var18) AS sum_all_vars, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_sex FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid JOIN sales s ON m3.refid = s.refid WHERE c.age > 33 AND d.income_k BETWEEN 357.35 AND 208.94 AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY d.geoid, c.sex, c.occupation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) > 37 AND SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.occupation, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings_yes_responses, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(SUM(s.amount)) OVER (PARTITION BY d.geoid, c.sex) AS avg_sales_per_geoid_sex, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON m1.refid = s.refid AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM m1.ref_date) WHERE d.inhabitants_k > '0' AND d.income_k BETWEEN 441.27 AND 472.39 AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY d.geoid, c.sex, c.occupation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) > 77 AND SUM(s.amount) > '0' UNION ALL SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.occupation, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailings_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings_yes_responses, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(SUM(s.amount)) OVER (PARTITION BY d.geoid, c.sex) AS avg_sales_per_geoid_sex, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON m3.refid = s.refid AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM m3.ref_date) WHERE d.inhabitants_k > '0' AND d.income_k BETWEEN 467.87 AND 377.99 AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY d.geoid, c.sex, c.occupation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) > 12 AND SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY sales_rank;

SELECT d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(c.age) AS avg_age, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(c.age)) AS age_percentile FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.amount > '0' AND c.age BETWEEN 56 AND 78 AND c.id IN ( SELECT s2.refid FROM sales s2 WHERE s2.amount > '0' GROUP BY s2.refid HAVING COUNT(*) > 72 ) GROUP BY d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND AVG(c.age) < '18' ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(c.age) AS avg_age, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(c.age)) AS age_percentile FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.amount > '0' AND c.age BETWEEN 91 AND 94 AND c.id IN ( SELECT s2.refid FROM sales s2 WHERE s2.amount > '0' GROUP BY s2.refid HAVING COUNT(*) > 91 ) GROUP BY d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND AVG(c.age) < '18' ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2, AVG(d.a_var3) AS avg_a_var3, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS unique_customers, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings1_yes_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings3_yes_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(s.eventid) AS total_sales_events, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank, LAG(SUM(s.amount), 1) OVER (ORDER BY d.geoid) AS prev_geoid_sales FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE d.income_k > 242.33 AND c.age BETWEEN 75 AND 85 AND m1.ref_date >= '2000-01-01' AND s.event_date >= '2000-01-01' AND m3.ref_date >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING AVG(d.a_var1) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 2142 UNION ALL SELECT d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var4) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var5) AS avg_a_var2, AVG(d.a_var6) AS avg_a_var3, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS unique_customers, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'NO' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings1_yes_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'NO' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings3_yes_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(s.eventid) AS total_sales_events, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank, LAG(SUM(s.amount), 1) OVER (ORDER BY d.geoid) AS prev_geoid_sales FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE d.income_k <= 283.07 AND c.age BETWEEN 98 AND 55 AND m1.ref_date < '2000-01-01' AND s.event_date < '2000-01-01' AND m3.ref_date < '2000-01-01' GROUP BY d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING AVG(d.a_var4) < '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) < 3645 ORDER BY geoid, total_sales_amount DESC;

SELECT s.refid, COUNT(*) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income FROM sales s JOIN customers c ON s.refid = c.id JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid WHERE s.amount > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY s.refid HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '100' INTERSECT SELECT m.refid, COUNT(*) AS mailings_count, NULL AS total_amount, NULL AS avg_income FROM mailings1_2 m WHERE m.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m.response = 'Yes' GROUP BY m.refid HAVING COUNT(*) > 36 ORDER BY sales_count DESC;

WITH customer_agg AS ( SELECT c.id AS c_id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS distinct_mailings1_2, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS distinct_mailings3, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS distinct_sales_events, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2 FROM customers c LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.response = 'YES' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.response = 'YES' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid INNER JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid WHERE c.age BETWEEN 39 AND 99 AND d.income_k > 120.11 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) > 22 AND COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) > 49 AND SUM(s.amount) > '1000' ), demog_stats AS ( SELECT geoid, AVG(inhabitants_k) AS avg_inhabitants, SUM(a_var3 + a_var4 + a_var5) AS sum_vars_345, COUNT(*) AS total_geos FROM demog WHERE a_var6 > '0' AND a_var7 < '0' GROUP BY geoid HAVING AVG(inhabitants_k) > '1' ) SELECT ca.c_id, ca.geoid, ca.age, ca.educationnum, ca.distinct_mailings1_2, ca.distinct_mailings3, ca.distinct_sales_events, ca.total_sales_amount, ca.avg_a_var1, ca.avg_a_var2, ds.avg_inhabitants, ds.sum_vars_345, ds.total_geos, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ca.total_sales_amount DESC) AS sales_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ca.geoid ORDER BY ca.distinct_sales_events DESC) AS event_rank_in_geo FROM customer_agg ca INNER JOIN demog_stats ds ON ca.geoid = ds.geoid WHERE ca.total_sales_amount > '5000' AND ca.distinct_mailings1_2 + ca.distinct_mailings3 > 100 ORDER BY ca.total_sales_amount DESC, ca.distinct_sales_events DESC LIMIT 771;

WITH customer_agg AS ( SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, d.a_var1, d.a_var2, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.ref_date) AS mailings_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.ref_date) AS mailings3_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS response_count_m1, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS response_count_m3, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_events, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sales_amount FROM customers c LEFT JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE c.age BETWEEN 80 AND 86 AND d.income_k >= 453.99 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, d.a_var1, d.a_var2 ) SELECT COALESCE(sex, 'ALL') AS sex, COALESCE(marital_status, 'ALL') AS marital_status, COALESCE(occupation, 'ALL') AS occupation, COUNT(customer_id) AS customer_count, AVG(age) AS avg_age, AVG(educationnum) AS avg_education, AVG(inhabitants_k) AS avg_inhabitants, AVG(income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(mailings_count) AS total_mailings, SUM(mailings3_count) AS total_mailings3, SUM(response_count_m1) AS total_responses_m1, SUM(response_count_m3) AS total_responses_m3, SUM(sales_events) AS total_sales_events, SUM(total_sales_amount) AS grand_total_sales, AVG(avg_sales_amount) AS overall_avg_sale FROM customer_agg GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (sex, marital_status, occupation), (sex, marital_status), (sex), (occupation), () ) HAVING SUM(total_sales_amount) > '0' ORDER BY sex, marital_status, occupation;

WHERE c.age BETWEEN 100 AND 91 AND d.income_k >= 60.66 AND (m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' OR m1.ref_date IS NULL) AND (s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' OR s.event_date IS NULL) AND (m3.ref_date >= sales_analysis sa INNER JOIN demog d ON sa.geoid = d.geoid WHERE d.income_k > 112.59 ), mailings3_analysis AS ( SELECT de.*, COUNT(m3.ref_date) AS mailings3_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings3_positive FROM demographic_enrichment de LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON de.customer_id = m3.refid WHERE m3.ref_date BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-01-01' GROUP BY de.customer_id, de.geoid, de.age, de.educationnum, de.sex, de.marital_status, de.mailings_count, de.avg_kxindex, de.positive_responses, de.sales_count, de.total_sales_amount, de.avg_sale_amount, avg_age, AVG(educationnum) AS avg_education, SUM(total_sales_amount) AS total_geoid_sales, AVG(total_sales_amount) AS avg_customer_sales, SUM(mailings_count) AS total_mailings, SUM(positive_responses) AS total_positive_responses, SUM(mailings3_count) AS total_mailings3, SUM(mailings3_positive) AS total_mailings3_positive, AVG(income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(inhabitants_k) AS total_inhabitants, SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS distinct_mailings1_2_refs, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS distinct_mailings3_refs, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS distinct_sales_events, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_demog_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_demog_var2, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC NULLS LAST) AS sales_rank_by_demo, LAG(SUM(s.amount), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.geoid ORDER BY d.income_k DESC) AS prev_total_sales_in_geo FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.response = 'YES' AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.response = 'YES' AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND s.amount > '0.0' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 54 AND 28 AND d.income_k > 38.38 AND d.inhabitants_k < '0.0' GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) > 49 AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 31 AND SUM(s.amount) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, d.income_k DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS unique_events, COUNT(m1.response) FILTER (WHERE m1.response = 'YES') AS mailings1_yes_count, COUNT(m3.response) FILTER (WHERE m3.response = 'YES') AS mailings3_yes_count, SUM(d.a_var1 + d.a_var2 + d.a_var3 + d.a_var4 + d.a_var5 + d.a_var6 + d.a_var7 + d.a_var8 + d.a_var9 + d.a_var10 + d.a_var11 + d.a_var12 + d.a_var13 + d.a_var14 + d.a_var15 + d.a_var16 + d.a_var17 + d.a_var18) AS sum_all_a_vars, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_demog FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE s.amount > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND c.age BETWEEN 47 AND 20 AND d.income_k > '0' GROUP BY d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) > 94 AND AVG(d.income_k) BETWEEN '0' AND '0' ORDER BY total_sales DESC, avg_income DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS unique_events, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses_m1, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses_m3, (SELECT AVG(data1) FROM customers c2 WHERE c2.geoid = d.geoid AND c2.age > 98) AS avg_data1_for_older_in_region, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_sex FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON s.refid = m1.refid AND s.event_date >= m1.ref_date LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON s.refid = m3.refid AND s.event_date >= m3.ref_date WHERE d.inhabitants_k > '0.0' AND s.event_date >= '2000-01-01' AND s.amount > '0.0' AND c.age BETWEEN 51 AND 85 GROUP BY d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0.0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 2 ORDER BY total_sales DESC, avg_income DESC;
