SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailings3_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(d.inhabitants_k) AS avg_inhabitants, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(d.a_var1 + d.a_var2 + d.a_var3 + d.a_var4 + d.a_var5 + d.a_var6 + d.a_var7 + d.a_var8 + d.a_var9 + d.a_var10 + d.a_var11 + d.a_var12 + d.a_var13 + d.a_var14 + d.a_var15 + d.a_var16 + d.a_var17 + d.a_var18) AS sum_all_a_vars, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_demographic FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date BETWEEN m1.ref_date AND m3.ref_date WHERE c.age > 57 AND d.income_k BETWEEN 393.62 AND 356.12 AND (c.nom1 LIKE 'A%' OR c.nom2 LIKE 'A%' OR c.nom3 LIKE 'A%') AND m1.response = 'Yes' AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND m3.ref_date <= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) > 55 AND SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, avg_income DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(d.a_var1 + d.a_var2 + d.a_var3 + d.a_var4 + d.a_var5 + d.a_var6 + d.a_var7 + d.a_var8 + d.a_var9 + d.a_var10 + d.a_var11 + d.a_var12 + d.a_var13 + d.a_var14 + d.a_var15 + d.a_var16 + d.a_var17 + d.a_var18) AS sum_all_vars, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY d.geoid, c.sex ORDER BY c.marital_status) AS prev_mailing_count FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE c.age >= 51 AND c.educationnum >= 9 AND d.income_k >= 635.5 AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.amount > '0' GROUP BY d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) > 67 AND SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND AVG(d.income_k) BETWEEN 347.37 AND 612.56 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, mailings_count DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS total_mailings, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses_m1, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS unique_sales_events, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_demo FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date >= m1.ref_date WHERE d.inhabitants_k > '0' AND d.income_k BETWEEN 128.43 AND 379.56 AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) > 28 AND SUM(s.amount) > '0' UNION ALL SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS total_mailings, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses_m3, AVG(d.a_var3) AS avg_a_var3, AVG(d.a_var4) AS avg_a_var4, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS unique_sales_events, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_demo FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date >= m3.ref_date WHERE d.inhabitants_k > '0' AND d.income_k BETWEEN 271.99 AND 422.39 AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) > 43 AND SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY geoid, sex, marital_status, occupation;

SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, COUNT(DISTINCT m12.refid) AS total_mailings, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS total_sales, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(d.inhabitants_k) AS avg_inhabitants, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(d.a_var1 + d.a_var2 + d.a_var3 + d.a_var4 + d.a_var5 + d.a_var6 + d.a_var7 + d.a_var8 + d.a_var9 + d.a_var10 + d.a_var11 + d.a_var12 + d.a_var13 + d.a_var14 + d.a_var15 + d.a_var16 + d.a_var17 + d.a_var18) AS sum_all_vars, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_demog, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY d.geoid, c.sex ORDER BY c.occupation) AS prev_sales_count FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m12 ON c.id = m12.refid AND m12.response = 'YES' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.response = 'YES' WHERE d.inhabitants_k > '0' AND d.income_k BETWEEN 77.83 AND 391.34 AND c.age >= 88 AND (m12.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' OR m12.ref_date IS NULL) AND (s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' OR s.event_date IS NULL) AND (m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' OR m3.ref_date IS NULL) GROUP BY d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) > 320 AND SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_amount DESC, total_sales DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM m1.ref_date) AS mailing_year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM m1.ref_date) AS mailing_month, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS total_mailings, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN m1.refid END) AS positive_responses, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS total_sales, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(d.inhabitants_k) AS total_inhabitants, AVG(c.age) AS avg_age, AVG(c.educationnum) AS avg_education, SUM(d.a_var1 + d.a_var2 + d.a_var3 + d.a_var4 + d.a_var5 + d.a_var6 + d.a_var7 + d.a_var8 + d.a_var9 + d.a_var10 + d.a_var11 + d.a_var12 + d.a_var13 + d.a_var14 + d.a_var15 + d.a_var16 + d.a_var17 + d.a_var18) AS sum_all_vars, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_demographic FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON m1.refid = s.refid AND s.event_date BETWEEN m1.ref_date AND m1.ref_date + INTERVAL '30 days' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date > m1.ref_date WHERE d.income_k > 730.3 AND c.age BETWEEN 53 AND 57 AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND (c.educationnum > 4 OR c.occupation IN ('Prof-specialty', 'Exec-managerial', 'Sales')) AND d.a_var1 < '0' AND d.a_var2 > '0' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM m1.ref_date), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM m1.ref_date)), (d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation), (d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status), (d.geoid, c.sex), (d.geoid), (c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation), (c.sex, c.marital_status), (c.sex), (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM m1.ref_date), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM m1.ref_date)), () ) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) > 931 AND SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, mailing_year, mailing_month;

SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM m1.ref_date) AS mailing_year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM m1.ref_date) AS mailing_month, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date) AS sales_year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM s.event_date) AS sales_month, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS total_mailings, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS total_sales, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, AVG(d.inhabitants_k) AS avg_inhabitants, SUM(d.a_var1 + d.a_var2 + d.a_var3 + d.a_var4 + d.a_var5 + d.a_var6 + d.a_var7 + d.a_var8 + d.a_var9 + d.a_var10 + d.a_var11 + d.a_var12 + d.a_var13 + d.a_var14 + d.a_var15 + d.a_var16 + d.a_var17 + d.a_var18) AS sum_all_a_vars, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_demog, LAG(SUM(s.amount), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY d.geoid, c.sex ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM s.event_date)) AS prev_month_sales FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON m1.refid = s.refid AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM m1.ref_date) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date) AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM m1.ref_date) = EXTRACT(MONTH FROM s.event_date) LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m1.ref_date < m3.ref_date WHERE d.income_k > 844.37 AND d.inhabitants_k BETWEEN '0' AND '10' AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND (s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' OR s.event_date IS NULL) AND c.age >= 100 AND c.educationnum >= 10 AND m1.response = 'YES' GROUP BY CUBE(d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM m1.ref_date), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM m1.ref_date), EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM s.event_date)) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) > 109 OR COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) = 0 ORDER BY total_amount DESC NULLS LAST, total_sales DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.occupation, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS unique_mailings_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid)) OVER (PARTITION BY d.geoid ORDER BY DATE_TRUNC('month', m1.ref_date) RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '30 days' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_30day_mailings FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON m1.refid = s.refid AND s.event_date BETWEEN m1.ref_date - INTERVAL '7 days' AND m1.ref_date + INTERVAL '7 days' WHERE d.income_k > 531.04 AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND c.age BETWEEN 89 AND 79 GROUP BY d.geoid, c.sex, c.occupation, DATE_TRUNC('month', m1.ref_date) HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(c.age) AS avg_age, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailing_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mailings3 m3 WHERE m3.response = 'YES' AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND m3.ref_date <= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND m3.refid IN (SELECT s2.refid FROM sales s2 WHERE s2.event_date >= '2019-01-01 00:00:00' AND s2.amount > '0')) AS recent_positive_mailings, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(d.income_k) ASC) AS income_percentile FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON s.refid = m1.refid AND s.event_date BETWEEN m1.ref_date AND m1.ref_date + INTERVAL '30 days' WHERE d.inhabitants_k > '0' AND d.income_k BETWEEN 180.04 AND 47.8 AND c.age >= 34 AND s.event_date >= '2018-01-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT m1.kxindex) >= 16 ORDER BY total_sales DESC, avg_age ASC;

SELECT d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(c.age) AS avg_age, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS unique_mailings, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT m3.refid FROM mailings3 m3 WHERE m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m3.ref_date <= '2020-01-01' AND m3.response = 'Yes') AS sub_sub) AS recent_positive_mailings_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid WHERE d.income_k > 542.82 AND c.age BETWEEN 97 AND 19 AND s.event_date >= '2019-01-01' GROUP BY d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) >= 852 ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(c.age) AS avg_age, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS unique_mailings_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE d.income_k > 791.77 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.event_date <= '2020-01-01' AND c.id IN ( SELECT s2.refid FROM sales s2 WHERE s2.amount > '0' GROUP BY s2.refid HAVING COUNT(s2.eventid) >= 81 ) GROUP BY d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(c.age) AS avg_customer_age, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS unique_mailings1_2_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS unique_mailings3_count, SUM(SUM(s.amount)) OVER (PARTITION BY d.geoid ORDER BY d.income_k) AS running_total_sales_by_income FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE s.amount > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND d.income_k BETWEEN 450.59 AND 415.6 GROUP BY d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > (SELECT AVG(amount) * 0.77 FROM sales WHERE event_date >= '2020-01-01') ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

SELECT d1.geoid, d1.inhabitants_k AS inhabitants_k_1, d2.inhabitants_k AS inhabitants_k_2, AVG(d1.income_k) AS avg_income_1, AVG(d2.income_k) AS avg_income_2, SUM(s1.amount) AS total_sales_amount_1, SUM(s2.amount) AS total_sales_amount_2, COUNT(DISTINCT c1.id) AS unique_customers_1, COUNT(DISTINCT c2.id) AS unique_customers_2 FROM demog d1 JOIN demog d2 ON d1.geoid = d2.geoid JOIN customers c1 ON d1.geoid = c1.geoid JOIN customers c2 ON d2.geoid = c2.geoid JOIN sales s1 ON c1.id = s1.refid JOIN sales s2 ON c2.id = s2.refid WHERE d1.inhabitants_k > '0' AND d2.inhabitants_k < '0' AND s1.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s2.event_date <= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY d1.geoid, d1.inhabitants_k, d2.inhabitants_k HAVING AVG(d1.income_k) > 202.64 AND AVG(d2.income_k) < 454.64 ORDER BY d1.geoid;

WITH customer_agg AS ( SELECT c.geoid, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS customer_count, AVG(c.educationnum) AS avg_education, SUM(d.a_var1 + d.a_var2 + d.a_var3) AS demographic_sum FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid WHERE c.age BETWEEN 67 AND 47 GROUP BY c.geoid ), mailing_response AS ( SELECT m.refid, COUNT(*) AS mailing_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m.response = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses FROM mailings1_2 m WHERE m.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY m.refid HAVING COUNT(*) > 6 ), sales_agg AS ( SELECT s.refid, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS unique_events FROM sales s WHERE s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY s.refid ) SELECT ca.geoid, ca.customer_count, ca.avg_education, ca.demographic_sum, mr.mailing_count, mr.positive_responses, sa.total_sales, sa.unique_events, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sa.total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM customer_agg ca JOIN mailing_response mr ON ca.geoid = mr.refid JOIN sales_agg sa ON mr.refid = sa.refid WHERE ca.demographic_sum > '0' ORDER BY sa.total_sales DESC LIMIT 100;

WITH customer_agg AS ( SELECT c.id AS c_id, c.geoid AS c_geoid, c.age AS c_age, c.educationnum AS c_educationnum, COUNT(DISTINCT m12.refid) AS m12_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS m3_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m12.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS m12_yes, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS m3_yes, AVG(c.data1) AS avg_data1, AVG(c.data2) AS avg_data2, AVG(c.data3) AS avg_data3 GROUP BY c.id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m12.refid) > 10 OR COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) > 10 ), sales_agg AS ( SELECT s.refid AS s_refid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS AVG(d.a_var9) AS avg_var9, AVG(d.a_var10) AS avg_var10, AVG(d.a_var11) AS avg_var11, AVG(d.a_var12) AS avg_var12, AVG(d.a_var13) AS avg_var13, AVG(d.a_var14) AS avg_var14, AVG(d.a_var15) AS avg_var15, AVG(d.a_var16) AS avg_var16, AVG(d.a_var17) AS avg_var17, AVG(d.a_var18) AS avg_var18 FROM demog d WHERE d.income_k > 180.42 GROUP BY d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING AVG(d.a_var1) > '0' AND AVG(d.a_var2) < '0' ) SELECT ca.c_id, ca.c_age, ca.c_educationnum, ca.m12_count, ca.m3_count, ca.m12_yes, ca.m3_yes, ca.avg_data1, ca.avg_data2, ca.avg_data3, sa.sales_count, sa.total_amount, sa.avg_amount, sa.first_sale, sa.last_sale, da.d_inhabitants_k, da.d_income_k, da.avg_var1, da.avg_var2, da.avg_var3, da.avg_var4, da.avg_var5, da.avg_var6, da.avg_var7, da.avg_var8, da.avg_var9, da.avg_var10, da.avg_var11, da.avg_var12, da.avg_var13, da.avg_var14, da.avg_var15, da.avg_var16, da.avg_var17, da.avg_var18, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sa.total_amount DESC) AS sales_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ca.m12_yes + ca.m3_yes DESC) AS response_rank, LAG(sa.total_amount, 1) OVER (ORDER BY sa.total_amount) AS prev_total_amount FROM customer_agg ca INNER JOIN sales_agg sa ON ca.c_id = sa.s_refid INNER JOIN demog_agg da ON ca.c_geoid = da.d_geoid WHERE ca.c_age > 41 AND sa.total_amount > '5000' ORDER BY sa.total_amount DESC, ca.c_age ASC LIMIT 895;

WITH customer_agg AS ( SELECT c.id AS c_id, c.geoid AS c_geoid, c.age AS c_age, c.educationnum AS c_educationnum, COUNT(DISTINCT m12.refid) AS m12_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS m3_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m12.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS m12_yes, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS m3_yes, AVG(c.data1) AS avg_data1, AVG(c.data2) AS avg_data2, AVG(c.data3) AS avg_data3 AVG(d.a_var4) AS avg_a_var4, AVG(d.a_var5) AS avg_a_var5, AVG(d.a_var6) AS avg_a_var6, AVG(d.a_var7) AS avg_a_var7, AVG(d.a_var8) AS avg_a_var8, AVG(d.a_var9) AS avg_a_var9, AVG(d.a_var10) AS avg_a_var10, AVG(d.a_var11) AS avg_a_var11, AVG(d.a_var12) AS avg_a_var12, AVG(d.a_var13) AS avg_a_var13, AVG(d.a_var14) AS avg_a_var14, AVG(d.a_var15) AS avg_a_var15, AVG(d.a_var16) AS avg_a_var16, SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) OVER(PARTITION BY d.geoid) AS avg_a_var1_by_geoid, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS unique_sales_events, COUNT(m1.refid) AS mailings1_2_count, COUNT(m3.refid) AS mailings3_count, (SELECT MAX(mx.amount) FROM sales mx WHERE mx.refid = c.id AND mx.event_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00') AS max_sale_after_date, (SELECT MIN(my.event_date) FROM sales my WHERE my.refid = c.id AND my.amount > '100.0') AS first_high_value_sale_date FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.response = 'Yes' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' WHERE (c.age > 26 OR c.educationnum < 13) AND (d.income_k > 412.49 OR d.inhabitants_k < '0.0') AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sales sx WHERE sx.refid = c.id AND sx.amount > '500.0') OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mailings1_2 mx WHERE mx.refid = c.id AND mx.kxindex > 149)) GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0.0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 52 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, customer_id;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings_response_count, COUNT(s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(s.amount) FILTER (WHERE s.amount IS NOT NULL) AS avg_sale_amount, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC NULLS LAST) AS sales_rank FROM customers c LEFT JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE c.age >= 86 AND c.age <= 23 AND d.income_k >= 68.25 AND (m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' OR m1.ref_date IS NULL) AND (s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' OR s.event_date IS NULL) GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING COUNT(s.eventid) < 81 OR COUNT(s.eventid) IS NULL ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC NULLS LAST, customer_id;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings_yes_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sales_amount FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE c.age >= 19 AND c.age <= 92 AND d.income_k >= 25.14 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) > 2 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date) AS sale_year, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM s.event_date) AS sale_quarter, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS total_sales, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_geoid_income, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date), c.sex ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS spending_rank_by_sex_year FROM customers c JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid WHERE s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.amount > '0' AND d.income_k BETWEEN 369.55 AND 162.33 GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM s.event_date) HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY sale_year, sale_quarter, spending_rank_by_sex_year;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m12.refid) AS mailings_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailings3_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN m12.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses_m12, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses_m3, SUM(d.a_var1 * d.a_var2) AS demographic_interaction1, SUM(d.a_var3 + d.a_var4 - d.a_var5) AS demographic_interaction2, CORR(d.a_var6, d.a_var7) AS demographic_correlation, STDDEV(d.a_var8) AS demographic_var8_stddev, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY d.a_var9) AS demographic_var9_median, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank, LAG(SUM(s.amount), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY d.geoid) AS prev_total_sales_by_demo FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m12 ON c.id = m12.refid AND m12.ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date BETWEEN '2021-01-01 00:00:00' AND '2021-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 74 AND 28 AND c.educationnum >= 7 AND d.income_k > 329.2 AND (d.a_var10 > '0' OR d.a_var11 < '0') GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) > 213 AND SUM(s.amount) >= '0' AND AVG(s.amount) BETWEEN '0' AND '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT m12.refid) + COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) > 1 AND STDDEV(d.a_var8) < '0' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, sales_count DESC, demographic_interaction1 ASC LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date) AS sale_year, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM s.event_date) AS sale_quarter, m1.response AS mailing1_response, m3.response AS mailing3_response, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS total_sales, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.ref_date) AS mailing1_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.ref_date) AS mailing3_count, SUM(d.a_var1 + d.a_var2 + d.a_var3 + d.a_var4 + d.a_var5 + d.a_var6 + d.a_var7 + d.a_var8 + d.a_var9 + d.a_var10 + d.a_var11 + d.a_var12 + d.a_var13 + d.a_var14 + d.a_var15 + d.a_var16 + d.a_var17 + d.a_var18) AS demog_var_sum, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS spending_rank_by_demog FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND s.event_date >= m1.ref_date JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND s.event_date >= m3.ref_date WHERE s.amount > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.event_date <= '2020-01-01' AND c.age BETWEEN 44 AND 66 AND d.income_k > 188.89 AND d.inhabitants_k > '0' AND (m1.response = 'Yes' OR m3.response = 'Yes') GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM s.event_date), m1.response, m3.response), (c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM s.event_date)), (c.sex, c.marital_status), (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM s.event_date)), () ) HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 38 ORDER BY total_amount DESC, sale_year, sale_quarter;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, COUNT(DISTINCT m.refid) AS mailings_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_sex FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m ON c.id = m.refid AND m.response = 'YES' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE c.age >= 37 AND c.age <= 46 AND d.income_k > 71.44 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m.refid) > 8 AND SUM(s.amount) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE (c.age BETWEEN 52 AND 93) AND (c.educationnum > 1 OR c.marital_status = 'Married-civ-spouse') AND NOT (d.income_k < 182.09) AND (m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' OR m1.ref_date IS NULL) GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, COUNT(DISTINCT m12.refid) AS mailings_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m12.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC NULLS LAST) AS sales_rank_by_sex FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m12 ON c.id = m12.refid AND m12.ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND '2020-01-01 00:00:00' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 64 AND 86 AND d.inhabitants_k > '0.0' AND (c.educationnum > 5 OR c.nom1 = 'A') GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0.0' OR COUNT(DISTINCT m12.refid) < 77 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC NULLS LAST;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.income_k, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT m1.response, ', ' ORDER BY m1.response) AS mailing_responses, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS total_sales, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE c.age >= 41 AND c.educationnum >= 12 AND d.income_k >= 258.51 AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' OR SUM(s.amount) IS NULL ORDER BY total_amount DESC NULLS LAST, d.income_k DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, SUM(d.a_var2) AS sum_a_var2, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS distinct_mailings1_2_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS distinct_mailings3_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(s.eventid) AS sales_count, AVG(SUM(s.amount)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY d.income_k ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_avg_sales_by_demo FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.response = 'YES' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.response = 'YES' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE c.age >= 98 AND c.educationnum >= 2 AND d.income_k >= 18.05 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.amount > '0' GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '1000' AND COUNT(s.eventid) >= 31 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, d.income_k ASC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS distinct_mailings1_2_refs, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS distinct_mailings3_refs, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS distinct_sales_events, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2, AVG(d.a_var3) AS avg_a_var3, AVG(d.a_var4) AS avg_a_var4, AVG(d.a_var5) AS avg_a_var5, AVG(d.a_var6) AS avg_a_var6, AVG(d.a_var7) AS avg_a_var7, AVG(d.a_var8) AS avg_a_var8, AVG(d.a_var9) AS avg_a_var9, AVG(d.a_var10) AS avg_a_var10, AVG(d.a_var11) AS avg_a_var11, AVG(d.a_var12) AS avg_a_var12, AVG(d.a_var13) AS avg_a_var13, AVG(d.a_var14) AS avg_a_var14, AVG(d.a_var15) AS avg_a_var15, AVG(d.a_var16) AS avg_a_var16, AVG(d.a_var17) AS avg_a_var17, AVG(d.a_var18) AS avg_a_var18, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_sex, LAG(SUM(s.amount), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.geoid ORDER BY d.income_k DESC) AS prev_total_sales_in_geoid FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.response = 'YES' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.response = 'YES' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE c.age >= 30 AND c.age <= 94 AND c.educationnum >= 14 AND d.income_k >= 499.18 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.event_date <= '2020-01-01' AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) > 58 AND COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) > 49 AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) > 72 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, d.income_k DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS total_mailings, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses_m1, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses_m3, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS total_sales, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND s.amount > '0.0' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 52 AND 83 AND d.income_k > 21.22 GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) > 53 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.id, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS distinct_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS distinct_mailings1_2, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS distinct_mailings3, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE c.age > 53 AND d.income_k < 201.47 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.id HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_amount DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.id, c.age, d.geoid, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.amount > '0' GROUP BY c.id, c.age, d.geoid HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '1000' INTERSECT SELECT c.id, c.age, d.geoid, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m ON c.id = m.refid WHERE m.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m.response = 'Yes' GROUP BY c.id, c.age, d.geoid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m.kxindex) >= 3 ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, AVG(c.age) AS avg_age, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS unique_mailings, SUM(d.inhabitants_k) AS total_inhabitants, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY d.income_k) AS median_income, SUM(d.a_var1 + d.a_var2 + d.a_var3 + d.a_var4 + d.a_var5 + d.a_var6 + d.a_var7 + d.a_var8 + d.a_var9 + d.a_var10 + d.a_var11 + d.a_var12 + d.a_var13 + d.a_var14 + d.a_var15 + d.a_var16 + d.a_var17 + d.a_var18) AS sum_all_vars, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE c.age > 63 AND s.amount > '10' AND d.income_k > 92.9 AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY d.geoid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) > 46 AND AVG(c.educationnum) > 18 INTERSECT SELECT d.geoid, AVG(c.age) AS avg_age, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS unique_mailings, SUM(d.inhabitants_k) AS total_inhabitants, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY d.income_k) AS median_income, SUM(d.a_var1 + d.a_var2 + d.a_var3 + d.a_var4 + d.a_var5 + d.a_var6 + d.a_var7 + d.a_var8 + d.a_var9 + d.a_var10 + d.a_var11 + d.a_var12 + d.a_var13 + d.a_var14 + d.a_var15 + d.a_var16 + d.a_var17 + d.a_var18) AS sum_all_vars, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE c.age < 76 AND s.amount < '10001' AND d.income_k < 457.93 AND m1.ref_date <= '2024-01-01' AND m3.ref_date <= '2024-01-01' GROUP BY d.geoid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) < 322 AND AVG(c.educationnum) < 21 ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) OVER(PARTITION BY d.geoid) AS avg_a_var1_by_geoid, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS distinct_sales_events, MAX(m1.ref_date) AS latest_mailing1_date, MIN(m3.ref_date) AS earliest_mailing3_date, COUNT(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 END) AS positive_responses_m1, COUNT(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 END) AS positive_responses_m3, (SELECT AVG(sub_s.amount) FROM sales sub_s WHERE sub_s.refid = c.id AND sub_s.event_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00') AS avg_recent_sales FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE c.age BETWEEN 41 AND 99 AND d.income_k > 89.67 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mailings1_2 ex_m WHERE ex_m.refid = c.id AND ex_m.kxindex > 651) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mailings3 ex_m3 WHERE ex_m3.refid = c.id AND ex_m3.ref_date <= '2020-01-01 00:00:00') GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 99 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, c.id;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS total_mailings, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS recent_mailings, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailing_responses, SUM(CASE WHEN s.amount > '100' THEN s.amount ELSE 0 END) AS high_value_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS total_sales, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_demog_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_demog_var2, SUM(d.a_var3 * d.a_var4) AS demog_interaction_sum, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s.amount) FILTER (WHERE s.event_date >= '2020-01-01') AS median_recent_sale, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date >= '2022-01-01' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE c.age BETWEEN 62 AND 45 AND c.educationnum >= 8 AND d.income_k > 165.66 AND s.event_date >= '2018-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '500' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 38 ORDER BY sales_rank, high_value_sales DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS unique_sales_events, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings1_2_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailings3_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings1_2_yes_responses, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings3_yes_responses, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_demographic, LAG(SUM(s.amount), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.id ORDER BY DATE_TRUNC('month', s.event_date)) AS prev_month_sales FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE s.amount > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.event_date <= '2020-01-01' AND d.income_k BETWEEN 294.32 AND 59.85 AND c.age >= 56 AND c.educationnum >= 2 AND (m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' OR m1.ref_date IS NULL) AND (m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' OR m3.ref_date IS NULL) GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, DATE_TRUNC('month', s.event_date) HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 26 AND AVG(d.a_var1) > '-100' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, sales_rank_by_demographic;

ca.c_age > 28 AND sa.total_amount > '0' ORDER BY sa.total_amount DESC, ca.c_age ASC LIMIT 152;

HAVING AVG(c.data1) > '0' ), mailing_response_agg AS ( SELECT m.refid, COUNT(*) AS total_mailings, SUM(CASE WHEN m.response = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses, MIN(m.ref_date) AS first_mailing_date, MAX(m.ref_date) AS last_mailing_date FROM ( SELECT refid, ref_date, response FROM mailings1_2 UNION ALL SELECT refid, ref_date, response FROM mailings3 ) m WHERE m.ref_date >= WITH customer_agg AS ( SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.geoid, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.ref_date) AS mailings_count, MAX(m1.kxindex) AS max_kxindex, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings_yes_count FROM customers c LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid WHERE c.age BETWEEN 50 AND 76 AND c.educationnum >= 14 GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.geoid, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status ), sales_agg AS ( SELECT s.refid, COUNT(*) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_amount, MIN(s.event_date) AS first_sale_date, MAX(s.event_date) AS last_sale_date FROM sales s WHERE s.amount > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY s.refid ), demog_agg AS ( SELECT d.geoid, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(d.inhabitants_k) AS total_inhabitants, COUNT(*) AS demog_records FROM demog d WHERE d.income_k >= 231.07 AND d.a_var1 BETWEEN '0' AND '0' GROUP BY d.geoid ) SELECT ca.customer_id, ca.age, ca.educationnum, ca.sex, ca.marital_status, ca.mailings_count, ca.max_kxindex, ca.mailings_yes_count, COALESCE(sa.sales_count, 0) AS sales_count, COALESCE(sa.total_amount, 0) AS total_sales_amount, COALESCE(sa.avg_amount, 0) AS avg_sale_amount, sa.first_sale_date, sa.last_sale_date, da.avg_income, da.total_inhabitants, da.demog_records, CASE WHEN sa.sales_count > 0 THEN 'HAS_SALES' ELSE 'NO_SALES' END AS sales_status FROM customer_agg ca LEFT JOIN sales_agg sa ON ca.customer_id = sa.refid LEFT JOIN demog_agg da ON ca.geoid = da.geoid WHERE (ca.mailings_count >= 1 OR ca.mailings_count IS NULL) AND (ca.mailings_yes_count >= 9 OR ca.mailings_yes_count IS NULL) AND (da.avg_income IS NULL OR da.avg_income <= 132.23) ORDER BY ca.age DESC, total_sales_amount DESC LIMIT 428;

WITH customer_agg AS ( SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.geoid, c.educationnum, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings_response_count, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sale_amount FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE c.age BETWEEN 99 AND 27 AND d.income_k >= 388.28 GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.geoid, c.educationnum, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k ), moving_avg AS ( SELECT customer_id, age, geoid, educationnum, inhabitants_k, income_k, mailings_count, mailings_response_count, avg_sale_amount, total_sale_amount, AVG(total_sale_amount) OVER ( PARTITION BY geoid ORDER BY income_k ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_sales_by_geo_income FROM customer_agg ) SELECT geoid, COUNT(customer_id) AS customer_count, AVG(age) AS avg_age, AVG(educationnum) AS avg_education, SUM(inhabitants_k) AS total_inhabitants_k, AVG(income_k) AS avg_income_k, SUM(mailings_count) AS total_mailings, SUM(mailings_response_count) AS total_responses, AVG(avg_sale_amount) AS overall_avg_sale_amount, SUM(total_sale_amount) AS grand_total_sales, AVG(moving_avg_sales_by_geo_income) AS avg_moving_avg_sales FROM moving_avg WHERE total_sale_amount > '0' GROUP BY geoid HAVING AVG(income_k) >= 126.2 ORDER BY grand_total_sales DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2, AVG(d.a_var3) AS avg_a_var3, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS unique_sales_events, COUNT(DISTINCT m12.refid) AS mailings1_2_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailings3_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mailings1_2 m12_sub WHERE m12_sub.refid = c.id AND m12_sub.response = 'YES' AND m12_sub.ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00') AS recent_m12_yes_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mailings3 m3_sub WHERE m3_sub.refid = c.id AND m3_sub.response = 'YES' AND m3_sub.ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00') AS recent_m3_yes_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.marital_status ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_marital, LAG(SUM(s.amount), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.geoid ORDER BY c.age) AS prev_sales_amount_by_geo_age FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date >= '2019-01-01 00:00:00' AND s.amount > '0.0' LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m12 ON c.id = m12.refid AND m12.ref_date BETWEEN '2019-01-01 00:00:00' AND '2019-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date BETWEEN '2019-01-01 00:00:00' AND '2019-01-01 00:00:00' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 51 AND 93 AND c.educationnum >= 18 AND d.income_k > 154.44 AND d.a_var4 < '0.0' AND (d.a_var5 > '0.0' OR d.a_var6 < '0.0') GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0.0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 42 AND AVG(d.a_var1) BETWEEN '0.0' AND '0.0' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, c.age ASC;

SELECT c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.age, c.sex) AS avg_a_var1_by_demo, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings1_2_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailings3_count, MAX(m1.ref_date) AS latest_mailing1_2_date, MAX(m3.ref_date) AS latest_mailing3_date FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE s.amount > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND c.age BETWEEN 95 AND 48 AND d.income_k > 747.95 GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) >= 98 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, c.id;

SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(d.inhabitants_k) AS total_inhabitants, SUM(d.a_var1 + d.a_var2 + d.a_var3 + d.a_var4 + d.a_var5 + d.a_var6 + d.a_var7 + d.a_var8 + d.a_var9 + d.a_var10 + d.a_var11 + d.a_var12 + d.a_var13 + d.a_var14 + d.a_var15 + d.a_var16 + d.a_var17 + d.a_var18) AS sum_all_vars, (SELECT AVG(age) FROM customers WHERE geoid = d.geoid AND age > 32) AS avg_age_above_threshold, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_demographic FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND m1.ref_date <= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND s.event_date <= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND m3.ref_date <= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' WHERE d.income_k > 559.96 AND d.inhabitants_k < '0' AND c.age BETWEEN 40 AND 86 GROUP BY d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) > 753 AND SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, avg_income DESC;

WITH customer_agg AS ( SELECT c.id AS c_id, c.age, c.geoid, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2 FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid WHERE c.age BETWEEN 65 AND 67 AND d.income_k > 194.4 GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.geoid, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) > 100 ), sales_agg AS ( SELECT s.refid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, MAX(s.event_date) AS last_sale_date, MIN(s.event_date) AS first_sale_date, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount FROM sales s WHERE s.amount > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY s.refid HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '100' ), mailings3_agg AS ( SELECT m3.refid, COUNT(*) AS m3_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS m3_positive FROM mailings3 m3 WHERE m3.ref_date >= '2023-01-01' GROUP BY m3.refid HAVING COUNT(*) > 17 ) SELECT ca.c_id, ca.age, ca.educationnum, ca.sex, ca.marital_status, ca.mailings_count, ca.positive_responses, ca.avg_a_var1, ca.avg_a_var2, COALESCE(sa.sales_count, 0) AS sales_count, COALESCE(sa.total_amount, 0) AS total_sales_amount, COALESCE(sa.avg_sale_amount, 0) AS avg_sale_amount, COALESCE(ma.m3_count, 0) AS m3_mailings_count, COALESCE(ma.m3_positive, 0) AS m3_positive_responses, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(sa.total_amount, 0) DESC) AS sales_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ca.sex ORDER BY ca.positive_responses DESC) AS response_rank_by_sex FROM customer_agg ca LEFT JOIN sales_agg sa ON ca.c_id = sa.refid LEFT JOIN mailings3_agg ma ON ca.c_id = ma.refid WHERE COALESCE(sa.total_amount, 0) > '0' OR COALESCE(ma.m3_count, 0) > 20 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, ca.positive_responses DESC LIMIT 987;

WITH customer_agg AS ( SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.geoid, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.ref_date) AS mailings_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.ref_date) AS mailings3_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings_yes, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings3_yes, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2, AVG(d.a_var3) AS avg_a_var3 FROM customers c LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid LEFT JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid WHERE c.age BETWEEN 56 AND 78 AND d.income_k > 440.86 GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.geoid, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation ), sales_agg AS ( SELECT s.refid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_amount, MIN(s.event_date) AS first_sale, MAX(s.event_date) AS last_sale FROM sales s WHERE s.amount > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY s.refid ) SELECT COALESCE(ca.sex, 'ALL') AS sex, COALESCE(ca.marital_status, 'ALL') AS marital_status, COALESCE(ca.occupation, 'ALL') AS occupation, COUNT(DISTINCT ca.customer_id) AS customer_count, SUM(sa.total_amount) AS grand_total_sales, AVG(sa.avg_amount) AS avg_sale_per_customer, SUM(ca.mailings_count) AS total_mailings, SUM(ca.mailings_yes) AS total_mailings_yes_responses, (SUM(ca.mailings_yes) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(ca.mailings_count), 0)) AS mailing_response_rate, AVG(ca.avg_a_var1) AS demog_var1_avg, AVG(ca.avg_a_var2) AS demog_var2_avg, AVG(ca.avg_a_var3) AS demog_var3_avg FROM customer_agg ca LEFT JOIN sales_agg sa ON ca.customer_id = sa.refid WHERE ca.educationnum > 19 AND ca.mailings_count >= 83 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (ca.sex, ca.marital_status, ca.occupation), (ca.sex, ca.marital_status), (ca.sex, ca.occupation), (ca.marital_status, ca.occupation), (ca.sex), (ca.marital_status), (ca.occupation), () ) HAVING SUM(sa.total_amount) > '0' OR SUM(sa.total_amount) IS NULL ORDER BY sex, marital_status, occupation, grand_total_sales DESC;

WITH ranked_sales AS ( SELECT s.refid, s.event_date, s.amount, c.id, c.age, c.educationnum, c.geoid AS customer_geoid, d.geoid AS demog_geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, d.a_var1, d.a_var2, d.a_var3, d.a_var4, d.a_var5, d.a_var6, d.a_var7, d.a_var8, d.a_var9, d.a_var10, d.a_var11, d.a_var12, d.a_var13, d.a_var14, d.a_var15, d.a_var16, d.a_var17, d.a_var18, m1.ref_date AS mailing1_date, m1.response AS mailing1_response, m3.ref_date AS mailing3_date, m3.response AS mailing3_response, SUM(s.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY c.id ORDER BY s.event_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_total, AVG(s.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY c.geoid, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date)) AS avg_amount_by_geoid_year, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.geoid ORDER BY s.amount DESC) AS rank_in_geoid FROM sales s JOIN customers c ON s.refid = c.id JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON s.refid = m1.refid AND s.event_date >= m1.ref_date LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON s.refid = m3.refid AND s.event_date >= m3.ref_date WHERE s.amount > '10' AND s.event_date BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND '2021-01-01' AND c.age BETWEEN 52 AND 65 AND d.income_k > 66.57 AND d.inhabitants_k < '1' ), aggregated AS ( SELECT customer_geoid, demog_geoid, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM event_date) AS sale_year, COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS unique_customers, SUM(amount) AS total_sales, AVG(amount) AS avg_sale_amount, MAX(running_total) AS max_running_total, AVG(avg_amount_by_geoid_year) AS avg_yearly_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN mailing1_response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_mailing1_responses, SUM(CASE WHEN mailing3_response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_mailing3_responses, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY amount) AS median_sale_amount FROM ranked_sales WHERE rank_in_geoid <= 71 GROUP BY customer_geoid, demog_geoid, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM event_date) HAVING SUM(amount) > '1000' AND COUNT(DISTINCT id) >= 1 ) SELECT customer_geoid, demog_geoid, sale_year, unique_customers, total_sales, avg_sale_amount, max_running_total, avg_yearly_amount, positive_mailing1_responses, positive_mailing3_responses, median_sale_amount, total_sales / NULLIF(unique_customers, 0) AS sales_per_customer, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank, LAG(total_sales, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_geoid ORDER BY sale_year) AS prev_year_sales FROM aggregated ORDER BY total_sales DESC, sale_year, customer_geoid LIMIT 819;

SELECT c.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, c.sex, c.marital_status, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) FILTER (WHERE s.amount > '100') AS high_value_sales, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 67 AND 66 AND d.income_k > 327.24 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (c.geoid, d.inhabitants_k), (c.sex, c.marital_status), () ) ORDER BY total_sales DESC NULLS LAST;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, d.a_var1, d.a_var2, d.a_var3, d.a_var4, d.a_var5, d.a_var6, d.a_var7, d.a_var8, mailings3_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, MAX(s.event_date) AS last_sale_date, MIN(m12.ref_date) AS first_mailing1_2_date, MIN(m3.ref_date) AS first_mailing3_date, SUM(CASE WHEN m12.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses_m12, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses_m3, (SUM(CASE WHEN m12.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT m12.refid), 0)) AS response_rate_m12, (SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid), 0)) AS response_rate_m3, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s.amount) AS median_sale_amount, STDDEV(s.amount) AS stddev_sale_amount, CORR(d.income_k, s.amount) AS income_sales_correlation, CORR(d.a_var1, s.amount) AS var1_sales_correlation, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) DESC) AS transaction_rank, LAG(SUM(s.amount), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.geoid ORDER BY MAX(s.event_date)) AS prev_geoid_sales FROM customers c LEFT JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m12 ON c.id = m12.refid AND m12.ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND s.amount > '0.0' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 78 AND 76 AND c.educationnum >= 20 AND d.income_k >= 352.61 AND (m12.response IS NULL OR m12.response IN ('YES', 'NO')) AND (m3.response IS NULL OR m3.response IN ('YES', 'NO')) GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, d.a_var1, d.a_var2, d.a_var3, d.a_var4, d.a_var5, d.a_var6, d.a_var7, d.a_var8, d.a_var9, d.a_var10, d.a_var11, d.a_var12, d.a_var13, d.a_var14, d.a_var15, d.a_var16, d.a_var17, d.a_var18 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 650 AND SUM(s.amount) >= '0.0' AND (COUNT(DISTINCT m12.refid) > 0 OR COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) > 0) ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, sales_count DESC LIMIT 475;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, d.a_var1, d.a_var2, d.a_var3, d.a_var4, d.a_var5, d.a_var6, d.a_var7, d.a_var8, d.a_var9, d.a_var10, d.a_var11, d.a_var12, d.a_var13, d.a_var14, d.a_var15, d.a_var16, d.a_var17, d.a_var18, COUNT(DISTINCT m12.refid) AS total_mailings_12, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS total_mailings_3, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, COUNT(s.eventid) AS total_sales_events, SUM(CASE WHEN m12.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses_m12, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses_m3, AVG(SUM(s.amount)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.occupation, c.marital_status ORDER BY d.income_k ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_sales_by_occupation_marital, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_sex FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m12 ON c.id = m12.refid AND m12.ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND '2020-01-01 00:00:00' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 93 AND 77 AND c.educationnum >= 3 AND d.income_k > 917.72 AND d.inhabitants_k BETWEEN '0' AND '0' GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, d.a_var1, d.a_var2, d.a_var3, d.a_var4, d.a_var5, d.a_var6, d.a_var7, d.a_var8, d.a_var9, d.a_var10, d.a_var11, d.a_var12, d.a_var13, d.a_var14, d.a_var15, d.a_var16, d.a_var17, d.a_var18 HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(s.eventid) >= 582 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, sales_rank_by_sex ASC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sale_amount FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE c.age >= 73 AND c.age <= 23 AND d.income_k >= 418.31 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.income_k HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) > 61 AND SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_sale_amount DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.income_k, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date) AS sale_year, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM s.event_date) AS sale_quarter, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS total_sales, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings1_2_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailings3_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings1_2_yes, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings3_yes, SUM(d.a_var1 + d.a_var2 + d.a_var3 + d.a_var4 + d.a_var5 + d.a_var6 + d.a_var7 + d.a_var8 + d.a_var9 + d.a_var10 + d.a_var11 + d.a_var12 + d.a_var13 + d.a_var14 + d.a_var15 + d.a_var16 + d.a_var17 + d.a_var18) AS demographic_var_sum, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM s.event_date) ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_quarter FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date BETWEEN s.event_date - INTERVAL '30 days' AND s.event_date + INTERVAL '30 days' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date BETWEEN s.event_date - INTERVAL '30 days' AND s.event_date + INTERVAL '30 days' WHERE s.amount > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.event_date <= '2020-01-01' AND c.age BETWEEN 80 AND 26 AND d.income_k >= 229.73 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.income_k, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM s.event_date)), (c.sex, c.marital_status, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM s.event_date)), (d.geoid, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM s.event_date)), (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM s.event_date)), () ) HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 962 ORDER BY sale_year, sale_quarter, total_amount DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS distinct_mailings1_2_refs, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS distinct_mailings3_refs, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS distinct_sales_events, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_demog_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_demog_var2, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings1_2_yes_responses, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings3_yes_responses, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_amount_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) DESC) AS sales_event_rank_by_sex FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND '2020-01-01 00:00:00' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 68 AND 23 AND c.educationnum >= 3 AND d.income_k > 866.82 AND d.inhabitants_k < '0' GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) > 292 AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 375 AND SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, distinct_sales_events DESC;

SELECT c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m.refid) AS mailing_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m.response = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, (SELECT AVG(amount) FROM sales WHERE event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND event_date <= '2020-01-01') AS global_avg_sale FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m ON c.id = m.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 99 AND 78 AND d.income_k > 175.82 GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m.refid) > 57 AND SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS customer_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE d.income_k > 494.8 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY d.geoid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 202 ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(c.data1) AS total_data1, COUNT(DISTINCT m.refid) AS unique_mailings, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(d.income_k) DESC) AS income_rank FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN mailings1_2 m ON c.id = m.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON m.refid = s.refid WHERE d.inhabitants_k > '0' AND c.age BETWEEN 42 AND 80 AND m.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY d.geoid HAVING AVG(d.income_k) > 36.28 ORDER BY avg_income DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS unique_sales_events, COUNT(m1.response) FILTER (WHERE m1.response =
