SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS unique_sales_events, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings1_2_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailings3_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings1_2_yes_responses, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings3_yes_responses, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank, LAG(SUM(s.amount), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex ORDER BY d.income_k) AS prev_sales_by_sex_income FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE c.age >= 98 AND c.age <= 54 AND d.income_k > 562.64 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND (m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' OR m1.ref_date IS NULL) AND (m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' OR m3.ref_date IS NULL) GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 92 AND (COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) > 4 OR COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) > 35) ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, d.income_k ASC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS unique_sales_events, COUNT(m1.response) FILTER (WHERE m1.response = 'YES') AS mailings1_yes_responses, COUNT(m3.response) FILTER (WHERE m3.response = 'YES') AS mailings3_yes_responses, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_sex, LAG(SUM(s.amount), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.id ORDER BY MIN(s.event_date)) AS prev_sales_amount FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE c.age >= 27 AND c.age <= 18 AND d.income_k > 336.62 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.event_date <= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 88 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, c.id ASC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(m1.kxindex) AS avg_kxindex, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS total_sales, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, COUNT(m3.refid) AS mailings3_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS spending_rank FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE c.age >= 24 AND c.age <= 26 AND d.income_k > 467.83 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_amount DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m12.refid) AS mailings_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m12 ON c.id = m12.refid AND m12.ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 61 AND 47 AND d.income_k > 495.03 GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) > 22 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC LIMIT 128;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m12.refid) AS mailings_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m12.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings_yes_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(CASE WHEN c.educationnum > 16 THEN s.amount ELSE NULL END) AS avg_sales_high_edu, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS unique_sales_events FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m12 ON c.id = m12.refid AND m12.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 71 AND 73 GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS total_sales_events, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings1_2_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailings3_count, SUM(CASE WHEN s.amount > '100' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_value_sales_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings1_2_yes_responses, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings3_yes_responses, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2, STDDEV(d.a_var3) AS stddev_a_var3, CORR(d.a_var4, d.a_var5) AS corr_a_var4_a_var5, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s.amount) AS median_sale_amount, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank, LAG(SUM(s.amount), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex ORDER BY d.income_k DESC) AS prev_sales_by_sex_income FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 32 AND 82 AND d.income_k >= 378.96 AND (d.a_var6 > '-100' OR d.a_var7 < '-100') GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 172 AND (SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 63 OR SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 60) ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, sales_rank LIMIT 999;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_last_30_days, COUNT(s.eventid) AS transaction_count_last_30_days, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_transaction_amount_last_30_days, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses_last_30_days FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND s.event_date = m1.ref_date WHERE s.event_date >= '2023-01-01' AND s.amount > '0' AND c.age BETWEEN 32 AND 69 GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_sales_last_30_days DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_percentile FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 76 AND 57 AND d.inhabitants_k > '0' AND (c.educationnum > 20 OR c.nom1 = 'A') GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' OR COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) < 72 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date) AS sale_year, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM s.event_date) AS sale_quarter, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS total_sales, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM s.event_date) ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS revenue_rank_per_quarter FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date BETWEEN s.event_date - INTERVAL '30 days' AND s.event_date + INTERVAL '30 days' WHERE s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.amount > '10' AND d.income_k BETWEEN 42.53 AND 217.77 GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM s.event_date) HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '100' ORDER BY sale_year DESC, sale_quarter DESC, revenue_rank_per_quarter ASC;

SELECT c.id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.ref_date) AS distinct_mailings1_2_dates, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.ref_date) AS distinct_mailings3_dates, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'Yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses_m1, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'Yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses_m3, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s.amount) AS median_sale_amount, STDDEV(s.amount) AS stddev_sale_amount FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.kxindex > 64 LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 19 AND 69 AND d.income_k >= 349.67 AND d.inhabitants_k <= '1' GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '1000' AND COUNT(DISTINCT m1.ref_date) >= 2 AND AVG(d.a_var1) < '0' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, avg_a_var1 ASC LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date) AS sale_year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM s.event_date) AS sale_month, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS total_sales, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(d.inhabitants_k) AS total_inhabitants FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m ON c.id = m.refid WHERE s.amount > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.event_date < '2020-02-01' AND c.age BETWEEN 28 AND 79 GROUP BY CUBE(c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, sale_year, sale_month) HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '100' ORDER BY total_amount DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS customer_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(d.income_k) DESC) AS income_rank FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid WHERE d.income_k > 412.6 GROUP BY d.geoid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 19 ORDER BY avg_income DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS customer_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN mailings1_2 m ON c.id = m.refid WHERE d.geoid IN ( SELECT s.geoid FROM ( SELECT c2.geoid FROM customers c2 JOIN sales s2 ON c2.id = s2.refid WHERE s2.amount > '0' GROUP BY c2.geoid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s2.eventid) >= 53 ) s ) AND d.inhabitants_k > '0' GROUP BY d.geoid HAVING AVG(d.income_k) > 185.08 ORDER BY avg_income DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS customer_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date BETWEEN (m1.ref_date - INTERVAL '30 days') AND (m1.ref_date + INTERVAL '30 days') WHERE m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM m1.ref_date) = 2020 AND d.inhabitants_k > '0' GROUP BY d.geoid HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT d.geoid, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_events, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, (SELECT AVG(sub_avg) FROM (SELECT AVG(c.data1) AS sub_avg FROM customers c WHERE c.geoid = d.geoid AND c.age > 82 GROUP BY c.nom1) AS inner_sub) AS avg_data1_by_nom1 FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid JOIN sales s ON m1.refid = s.refid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON s.refid = m3.refid WHERE d.inhabitants_k >= '1' AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY d.geoid HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '1000' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 81 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS unique_customers, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses_m1, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses_m3, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank, AVG(d.a_var1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.marital_status) AS avg_a_var1_by_marital FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE s.amount > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND c.age BETWEEN 66 AND 28 GROUP BY d.geoid, c.marital_status HAVING AVG(d.income_k) > 171.15 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 625 INTERSECT SELECT d.geoid, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS unique_customers, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses_m1, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses_m3, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank, AVG(d.a_var1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.marital_status) AS avg_a_var1_by_marital FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE s.amount < '0' AND s.event_date <= '2020-01-01' AND c.educationnum > 8 GROUP BY d.geoid, c.marital_status HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND AVG(d.a_var2) < '0' ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS total_sales_events, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_geoid_income, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY d.a_var1) AS median_a_var1, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY d.a_var2) AS p75_a_var2, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) FILTER (WHERE m1.response = 'YES') AS mailings1_yes_responses, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) FILTER (WHERE m3.response = 'YES') AS mailings3_yes_responses, SUM(d.a_var3 * d.a_var4) / NULLIF(SUM(d.a_var5), 0) AS weighted_demog_ratio FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE s.amount > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND d.income_k BETWEEN 464.0 AND 240.87 AND c.age >= 88 GROUP BY d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 339 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date) AS sale_year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM s.event_date) AS sale_month, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS total_sales, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings1_2_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailings3_count, SUM(d.inhabitants_k) AS total_inhabitants, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(d.a_var1 * d.a_var2) AS demographic_score, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_demographic FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date BETWEEN s.event_date - INTERVAL '30 days' AND s.event_date + INTERVAL '30 days' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date BETWEEN s.event_date - INTERVAL '30 days' AND s.event_date + INTERVAL '30 days' WHERE s.amount > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.event_date <= '2020-01-01' AND c.age BETWEEN 39 AND 58 AND d.income_k > 80.19 GROUP BY CUBE(d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM s.event_date)) HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 659 ORDER BY total_amount DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(c.age) AS avg_age, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mailings3 m3 WHERE m3.refid IN (SELECT s2.refid FROM sales s2 WHERE s2.event_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND s2.amount > '0')) AS complex_subquery_count FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON s.refid = m1.refid WHERE d.income_k > 38.18 AND c.age BETWEEN 66 AND 51 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(c.age) AS avg_age, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mailings3 m3 WHERE m3.response = 'Yes' AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND m3.ref_date <= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND m3.refid IN (SELECT s2.refid FROM sales s2 WHERE s2.event_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND s2.amount > '0')) AS recent_positive_mailings, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY d.income_k) AS income_percentile FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON s.refid = m1.refid AND s.event_date BETWEEN m1.ref_date AND m1.ref_date + INTERVAL '30 days' WHERE d.inhabitants_k > '0' AND d.income_k BETWEEN 330.26 AND 219.48 AND c.age >= 79 AND s.amount > '0' AND m1.kxindex > 429 GROUP BY d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) >= 25 ORDER BY total_sales DESC, d.geoid;

SELECT d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS customer_count, AVG(c.age) AS avg_age, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailing_count_1_2, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailing_count_3, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS response_count_1_2, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS response_count_3, AVG(d.a_var1 + d.a_var2 + d.a_var3 + d.a_var4 + d.a_var5 + d.a_var6 + d.a_var7 + d.a_var8 + d.a_var9 + d.a_var10 + d.a_var11 + d.a_var12 + d.a_var13 + d.a_var14 + d.a_var15 + d.a_var16 + d.a_var17 + d.a_var18) AS avg_demog_sum, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE s.event_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND s.event_date <= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND m1.ref_date <= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND m3.ref_date <= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND d.income_k > 872706.65 AND c.age BETWEEN 53 AND 52 AND c.educationnum > 6 AND s.amount > '0' GROUP BY d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 7820 AND SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) > 8342 AND COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) > 8081 EXCEPT SELECT d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS customer_count, AVG(c.age) AS avg_age, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailing_count_1_2, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailing_count_3, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS response_count_1_2, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS response_count_3, AVG(d.a_var1 + d.a_var2 + d.a_var3 + d.a_var4 + d.a_var5 + d.a_var6 + d.a_var7 + d.a_var8 + d.a_var9 + d.a_var10 + d.a_var11 + d.a_var12 + d.a_var13 + d.a_var14 + d.a_var15 + d.a_var16 + d.a_var17 + d.a_var18) AS avg_demog_sum, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE s.event_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND s.event_date <= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND m1.ref_date <= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND m3.ref_date <= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND d.income_k <= 146164.84 AND c.age NOT BETWEEN 19 AND 95 AND c.educationnum <= 16 AND s.amount <= '0' GROUP BY d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) <= 4056 OR SUM(s.amount) <= '0' OR COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) <= 4349 OR COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) <= 2677 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, sales_rank;

SELECT d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailing_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailing_responses, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sale_amount, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s.amount) AS median_sale_amount, MAX(m3.ref_date) AS last_mailing3_date, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS unique_sales_events, SUM(d.a_var1 + d.a_var2 + d.a_var3 + d.a_var4 + d.a_var5 + d.a_var6 + d.a_var7 + d.a_var8 + d.a_var9 + d.a_var10 + d.a_var11 + d.a_var12 + d.a_var13 + d.a_var14 + d.a_var15 + d.a_var16 + d.a_var17 + d.a_var18) AS sum_demog_vars, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE s.event_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND s.amount > '0.0' AND m1.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND c.id IN ( SELECT s2.refid FROM sales s2 WHERE s2.amount > '0.0' GROUP BY s2.refid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s2.eventid) > 17 ) GROUP BY d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0.0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) >= 28 ORDER BY total_sale_amount DESC, mailing_count ASC;

SELECT d1.geoid AS geoid1, d2.geoid AS geoid2, AVG(d1.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1_d1, AVG(d2.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2_d2, SUM(CASE WHEN c1.sex = 'Male' THEN c1.data1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_data1_sum, SUM(CASE WHEN c2.sex = 'Female' THEN c2.data2 ELSE 0 END) AS female_data2_sum, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS distinct_mailings1_2_refs, MAX(s.amount) AS max_sale_amount, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank, LAG(SUM(s.amount), 1) OVER (ORDER BY d1.geoid) AS prev_geoid_sales FROM demog d1 JOIN demog d2 ON d1.geoid < d2.geoid AND d1.inhabitants_k > '0' JOIN customers c1 ON d1.geoid = c1.geoid AND c1.age BETWEEN 87 AND 19 JOIN customers c2 ON d2.geoid = c2.geoid AND c2.educationnum > 0 JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c1.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c2.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date <= '2020-01-01' JOIN sales s ON m1.refid = s.refid AND s.event_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' WHERE d1.income_k > 857.08 AND d2.income_k < 578.3 GROUP BY d1.geoid, d2.geoid HAVING COUNT(s.eventid) > 8156 AND AVG(d1.a_var3) < '-100' ORDER BY sales_rank, d1.geoid, d2.geoid;

SELECT d1.geoid AS geoid1, d2.geoid AS geoid2, AVG(d1.a_var1) AS avg_var1_geoid1, AVG(d2.a_var2) AS avg_var2_geoid2, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings1_yes_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings3_yes_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS distinct_sales_events, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_amount_percentile, AVG(c.educationnum) FILTER (WHERE c.sex = 'Male') AS avg_education_male, AVG(c.educationnum) FILTER (WHERE c.sex = 'Female') AS avg_education_female FROM demog d1 JOIN demog d2 ON d1.geoid < d2.geoid AND d1.inhabitants_k > '0' AND d2.inhabitants_k > '0' JOIN customers c ON c.geoid = d1.geoid OR c.geoid = d2.geoid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON m1.refid = c.id AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON m3.refid = c.id AND m3.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN sales s ON s.refid = c.id AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' WHERE d1.income_k BETWEEN 188.26 AND 133.48 AND d2.income_k BETWEEN 304.71 AND 300.32 AND c.age >= 95 GROUP BY d1.geoid, d2.geoid HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 917 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

SELECT s.refid, COUNT(*) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income FROM sales s JOIN customers c ON s.refid = c.id JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid WHERE s.amount > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY s.refid HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '100' INTERSECT SELECT m.refid, COUNT(*) AS mailings_count, NULL AS total_amount, NULL AS avg_income FROM mailings1_2 m WHERE m.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m.response = 'Yes' GROUP BY m.refid HAVING COUNT(*) > 16 ORDER BY sales_count DESC;

WITH customer_agg AS ( SELECT c.geoid, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS customer_count, AVG(c.educationnum) AS avg_education, SUM(d.a_var1 + d.a_var2 + d.a_var3) AS demographic_sum FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid WHERE c.age BETWEEN 61 AND 69 GROUP BY c.geoid ), mailing_response AS ( SELECT m.refid, COUNT(*) AS mailing_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m.response = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses FROM mailings1_2 m WHERE m.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY m.refid HAVING COUNT(*) > 33 ), sales_agg AS ( SELECT s.refid, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS unique_events FROM sales s WHERE s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY s.refid ) SELECT ca.geoid, ca.customer_count, ca.avg_education, ca.demographic_sum, mr.mailing_count, mr.positive_responses, sa.total_sales, sa.unique_events, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sa.total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM customer_agg ca JOIN mailing_response mr ON ca.geoid = mr.refid JOIN sales_agg sa ON mr.refid = sa.refid WHERE ca.demographic_sum > '0' ORDER BY sa.total_sales DESC LIMIT 100;

WITH customer_agg AS ( SELECT c.id AS c_id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS distinct_mailings1_2, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS distinct_mailings3, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS distinct_sales_events, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2 FROM customers c LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.response = 'YES' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.response = 'YES' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid INNER JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid WHERE c.age BETWEEN 25 AND 27 AND d.income_k > 23.84 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) > 34 AND COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) > 14 AND SUM(s.amount) > '1000' ), demog_stats AS ( SELECT geoid, AVG(inhabitants_k) AS avg_inhabitants, SUM(a_var3 + a_var4 + a_var5) AS sum_vars_345, COUNT(*) AS total_geos FROM demog WHERE a_var6 > '0' AND a_var7 < '0' GROUP BY geoid HAVING AVG(inhabitants_k) > '1' ) SELECT ca.c_id, ca.geoid, ca.age, ca.educationnum, ca.distinct_mailings1_2, ca.distinct_mailings3, ca.distinct_sales_events, ca.total_sales_amount, ca.avg_a_var1, ca.avg_a_var2, ds.avg_inhabitants, ds.sum_vars_345, ds.total_geos, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ca.total_sales_amount DESC) AS sales_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ca.geoid ORDER BY ca.distinct_sales_events DESC) AS event_rank_in_geo FROM customer_agg ca INNER JOIN demog_stats ds ON ca.geoid = ds.geoid WHERE ca.total_sales_amount > '5000' AND ca.distinct_mailings1_2 + ca.distinct_mailings3 > 78 ORDER BY ca.total_sales_amount DESC, ca.distinct_sales_events DESC LIMIT 90;

WITH customer_agg AS ( SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.geoid, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, d.a_var1, d.a_var2, COUNT(DISTINCT m12.ref_date) AS mailings_count_12, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.ref_date) AS mailings_count_3, SUM(CASE WHEN m12.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS responses_12, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS responses_3, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m12 ON c.id = m12.refid LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE c.age BETWEEN 42 AND 39 AND d.income_k >= 71.92 AND (m12.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' OR m12.ref_date IS NULL) AND (m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' OR m3.ref_date IS NULL) AND (s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' OR s.event_date IS NULL) GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.geoid, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, d.a_var1, d.a_var2 ), ranked_customers AS ( SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY marital_status, occupation ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC NULLS LAST) AS sales_rank, AVG(total_sales_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY geoid) AS avg_sales_by_geoid, SUM(total_sales_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY occupation ORDER BY age ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_total_by_occupation FROM customer_agg WHERE total_sales_amount > '0' AND mailings_count_12 + mailings_count_3 >= 31 ) SELECT customer_id, age, geoid, educationnum, sex, marital_status, occupation, inhabitants_k, income_k, mailings_count_12, mailings_count_3, responses_12, responses_3, sales_count, total_sales_amount, avg_sale_amount, sales_rank, avg_sales_by_geoid, running_total_by_occupation, (total_sales_amount - avg_sales_by_geoid) AS sales_deviation_from_geoid_avg FROM ranked_customers WHERE sales_rank <= 12 AND avg_sale_amount BETWEEN '0' AND '0' ORDER BY sales_rank, total_sales_amount DESC;

WITH customer_agg AS ( SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS total_sales, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount FROM customers c LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum ), demog_stats AS ( SELECT d.geoid, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(d.inhabitants_k) AS total_inhabitants FROM demog d WHERE d.income_k > 31.69 GROUP BY d.geoid ) SELECT ca.customer_id, ca.age, ca.educationnum, ca.total_sales, ca.total_amount, ca.avg_sale_amount, ds.avg_income, ds.total_inhabitants, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mailings1_2 m WHERE m.refid = ca.customer_id AND m.response = 'YES' AND m.ref_date BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-01-01') AS positive_mailings_count FROM customer_agg ca JOIN demog_stats ds ON ca.geoid = ds.geoid WHERE ca.total_amount > '1000' AND ca.age BETWEEN 32 AND 85 ORDER BY ca.total_amount DESC LIMIT 100;

WITH customer_aggregates AS ( SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.geoid, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, d.a_var1, d.a_var2, d.a_var3, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings_yes_responses, AVG(m1.kxindex) AS avg_kxindex, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS distinct_sales_events, MAX(s.event_date) AS last_sale_date, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailings3_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings3_yes_responses FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE c.age BETWEEN 76 AND 74 AND d.income_k >= 219.27 AND (m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' OR m1.ref_date IS NULL) AND (s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' OR s.event_date IS NULL) AND (m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' OR m3.ref_date IS NULL) GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.geoid, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, d.a_var1, d.a_var2, d.a_var3 HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) >= 69 ), demographic_segments AS ( SELECT d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var4) AS avg_a_var4, AVG(d.a_var5) AS avg_a_var5, AVG(d.a_var6) AS avg_a_var6, AVG(d.a_var7) AS avg_a_var7, AVG(d.a_var8) AS avg_a_var8, AVG(d.a_var9) AS avg_a_var9, AVG(d.a_var10) AS avg_a_var10, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_customers, SUM(CASE WHEN c.educationnum > 20 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_education_customers, SUM(CASE WHEN c.marital_status = 'Married' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS married_customers, SUM(s.amount) AS segment_sales_total, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS segment_sales_events, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS segment_mailings_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS segment_mailings3_count FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE d.inhabitants_k >= '0' AND d.income_k BETWEEN 88.04 AND 249.59 AND (s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' OR s.event_date IS NULL) AND (m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' OR m1.ref_date IS NULL) GROUP BY d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 2008 AND SUM(s.amount) > '0' ) SELECT 'customer_aggregate' AS source, customer_id, age, geoid, educationnum, sex, marital_status, occupation, inhabitants_k, income_k, a_var1, a_var2, a_var3, mailings_count, mailings_yes_responses, avg_kxindex, total_sales_amount, distinct_sales_events, last_sale_date, mailings3_count, mailings3_yes_responses, NULL AS avg_a_var4, NULL AS avg_a_var5, NULL AS avg_a_var6, NULL AS avg_a_var7, NULL AS avg_a_var8, NULL AS avg_a_var9, NULL AS avg_a_var10, NULL AS total_customers, NULL AS high_education_customers, NULL AS married_customers, NULL AS segment_sales_total, NULL AS segment_sales_events, NULL AS segment_mailings_count, NULL AS segment_mailings3_count FROM customer_aggregates WHERE total_sales_amount > '0' UNION ALL SELECT 'demographic_segment' AS source, NULL AS customer_id, NULL AS age, geoid, NULL AS educationnum, NULL AS sex, NULL AS marital_status, NULL AS occupation, inhabitants_k, income_k, NULL AS a_var1, NULL AS a_var2, NULL AS a_var3, NULL AS mailings_count, NULL AS mailings_yes_responses, NULL AS avg_kxindex, NULL AS total_sales_amount, NULL AS distinct_sales_events, NULL AS last_sale_date, NULL AS mailings3_count, NULL AS mailings3_yes_responses, avg_a_var4, avg_a_var5, avg_a_var6, avg_a_var7, avg_a_var8, avg_a_var9, avg_a_var10, total_customers, high_education_customers, married_customers, segment_sales_total, segment_sales_events, segment_mailings_count, segment_mailings3_count FROM demographic_segments WHERE segment_sales_total > '0' ORDER BY income_k DESC, total_sales_amount DESC NULLS LAST, segment_sales_total DESC NULLS LAST;

WITH customer_aggregates AS ( SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.geoid, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, d.a_var1, d.a_var2, d.a_var3, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count_1_2, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailings_count_3, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS responses_1_2, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS responses_3, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sales_amount FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE c.age >= 22 AND c.educationnum >= 9 AND d.income_k >= 191.38 AND (m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' OR m1.ref_date IS NULL) AND (m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' OR m3.ref_date IS NULL) AND (s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' OR s.event_date IS NULL) GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.geoid, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, d.a_var1, d.a_var2, d.a_var3 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 13 AND SUM(s.amount) >= '100' ), demographic_segments AS ( SELECT d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2, AVG(d.a_var3) AS avg_a_var3, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_customers, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.age >= 81 THEN c.id END) AS senior_customers, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.educationnum >= 19 THEN c.id END) AS educated_customers, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_responses_1_2, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_responses_3, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS total_sales_events, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount FROM demog d LEFT JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE d.income_k >= 442.89 AND (m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' OR m1.ref_date IS NULL) AND (m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' OR m3.ref_date IS NULL) AND (s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' OR s.event_date IS NULL) GROUP BY d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) >= 495 AND SUM(s.amount) >= '1000' ) SELECT 'customer_level' AS analysis_type, customer_id, age, educationnum, sex, marital_status, occupation, inhabitants_k, income_k, a_var1, a_var2, a_var3, mailings_count_1_2, mailings_count_3, responses_1_2, responses_3, sales_count, total_sales_amount, avg_sales_amount FROM customer_aggregates WHERE total_sales_amount >= '500' UNION ALL SELECT 'demographic_segment' AS analysis_type, NULL AS customer_id, NULL AS age, NULL AS educationnum, NULL AS sex, NULL AS marital_status, NULL AS occupation, inhabitants_k, income_k, avg_a_var1 AS a_var1, avg_a_var2 AS a_var2, avg_a_var3 AS a_var3, NULL AS mailings_count_1_2, NULL AS mailings_count_3, total_responses_1_2 AS responses_1_2, total_responses_3 AS responses_3, total_sales_events AS sales_count, total_sales_amount, NULL AS avg_sales_amount FROM demographic_segments WHERE total_sales_amount >= '5000' ORDER BY analysis_type, total_sales_amount DESC;

WITH customer_aggregates AS ( SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, MAX(m3.ref_date) AS last_mailing_date FROM customers c LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE c.age BETWEEN 96 AND 52 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '1000' ), demographic_analysis AS ( SELECT d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_var2, SUM(d.a_var3) AS sum_var3, CORR(d.a_var4, d.a_var5) AS corr_var4_var5 FROM demog d WHERE d.income_k >= 188.83 AND d.inhabitants_k <= '1' GROUP BY d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING AVG(d.a_var1) > '0' ), joined_analysis AS ( SELECT ca.customer_id, ca.age, ca.educationnum, ca.mailings_count, ca.positive_responses, ca.avg_sale_amount, ca.total_sales, ca.last_mailing_date, da.inhabitants_k, da.income_k, da.avg_var1, da.avg_var2, da.sum_var3, da.corr_var4_var5, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY da.geoid ORDER BY ca.total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank_in_geoid, LAG(ca.total_sales, 1) OVER (ORDER BY ca.customer_id) AS prev_customer_sales, LEAD(ca.avg_sale_amount, 1) OVER (ORDER BY ca.customer_id) AS next_customer_avg_sale FROM customer_aggregates ca INNER JOIN demographic_analysis da ON ca.geoid = da.geoid WHERE ca.total_sales > da.income_k * 5.8 ) SELECT ja.customer_id, ja.age, ja.educationnum, ja.mailings_count, ja.positive_responses, ja.avg_sale_amount, ja.total_sales, ja.last_mailing_date, ja.inhabitants_k, ja.income_k, ja.avg_var1, ja.avg_var2, ja.sum_var3, ja.corr_var4_var5, ja.sales_rank_in_geoid, ja.prev_customer_sales, ja.next_customer_avg_sale, (ja.total_sales - sales_days, COALESCE(sa.total_amount, 0) AS total_sales_amount, COALESCE(sa.avg_amount, 0) AS avg_sale_amount, COALESCE(sa.last_sale_date, '1900-01-01'::timestamp) AS last_sale_date, PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_total_sales FROM customer_aggregates ca LEFT JOIN sales_aggregates sa ON ca.customer_id = sa.refid LEFT JOIN mailings3_aggregates m3a ON ca.customer_id = m3a.refid LEFT JOIN demog_aggregates da ON ca.geoid = da.geoid WHERE ca.age BETWEEN 24 AND 69 AND ca.educationnum > 8 AND (ca.mailings_count > 34 OR ca.positive_responses > 14) AND WITH customer_aggregates AS ( SELECT c.id, c.age, c.geoid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS total_sales, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_amount FROM customers c LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.geoid ), demog_stats AS ( SELECT d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1 FROM demog d GROUP BY d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k ) SELECT ca.id, ca.age, ca.total_sales, ca.total_amount, ca.avg_amount, ds.inhabitants_k, ds.income_k, ds.avg_a_var1, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mailings1_2 m WHERE m.refid = ca.id AND m.response = 'Yes' AND m.ref_date BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-01-01') AS positive_mailings FROM customer_aggregates ca JOIN demog_stats ds ON ca.geoid = ds.geoid WHERE ca.total_amount > '1000' AND ca.age BETWEEN 24 AND 37 AND ds.income_k >= 80.34 ORDER BY ca.total_amount DESC LIMIT 100;

WITH filtered_sales AS ( SELECT s.refid, s.amount, s.event_date FROM sales s WHERE s.amount > '10' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' ) SELECT c.id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT fs.refid) AS sales_count, SUM(fs.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(fs.amount) AS avg_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT m12.refid) AS mailings_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailings3_count FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN filtered_sales fs ON c.id = fs.refid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m12 ON c.id = m12.refid AND m12.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 92 AND 44 AND d.income_k > 29.36 GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(fs.amount) > '100' ORDER BY total_amount DESC;

s INNER JOIN customers c ON s.refid = c.id INNER JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON s.refid = m1.refid AND s.event_date >= m1.ref_date LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON s.refid = m3.refid AND s.event_date >= m3.ref_date WHERE s.amount > '10' AND s.event_date >= '2010-01-01' AND c.age BETWEEN 32 AND 66 AND d.income_k > 156.86 AND (m1.response = 'YES' OR m1.response IS NULL) AND (m3.response = 'YES' OR m3.response IS NULL) ), aggregated AS ( SELECT d_geoid, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM event_date) AS sale_year, c.marital_status, c.occupation, COUNT(DISTINCT c_id) AS unique_customers, a.unique_customers, a.total_sales, a.avg_sale_amount, a.max_running_total, a.top_sale_amount, a.median_sale_amount, a.sale_amount_stddev, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, d.a_var1, d.a_var2, d.a_var3, demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND s.event_date >= m1.ref_date LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND s.event_date >= m3.ref_date WHERE s.amount > '10' AND s.event_date >= '2010-01-01' AND c.age BETWEEN 30 AND 80 AND d.income_k >= 76.13 AND (m1.response = 'Y' OR m1.response IS NULL) AND (m3.response = 'Y' OR m3.response IS NULL) ), aggregated AS ( SELECT customer_id, geoid, sex, marital_status, occupation, SUM(amount) AS total_spent, AVG(amount) AS avg_spent, MAX(amount) AS max_spent, MIN(amount) AS min_spent, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count, avg_running_total, SUM(CASE WHEN mailing1_response = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_mailing1_responses, SUM(CASE WHEN mailing3_response = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_mailing3_responses, AS avg_a_var8, AVG(a_var9) AS avg_a_var9, AVG(a_var10) AS avg_a_var10, AVG(a_var11) AS avg_a_var11, AVG(a_var12) AS avg_a_var12, AVG(a_var13) AS avg_a_var13, AVG(a_var14) AS avg_a_var14, AVG(a_var15) AS avg_a_var15, AVG(a_var16) AS avg_a_var16, AVG(a_var17) AS avg_a_var17, AVG(a_var18) AS avg_a_var18 FROM ranked_sales GROUP BY customer_id, geoid, sex, marital_status, occupation HAVING SUM(amount) rank_in_geoid FROM sales s JOIN customers c ON s.refid = c.id JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON s.refid = m1.refid AND s.event_date >= m1.ref_date LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON s.refid = m3.refid AND s.event_date >= m3.ref_date WHERE s.amount > '10' AND s.event_date BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND '2021-01-01' AND c.age BETWEEN 44 AND 35 AND d.income_k > 50.99 AND d.inhabitants_k < '1' ), aggregated AS ( SELECT customer_geoid, demog_geoid, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM event_date) AS sale_year, COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS unique_customers, SUM(amount) AS total_sales, AVG(amount) AS SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_demog_var1, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT m12.ref_date) AS distinct_mailings_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m12 ON c.id = m12.refid WHERE c.age >= 18 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND d.income_k >= 484.04 GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' INTERSECT SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_demog_var2, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.ref_date) AS distinct_mailings3_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT m3.ref_date) DESC) AS mailings_rank FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE c.educationnum <= 2 AND s.event_date <= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND d.inhabitants_k <= '0' GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m3.ref_date) < 65 ORDER BY customer_id;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS unique_sales_events, COUNT(DISTINCT m12.refid) AS mailings1_2_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailings3_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m12.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings1_2_yes_responses, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings3_yes_responses, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank, LAG(SUM(s.amount), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.geoid ORDER BY c.age) AS prev_sales_in_geoid_age_group FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m12 ON c.id = m12.refid LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE (c.age > 61 AND c.educationnum < 17) OR (d.income_k > 242.11 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sales s2 WHERE s2.refid = c.id AND s2.amount > '0' AND s2.event_date >= '2020-01-01')) OR (d.a_var1 < '-100' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mailings1_2 m12sub WHERE m12sub.refid = c.id AND m12sub.response = 'YES' AND m12sub.ref_date <= '2020-01-01')) GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' OR COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) < 74 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, c.age ASC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) OVER(PARTITION BY d.geoid) AS avg_a_var1_by_geoid, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS distinct_sales_events, COUNT(m1.response) FILTER (WHERE m1.response = 'YES') AS mailings1_yes_responses, COUNT(m3.response) FILTER (WHERE m3.response = 'YES') AS mailings3_yes_responses, MAX(s.event_date) AS latest_sale_date FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND s.event_date >= m1.ref_date LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND s.event_date >= m3.ref_date WHERE s.amount > '0' AND s.event_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' AND d.income_k BETWEEN 396.92 AND 150.81 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM mailings1_2 m1_sub WHERE m1_sub.refid = c.id AND m1_sub.kxindex > 99790 ORDER BY m1_sub.ref_date DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 17 ) GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 45 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, latest_sale_date DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2, AVG(d.a_var3) AS avg_a_var3, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings1_2_yes_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings3_yes_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS distinct_sales_events, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, MAX(s.event_date) AS last_sale_date, MIN(m1.ref_date) AS first_mailing1_2_date, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_demographic, AVG(SUM(s.amount)) OVER (PARTITION BY d.geoid) AS avg_sales_per_geoid FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE c.age >= 30 AND c.educationnum >= 12 AND d.income_k >= 499.94 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '1000' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 11 AND AVG(d.a_var1) < '0' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, sales_rank_by_demographic;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS unique_sales_events, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings1_2_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailings3_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings1_2_yes_responses, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings3_yes_responses, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_demographic FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - 1 AND s.amount > '0' LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' AND m1.kxindex BETWEEN 87 AND 74 LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 24 AND 85 AND c.educationnum > 2 AND d.income_k BETWEEN 74.54 AND 455.0 AND (d.a_var2 > '0' OR d.a_var3 < '0') AND (s.event_date IS NULL OR s.event_date >= DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '21 months') GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 93 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, avg_a_var1 ASC;

WITH ranked_sales AS ( SELECT s.eventid, s.refid, s.event_date, s.amount, c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date) AS sale_year, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM s.event_date) AS sale_quarter, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS total_sales, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_geoid_income, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date), c.sex ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS spending_rank_by_sex_year FROM customers c JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid WHERE s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.amount > '0' AND d.income_k BETWEEN 167.46 AND 142.52 GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM s.event_date) HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY sale_year, sale_quarter, spending_rank_by_sex_year;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS unique_sales_events, COUNT(m1.response) FILTER (WHERE m1.response = 'YES') AS mailings1_yes_count, COUNT(m3.response) FILTER (WHERE m3.response = 'YES') AS mailings3_yes_count, SUM(d.a_var1 * d.a_var2) / NULLIF(SUM(d.a_var3), 0) AS computed_demog_ratio, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_demographic, LAG(SUM(s.amount), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.id ORDER BY DATE_TRUNC('month', s.event_date)) AS prev_month_sales FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid JOIN sales s2 ON s.eventid = s2.eventid AND s.refid <> s2.refid WHERE s.amount > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.event_date <= '2020-01-01' AND d.income_k BETWEEN 139.99 AND 287.57 AND m1.ref_date >= '2019-01-01' AND m3.ref_date >= '2019-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, DATE_TRUNC('month', s.event_date) HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '100' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 32 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, sales_rank_by_demographic;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS unique_sales_events, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings1_2_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailings3_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings1_2_yes_responses, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings3_yes_responses, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_demographic, AVG(SUM(s.amount)) OVER (PARTITION BY d.geoid) AS avg_sales_per_geoid FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND '2020-01-01 00:00:00' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 85 AND 30 AND c.educationnum >= 4 AND (c.occupation LIKE '%Manager%' OR c.nom1 LIKE '%A%') AND d.income_k > 262.35 AND d.inhabitants_k < '0' GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 17 AND (SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 OR SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0) ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, avg_a_var1 ASC LIMIT 306;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS distinct_mailings1_2_refs, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS distinct_mailings3_refs, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS distinct_sales_events, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_demog_var1 FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE c.age >= 49 AND c.age <= 57 AND d.income_k > 138.71 AND (m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' OR m1.ref_date IS NULL) AND (m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' OR m3.ref_date IS NULL) GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.income_k HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) > 59 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS total_mailings, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses_m1, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses_m3, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS unique_sales_events, AVG(CASE WHEN s.amount > '0' THEN s.amount ELSE NULL END) AS avg_large_sale_amount FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 23 AND 75 AND d.income_k >= 438.52 GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) >= 368 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, d.income_k DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status) AS avg_a_var1_by_demo, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT m12.ref_date) AS mailing_campaigns_count, (SELECT MAX(m3.ref_date) FROM mailings3 m3 WHERE m3.refid = c.id AND m3.response = 'YES') AS last_positive_mailing3_date FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m12 ON c.id = m12.refid WHERE c.age >= 48 AND c.educationnum >= 3 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.amount > '0' AND d.income_k BETWEEN 58.23 AND 0.83 AND m12.kxindex > 140 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mailings3 m3sub WHERE m3sub.refid = c.id AND m3sub.response = 'YES') GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 66 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, mailing_campaigns_count DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS distinct_mailings1_2_refs, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS distinct_mailings3_refs, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS distinct_sales_events, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_demog_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_demog_var2, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings1_2_yes_responses, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings3_yes_responses, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_amount_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) DESC) AS sales_event_rank_by_sex FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND '2020-01-01 00:00:00' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 75 AND 18 AND c.educationnum >= 17 AND d.income_k > 639.12 AND d.inhabitants_k < '0' GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) > 486 AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 636 AND SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, distinct_sales_events DESC;

SELECT c.id, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income FROM customers c JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid WHERE s.amount > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, COUNT(s.eventid) AS sale_count, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.amount > '0' AND c.id IN (SELECT m.refid FROM mailings1_2 m WHERE m.response = 'YES' AND m.ref_date >= '2020-01-01') GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '100' ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT c.id, c.age, d.geoid, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.amount > '0' GROUP BY c.id, c.age, d.geoid HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '1000' INTERSECT SELECT c.id, c.age, d.geoid, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m ON c.id = m.refid WHERE m.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m.response = 'Yes' GROUP BY c.id, c.age, d.geoid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m.kxindex) >= 9 ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT c1.id AS cust_id1, c2.id AS cust_id2, c1.age AS age1, c2.age AS age2, AVG(c1.data1) AS avg_data1_c1, AVG(c2.data2) AS avg_data2_c2, COUNT(DISTINCT s1.eventid) AS sales_count_c1, COUNT(DISTINCT s2.eventid) AS sales_count_c2, SUM(s1.amount) AS total_sales_c1, SUM(s2.amount) AS total_sales_c2 FROM customers c1 JOIN customers c2 ON c1.geoid = c2.geoid AND c1.id < c2.id LEFT JOIN sales s1 ON c1.id = s1.refid AND s1.event_date >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN sales s2 ON c2.id = s2.refid AND s2.event_date >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN demog d ON c1.geoid = d.geoid WHERE c1.age BETWEEN 94 AND 50 AND c2.age BETWEEN 52 AND 88 AND d.income_k > 651.84 GROUP BY c1.id, c2.id, c1.age, c2.age HAVING SUM(s1.amount) > '0' OR SUM(s2.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_sales_c1 DESC, total_sales_c2 DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(c.data1) AS total_data1, COUNT(DISTINCT m.refid) AS unique_mailings, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(d.income_k) DESC) AS income_rank FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN mailings1_2 m ON c.id = m.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON m.refid = s.refid WHERE d.inhabitants_k > '0' AND c.age BETWEEN 94 AND 72 AND m.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY d.geoid HAVING AVG(d.income_k) > 486.23 ORDER BY avg_income DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS unique_customers, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m ON s.refid = m.refid WHERE d.inhabitants_k > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m.response = 'Yes' GROUP BY d.geoid HAVING AVG(d.income_k) > 203.26 ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT c.nom1, ', ' ORDER BY c.nom1) AS aggregated_nom1, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailing_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses, AVG(c.data1) OVER (PARTITION BY d.geoid) AS avg_data1_by_geoid, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE d.income_k > 573.02 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.amount BETWEEN '0' AND '10000' AND c.age >= 42 GROUP BY d.geoid, c.data1 HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '1000' ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date) AS sale_year, COUNT(DISTINCT s.refid) AS unique_customers, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, SUM(d.inhabitants_k) AS total_inhabitants_k, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income_k FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m ON s.refid = m.refid WHERE s.amount > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.event_date <= '2020-01-01' AND d.income_k BETWEEN 254.43 AND 329.68 GROUP BY CUBE(d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date)) HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date) AS sale_year, COUNT(s.eventid) AS total_sales, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, GROUPING(d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date)) AS grouping_id FROM sales s JOIN customers c ON s.refid = c.id JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid WHERE s.amount > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND d.income_k BETWEEN 204.99 AND 211.9 GROUP BY CUBE(d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date)) HAVING COUNT(s.eventid) > 41 ORDER BY total_amount DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS total_mailings, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS total_sales, SUM(s.amount) AS total_revenue, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, AVG(d.inhabitants_k) AS avg_inhabitants, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses_m3, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS revenue_rank, (SELECT AVG(sub.amount) FROM sales sub WHERE sub.refid IN (SELECT m2.refid FROM mailings1_2 m2 WHERE m2.response = 'YES' AND m2.ref_date >= '2020-01-01') AND sub.event_date >= '2020-01-01') AS avg_sales_from_positive_mailings FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE d.income_k > 383.32 AND d.inhabitants_k BETWEEN '0' AND '0' AND c.age >= 58 GROUP BY d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) > 518 AND SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(c.age) AS avg_age, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS unique_mailings, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mailings3 m3 WHERE m3.refid IN (SELECT s2.refid FROM sales s2 WHERE s2.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s2.amount > '100') AND m3.response = 'Yes') AS high_value_mailings_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON s.refid = m1.refid WHERE d.income_k > 33.15 AND c.age BETWEEN 18 AND 100 AND s.event_date >= '2019-01-01' GROUP BY d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '5000' AND COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) >= 5 ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

WITH customer_agg AS ( SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.educationnum, c.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, d.a_var1, d.a_var2, d.a_var3, d.a_var4, d.a_var5, COUNT(DISTINCT m12.ref_date) AS mailings_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m12.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings_yes_count, AVG(m12.kxindex) AS avg_kxindex, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.ref_date) AS mailings3_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings3_yes_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS distinct_sales_events, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m12 ON c.id = m12.refid LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE c.age BETWEEN 84 AND 61 AND d.income_k >= 12.19 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.educationnum, c.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, d.a_var1, d.a_var2, d.a_var3, d.a_var4, d.a_var5 HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '1000' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 31 ) SELECT ca.customer_id, ca.age, ca.educationnum, ca.inhabitants_k, ca.income_k, ca.total_sales_amount, ca.distinct_sales_events, ca.avg_sale_amount, ca.mailings_count, ca.mailings_yes_count, ca.avg_kxindex, ca.mailings3_count, ca.mailings3_yes_count, ca.a_var1, ca.a_var2, ca.a_var3, ca.a_var4, ca.a_var5, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ca.total_sales_amount DESC) AS sales_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ca.total_sales_amount DESC) AS sales_percent_rank, SUM(ca.total_sales_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY ca.geoid) AS geoid_total_sales, AVG(ca.avg_sale_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY ca.geoid) AS geoid_avg_sale FROM customer_agg ca WHERE ca.customer_id IN ( SELECT s.refid FROM sales s JOIN mailings1_2 m12 ON s.refid = m12.refid WHERE s.amount > '500' AND m12.kxindex >= 627 AND s.event_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' GROUP BY s.refid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) > 18 AND SUM(s.amount) >= '5000' ) ORDER BY ca.total_sales_amount DESC, ca.customer_id LIMIT 4356;

WITH customer_agg AS ( SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.educationnum, c.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, d.a_var1, d.a_var2, d.a_var3, d.a_var4, d.a_var5, d.a_var6, d.a_var7, d.a_var8, mailings_count_3, SUM(CASE WHEN m12.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS response_count_12, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS response_count_3, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(s.eventid) AS sales_count, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, MIN(s.event_date) AS first_sale_date, MAX(s.event_date) AS last_sale_date FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m12 ON c.id = m12.refid AND m12.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 78 AND 69 AND c.educationnum >= 1 AND d.income_k > 93.8 AND d.inhabitants_k < '1' GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.educationnum, c.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, d.a_var1, d.a_var2, d.a_var3, d.a_var4, d.a_var5, d.a_var6, d.a_var7, d.a_var8, d.a_var9, d.a_var10, d.a_var11, d.a_var12, d.a_var13, d.a_var14, d.a_var15, d.a_var16, d.a_var17, d.a_var18 ) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(age_group) = 0 THEN age_group ELSE 'ALL' END AS age_group, CASE WHEN GROUPING(education_group) = 0 THEN education_group ELSE
