SELECT c.id, c.sex, d.geoid, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, COUNT(m1.refid) AS mail_count FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid WHERE s.amount > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND d.income_k BETWEEN 45.54 AND 480.11 GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, d.geoid HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT c1.id AS customer1_id, c2.id AS customer2_id, d1.geoid AS demog1_geoid, d2.geoid AS demog2_geoid, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings1_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailings3_count, SUM(s1.amount) AS total_sales_amount_customer1, SUM(s2.amount) AS total_sales_amount_customer2, AVG(d1.a_var1 * d2.a_var2) AS avg_interaction_var, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (SUM(s1.amount) + SUM(s2.amount)) DESC) AS combined_sales_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(d1.income_k) DESC) AS income_percentile_rank FROM customers c1 JOIN customers c2 ON c1.geoid = c2.geoid AND c1.id < c2.id JOIN demog d1 ON c1.geoid = d1.geoid JOIN demog d2 ON c2.geoid = d2.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c1.id = m1.refid AND m1.response = 'YES' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c2.id = m3.refid AND m3.response = 'YES' LEFT JOIN sales s1 ON c1.id = s1.refid AND s1.event_date >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN sales s2 ON c2.id = s2.refid AND s2.event_date >= '2020-01-01' WHERE c1.age BETWEEN 23 AND 37 AND c2.age BETWEEN 64 AND 30 AND d1.inhabitants_k > '0.0' AND d2.inhabitants_k > '0.0' AND (d1.a_var3 + d2.a_var4) > '0.0' GROUP BY c1.id, c2.id, d1.geoid, d2.geoid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) > 92 AND COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) > 64 AND SUM(s1.amount) + SUM(s2.amount) > '0.0' ORDER BY combined_sales_rank, income_percentile_rank DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS customer_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE s.event_date >= (SELECT MIN(ref_date) FROM mailings3 WHERE response = (SELECT response FROM mailings1_2 WHERE refid = 31582 LIMIT 1)) AND d.inhabitants_k > '0.0' GROUP BY d.geoid HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0.0' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS unique_customers, MAX(m1.ref_date) AS latest_mailing_date, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank, LAG(SUM(s.amount), 1) OVER (ORDER BY d.geoid) AS prev_geoid_sales FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON s.refid = m1.refid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON s.refid = m3.refid WHERE s.event_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND s.amount > '10' AND d.income_k BETWEEN 160.98 AND 177.82 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM mailings1_2 m1_sub WHERE m1_sub.refid = c.id AND m1_sub.response = 'Yes' AND m1_sub.ref_date >= '2019-01-01 00:00:00' ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM mailings3 m3_sub WHERE m3_sub.refid = c.id AND m3_sub.ref_date <= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' ) GROUP BY d.geoid, c.educationnum, c.marital_status HAVING COUNT(s.eventid) > 90 AND AVG(d.a_var1) < '0' ORDER BY total_sales DESC, avg_income ASC;

SELECT d.geoid, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS unique_customers, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses_m1, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses_m3, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank, LAG(SUM(s.amount), 1) OVER (ORDER BY d.geoid) AS prev_geoid_sales FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND s.event_date >= m1.ref_date JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND s.event_date >= m3.ref_date WHERE d.income_k > 749.87 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.amount > '0' AND c.age BETWEEN 21 AND 98 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM mailings1_2 m1_sub WHERE m1_sub.refid = c.id AND m1_sub.response = 'YES' AND m1_sub.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' ) GROUP BY d.geoid HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 879 ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS distinct_sales_events, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS distinct_mailings1_2_refs, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS distinct_mailings3_refs, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income_k, AVG(d.inhabitants_k) AS avg_inhabitants_k, SUM(d.a_var1 + d.a_var2 + d.a_var3 + d.a_var4 + d.a_var5 + d.a_var6 + d.a_var7 + d.a_var8 + d.a_var9 + d.a_var10 + d.a_var11 + d.a_var12 + d.a_var13 + d.a_var14 + d.a_var15 + d.a_var16 + d.a_var17 + d.a_var18) AS sum_all_a_vars, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY d.geoid) AS prev_distinct_events_by_demo FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' WHERE d.income_k > 771.61 AND d.inhabitants_k BETWEEN '0' AND '1000' GROUP BY d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) > 356 AND SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, d.geoid;

SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS total_sales_events, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_geoid_income, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT m1.response, ', ' ORDER BY m1.response) AS mailing_responses_1_2, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT m3.response, ', ' ORDER BY m3.response) AS mailing_responses_3, SUM(d.a_var1 * d.a_var2) / NULLIF(SUM(d.a_var3), 0) AS computed_demog_ratio, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_amount_percentile FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON s.refid = m1.refid AND s.event_date >= m1.ref_date JOIN mailings3 m3 ON s.refid = m3.refid AND s.event_date >= m3.ref_date WHERE s.amount > '0' AND d.income_k BETWEEN 392.65 AND 407.07 AND c.age >= 67 GROUP BY d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) > 45 AND AVG(d.income_k) < 400.55 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, d.geoid;

SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS distinct_mailings1_2_refid, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS distinct_mailings3_refid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS distinct_sales_eventid, SUM(d.inhabitants_k) AS total_inhabitants_k, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income_k, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(c.age) AS avg_customer_age, SUM(d.a_var1 + d.a_var2 + d.a_var3 + d.a_var4 + d.a_var5 + d.a_var6 + d.a_var7 + d.a_var8 + d.a_var9 + d.a_var10 + d.a_var11 + d.a_var12 + d.a_var13 + d.a_var14 + d.a_var15 + d.a_var16 + d.a_var17 + d.a_var18) AS sum_all_a_vars, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank, LAG(SUM(s.amount), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY d.geoid) AS prev_geoid_sales FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.response = 'YES' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.response = 'YES' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE d.income_k > 115.09 AND c.age BETWEEN 36 AND 88 AND s.event_date >= '2000-01-01' AND m1.ref_date >= '2000-01-01' AND m3.ref_date >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) > 51 AND COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) > 100 AND SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, d.geoid;

SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailings3_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(d.inhabitants_k) AS avg_inhabitants, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(d.a_var1 + d.a_var2 + d.a_var3 + d.a_var4 + d.a_var5 + d.a_var6 + d.a_var7 + d.a_var8 + d.a_var9 + d.a_var10 + d.a_var11 + d.a_var12 + d.a_var13 + d.a_var14 + d.a_var15 + d.a_var16 + d.a_var17 + d.a_var18) AS sum_all_a_vars, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_demographic, AVG(c.age) FILTER (WHERE c.educationnum > 14) AS avg_age_high_edu, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE m1.response = 'YES' AND m3.response = 'YES') AS double_positive_response_count FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND '2020-01-01 00:00:00' WHERE d.inhabitants_k > '1.0' AND d.income_k BETWEEN 466.62 AND 489.49 GROUP BY d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) > 802 AND SUM(s.amount) > '0.0' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, sales_count DESC LIMIT 390;

WITH customer_aggregates AS ( SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.ref_date) AS mailings_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_demog_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_demog_var2 FROM customers c LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid WHERE c.age BETWEEN 84 AND 25 AND c.educationnum >= 20 GROUP BY c.id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status ), sales_analysis AS ( SELECT s.refid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_events, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, MIN(s.event_date) AS first_sale_date, MAX(s.event_date) AS last_sale_date FROM sales s WHERE s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.amount > '0' GROUP BY s.refid ), mailings3_analysis AS ( SELECT m3.refid, COUNT(*) AS mailings3_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings3_positive FROM mailings3 m3 WHERE m3.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' GROUP BY m3.refid ), combined_metrics AS ( SELECT ca.customer_id, ca.geoid, ca.age, ca.educationnum, ca.sex, ca.marital_status, ca.mailings_count, ca.positive_responses, ca.avg_demog_var1, ca.avg_demog_var2, COALESCE(sa.sales_events, 0) AS sales_events, COALESCE(sa.total_sales_amount, 0) AS total_sales_amount, COALESCE(sa.avg_sale_amount, 0) AS avg_sale_amount, sa.first_sale_date, sa.last_sale_date, COALESCE(m3a.mailings3_count, 0) AS mailings3_count, COALESCE(m3a.mailings3_positive, 0) AS mailings3_positive, (ca.positive_responses * 1.0 / NULLIF(ca.mailings_count, 0)) AS response_rate, (COALESCE(sa.total_sales_amount, 0) * 1.0 / NULLIF(ca.mailings_count, 0)) AS sales_per_mailing FROM customer_aggregates ca LEFT JOIN sales_analysis sa ON ca.customer_id = sa.refid LEFT JOIN mailings3_analysis m3a ON ca.customer_id = m3a.refid ) SELECT cm.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT cm.customer_id) AS total_customers, AVG(cm.age) AS avg_age, AVG(cm.educationnum) AS avg_education, SUM(cm.mailings_count) AS total_mailings, SUM(cm.positive_responses) AS total_positive_responses, SUM(cm.sales_events) AS total_sales_events, SUM(cm.total_sales_amount) AS grand_total_sales, AVG(cm.avg_sale_amount) AS overall_avg_sale, SUM(cm.mailings3_count) AS total_mailings3, SUM(cm.mailings3_positive) AS total_mailings3_positive, AVG(cm.response_rate) AS avg_response_rate, AVG(cm.sales_per_mailing) AS avg_sales_per_mailing, CORR(cm.avg_demog_var1, cm.total_sales_amount) AS corr_var1_sales, CORR(cm.avg_demog_var2, cm.response_rate) AS corr_var2_response FROM combined_metrics cm LEFT JOIN demog d ON cm.geoid = d.geoid WHERE cm.total_sales_amount > '0' AND cm.mailings_count >= 33 AND (cm.response_rate >= '0' OR cm.response_rate IS NULL) GROUP BY cm.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cm.customer_id) > 33 AND AVG(cm.age) BETWEEN 81 AND 78 AND SUM(cm.total_sales_amount) > '0' ORDER BY grand_total_sales DESC, avg_response_rate DESC LIMIT 717;

WITH customer_aggregates AS ( SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.ref_date) AS mailings_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(s.eventid) AS sales_count, MAX(s.event_date) AS last_sale_date, MIN(m3.ref_date) AS first_mailing3_date FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE c.age BETWEEN 46 AND 70 AND d.income_k > 431.79 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m3.ref_date <= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '1000' AND COUNT(DISTINCT m1.ref_date) >= 72 ), demographic_analysis AS ( SELECT d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(c.age) AS avg_age, AVG(c.educationnum) AS avg_education, SUM(CASE WHEN c.sex = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_count, SUM(CASE WHEN c.marital_status = 'Married' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS married_count, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY d.a_var3) AS median_a_var3, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY d.a_var4) AS p75_a_var4, CORR(d.a_var5, d.a_var6) AS corr_a_var5_a_var6, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS unique_customers, SUM(s.amount) AS total_region_sales, COUNT(s.eventid) AS total_region_sales_count, AVG(m1.kxindex) AS avg_kxindex FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid WHERE d.inhabitants_k > '0' AND d.a_var7 > '0' AND s.event_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' GROUP BY d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 910 AND SUM(s.amount) > '10000' ) SELECT customer_id, geoid, age, educationnum, inhabitants_k, income_k, mailings_count, positive_responses, avg_a_var1, avg_a_var2, total_sales_amount, sales_count, last_sale_date, first_mailing3_date FROM customer_aggregates WHERE total_sales_amount > '5000' INTERSECT SELECT ca.customer_id, ca.geoid, ca.age, ca.educationnum, ca.inhabitants_k, ca.income_k, ca.mailings_count, ca.positive_responses, ca.avg_a_var1, ca.avg_a_var2, ca.total_sales_amount, ca.sales_count, ca.last_sale_date, ca.first_mailing3_date FROM customer_aggregates ca JOIN demographic_analysis da ON ca.geoid = da.geoid WHERE da.total_region_sales > '50000' AND da.avg_kxindex > 92 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

WITH customer_aggregates AS ( SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.ref_date) AS mailings_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(s.eventid) AS sales_count, MAX(s.event_date) AS last_sale_date, MIN(m3.ref_date) AS first_mailing3_date FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE c.age BETWEEN 63 AND 92 AND d.income_k > 192.04 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m3.ref_date <= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '1000' AND COUNT(DISTINCT m1.ref_date) >= 96 ), demographic_analysis AS ( SELECT d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(c.age) AS avg_age, AVG(c.educationnum) AS avg_education, SUM(CASE WHEN c.sex = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_count, SUM(CASE WHEN c.marital_status = 'Married' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS married_count, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY d.a_var3) AS median_a_var3, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY d.a_var4) AS p75_a_var4, CORR(d.a_var5, d.a_var6) AS corr_a_var5_a_var6, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS unique_customers, SUM(s.amount) AS total_region_sales, COUNT(s.eventid) AS total_region_sales_count, AVG(m1.kxindex) AS avg_kxindex FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid WHERE d.inhabitants_k > '0' AND d.a_var7 > '0' AND s.event_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' GROUP BY d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 486 AND SUM(s.amount) > '10000' ) SELECT customer_id, geoid, age, educationnum, inhabitants_k, income_k, mailings_count, positive_responses, avg_a_var1, avg_a_var2, total_sales_amount, sales_count, last_sale_date, first_mailing3_date FROM customer_aggregates WHERE total_sales_amount > '5000' INTERSECT SELECT ca.customer_id, ca.geoid, ca.age, ca.educationnum, ca.inhabitants_k, ca.income_k, ca.mailings_count, ca.positive_responses, ca.avg_a_var1, ca.avg_a_var2, ca.total_sales_amount, ca.sales_count, ca.last_sale_date, ca.first_mailing3_date FROM customer_aggregates ca JOIN demographic_analysis da ON ca.geoid = da.geoid WHERE da.total_region_sales > '50000' AND da.avg_kxindex > 37 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

WITH ranked_sales AS ( SELECT s.eventid, s.refid, s.event_date, s.amount, c.id, c.age, c.geoid, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, d.a_var1, d.a_var2, d.a_var3, d.a_var4, d.a_var5, d.a_var6, d.a_var7, d.a_var8, d.a_var9, d.a_var10, d.a_var11, d.a_var12, d.a_var13, d.a_var14, d.a_var15, d.a_var16, d.a_var17, d.a_var18, m1.ref_date AS mailing1_date, m1.response AS mailing1_response, m3.ref_date AS mailing3_date, m3.response AS mailing3_response, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.geoid, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date) ORDER BY s.amount DESC) AS sale_rank_in_geo_year, AVG(s.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY c.geoid, c.marital_status) AS avg_amount_by_geo_marital, SUM(s.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY c.occupation ORDER BY s.event_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_total_by_occupation FROM sales s INNER JOIN customers c ON s.refid = c.id INNER JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND s.event_date >= m1.ref_date LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND s.event_date >= m3.ref_date WHERE s.amount > '10' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND c.age BETWEEN 25 AND 70 SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS total_mailings, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses_m1, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses_m3, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS total_sales, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' WHERE c.age >= 96 AND c.educationnum >= 2 GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;
SELECT c.id, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount FROM customers c JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE s.amount > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

SELECT c.id, c.age, d.geoid, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.amount > '0' GROUP BY c.id, c.age, d.geoid HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '100' INTERSECT SELECT c.id, c.age, d.geoid, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m ON c.id = m.refid WHERE m.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m.response = 'Yes' GROUP BY c.id, c.age, d.geoid HAVING COUNT(m.refid) >= 10 ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS customer_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m ON s.refid = m.refid WHERE d.income_k > 533.91 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m.response = 'Yes' GROUP BY d.geoid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 834 ORDER BY sales_rank;

SELECT d.geoid, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS customer_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE s.event_date >= (SELECT MIN(ref_date) FROM mailings1_2 WHERE response = (SELECT MAX(response) FROM mailings3 WHERE ref_date < '2020-01-01')) AND c.age BETWEEN 30 AND 61 GROUP BY d.geoid HAVING AVG(d.income_k) > 68.84 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS customer_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mailings1_2 m WHERE m.refid = c.id AND m.response = 'Yes' AND m.ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00') AS positive_mailings_count, SUM(d.a_var1 + d.a_var2 + d.a_var3 + d.a_var4 + d.a_var5 + d.a_var6 + d.a_var7 + d.a_var8 + d.a_var9 + d.a_var10 + d.a_var11 + d.a_var12 + d.a_var13 + d.a_var14 + d.a_var15 + d.a_var16 + d.a_var17 + d.a_var18) AS demographic_sum, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE c.age >= 28 AND c.age <= 25 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND s.event_date <= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND d.income_k > 115.57 GROUP BY d.geoid, c.id HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 55 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS distinct_events, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS distinct_mailings1_2_refs, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS distinct_mailings3_refs, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(d.inhabitants_k) AS total_inhabitants, SUM(d.a_var1 + d.a_var2 + d.a_var3 + d.a_var4 + d.a_var5 + d.a_var6 + d.a_var7 + d.a_var8 + d.a_var9 + d.a_var10 + d.a_var11 + d.a_var12 + d.a_var13 + d.a_var14 + d.a_var15 + d.a_var16 + d.a_var17 + d.a_var18) AS sum_all_a_vars, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_demo FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE s.amount > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.event_date <= '2020-01-01' AND d.income_k BETWEEN 166.79 AND 324.41 AND c.age >= 86 AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) > 68 AND COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) > 3 AND COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) > 13 AND SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, d.geoid;

SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date) AS sale_year, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM s.event_date) AS sale_quarter, COUNT(DISTINCT s.refid) AS unique_customers, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, SUM(d.income_k) AS total_income_in_area, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM s.event_date) ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_quarter FROM sales s JOIN customers c ON s.refid = c.id JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid WHERE s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.amount > '0' AND d.income_k BETWEEN 215.73 AND 289.97 GROUP BY d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM s.event_date) HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY sale_year DESC, sale_quarter DESC, sales_rank_by_quarter ASC;

SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_demographic, AVG(d.a_var1 + d.a_var2 + d.a_var3 + d.a_var4 + d.a_var5 + d.a_var6 + d.a_var7 + d.a_var8 + d.a_var9 + d.a_var10 + d.a_var11 + d.a_var12 + d.a_var13 + d.a_var14 + d.a_var15 + d.a_var16 + d.a_var17 + d.a_var18) OVER (PARTITION BY d.geoid) AS avg_composite_var_per_geo FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE d.income_k > 414.04 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.amount BETWEEN '0' AND '10000' AND c.age >= 40 AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) > 19 ORDER BY total_sales DESC, avg_income DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(c.age) AS avg_age, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank, LAG(SUM(s.amount), 1) OVER (ORDER BY d.geoid) AS prev_geoid_sales FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid WHERE d.income_k > 822.84 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.event_date <= '2020-01-01' AND c.age BETWEEN 75 AND 25 GROUP BY d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) > 103 EXCEPT SELECT d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(c.age) AS avg_age, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailings_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank, LAG(SUM(s.amount), 1) OVER (ORDER BY d.geoid) AS prev_geoid_sales FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE d.income_k > 336.51 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.event_date <= '2020-01-01' AND c.age BETWEEN 40 AND 96 GROUP BY d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) > 315 ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE d.income_k <= 885.16 AND c.age NOT BETWEEN 20 AND 20 AND s.event_date < '2000-01-01' AND (m12.ref_date < '2000-01-01' AND m3.ref_date < '2000-01-01') GROUP BY d.geoid, SELECT d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2, AVG(d.a_var3) AS avg_a_var3, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.refid) AS unique_sales_customers, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS unique_mailings1_2_customers, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS unique_mailings3_customers, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.geoid ORDER BY AVG(d.a_var1) DESC) AS a_var1_rank_in_geoid FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' WHERE d.income_k > 91.0 AND c.age BETWEEN 99 AND 86 GROUP BY d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.refid) >= 1031 UNION SELECT d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var4) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var5) AS avg_a_var2, AVG(d.a_var6) AS avg_a_var3, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.refid) AS unique_sales_customers, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS unique_mailings1_2_customers, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS unique_mailings3_customers, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.geoid ORDER BY AVG(d.a_var4) DESC) AS a_var1_rank_in_geoid FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' WHERE d.income_k > 199.53 AND c.age BETWEEN 75 AND 46 GROUP BY d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.refid) >= 3187 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

SELECT d1.geoid AS geoid1, d2.geoid AS geoid2, AVG(d1.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1_d1, AVG(d2.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2_d2, SUM(CASE WHEN c1.sex = 'Male' THEN c1.data1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_data1_sum, SUM(CASE WHEN c2.sex = 'Female' THEN c2.data2 ELSE 0 END) AS female_data2_sum, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS distinct_mailings1_2_refs, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS distinct_mailings3_refs, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank, LAG(SUM(s.amount), 1) OVER (ORDER BY d1.geoid, d2.geoid) AS prev_total_sales FROM demog d1 JOIN demog d2 ON d1.geoid < d2.geoid AND d1.inhabitants_k > '0' JOIN customers c1 ON d1.geoid = c1.geoid AND c1.age BETWEEN 33 AND 70 JOIN customers c2 ON d2.geoid = c2.geoid AND c2.educationnum > 20 JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c1.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c2.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date <= '2020-01-01' JOIN sales s ON m1.refid = s.refid AND s.event_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' WHERE d1.income_k > 681.79 AND d2.income_k < 448.76 GROUP BY d1.geoid, d2.geoid HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) >= 780 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, geoid1, geoid2;

WITH customer_agg AS ( SELECT c.geoid, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS customer_count, AVG(c.age) AS avg_age, SUM(c.data1) AS total_data1 FROM customers c WHERE c.age >= 73 AND c.educationnum >= 3 GROUP BY c.geoid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 10 ) SELECT d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, ca.customer_count, ca.avg_age, ca.total_data1, COUNT(DISTINCT m.refid) AS mailing_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m.response = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount FROM demog d JOIN customer_agg ca ON d.geoid = ca.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m ON ca.geoid = m.kxindex LEFT JOIN sales s ON m.refid = s.refid WHERE d.income_k >= 31.2 GROUP BY d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, ca.customer_count, ca.avg_age, ca.total_data1 ORDER BY d.income_k DESC LIMIT 100;

WITH customer_agg AS ( SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.educationnum, c.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, COUNT(DISTINCT m12.ref_date) AS mailings_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m12.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_demog_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_demog_var2 FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m12 ON c.id = m12.refid WHERE c.age BETWEEN 20 AND 34 AND d.income_k > 107.62 GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.educationnum, c.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m12.ref_date) > 27 ), sales_analysis AS ( SELECT s.refid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_events, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_amount, MIN(s.event_date) AS first_sale, MAX(s.event_date) AS last_sale FROM sales s WHERE s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.amount > '0' GROUP BY s.refid ), mailings3_agg AS ( SELECT m3.refid, COUNT(*) AS m3_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS m3_positive FROM mailings3 m3 WHERE m3.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' GROUP BY m3.refid ) SELECT ca.customer_id, ca.age, ca.educationnum, ca.sex, ca.marital_status, ca.occupation, ca.mailings_count, ca.positive_responses, ca.avg_demog_var1, ca.avg_demog_var2, COALESCE(sa.sales_events, 0) AS sales_events, COALESCE(sa.total_amount, 0) AS total_sales_amount, COALESCE(sa.avg_amount, 0) AS avg_sale_amount, COALESCE(ma.m3_count, 0) AS m3_mailings_count, COALESCE(ma.m3_positive, 0) AS m3_positive_responses, (COALESCE(sa.total_amount, 0) * ca.avg_demog_var1) AS weighted_sales_demog, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(sa.total_amount, 0) DESC) AS sales_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ca.sex ORDER BY ca.avg_demog_var2 DESC) AS demog_rank_by_sex FROM customer_agg ca LEFT JOIN sales_analysis sa ON ca.customer_id = sa.refid LEFT JOIN mailings3_agg ma ON ca.customer_id = ma.refid WHERE COALESCE(sa.total_amount, 0) > '0' OR COALESCE(ma.m3_count, 0) > 47 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, ca.age ASC LIMIT 5113;

WITH customer_agg AS ( SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS total_sales, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount FROM customers c LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum ), demog_stats AS ( SELECT d.geoid, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(d.inhabitants_k) AS total_inhabitants FROM demog d WHERE d.income_k > 88.48 GROUP BY d.geoid ) SELECT ca.customer_id, ca.age, ca.educationnum, ca.total_sales, ca.total_amount, ca.avg_sale_amount, ds.avg_income, ds.total_inhabitants, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mailings1_2 m WHERE m.refid = ca.customer_id AND m.response = 'YES' AND m.ref_date BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-01-01') AS positive_mailings_count FROM customer_agg ca JOIN demog_stats ds ON ca.geoid = ds.geoid WHERE ca.total_amount > '1000' AND ca.age BETWEEN 30 AND 85 ORDER BY ca.total_amount DESC LIMIT 100;

WITH customer_aggregates AS ( SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.ref_date) AS mailings_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_demog_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_demog_var2 FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid WHERE c.age BETWEEN 84 AND 75 AND d.income_k > 192.78 GROUP BY c.id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m1.ref_date) > 99 ), sales_analysis AS ( SELECT s.refid, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date) AS sale_year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM s.event_date) AS sale_month, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_transaction FROM sales s WHERE s.event_date >= '2010-01-01' GROUP BY s.refid, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM s.event_date) HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '1000' ), mailings_consolidated AS ( SELECT m3.refid, COUNT(*) AS m3_count, MAX(m3.ref_date) AS latest_mailing FROM mailings3 m3 WHERE m3.ref_date >= '2010-01-01' GROUP BY m3.refid HAVING COUNT(*) >= 45 ) SELECT ca.customer_id, ca.age, ca.educationnum, ca.mailings_count, ca.positive_responses, ca.avg_demog_var1, ca.avg_demog_var2, COALESCE(SUM(sa.total_amount), 0) AS lifetime_spend, COALESCE(SUM(sa.transaction_count), 0) AS total_transactions, COALESCE(AVG(sa.avg_transaction), 0) AS overall_avg_transaction, COALESCE(mc.m3_count, 0) AS m3_mailings_count, COALESCE(mc.latest_mailing, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS latest_m3_mailing, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(sa.total_amount), 0) DESC) AS spend_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ca.geoid ORDER BY ca.positive_responses DESC) AS response_rank_in_geo FROM customer_aggregates ca LEFT JOIN sales_analysis sa ON ca.customer_id = sa.refid LEFT JOIN mailings_consolidated mc ON ca.customer_id = mc.refid WHERE ca.avg_demog_var1 > '0' AND (ca.positive_responses > 52 OR mc.m3_count > 10) GROUP BY ca.customer_id, ca.age, ca.educationnum, ca.mailings_count, ca.positive_responses, ca.avg_demog_var1, ca.avg_demog_var2, ca.geoid, mc.m3_count, mc.latest_mailing HAVING COALESCE(SUM(sa.total_amount), 0) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT sa.sale_year) >= 6 ORDER BY lifetime_spend DESC, response_rank_in_geo ASC LIMIT 1148;

customers c ON s.refid = c.id JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND s.event_date >= m1.ref_date LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND s.event_date m1.response IS NULL) ), aggregated AS ( SELECT customer_id, age, educationnum, sex, marital_status, occupation, geoid, inhabitants_k, income_k, COUNT(*) AS total_sales, SUM(amount) AS total_amount, MAX(yearly_spent) AS max_yearly_spent, AVG(avg_occupation_area_spent) AS avg_peer_spending, SUM(CASE WHEN sale_rank = 1 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS latest_sale_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN mailing1_response = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_mailings1, SUM(CASE WHEN mailing3_response = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_mailings3, SUM(a_var1 + a_var2 + a_var3 + a_var4 + a_var5 + a_var6 + a_var7 + a_var8 + a_var9 + a_var10 + a_var11 + a_var12 + a_var13 + a_var14 + a_var15 + a_var16 + a_var17 + a_var18) AS total_demog_vars FROM ranked_sales GROUP BY customer_id, age, educationnum, sex, marital_status, (ORDER BY SUM(total_amount) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM aggregated GROUP BY geoid, sex, marital_status, occupation HAVING AVG(total_amount) > '500' AND COUNT(customer_id) >= 68 ORDER BY grand_total_spent DESC, revenue_rank;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2, AVG(d.a_var3) AS avg_a_var3, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS unique_sales_events, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings1_2_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailings3_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings1_2_yes_responses, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings3_yes_responses, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank, LAG(SUM(s.amount), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex ORDER BY d.income_k DESC) AS prev_sales_by_sex_income FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND '2020-01-01 00:00:00' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 86 AND 77 AND d.income_k > 635.18 AND d.inhabitants_k < '0' GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 106 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, d.income_k DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings_yes_responses, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, COALESCE(SUM(s.amount), 0) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_demog_var1 FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 84 AND 94 GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING COALESCE(SUM(s.amount), 0) > '0' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE c.age BETWEEN 43 AND 22 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM mailings3 m3 WHERE m3.refid = c.id AND m3.response = 'YES' AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' ) GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS total_sales, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS total_mailings, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid WHERE s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND c.age BETWEEN 21 AND 30 GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '1000' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 1 ORDER BY total_amount DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS unique_sales_events, (SELECT AVG(m3.response::integer) FROM mailings3 m3 WHERE m3.refid = c.id AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01') AS avg_mailing3_response_rate FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m12 ON c.id = m12.refid WHERE s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.amount > '0' GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '100' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date) AS sale_year, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM s.event_date) AS sale_quarter, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS total_sales, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_geoid_income, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date), c.sex ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS spending_rank_by_year_sex FROM customers c JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid WHERE s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.amount > '0' AND d.income_k BETWEEN 470.83 AND 132.85 GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM s.event_date) HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY sale_year DESC, sale_quarter, total_amount DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, COUNT(DISTINCT m12.refid) AS mailings_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m12.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_geoid_income, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m12 ON c.id = m12.refid AND m12.ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND '2020-01-01 00:00:00' WHERE c.occupation LIKE '%' AND c.marital_status LIKE '%' GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' OR SUM(s.amount) IS NULL ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC NULLS LAST;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS unique_sales_events, COUNT(m1.response) FILTER (WHERE m1.response = 'YES') AS mailings1_yes_count, COUNT(m3.response) FILTER (WHERE m3.response = 'YES') AS mailings3_yes_count, SUM(d.a_var1 * d.a_var2) / NULLIF(SUM(d.a_var3), 0) AS computed_demog_ratio, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_demographic, LAG(SUM(s.amount), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.id ORDER BY DATE_TRUNC('month', s.event_date)) AS prev_month_sales FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid JOIN sales s2 ON s.eventid = s2.eventid AND s.refid <> s2.refid WHERE s.amount > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.event_date <= '2020-01-01' AND d.income_k BETWEEN 20.54 AND 464.24 AND m1.ref_date >= '2019-01-01' AND m3.ref_date >= '2019-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, DATE_TRUNC('month', s.event_date) HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '100' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 2 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, sales_rank_by_demographic;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.ref_date) AS mailings_count, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT m3.response, ', ' ORDER BY m3.response) AS response_list, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_percentile, LAG(SUM(s.amount), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex ORDER BY d.income_k DESC) AS prev_sales_by_sex_income FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE c.age > 62 AND d.income_k BETWEEN 284.12 AND 502.96 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m1.ref_date < '2023-01-01' AND m3.response IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '1000' AND COUNT(DISTINCT m1.kxindex) >= 48 ORDER BY total_sales DESC, avg_income ASC;

SELECT c.id, c.age, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, d.a_var1, d.a_var2, d.a_var3, d.a_var4, d.a_var5, d.a_var6, d.a_var7, d.a_var8, d.a_var9, d.a_var10, d.a_var11, d.a_var12, d.a_var13, d.a_var14, d.a_var15, d.a_var16, d.a_var17, d.a_var18, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count_m12, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailings_count_m3, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS distinct_sales_events, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s.amount) AS median_sale_amount, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s.amount) AS percentile_75_sale_amount, AVG(d.a_var1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.marital_status, c.occupation) AS avg_a_var1_by_demo, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank, (SELECT AVG(sub_s.amount) FROM sales sub_s WHERE sub_s.refid IN (SELECT sub_m.refid FROM mailings1_2 sub_m WHERE sub_m.response = 'Yes') AND sub_s.amount > '0') AS avg_sales_from_responders_above_threshold FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 69 AND 38 AND c.educationnum > 15 AND d.income_k > 391.33 AND d.a_var1 < '-1000' GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, d.a_var1, d.a_var2, d.a_var3, d.a_var4, d.a_var5, d.a_var6, d.a_var7, d.a_var8, d.a_var9, d.a_var10, d.a_var11, d.a_var12, d.a_var13, d.a_var14, d.a_var15, d.a_var16, d.a_var17, d.a_var18 HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 72 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, sales_rank;

SELECT c.id, c.age, d.geoid, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.amount > '0' GROUP BY c.id, c.age, d.geoid INTERSECT SELECT c.id, c.age, d.geoid, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN mailings1_2 m ON c.id = m.refid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE m.response = 'Yes' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.age, d.geoid ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.refid) AS unique_customers, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m ON s.refid = m.refid WHERE s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.amount > '0' AND d.income_k BETWEEN 290.14 AND 129.61 GROUP BY d.geoid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.refid) > 46 UNION ALL SELECT d.geoid, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.refid) AS unique_customers, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings3 m ON s.refid = m.refid WHERE s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.amount > '0' AND d.income_k BETWEEN 1.12 AND 143.03 GROUP BY d.geoid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.refid) > 30 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date) AS sale_year, COUNT(s.eventid) AS total_sales, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, GROUPING(d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date)) AS grouping_id FROM sales s JOIN customers c ON s.refid = c.id JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid WHERE s.amount > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND d.income_k BETWEEN 211.39 AND 348.59 GROUP BY CUBE(d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date)) HAVING COUNT(s.eventid) > 987 ORDER BY total_amount DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(c.age) AS avg_age, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mailings3 m3 WHERE m3.refid IN (SELECT s2.refid FROM sales s2 WHERE s2.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s2.amount > '0') AND m3.response = 'Y') AS recent_positive_mailings FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON s.refid = m1.refid WHERE d.income_k > 245.1 AND c.age BETWEEN 66 AND 99 AND s.event_date >= '2019-01-01' GROUP BY d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) >= 22 ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS unique_mailings1_2_refs, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS unique_mailings3_refs, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE d.income_k > 235.98 AND s.event_date >= '2000-01-01' AND m1.ref_date >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' UNION SELECT d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS unique_mailings1_2_refs, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS unique_mailings3_refs, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE d.income_k > 803.84 AND s.event_date >= '2000-01-01' AND m3.ref_date >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

WITH customer_agg AS ( SELECT c.id AS c_id, c.geoid AS c_geoid, c.age AS c_age, c.educationnum AS c_educationnum, COUNT(DISTINCT m12.refid) AS m12_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS m3_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m12.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS m12_yes, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS m3_yes, AVG(c.data1) AS avg_data1, AVG(c.data2) AS avg_data2, AVG(c.data3) AS avg_data3 FROM customers c LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m12 ON c.id = m12.refid AND m12.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 46 AND 48 GROUP BY c.id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m12.refid) > 2 OR COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) > 7 ), sales_agg AS ( SELECT s.refid AS s_refid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_amount, MIN(s.event_date) AS first_sale, MAX(s.event_date) AS last_sale FROM sales s WHERE s.event_date BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' GROUP BY s.refid HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '1000' ), demog_agg AS ( SELECT d.geoid AS d_geoid, d.inhabitants_k AS d_inhabitants_k, d.income_k AS d_income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_var2, AVG(d.a_var3) AS avg_var3, AVG(d.a_var4) AS avg_var4, AVG(d.a_var5) AS avg_var5, AVG(d.a_var6) AS avg_var6, AVG(d.a_var7) AS avg_var7, AVG(d.a_var8) AS avg_var8, AVG(d.a_var9) AS avg_var9, AVG(d.a_var10) AS avg_var10, AVG(d.a_var11) AS avg_var11, AVG(d.a_var12) AS avg_var12, AVG(d.a_var13) AS avg_var13, AVG(d.a_var14) AS avg_var14, AVG(d.a_var15) AS avg_var15, AVG(d.a_var16) AS avg_var16, AVG(d.a_var17) AS avg_var17, AVG(d.a_var18) AS avg_var18 FROM demog d WHERE d.income_k > 159.28 GROUP BY d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING AVG(d.a_var1) > '0' AND AVG(d.a_var2) < '0' ) SELECT ca.c_id, ca.c_age, ca.c_educationnum, ca.m12_count, ca.m3_count, ca.m12_yes, ca.m3_yes, ca.avg_data1, ca.avg_data2, ca.avg_data3, sa.sales_count, sa.total_amount, sa.avg_amount, sa.first_sale, sa.last_sale, da.d_inhabitants_k, da.d_income_k, da.avg_var1, da.avg_var2, da.avg_var3, da.avg_var4, da.avg_var5, da.avg_var6, da.avg_var7, da.avg_var8, da.avg_var9, da.avg_var10, da.avg_var11, da.avg_var12, da.avg_var13, da.avg_var14, da.avg_var15, da.avg_var16, da.avg_var17, da.avg_var18, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sa.total_amount DESC) AS sales_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ca.m12_yes + ca.m3_yes DESC) AS response_rank, LAG(sa.total_amount, 1) OVER (ORDER BY sa.total_amount) AS prev_total_amount FROM customer_agg ca INNER JOIN sales_agg sa ON ca.c_id = sa.s_refid INNER JOIN demog_agg da ON ca.c_geoid = da.d_geoid WHERE ca.c_age > 31 AND sa.total_amount > '5000' ORDER BY sa.total_amount DESC, ca.c_age ASC LIMIT 408;

WITH customer_agg AS ( SELECT c.id AS c_id, c.geoid AS c_geoid, c.age AS c_age, c.educationnum AS c_educationnum, c.sex AS c_sex, c.marital_status AS c_marital_status, c.occupation AS c_occupation, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS m1_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS m3_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS m1_yes, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS m3_yes, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2, AVG(d.a_var3) AS avg_a_var3 FROM customers c LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' INNER JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid WHERE c.age BETWEEN 24 AND 18 GROUP BY c.id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation ), sales_agg AS ( SELECT s.refid AS s_refid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_amount, MIN(s.event_date) AS first_sale, MAX(s.event_date) AS last_sale FROM sales s WHERE s.event_date BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2019-01-01' GROUP BY s.refid ), self_joined_customers AS ( SELECT ca1.c_id AS cust1_id, ca1.c_age AS cust1_age, ca1.c_educationnum AS cust1_edu, ca1.c_sex AS cust1_sex, ca1.c_occupation AS cust1_occ, ca1.m1_count AS cust1_m1_cnt, ca1.m3_yes AS cust1_m3_yes, ca1.avg_a_var1 AS cust1_avg_var1, ca2.c_id AS cust2_id, ca2.c_age AS cust2_age, ca2.c_educationnum AS cust2_edu, ca2.c_sex AS cust2_sex, ca2.c_occupation AS cust2_occ, ca2.m1_count AS cust2_m1_cnt, ca2.m3_yes AS cust2_m3_yes, ca2.avg_a_var1 AS cust2_avg_var1, ABS(ca1.c_age - ca2.c_age) AS age_diff, ABS(ca1.c_educationnum - ca2.c_educationnum) AS edu_diff FROM customer_agg ca1 INNER JOIN customer_agg ca2 ON ca1.c_geoid = ca2.c_geoid AND ca1.c_id < ca2.c_id WHERE ca1.c_marital_status = ca2.c_marital_status AND ca1.c_sex = ca2.c_sex AND ca1.avg_a_var1 > '0.0' AND ca2.avg_a_var1 > '0.0' ) SELECT sjc.cust1_id, sjc.cust2_id, sjc.age_diff, sjc.edu_diff, sjc.cust1_avg_var1, sjc.cust2_avg_var1, sa1.sales_count AS cust1_sales_cnt, sa1.total_amount AS cust1_total_amt, sa1.avg_amount AS cust1_avg_amt, sa2.sales_count AS cust2_sales_cnt, sa2.total_amount AS cust2_total_amt, sa2.avg_amount AS cust2_avg_amt, d1.inhabitants_k AS cust1_inhabitants, d1.income_k AS cust1_income, d2.inhabitants_k AS cust2_inhabitants, d2.income_k AS cust2_income, (sa1.total_amount + sa2.total_amount) AS combined_sales, (sjc.cust1_m1_cnt + sjc.cust2_m1_cnt) AS combined_m1_cnt, (sjc.cust1_m3_yes + sjc.cust2_m3_yes) AS combined_m3_yes FROM self_joined_customers sjc LEFT JOIN sales_agg sa1 ON sjc.cust1_id = sa1.s_refid LEFT JOIN sales_agg sa2 ON sjc.cust2_id = sa2.s_refid INNER JOIN demog d1 ON sjc.cust1_id = d1.geoid INNER JOIN demog d2 ON sjc.cust2_id = d2.geoid WHERE (sa1.total_amount > '1000.0' OR sa2.total_amount > '1000.0') AND (d1.income_k BETWEEN 10.94 AND 105.6) AND (d2.income_k BETWEEN 148.29 AND 197.17) AND sjc.age_diff <= 30 AND sjc.edu_diff <= 18 ORDER BY combined_sales DESC, age_diff ASC, edu_diff ASC LIMIT 6250;

SELECT c.geoid, c.sex, c.occupation, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date) AS sale_year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM s.event_date) AS sale_month, COUNT(DISTINCT s.refid) AS unique_customers, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_amount, SUM(d.inhabitants_k) AS total_inhabitants_k, SUM(d.income_k) AS total_income_k FROM customers c JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.response = 'YES' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.response = 'YES' WHERE s.amount > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND c.age BETWEEN 46 AND 91 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (c.geoid, c.sex, c.occupation, sale_year, sale_month), (c.geoid, c.sex, c.occupation), (c.geoid, sale_year, sale_month), (c.sex, sale_year, sale_month), (sale_year, sale_month), () ) HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '1000' ORDER BY total_amount DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1 FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE c.age >= 42 AND c.educationnum >= 14 AND d.income_k >= 53.44 GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '100' AND COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) >= 7 ORDER BY total_amount DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_demog_var FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE c.age BETWEEN 34 AND 31 AND d.income_k > 91.66 AND (m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' OR m1.ref_date IS NULL) GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.income_k HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) > 8 AND SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_amount DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m12.refid) AS mailings_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2 FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m12 ON c.id = m12.refid AND m12.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 28 AND 31 AND d.income_k > 99.05 GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '1000' AND COUNT(DISTINCT m12.refid) >= 5 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2, AVG(d.a_var3) AS avg_a_var3, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS unique_sales_events, COUNT(m12.refid) AS mailings1_2_count, COUNT(m3.refid) AS mailings3_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m12.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings1_2_yes_responses, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings3_yes_responses, AVG(c.educationnum) OVER (PARTITION BY c.marital_status, c.occupation) AS avg_education_by_status_occupation, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_amount_rank FROM customers c INNER JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m12 ON c.id = m12.refid AND m12.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND '2020-01-01 00:00:00' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 92 AND 68 AND d.income_k > 721.36 AND (c.sex = 'M' OR c.marital_status = 'Married') GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 72 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, avg_education_by_status_occupation ASC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, d.a_var1, d.a_var2, d.a_var3, d.a_var4, d.a_var5, d.a_var6, d.a_var7, d.a_var8, d.a_var9, d.a_var10, d.a_var11, d.a_var12, d.a_var13, d.a_var14, d.a_var15, d.a_var16, d.a_var17, d.a_var18, COUNT(DISTINCT m12.refid) AS mailings12_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailings3_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, MAX(s.event_date) AS last_sale_date, MIN(m12.ref_date) AS first_mailing12_date, MIN(m3.ref_date) AS first_mailing3_date, SUM(CASE WHEN m12.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings12_yes_responses, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings3_yes_responses, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s.amount) AS median_sale_amount, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_amount_rank, LAG(SUM(s.amount), 1) OVER (ORDER AND s.amount > '0.0' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 42 AND 63 AND c.educationnum >= 6 AND d.income_k > 390.01 AND d.inhabitants_k < '0.0' AND (d.a_var1 > '-100.0' OR d.a_var2 < '-100.0') AND d.a_var3 BETWEEN '-100.0' AND '-50.0' AND d.a_var4 NOT BETWEEN '-100.0' AND '-50.0' AND (c.marital_status = 'Married-civ-spouse' OR c.occupation = 'Adm-clerical') AND c.sex IN ('Male', 'Female') GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, d.a_var1, d.a_var2, d.a_var3, d.a_var4, d.a_var5, d.a_var6, d.a_var7, d.a_var8, d.a_var9, d.a_var10, d.a_var11, d.a_var12, d.a_var13, d.a_var14, d.a_var15, d.a_var16, d.a_var17, d.a_var18 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 68 AND SUM(s.amount) > '0.0' AND AVG(s.amount) BETWEEN '0.0' AND '100.0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT m12.refid) + COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) > 44 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, sales_count DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.income_k, AVG(s.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status) AS avg_amount_by_demographic, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status) AS count_by_demographic, SUM(s.amount) AS total_spent, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS unique_sales_events FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE s.amount > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.income_k, s.amount, s.event_date ORDER BY total_spent DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales FROM customers c INNER JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 30 AND 37 AND d.income_k > 408.58 GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.income_k HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) > 613 AND SUM(s.amount) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY total_sales DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS total_mailings, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses, SUM(CASE WHEN s.eventid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sales_count, COALESCE(SUM(s.amount), 0) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_demog_var1 FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 81 AND 71 AND d.income_k > 324.06 GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.income_k HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) > 12 AND COALESCE(SUM(s.amount), 0) < '0' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, total_mailings DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS total_mailings, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses, SUM(CASE WHEN s.eventid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sales_count, SUM(CASE WHEN s.eventid IS NOT NULL THEN s.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN d.a_var1 END) AS avg_a_var1_for_yes FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 29 AND 48 AND d.income_k > 327.91 GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.income_k HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) > 58 AND SUM(CASE WHEN s.eventid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 17 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, total_mailings DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m12.refid) AS mailings_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m12.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings_yes_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(CASE WHEN c.educationnum > 7 THEN s.amount ELSE NULL END) AS avg_sales_high_edu, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS unique_sales_events FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m12 ON c.id = m12.refid AND m12.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 19 AND 22 GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS unique_sales_events, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings1_2_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailings3_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings1_2_yes_responses, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings3_yes_responses, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_demographic FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND '2020-01-01 00:00:00' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 94 AND 82 AND c.educationnum >= 11 AND d.income_k > 444.38 AND (d.a_var3 > '0' OR d.a_var4 < '0') GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 29 AND (COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) > 37 OR COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) > 20) ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, sales_rank_by_demographic;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(s.eventid) AS sales_count FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.response = 'YES' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE c.age >= 68 AND c.educationnum >= 20 GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(s.eventid) >= 80 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.ref_date) AS mailings_count, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT m3.response, ', ' ORDER BY m3.response) AS response_list, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_percentile, LAG(SUM(s.amount), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex ORDER BY d.income_k DESC) AS prev_sales_by_sex_income FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE c.age > 19 AND d.income_k BETWEEN 477.39 AND 150.19 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m1.ref_date < '2023-01-01' AND m3.response IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '1000' AND COUNT(DISTINCT m1.kxindex) >= 29 ORDER BY total_sales DESC, avg_income ASC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, (SELECT AVG(m3.response::integer) FROM mailings3 m3 WHERE m3.refid = c.id AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01') AS recent_response_rate, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.marital_status ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_marital FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE c.age BETWEEN 64 AND 96 AND d.income_k > 363.72 AND s.event_date >= '2019-01-01' AND m1.response = 'YES' GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT m1.kxindex) >= 16 ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS total_mailings, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS total_mailings3, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS responses_m1, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS responses_m3, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS total_sales_events, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN s.amount > '1000' THEN s.amount ELSE 0 END) AS high_value_sales, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2, STDDEV(d.a_var3) AS stddev_a_var3, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY d.a_var4) AS median_a_var4, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank, LAG(SUM(s.amount), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex ORDER BY d.income_k DESC) AS prev_sales_by_sex_income FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m1.ref_date < '2021-01-01' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m3.ref_date < '2021-01-01' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.event_date < '2021-01-01' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 74 AND 87 AND d.income_k > 189.45 AND (c.educationnum > 0 OR c.nom1 = 'A') GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) > 52 AND SUM(s.amount) >= '0' AND AVG(d.a_var1) < '-1000' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, sales_rank ASC LIMIT 74;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m12.refid) AS mailings_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) FILTER (WHERE s.amount > 0) AS positive_sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, CASE WHEN d.income_k >= 356.8 THEN 'High Income' WHEN d.income_k >= 78.46 THEN 'Medium Income' ELSE 'Low Income' END AS income_category, CASE WHEN c.age >= 75 THEN 'Senior' WHEN c.age >= 43 THEN 'Adult' ELSE 'Young' END AS age_group FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m12 ON c.id = m12.refid AND m12.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 83 AND 36 AND d.inhabitants_k >= '1' GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, c.age HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

SELECT c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.amount > '0' GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '1000' EXCEPT SELECT c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m ON c.id = m.refid WHERE m.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m.response = 'Yes' GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k ORDER BY total_amount DESC;

SELECT c.id, c.sex, d.geoid, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, COUNT(m1.refid) AS mail_count FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid WHERE s.amount > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND d.income_k BETWEEN 263.72 AND 121.91 GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, d.geoid HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS customer_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailing_response_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE d.inhabitants_k > '0' AND c.age BETWEEN 51 AND 52 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY d.geoid HAVING AVG(d.income_k) > 269.86 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS customer_count, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, MAX(s.event_date) AS latest_sale_date FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM mailings1_2 m WHERE m.refid = c.id AND m.response = 'YES' AND m.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' ) AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND d.income_k BETWEEN 134.49 AND 56.39 GROUP BY d.geoid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 809 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailing_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) FILTER (WHERE s.amount > '100') AS high_value_sales_count, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(d.inhabitants_k) AS total_inhabitants, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_sex FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE c.age BETWEEN 18 AND 98 AND d.income_k >= 159.45 AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status), (d.geoid, c.sex), (d.geoid), () ) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) > 55 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC NULLS LAST;

SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date) AS sale_year, COUNT(DISTINCT s.refid) AS unique_customers, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, SUM(SUM(s.amount)) OVER (PARTITION BY d.geoid, c.sex ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date)) AS cumulative_sales_by_demo FROM sales s JOIN customers c ON s.refid = c.id JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON s.refid = m1.refid AND s.event_date >= m1.ref_date LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON s.refid = m3.refid AND s.event_date >= m3.ref_date WHERE s.amount > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND d.income_k BETWEEN 197.88 AND 87.6 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, sale_year), (d.geoid, c.sex, sale_year), (d.geoid, sale_year), (sale_year), () ) HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY d.geoid, c.sex, sale_year;

SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS responses_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank, LAG(SUM(s.amount), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY d.geoid ORDER BY DATE_TRUNC('month', s.event_date)) AS prev_month_sales FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid WHERE d.income_k > 251.38 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.amount < '0' GROUP BY d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, DATE_TRUNC('month', s.event_date) HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '100' AND COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) >= 82 UNION ALL SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailings_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS responses_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank, LAG(SUM(s.amount), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY d.geoid ORDER BY DATE_TRUNC('month', s.event_date)) AS prev_month_sales FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE d.income_k > 469.69 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.amount < '0' GROUP BY d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, DATE_TRUNC('month', s.event_date) HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '100' AND COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) >= 28 ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS unique_mailings1_2, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS unique_mailings3, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses_m1, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses_m3, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY d.a_var1) AS median_a_var1, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY d.a_var2) AS median_a_var2, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY d.a_var3) AS median_a_var3, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY d.a_var4) AS median_a_var4, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY d.a_var5) AS median_a_var5, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY d.a_var6) AS median_a_var6, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY d.a_var7) AS median_a_var7, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY d.a_var8) AS median_a_var8, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY d.a_var9) AS median_a_var9, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY d.a_var10) AS median_a_var10, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY d.a_var11) AS median_a_var11, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5)
