PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY d.a_var15) AS median_a_var15, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY d.a_var16) AS median_a_var16, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY d.a_var17) AS median_a_var17, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY d.a_var18) AS median_a_var18, AVG(c.data1) AS avg_data1, AVG(c.data2) AS avg_data2, AVG(c.data3) AS avg_data3, COUNT(*) AS total_records, SUM(d.inhabitants_k) AS total_inhabitants FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE s.event_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND s.event_date <= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND m1.ref_date <= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND m3.ref_date <= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND c.age >= 49 AND c.age <= 94 AND c.educationnum >= 19 AND c.educationnum <= 1 AND d.income_k >= 591.24 AND d.income_k <= 758.4 GROUP BY d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation HAVING SUM(s.amount) > (SELECT AVG(amount) * 1.81 FROM sales WHERE event_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND event_date <= '2020-01-01 00:00:00') AND COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) > 603 AND COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) > 394 AND AVG(d.income_k) > (SELECT AVG(income_k) FROM demog WHERE geoid IN (SELECT geoid FROM customers WHERE age >= 70 AND age <= 50)) ORDER BY total_sales DESC, avg_income DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailings3_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(d.inhabitants_k) AS avg_inhabitants, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(d.a_var1 + d.a_var2 + d.a_var3 + d.a_var4 + d.a_var5 + d.a_var6 + d.a_var7 + d.a_var8 + d.a_var9 + d.a_var10 + d.a_var11 + d.a_var12 + d.a_var13 + d.a_var14 + d.a_var15 + d.a_var16 + d.a_var17 + d.a_var18) AS sum_all_a_vars, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY d.geoid) AS prev_sales_count_by_demo FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND '2020-01-01 00:00:00' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 61 AND 82 AND c.educationnum >= 20 AND d.income_k > 793.82 AND (m1.response = 'YES' OR m1.response IS NULL) AND (m3.response = 'YES' OR m3.response IS NULL) GROUP BY d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) > 752 AND SUM(s.amount) >= '0' AND AVG(d.inhabitants_k) < '0' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, sales_count ASC;

SELECT d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(c.age) AS avg_age, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailing_count, MAX(m3.ref_date) AS latest_mailing_date, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank, LAG(d.inhabitants_k, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY d.geoid ORDER BY MAX(m3.ref_date)) AS prev_inhabitants FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE s.amount > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM mailings1_2 m2 WHERE m2.refid = c.id AND m2.response = 'Yes' AND m2.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' ORDER BY m2.ref_date DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 69 ) AND d.income_k BETWEEN 328.55 AND 408.69 GROUP BY d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) > 27 AND AVG(c.age) < 81 ORDER BY total_sales DESC, d.geoid;

WITH customer_aggregates AS ( SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status, COUNT(DISTINCT m12.refid) AS mailings_count, AVG(m12.kxindex) AS avg_kxindex, SUM(CASE WHEN m12.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses FROM customers c LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m12 ON c.id = m12.refid WHERE c.age BETWEEN 64 AND 72 AND c.educationnum >= 2 GROUP BY c.id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m12.refid) > 57 ), sales_analysis AS ( SELECT s.refid, COUNT(s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, MIN(s.event_date) AS first_sale_date, MAX(s.event_date) AS last_sale_date FROM sales s WHERE s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.amount > '0.0' GROUP BY s.refid ), mailings3_aggregates AS ( SELECT m3.refid, COUNT(*) AS m3_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS m3_positive FROM mailings3 m3 WHERE m3.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' GROUP BY m3.refid ) SELECT ca.customer_id, ca.age, ca.educationnum, ca.sex, ca.marital_status, ca.mailings_count, ca.avg_kxindex, ca.positive_responses, COALESCE(sa.sales_count, 0) AS sales_count, COALESCE(sa.total_amount, 0) AS total_sales_amount, COALESCE(sa.avg_sale_amount, 0) AS avg_sale_amount, sa.first_sale_date, sa.last_sale_date, COALESCE(ma.m3_count, 0) AS m3_mailings_count, COALESCE(ma.m3_positive, 0) AS m3_positive_responses, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, d.a_var1, d.a_var2, d.a_var3, d.a_var4, d.a_var5, d.a_var6, d.a_var7, d.a_var8, d.a_var9, d.a_var10, d.a_var11, d.a_var12, d.a_var13, d.a_var14, d.a_var15, d.a_var16, d.a_var17, d.a_var18, (ca.positive_responses * 1.0 / NULLIF(ca.mailings_count, 0)) AS response_rate, (COALESCE(sa.total_amount, 0) * 1.0 / NULLIF(ca.mailings_count, 0)) AS revenue_per_mailing, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(sa.total_amount, 0) DESC) AS sales_rank, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ca.sex ORDER BY ca.age DESC) AS age_rank_by_sex FROM customer_aggregates ca LEFT JOIN sales_analysis sa ON ca.customer_id = sa.refid LEFT JOIN mailings3_aggregates ma ON ca.customer_id = ma.refid LEFT JOIN demog d ON ca.geoid = d.geoid WHERE d.income_k > 378.99 AND d.inhabitants_k BETWEEN '0.0' AND '0.0' AND (d.a_var1 + d.a_var2 + d.a_var3) > '0.0' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, ca.customer_id LIMIT 9997;

WITH ranked_sales AS ( SELECT s.eventid, s.refid, s.event_date, s.amount, c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, d.a_var1, d.a_var2, d.a_var3, d.a_var4, d.a_var5, d.a_var6, d.a_var7, d.a_var8, d.a_var9, d.a_var10, d.a_var11, d.a_var12, d.a_var13, d.a_var14, d.a_var15, d.a_var16, d.a_var17, d.a_var18, m1.ref_date AS mailing1_date, m1.response AS mailing1_response, m3.ref_date AS mailing3_date, m3.response AS mailing3_response, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.id ORDER BY s.event_date DESC) AS sale_rank, SUM(s.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY c.id, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date)) AS yearly_spent, AVG(s.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY c.geoid, c.occupation) AS avg_occupation_area_amount FROM sales s JOIN customers c ON s.refid = c.id JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND s.event_date >= m1.ref_date LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND s.event_date >= m3.ref_date WHERE s.amount > '10' AND s.event_date >= '2010-01-01' AND c.age BETWEEN 22 AND 92 AND d.income_k > 20.99 ), aggregated_data AS ( SELECT customer_id, age, educationnum, sex, marital_status, occupation, geoid, inhabitants_k, income_k, COUNT(*) AS total_sales, SUM(amount) AS total_amount, MAX(yearly_spent) AS max_yearly_spent, AVG(avg_occupation_area_amount) AS avg_area_occupation_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN mailing1_response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_mailing1_responses, SUM(CASE WHEN mailing3_response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_mailing3_responses, SUM(a_var1 + a_var2 + a_var3 + a_var4 + a_var5 + a_var6 + a_var7 + a_var8 + a_var9 + a_var10 + a_var11 + a_var12 + a_var13 + a_var14 + a_var15 + a_var16 + a_var17 + a_var18) AS sum_demog_vars FROM ranked_sales WHERE sale_rank <= 14 GROUP BY customer_id, age, educationnum, sex, marital_status, occupation, geoid, inhabitants_k, income_k HAVING SUM(amount) > '1000' AND AVG(avg_occupation_area_amount) < '500' ) SELECT geoid, occupation, sex, marital_status, COUNT(customer_id) AS customer_count, AVG(age) AS avg_age, AVG(educationnum) AS avg_education, SUM(total_amount) AS grand_total_amount, AVG(total_amount) AS avg_customer_spend, MAX(max_yearly_spent) AS peak_yearly_spend, AVG(avg_area_occupation_amount) AS avg_occupation_area_spend, SUM(positive_mailing1_responses) AS total_mailing1_positive, SUM(positive_mailing3_responses) AS total_mailing3_positive, AVG(sum_demog_vars) AS avg_demog_sum, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(total_amount) DESC) AS revenue_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY occupation ORDER BY AVG(total_amount) DESC) AS occupation_spend_rank FROM aggregated_data GROUP BY geoid, occupation, sex, marital_status ORDER SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, COALESCE(SUM(s.amount), 0) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailing_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailing3_count, AVG(d.a_var1) OVER(PARTITION BY c.marital_status, c.sex) AS avg_a_var1_by_demo FROM customers c LEFT JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 32 AND 81 AND c.educationnum >= 3 AND (d.income_k IS NULL OR d.income_k > 255.99) GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING COALESCE(SUM(s.amount), 0) < '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) <= 76 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, sales_count DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(m1.kxindex) AS avg_kxindex, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.ref_date) AS distinct_mailing_dates, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, (SELECT AVG(s2.amount) FROM sales s2 WHERE s2.refid = c.id AND s2.event_date >= '2020-01-01') AS avg_recent_sales, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.marital_status ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_marital, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(m1.kxindex)) AS kxindex_percentile FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE c.age BETWEEN 25 AND 68 AND d.income_k > 201.57 AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.amount > '0' GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, c.marital_status HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) > 52 AND AVG(m1.kxindex) < 363 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, avg_kxindex ASC LIMIT 56;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings_yes_count, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sale_amount, COUNT(s.eventid) AS sales_count FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE c.age >= 48 AND c.age <= 32 AND d.income_k > 154.75 AND (m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' OR m1.ref_date IS NULL) AND (s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' OR s.event_date IS NULL) GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING COUNT(s.eventid) > 0 ORDER BY total_sale_amount DESC NULLS LAST;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS total_mailings, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses_m1, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses_m3, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS unique_sales_events, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' WHERE c.age >= 88 AND c.age <= 62 AND d.income_k >= 90.94 GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS total_sales, SUM(CASE WHEN s.amount > '100' THEN s.amount ELSE 0 END) AS high_value_sales_sum, COUNT(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'Y' THEN 1 END) AS positive_mailings1_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'Y' THEN 1 END) AS positive_mailings3_count, AVG(s.amount) FILTER (WHERE s.event_date >= '2020-01-01') AS avg_sales_amount_recent FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE c.age BETWEEN 50 AND 65 AND d.income_k >= 115.91 GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) > 11 ORDER BY high_value_sales_sum DESC NULLS LAST;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS unique_sales_events, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings1_2_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailings3_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings1_2_yes_responses, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings3_yes_responses, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_demographic, LAG(SUM(s.amount), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.id ORDER BY DATE_TRUNC('month', s.event_date)) AS prev_month_sales FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND s.event_date BETWEEN m1.ref_date - INTERVAL '30 days' AND m1.ref_date + INTERVAL '30 days' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND s.event_date BETWEEN m3.ref_date - INTERVAL '30 days' AND m3.ref_date + INTERVAL '30 days' WHERE c.occupation LIKE '%' AND c.marital_status ~ '^.*$' AND s.amount > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND d.income_k BETWEEN 204.68 AND 336.0 GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, DATE_TRUNC('month', s.event_date) HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 76 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, sales_rank_by_demographic;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status) AS avg_a_var1_by_demo, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT m12.refid) AS mailings1_2_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailings3_count, MAX(s.event_date) AS latest_sale_date, MIN(m12.ref_date) AS first_mailing1_2_date FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m12 ON c.id = m12.refid LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE c.age >= 96 AND c.age <= 86 AND d.income_k > 135.84 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m12.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT m12.refid) >= 127 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, MAX(s.event_date) AS last_sale_date FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE s.event_date >= (CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '329 days') AND s.amount > '0' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date) = 2020 GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '100' ORDER BY total_amount DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS unique_sales_events, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT m1.response, ', ' ORDER BY m1.response) AS mailing_responses_1_2, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT m3.response, ', ' ORDER BY m3.response) AS mailing_responses_3, SUM(d.a_var1 * d.a_var2) / NULLIF(SUM(d.a_var3), 0) AS complex_demog_ratio, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank, LAG(SUM(s.amount), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY d.geoid) AS prev_geoid_sales FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE s.amount > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND d.income_k BETWEEN 178.56 AND 489.57 AND c.age >= 43 GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 46 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, d.geoid;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM m1.ref_date) AS mailing_year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM m1.ref_date) AS mailing_month, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS total_mailings, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN m1.refid END) AS positive_responses, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS total_sales, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_geoid_income, SUM(d.a_var1 + d.a_var2 + d.a_var3 + d.a_var4 + d.a_var5 + d.a_var6 + d.a_var7 + d.a_var8 + d.a_var9 + d.a_var10 + d.a_var11 + d.a_var12 + d.a_var13 + d.a_var14 + d.a_var15 + d.a_var16 + d.a_var17 + d.a_var18) AS sum_all_a_vars, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_demographic FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date BETWEEN m1.ref_date AND m1.ref_date + INTERVAL '30 days' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date > m1.ref_date WHERE c.age >= 58 AND c.educationnum >= 9 AND d.income_k >= 155.18 AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND (s.amount >= '0' OR s.amount IS NULL) GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM m1.ref_date), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM m1.ref_date)), (c.sex, c.marital_status, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM m1.ref_date), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM m1.ref_date)), (d.geoid, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM m1.ref_date)), (c.sex, c.marital_status), (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM m1.ref_date)), () ) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) > 71 AND (SUM(s.amount) >= '0' OR SUM(s.amount) IS NULL) ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC NULLS LAST, mailing_year, mailing_month, customer_id;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings1_2_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailings3_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings1_2_yes_responses, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings3_yes_responses, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS distinct_sales_events, SUM(CASE WHEN s.amount > '1000' THEN s.amount ELSE 0 END) AS high_value_sales, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2, SUM(d.a_var3) AS sum_a_var3, SUM(d.a_var4) AS sum_a_var4, COUNT(DISTINCT c.nom1) FILTER (WHERE c.nom1 IS NOT NULL) AS distinct_nom1_count, SUM(CASE WHEN c.educationnum > 14 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_education_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank, LAG(SUM(s.amount), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex ORDER BY d.income_k DESC) AS prev_sales_by_sex_income FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 56 AND 53 AND d.income_k >= 102.78 AND (c.occupation = 'Prof-specialty' OR c.occupation IS NULL) GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) + COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) >= 12 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, d.income_k DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses_m1, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses_m3, AVG(CASE WHEN s.amount > '500' THEN s.amount ELSE NULL END) AS avg_large_sale, COUNT(CASE WHEN c.age BETWEEN 30 AND 45 THEN 1 END) AS customers_in_age_range, SUM(d.a_var1 * d.a_var2) AS demographic_interaction, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_sex, LAG(SUM(s.amount), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.geoid ORDER BY MAX(s.event_date)) AS prev_total_sales_in_area FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2024-01-01' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' WHERE c.educationnum > 12 AND d.income_k BETWEEN 84.46 AND 175.7 AND (c.nom1 = 'ValueA' OR c.nom2 = 'ValueA') GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '1000' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 10 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, sales_count ASC LIMIT 226;
SELECT c.id, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales FROM customers c JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE s.amount > '100' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date) AS sale_year, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM s.event_date) AS sale_quarter, COUNT(DISTINCT s.refid) AS unique_customers, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, SUM(d.income_k) AS total_income_in_area, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM s.event_date) ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_quarter FROM sales s JOIN customers c ON s.refid = c.id JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid WHERE s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.amount > '0' AND d.income_k BETWEEN 178.58 AND 446.19 GROUP BY d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM s.event_date) HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY sale_year DESC, sale_quarter DESC, sales_rank_by_quarter ASC;

SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS unique_events, COUNT(m1.response) FILTER (WHERE m1.response = 'YES') AS mailings1_yes_count, COUNT(m3.response) FILTER (WHERE m3.response = 'YES') AS mailings3_yes_count, SUM(d.a_var1 + d.a_var2 + d.a_var3 + d.a_var4 + d.a_var5 + d.a_var6 + d.a_var7 + d.a_var8 + d.a_var9 + d.a_var10 + d.a_var11 + d.a_var12 + d.a_var13 + d.a_var14 + d.a_var15 + d.a_var16 + d.a_var17 + d.a_var18) AS sum_all_a_vars, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_demog FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE s.amount > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND c.age BETWEEN 65 AND 94 AND d.income_k > '0' GROUP BY d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) > 47 AND AVG(d.income_k) BETWEEN '0' AND '0' ORDER BY total_sales DESC, avg_income DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings_responses, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_events, (SELECT AVG(s2.amount) FROM sales s2 WHERE s2.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s2.amount > '0') AS avg_recent_sales_amount FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON m1.refid = s.refid AND s.event_date BETWEEN m1.ref_date AND m1.ref_date + INTERVAL '30 days' WHERE d.inhabitants_k > '0' AND d.income_k BETWEEN 379.36 AND 215.88 AND c.age >= 44 AND c.educationnum >= 4 GROUP BY d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) >= 28 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, mailings_count DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, COUNT(DISTINCT m12.refid) AS mailings_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC NULLS LAST) AS sales_rank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) DESC) AS sales_count_rank_by_demo FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m12 ON c.id = m12.refid AND m12.ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND '2020-01-01 00:00:00' WHERE d.inhabitants_k > '0.0' AND d.income_k BETWEEN 686.51 AND 131.72 AND c.age >= 71 GROUP BY d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) > 499 AND SUM(s.amount) > '0.0' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

WITH customer_agg AS ( SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS total_sales, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount FROM customers c LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum ), demog_stats AS ( SELECT d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, SUM(d.a_var2) AS sum_a_var2 FROM demog d WHERE d.income_k >= 126.81 GROUP BY d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k ), mailing_response AS ( SELECT m.refid, COUNT(*) AS total_mailings, SUM(CASE WHEN m.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses FROM mailings1_2 m WHERE m.ref_date BETWEEN '2022-01-01' AND '2023-01-01' GROUP BY m.refid ) SELECT ca.customer_id, ca.age, ca.educationnum, ca.total_sales, ca.total_amount, ca.avg_sale_amount, ds.inhabitants_k, ds.income_k, ds.avg_a_var1, ds.sum_a_var2, mr.total_mailings, mr.positive_responses, AVG(ca.total_amount) OVER ( PARTITION BY ca.geoid ORDER BY ca.customer_id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_amount_by_geoid FROM customer_agg ca JOIN demog_stats ds ON ca.geoid = ds.geoid LEFT JOIN mailing_response mr ON ca.customer_id = mr.refid WHERE ca.total_amount > '1000' ORDER BY ca.total_amount DESC LIMIT 100;

WITH customer_aggregates AS ( SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.educationnum, c.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, d.a_var1, d.a_var2, d.a_var3, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.ref_date) AS mailings_count_1_2, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.ref_date) AS mailings_count_3, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS response_count_1_2, SUM(CASE WHEN SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS unique_sales_events, COUNT(DISTINCT m12.refid) AS mailings1_2_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailings3_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m12.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings1_2_yes_responses, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings3_yes_responses, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_demographic, LAG(SUM(s.amount), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.id ORDER BY DATE_TRUNC('month', s.event_date)) AS prev_month_sales FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m12 ON c.id = m12.refid AND s.event_date BETWEEN m12.ref_date AND (m12.ref_date + INTERVAL '30 days') LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND s.event_date BETWEEN m3.ref_date AND (m3.ref_date + INTERVAL '30 days') WHERE c.age >= 27 AND c.age <= 73 AND c.educationnum >= 18 AND d.income_k >= 426.59 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.event_date <= '2020-01-01' AND (m12.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' OR m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01') GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, DATE_TRUNC('month', s.event_date) HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 852 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, sales_rank_by_demographic;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) OVER(PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid) AS avg_a_var1_by_demo, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings1_2_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailings3_count, (SELECT MAX(m2.ref_date) FROM mailings1_2 m2 WHERE m2.refid = c.id AND m2.response = 'YES') AS last_positive_mailing_date FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 68 AND 27 AND c.educationnum > 1 AND d.income_k >= 280.46 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sales s2 WHERE s2.refid = c.id AND s2.amount > '0') GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) + COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) >= 44 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, avg_a_var1_by_demo ASC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS distinct_mailings1_2_refs, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.kxindex) AS distinct_mailings1_2_kx, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS distinct_mailings3_refs, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS distinct_sales_events, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_demog_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_demog_var2, SUM(d.a_var3) AS sum_demog_var3, SUM(d.a_var4) AS sum_demog_var4, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_sex, LAG(SUM(s.amount), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.marital_status ORDER BY d.income_k DESC) AS prev_sales_by_marital_income FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.response = 'YES' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.response = 'YES' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE c.age >= 45 AND c.age <= 100 AND d.income_k > 242.37 AND (m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' OR m1.ref_date IS NULL) AND (m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' OR m3.ref_date IS NULL) AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) > 19 AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 24 AND SUM(s.amount) BETWEEN '0' AND '0' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, d.income_k DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date) AS sale_year, COUNT(DISTINCT s.refid) AS unique_customers, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE m1.response = 'YES') AS mailings1_yes_responses, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE m3.response = 'YES') AS mailings3_yes_responses FROM sales s JOIN customers c ON s.refid = c.id JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON s.refid = m1.refid AND DATE_TRUNC('month', s.event_date) = DATE_TRUNC('month', m1.ref_date) LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON s.refid = m3.refid AND DATE_TRUNC('month', s.event_date) = DATE_TRUNC('month', m3.ref_date) WHERE s.amount > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND d.income_k BETWEEN 278.21 AND 348.78 GROUP BY CUBE(d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date)) HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_sex, AVG(d.a_var1 + d.a_var2 + d.a_var3 + d.a_var4 + d.a_var5 + d.a_var6 + d.a_var7 + d.a_var8 + d.a_var9 + d.a_var10 + d.a_var11 + d.a_var12 + d.a_var13 + d.a_var14 + d.a_var15 + d.a_var16 + d.a_var17 + d.a_var18) AS avg_demog_index FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE s.amount > 893.24 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND d.income_k BETWEEN 458.86 AND 205.92 AND c.age >= 90 GROUP BY d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation HAVING SUM(s.amount) > 57505.14 AND COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) >= 58 ORDER BY total_sales DESC, avg_income DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailings3_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(d.inhabitants_k) AS total_inhabitants, AVG(c.age) AS avg_customer_age, AVG(c.educationnum) AS avg_education_num, SUM(d.a_var1 + d.a_var2 + d.a_var3 + d.a_var4 + d.a_var5 + d.a_var6 + d.a_var7 + d.a_var8 + d.a_var9 + d.a_var10 + d.a_var11 + d.a_var12 + d.a_var13 + d.a_var14 + d.a_var15 + d.a_var16 + d.a_var17 + d.a_var18) AS sum_all_a_vars, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank, LAG(SUM(s.amount), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY d.geoid) AS prev_geoid_sales FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE d.income_k > 610.99 AND c.age BETWEEN 58 AND 50 AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.amount > '0' GROUP BY d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) > 862 AND SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, d.geoid;

SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailings3_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(d.inhabitants_k) AS total_inhabitants, AVG(c.age) AS avg_customer_age, AVG(c.educationnum) AS avg_education_num, SUM(d.a_var1 + d.a_var2 + d.a_var3 + d.a_var4 + d.a_var5 + d.a_var6 + d.a_var7 + d.a_var8 + d.a_var9 + d.a_var10 + d.a_var11 + d.a_var12 + d.a_var13 + d.a_var14 + d.a_var15 + d.a_var16 + d.a_var17 + d.a_var18) AS sum_all_a_vars, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank, LAG(SUM(s.amount), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY d.geoid) AS prev_geoid_sales FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE d.income_k > 888.29 AND c.age BETWEEN 41 AND 40 AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.amount > '0' GROUP BY d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) > 346 AND SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, d.geoid;

SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS total_mailings, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses_m1, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS unique_sales_events, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_demo FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date >= m1.ref_date WHERE d.inhabitants_k > '0' AND d.income_k BETWEEN 250.59 AND 72.47 AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) > 64 AND SUM(s.amount) > '0' UNION ALL SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS total_mailings, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses_m3, AVG(d.a_var3) AS avg_a_var3, AVG(d.a_var4) AS avg_a_var4, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS unique_sales_events, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_demo FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date >= m3.ref_date WHERE d.inhabitants_k > '0' AND d.income_k BETWEEN 204.3 AND 353.79 AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) > 38 AND SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY geoid, sex, marital_status, occupation;

SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, COUNT(DISTINCT m12.refid) AS total_mailings, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS total_sales, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(d.inhabitants_k) AS avg_inhabitants, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(d.a_var1 + d.a_var2 + d.a_var3 + d.a_var4 + d.a_var5 + d.a_var6 + d.a_var7 + d.a_var8 + d.a_var9 + d.a_var10 + d.a_var11 + d.a_var12 + d.a_var13 + d.a_var14 + d.a_var15 + d.a_var16 + d.a_var17 + d.a_var18) AS sum_all_vars, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_demog, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY d.geoid, c.sex ORDER BY c.occupation) AS prev_sales_count FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m12 ON c.id = m12.refid AND m12.response = 'YES' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.response = 'YES' WHERE d.inhabitants_k > '0' AND d.income_k BETWEEN 161.18 AND 245.46 AND c.age >= 46 AND (m12.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' OR m12.ref_date IS NULL) AND (s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' OR s.event_date IS NULL) AND (m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' OR m3.ref_date IS NULL) GROUP BY d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) > 365 AND SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_amount DESC, total_sales DESC;

'2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' WHERE d.income_k > 80.55 AND d.inhabitants_k BETWEEN '0' AND '0' GROUP BY d.geoid, DESC) AS sales_rank, LAG(SUM(s.amount), 1) OVER (ORDER BY d.geoid) AS prev_geoid_sales FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date >= WITH customer_agg AS ( SELECT c.geoid, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS customer_count, AVG(c.educationnum) AS avg_education, SUM(d.a_var1 + d.a_var2 + d.a_var3) AS demographic_sum FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid WHERE c.age BETWEEN 88 AND 80 GROUP BY c.geoid ), mailing_response AS ( SELECT m.refid, COUNT(*) AS mailing_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m.response = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses FROM mailings1_2 m WHERE m.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY m.refid HAVING COUNT(*) > 46 ), sales_agg AS ( SELECT s.refid, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS unique_events FROM sales s WHERE s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY s.refid ) SELECT ca.geoid, ca.customer_count, ca.avg_education, ca.demographic_sum, mr.mailing_count, mr.positive_responses, sa.total_sales, sa.unique_events, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sa.total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM customer_agg ca JOIN mailing_response mr ON ca.geoid = mr.refid JOIN sales_agg sa ON mr.refid = sa.refid WHERE ca.demographic_sum > '0' ORDER BY sa.total_sales DESC LIMIT 100;

WITH customer_agg AS ( SELECT c.id AS c_id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, COUNT(DISTINCT m12.ref_date) AS m12_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.ref_date) AS m3_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m12.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS m12_yes, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS m3_yes, AVG(c.data1) AS avg_data1, AVG(c.data2) AS avg_data2, AVG(c.data3) AS avg_data3 FROM customers c LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m12 ON c.id = m12.refid AND m12.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 25 AND 59 AND c.educationnum >= 10 GROUP BY c.id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation ), sales_agg AS ( SELECT s.refid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_amount, MIN(s.event_date) AS first_sale, MAX(s.event_date) AS last_sale FROM sales s WHERE s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.amount > '10.0' GROUP BY s.refid ), demog_agg AS ( SELECT d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, SUM(d.a_var1 + d.a_var2 + d.a_var3 + d.a_var4 + d.a_var5 + d.a_var6 + d.a_var7 + d.a_var8 + d.a_var9 + d.a_var10 + d.a_var11 + d.a_var12 + d.a_var13 + d.a_var14 + d.a_var15 + d.a_var16 + d.a_var17 + d.a_var18) AS total_a_var, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, STDDEV(d.a_var1) AS std_a_var1 FROM demog d WHERE d.income_k >= 183.25 AND d.inhabitants_k <= '1.0' GROUP BY d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(d.a_var1 + d.a_var2 + d.a_var3 + d.a_var4 + d.a_var5 + d.a_var6 + d.a_var7 + d.a_var8 + d.a_var9 + d.a_var10 + d.a_var11 + d.a_var12 + d.a_var13 + d.a_var14 + d.a_var15 + d.a_var16 + d.a_var17 + d.a_var18) > '1000.0' ) SELECT ca.c_id, ca.age, ca.educationnum, ca.sex, ca.marital_status, ca.occupation, ca.m12_count, ca.m3_count, ca.m12_yes, ca.m3_yes, ca.avg_data1, ca.avg_data2, ca.avg_data3, sa.sales_count, sa.total_amount, sa.avg_amount, sa.first_sale, sa.last_sale, da.inhabitants_k, da.income_k, da.total_a_var, da.avg_a_var1, da.std_a_var1, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ca.sex, ca.marital_status ORDER BY sa.total_amount DESC NULLS LAST) AS sales_rank_by_demog, LAG(sa.total_amount, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY ca.geoid ORDER BY ca.age) AS prev_amount_in_geoid FROM customer_agg ca LEFT JOIN sales_agg sa ON ca.c_id = sa.refid LEFT JOIN demog_agg da ON ca.geoid = da.geoid WHERE (ca.m12_yes + SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS unique_sales_events, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings1_2_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailings3_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings1_2_yes_responses, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings3_yes_responses, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_demographic, LAG(SUM(s.amount), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.id ORDER BY DATE_TRUNC('month', s.event_date)) AS prev_month_sales FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND s.event_date >= m1.ref_date JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND s.event_date >= m3.ref_date WHERE s.amount > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.event_date <= '2020-01-01' AND d.income_k BETWEEN 491.13 AND 308.99 AND c.age >= 47 GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, DATE_TRUNC('month', s.event_date) HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 40 AND AVG(d.a_var1) < '-100' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, sales_rank_by_demographic;

SELECT d.geoid, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS customer_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(SUM(s.amount)) OVER (PARTITION BY d.geoid ORDER BY DATE_TRUNC('month', s.event_date) ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_sales FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE d.income_k > 439.26 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY d.geoid, DATE_TRUNC('month', s.event_date) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 96 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.amount > '0' AND s.refid IN (SELECT m.refid FROM mailings1_2 m WHERE m.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m.response = 'Yes') GROUP BY d.geoid HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '1000' ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS unique_customers, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS unique_sales_events, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m ON c.id = m.refid WHERE d.income_k > 412.72 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY d.geoid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 624 AND SUM(s.amount) < '1000' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS unique_sales_events, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings1_2_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailings3_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses_m1, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses_m3, AVG(d.a_var1 + d.a_var2 + d.a_var3 + d.a_var4 + d.a_var5 + d.a_var6 + d.a_var7 + d.a_var8 + d.a_var9 + d.a_var10 + d.a_var11 + d.a_var12 + d.a_var13 + d.a_var14 + d.a_var15 + d.a_var16 + d.a_var17 + d.a_var18) AS avg_a_var_sum, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_demographic, LAG(SUM(s.amount), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY d.geoid ORDER BY MIN(s.event_date)) AS prev_total_sales_by_geoid FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE s.amount > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.event_date <= '2020-01-01' AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND d.income_k BETWEEN '0' AND '0' AND c.age BETWEEN 42 AND 92 AND c.educationnum >= 10 GROUP BY d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 49 AND AVG(d.income_k) > '0' ORDER BY total_sales DESC, avg_income DESC;

sa.total_amount, sa.avg_amount, sa.first_sale, sa.last_sale, da.d_inhabitants_k, da.d_income_k, da.avg_a_var1, da.avg_a_var2, da.avg_a_var3, da.avg_a_var4, da.avg_a_var5, da.avg_a_var6, da.avg_a_var7, SUM(m12_count) AS total_mailings1_2, SUM(m3_count) AS total_mailings3, SUM(m12_yes) AS total_m12_responses, SUM(m3_yes) AS total_m3_responses, AVG(income_k) AS avg_income, AVG(inhabitants_k) AS THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings_yes_responses, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_demog_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_demog_var2 FROM customers c LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m12 ON c.id = m12.refid LEFT JOIN demog d ON ca.marital_status, ca.mailings_count, ca.mailings_yes_responses, ca.avg_demog_var1, ca.avg_demog_var2, COALESCE(sa.sales_days, 0) AS sales_days, COALESCE(sa.total_sales_amount, 0) AS mailings3_yes_responses, m3a.last_mailing3_date, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, d.a_var3, d.a_var4, d.a_var5 FROM customer_aggregates ca LEFT JOIN sales_aggregates sa ON ca.customer_id = sa.refid LEFT JOIN mailings3_aggregates m3a ON ca.customer_id = m3a.refid LEFT JOIN demog d ON ca.geoid = d.geoid WHERE d.a_var3 > '0' AND d.a_var4 < '0' ) SELECT geoid, sex, marital_status, COUNT(customer_id) AS SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date) AS sale_year, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM s.event_date) AS sale_quarter, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS total_sales, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM s.event_date) ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS revenue_rank_per_quarter FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date BETWEEN s.event_date - INTERVAL '30 days' AND s.event_date WHERE s.amount > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.event_date < '2020-01-01' AND c.age BETWEEN 91 AND 23 GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM s.event_date) HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '100' ORDER BY sale_year DESC, sale_quarter DESC, total_amount DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS total_mailings, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses_m1, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses_m3, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS unique_sales_events, AVG(CASE WHEN s.amount > '100' THEN s.amount ELSE NULL END) AS avg_large_sale_amount FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 58 AND 72 AND d.income_k >= 68.93 GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.income_k HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) > 556 AND SUM(s.amount) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS distinct_sales_events, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS distinct_mailings1_2_refs, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS distinct_mailings3_refs, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_demog_var1 FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 28 AND 92 AND d.income_k > 3.88 GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.income_k HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) > 68 AND SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings_yes_responses, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS unique_sales_events, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_demog_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_demog_var2, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC NULLS LAST) AS sales_rank_by_demographic, LAG(SUM(s.amount), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY d.income_k DESC) AS prev_sales_by_income FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' WHERE c.age >= 77 AND c.age <= 27 AND c.educationnum >= 12 AND d.income_k >= 99.67 AND d.inhabitants_k <= '0' GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) >= 673 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, sales_rank_by_demographic;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT m1.response, ', ' ORDER BY m1.response) AS mailing_responses, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, MAX(s.event_date) AS last_sale_date FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE c.age >= 51 AND c.age <= 41 AND d.income_k > 492.77 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) > 98 AND SUM(s.amount) < '0' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS unique_customers, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m ON c.id = m.refid WHERE s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.amount > '0' AND c.id IN ( SELECT refid FROM mailings3 WHERE ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' AND response = 'Y' ) GROUP BY d.geoid HAVING AVG(d.income_k) > 89.71 AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) >= 750 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND d.income_k > 122.04 GROUP BY d.geoid HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailing_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) FILTER (WHERE s.amount > '100') AS high_value_sales_count, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(d.inhabitants_k) AS total_inhabitants, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_sex FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE c.age BETWEEN 24 AND 72 AND d.income_k >= 199.87 AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status), (d.geoid, c.sex), (d.geoid), () ) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) > 15 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC NULLS LAST;

SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailing_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) FILTER (WHERE s.amount > '100') AS high_value_sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(d.a_var1 * d.a_var2) / NULLIF(SUM(d.a_var3), 0) AS demographic_ratio, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_sex, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid), 1) OVER (ORDER BY d.geoid) AS prev_mailing3_count FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON m1.refid = s.refid AND s.event_date BETWEEN m1.ref_date AND m1.ref_date + INTERVAL '30 days' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' WHERE d.inhabitants_k > '1' AND c.age BETWEEN 29 AND 71 AND m1.response = 'YES' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sales s2 WHERE s2.refid = c.id AND s2.amount > (SELECT AVG(amount) * 1.5 FROM sales WHERE event_date >= '2019-01-01') ) GROUP BY d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m1.kxindex) > 22 AND SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailings3_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(d.inhabitants_k) AS avg_inhabitants, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(d.a_var1 + d.a_var2 + d.a_var3 + d.a_var4 + d.a_var5 + d.a_var6 + d.a_var7 + d.a_var8 + d.a_var9 + d.a_var10 + d.a_var11 + d.a_var12 + d.a_var13 + d.a_var14 + d.a_var15 + d.a_var16 + d.a_var17 + d.a_var18) AS sum_all_a_vars, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY d.geoid) AS prev_sales_count_by_demo FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.response = 'YES' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.response = 'YES' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE c.age >= 20 AND c.educationnum >= 7 AND d.income_k >= 491.53 AND (m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' OR m1.ref_date IS NULL) AND (m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' OR m3.ref_date IS NULL) AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) > 374 AND SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND AVG(d.inhabitants_k) < '0' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, sales_count DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailings3_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(d.inhabitants_k) AS avg_inhabitants, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(d.a_var1 + d.a_var2 + d.a_var3 + d.a_var4 + d.a_var5 + d.a_var6 + d.a_var7 + d.a_var8 + d.a_var9 + d.a_var10 + d.a_var11 + d.a_var12 + d.a_var13 + d.a_var14 + d.a_var15 + d.a_var16 + d.a_var17 + d.a_var18) AS sum_all_a_vars, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_demographic, AVG(c.age) FILTER (WHERE c.educationnum > 15) AS avg_age_high_edu, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE m1.response = 'YES' AND m3.response = 'YES') AS double_positive_response_count FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND '2020-01-01 00:00:00' WHERE d.inhabitants_k > '1.0' AND d.income_k BETWEEN 409.51 AND 349.49 GROUP BY d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) > 772 AND SUM(s.amount) > '0.0' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, sales_count DESC LIMIT 595;

SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM m1.ref_date) AS mailing_year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM m1.ref_date) AS mailing_month, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS total_mailings, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN m1.refid END) AS positive_responses, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS total_sales, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(d.inhabitants_k) AS total_inhabitants, AVG(c.age) AS avg_age, AVG(c.educationnum) AS avg_education, SUM(d.a_var1 + d.a_var2 + d.a_var3 + d.a_var4 + d.a_var5 + d.a_var6 + d.a_var7 + d.a_var8 + d.a_var9 + d.a_var10 + d.a_var11 + d.a_var12 + d.a_var13 + d.a_var14 + d.a_var15 + d.a_var16 + d.a_var17 + d.a_var18) AS sum_all_vars, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_demographic FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON m1.refid = s.refid AND s.event_date BETWEEN m1.ref_date AND m1.ref_date + INTERVAL '30 days' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date > m1.ref_date WHERE d.income_k > 867.8 AND c.age BETWEEN 85 AND 19 AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND (c.educationnum > 9 OR c.occupation IN ('Prof-specialty', 'Exec-managerial', 'Sales')) AND d.a_var1 < '0' AND d.a_var2 > '0' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM m1.ref_date), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM m1.ref_date)), (d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation), (d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status), (d.geoid, c.sex), (d.geoid), (c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation), (c.sex, c.marital_status), (c.sex), (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM m1.ref_date), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM m1.ref_date)), () ) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) > 249 AND SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, mailing_year, mailing_month;

SELECT d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings_yes_count, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sale_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS unique_sales_events, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s.amount) AS median_sale_amount, MAX(m3.ref_date) AS latest_mailing3_date FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON m1.refid = s.refid AND s.event_date >= m1.ref_date LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE d.income_k > 228.26 AND d.inhabitants_k BETWEEN '0' AND '0' AND c.age >= 84 AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND c.id IN ( SELECT s2.refid FROM sales s2 WHERE s2.amount > '0' GROUP BY s2.refid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s2.eventid) > 6 ) GROUP BY d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation HAVING AVG(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) >= 528 ORDER BY total_sale_amount DESC, mailings_count DESC;

WITH customer_agg AS ( SELECT c.geoid, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS customer_count, AVG(c.age) AS avg_age, SUM(c.data1) AS total_data1 FROM customers c WHERE c.age >= 35 AND c.educationnum >= 6 GROUP BY c.geoid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 28 ) SELECT d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, ca.customer_count, ca.avg_age, ca.total_data1, COUNT(DISTINCT m.refid) AS mailing_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m.response = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount FROM demog d JOIN customer_agg ca ON d.geoid = ca.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m ON ca.geoid = m.kxindex LEFT JOIN sales s ON m.refid = s.refid WHERE d.income_k >= 198.0 GROUP BY d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, ca.customer_count, ca.avg_age, ca.total_data1 ORDER BY d.income_k DESC LIMIT 100;

WITH customer_agg AS ( SELECT c.id AS c_id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, COUNT(DISTINCT m12.ref_date) AS m12_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.ref_date) AS m3_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m12.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS m12_yes, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS m3_yes, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2 FROM customers c LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m12 ON c.id = m12.refid LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid LEFT JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid WHERE c.age BETWEEN 89 AND 59 GROUP BY c.id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation ), sales_agg AS ( SELECT s.refid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_amount, MIN(s.event_date) AS first_sale, MAX(s.event_date) AS last_sale FROM sales s WHERE s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY s.refid ), combined AS ( SELECT ca.c_id, ca.age, ca.educationnum, ca.sex, ca.marital_status, ca.occupation, ca.m12_count, ca.m3_count, ca.m12_yes, ca.m3_yes, ca.avg_a_var1, ca.avg_a_var2, COALESCE(sa.sales_count, 0) AS sales_count, COALESCE(sa.total_amount, 0) AS total_amount, COALESCE(sa.avg_amount, 0) AS avg_amount, sa.first_sale, sa.last_sale, CASE WHEN ca.m12_count > 0 THEN ca.m12_yes::FLOAT / ca.m12_count ELSE 0 END AS m12_response_rate, CASE WHEN ca.m3_count > 0 THEN ca.m3_yes::FLOAT / ca.m3_count ELSE 0 END AS m3_response_rate, CASE WHEN sa.sales_count > 0 THEN sa.total_amount / sa.sales_count ELSE 0 END AS avg_sale_per_event, CASE WHEN ca.age < 30 THEN 'Young' WHEN ca.age BETWEEN 30 AND 50 THEN 'Middle' ELSE 'Senior' END AS age_group, CASE WHEN ca.educationnum > 16 THEN 'High' WHEN ca.educationnum BETWEEN 13 AND 16 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS education_level, CASE WHEN ca.avg_a_var1 > '0' THEN 'High Var1' ELSE 'Low Var1' END AS var1_category FROM customer_agg ca LEFT JOIN sales_agg sa ON ca.c_id = sa.refid WHERE ca.m12_count >= 20 OR ca.m3_count >= 13 ) SELECT age_group, education_level, var1_category, sex, marital_status, occupation, COUNT(*) AS customer_count, AVG(m12_response_rate) AS avg_m12_response, AVG(m3_response_rate) AS avg_m3_response, SUM(sales_count) AS total_sales_events, SUM(total_amount) AS grand_total_amount, AVG(avg_amount) AS overall_avg_sale_amount, MIN(first_sale) AS earliest_sale, MAX(last_sale) AS latest_sale, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY total_amount) AS median_total_amount FROM combined GROUP BY age_group, education_level, var1_category, sex, marital_status, occupation HAVING SUM(sales_count) > 93 AND AVG(m12_response_rate) < '0' ORDER BY grand_total_amount DESC, customer_count DESC LIMIT 910;

WITH customer_agg AS ( SELECT c.id AS c_id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, d.a_var1, d.a_var2, d.a_var3, d.a_var4, d.a_var5, d.a_var6, d.a_var7, d.a_var8, d.a_var9, d.a_var10, d.a_var11, d.a_var12, d.a_var13, d.a_var14, d.a_var15, d.a_var16, d.a_var17, d.a_var18, COUNT(DISTINCT m12.ref_date) AS m12_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.ref_date) AS m3_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m12.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS m12_yes, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS m3_yes, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sale_amount, COUNT(s.eventid) AS sale_count FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m12 ON c.id = m12.refid LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE c.age BETWEEN 85 AND 80 AND d.income_k >= 430.03 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, d.a_var1, d.a_var2, d.a_var3, d.a_var4, d.a_var5, d.a_var6, d.a_var7, d.a_var8, d.a_var9, d.a_var10, d.a_var11, d.a_var12, d.a_var13, d.a_var14, d.a_var15, d.a_var16, d.a_var17, d.a_var18 HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' ), windowed_stats AS ( SELECT c_id, geoid, age, educationnum, sex, marital_status, occupation, inhabitants_k, income_k, m12_count, m3_count, m12_yes, m3_yes, avg_sale_amount, total_sale_amount, sale_count, AVG(total_sale_amount) OVER ( PARTITION BY geoid, marital_status ORDER BY income_k ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_sales_by_geo_marital, SUM(m12_yes) OVER ( PARTITION BY occupation ORDER BY age ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS cumulative_m12_yes_by_occupation, RANK() OVER ( PARTITION BY geoid ORDER BY total_sale_amount DESC, age DESC ) AS sales_rank_in_geoid FROM customer_agg WHERE income_k <= 163.24 ) SELECT geoid, marital_status, occupation, COUNT(c_id) AS customer_count, AVG(age) AS avg_age, AVG(educationnum) AS avg_education, SUM(inhabitants_k) AS total_inhabitants_k, AVG(income_k) AS avg_income_k, SUM(m12_count) AS total_m12_count, SUM(m3_count) AS total_m3_count, SUM(m12_yes) AS total_m12_yes, SUM(m3_yes) AS total_m3_yes, AVG(avg_sale_amount) AS overall_avg_sale_amount, SUM(total_sale_amount) AS grand_total_sales, SUM(sale_count) AS total_sale_events, AVG(moving_avg_sales_by_geo_marital) AS avg_moving_avg_sales, MAX(cumulative_m12_yes_by_occupation) AS max_cumulative_m12_yes, MIN(sales_rank_in_geoid) AS best_sales_rank FROM windowed_stats WHERE moving_avg_sales_by_geo_marital >= '0' AND cumulative_m12_yes_by_occupation > 26 GROUP BY geoid, marital_status, occupation HAVING AVG(income_k) > 331.21 AND SUM(total_sale_amount) < '0' ORDER BY grand_total_sales DESC, avg_income_k DESC LIMIT 100;

WITH customer_agg AS ( SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.educationnum, c.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, COUNT(DISTINCT m12.ref_date) AS mailings_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.ref_date) AS mailings3_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m12.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS response_count_m12, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS response_count_m3, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2, AVG(d.a_var3) AS avg_a_var3 FROM customers c LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m12 ON c.id = m12.refid LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid LEFT JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid WHERE c.age BETWEEN 54 AND 29 AND m12.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.educationnum, c.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation ), sales_agg AS ( SELECT s.refid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_amount, MIN(s.event_date) AS first_sale_date, MAX(s.event_date) AS last_sale_date FROM sales s WHERE s.amount > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY s.refid ), combined AS ( SELECT ca.customer_id, ca.age, ca.educationnum, ca.sex, ca.marital_status, ca.occupation, ca.mailings_count, ca.mailings3_count, ca.response_count_m12, ca.response_count_m3, ca.avg_a_var1, ca.avg_a_var2, ca.avg_a_var3, COALESCE(sa.sales_count, 0) AS sales_count, COALESCE(sa.total_amount, 0) AS total_amount, COALESCE(sa.avg_amount, 0) AS avg_amount, sa.first_sale_date, sa.last_sale_date, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, d.a_var4, d.a_var5, d.a_var6 FROM customer_agg ca LEFT JOIN sales_agg sa ON ca.customer_id = sa.refid LEFT JOIN demog d ON ca.geoid = d.geoid WHERE d.income_k > 348.69 AND d.inhabitants_k BETWEEN '0' AND '0' ) SELECT sex, marital_status, occupation, COUNT(*) AS customer_count, AVG(age) AS avg_age, AVG(educationnum) AS avg_education, SUM(mailings_count) AS total_mailings, SUM(mailings3_count) AS total_mailings3, SUM(response_count_m12) AS total_responses_m12, SUM(response_count_m3) AS total_responses_m3, AVG(avg_a_var1) AS overall_avg_a_var1, AVG(avg_a_var2) AS overall_avg_a_var2, AVG(avg_a_var3) AS overall_avg_a_var3, SUM(sales_count) AS total_sales, SUM(total_amount) AS grand_total_amount, AVG(avg_amount) AS overall_avg_sale_amount, MIN(first_sale_date) AS earliest_sale, MAX(last_sale_date) AS latest_sale, AVG(inhabitants_k) AS avg_inhabitants, AVG(income_k) AS avg_income, AVG(a_var4) AS avg_a_var4, AVG(a_var5) AS avg_a_var5, AVG(a_var6) AS avg_a_var6 FROM combined GROUP BY sex, marital_status, occupation HAVING COUNT(*) > 887 AND WITH customer_agg AS ( SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.geoid, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.ref_date) AS mailings_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.ref_date) AS mailings3_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings_yes, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings3_yes, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2, AVG(d.a_var3) AS avg_a_var3 FROM customers c LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid LEFT JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid WHERE c.age BETWEEN 68 AND 61 AND d.income_k > 179.84 GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.geoid, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation ), sales_agg AS ( SELECT s.refid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_amount, MIN(s.event_date) AS first_sale, MAX(s.event_date) AS last_sale FROM sales s WHERE s.amount > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY s.refid ) SELECT COALESCE(ca.sex, 'ALL') AS sex, COALESCE(ca.marital_status, 'ALL') AS marital_status, COALESCE(ca.occupation, 'ALL') AS occupation, COUNT(DISTINCT ca.customer_id) AS customer_count, SUM(sa.total_amount) AS grand_total_sales, AVG(sa.avg_amount) AS avg_sale_per_customer, SUM(ca.mailings_count) AS total_mailings, SUM(ca.mailings_yes) AS total_mailings_yes_responses, (SUM(ca.mailings_yes) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(ca.mailings_count), 0)) AS mailing_response_rate, AVG(ca.avg_a_var1) AS demog_var1_avg, AVG(ca.avg_a_var2) AS demog_var2_avg,
