ca.marital_status, ca.occupation), (ca.sex, ca.marital_status), (ca.sex, ca.occupation), (ca.marital_status, ca.occupation), (ca.sex), (ca.marital_status), (ca.occupation), () ) HAVING SUM(sa.total_amount) > '0' OR SUM(sa.total_amount) IS NULL ORDER BY sex, marital_status, occupation, grand_total_sales DESC;

WITH customer_agg AS ( SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.geoid, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, COUNT(DISTINCT m12.ref_date) AS mailings_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m12.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings_yes_responses, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2 FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m12 ON c.id = m12.refid WHERE c.age BETWEEN 68 AND 37 AND d.income_k > 238.92 AND m12.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.geoid, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m12.ref_date) > 73 ), sales_agg AS ( SELECT s.refid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.event_date) AS sales_days, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, MAX(s.event_date) AS last_sale_date FROM sales s WHERE s.amount > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY s.refid ), mailings3_agg AS ( SELECT m3.refid, COUNT(*) AS mailings3_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings3_yes FROM mailings3 m3 WHERE m3.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' GROUP BY m3.refid ) SELECT ca.customer_id, ca.age, ca.educationnum, ca.sex, ca.marital_status, ca.occupation, ca.mailings_count, ca.mailings_yes_responses, ca.avg_a_var1, ca.avg_a_var2, COALESCE(sa.sales_days, 0) AS sales_days, COALESCE(sa.total_sales_amount, 0) AS total_sales_amount, COALESCE(sa.avg_sale_amount, 0) AS avg_sale_amount, COALESCE(m3a.mailings3_count, 0) AS mailings3_count, COALESCE(m3a.mailings3_yes, 0) AS mailings3_yes, (COALESCE(sa.total_sales_amount, 0) / NULLIF(ca.mailings_count, 0)) AS sales_per_mailing, (COALESCE(m3a.mailings3_yes, 0) * 1.0 / NULLIF(m3a.mailings3_count, 0)) AS mailings3_response_rate FROM customer_agg ca LEFT JOIN sales_agg sa ON ca.customer_id = sa.refid LEFT JOIN mailings3_agg m3a ON ca.customer_id = m3a.refid WHERE COALESCE(sa.total_sales_amount, 0) > '0' AND COALESCE(m3a.mailings3_count, 0) >= 35 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, ca.mailings_count DESC LIMIT 575;

WITH customer_aggregates AS ( SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS total_sales, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount FROM customers c LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum ), demographic_stats AS ( SELECT d.geoid, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(d.inhabitants_k) AS total_inhabitants, COUNT(*) AS num_areas FROM demog d WHERE d.income_k > 102.04 GROUP BY d.geoid ), mailing_response_rates AS ( SELECT m.refid, COUNT(*) AS total_mailings, SUM(CASE WHEN m.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses FROM mailings1_2 m WHERE m.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' GROUP BY m.refid ) SELECT ca.customer_id, ca.age, ca.educationnum, ca.total_sales, ca.total_amount, ca.avg_sale_amount, ds.avg_income, ds.total_inhabitants, ds.num_areas, mrr.total_mailings, mrr.positive_responses, (SELECT AVG(income_k) FROM demog WHERE geoid = ca.geoid AND income_k > 56.58) AS local_avg_income FROM customer_aggregates ca JOIN demographic_stats ds ON ca.geoid = ds.geoid LEFT JOIN mailing_response_rates mrr ON ca.customer_id = mrr.refid WHERE ca.total_amount > '1000' AND ca.age BETWEEN 20 AND 47 ORDER BY ca.total_amount DESC, ca.age ASC LIMIT 42;

WITH customer_aggregates AS ( SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status, COUNT(DISTINCT m12.ref_date) AS mailings_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m12.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings_yes_responses, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_demog_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_demog_var2 FROM customers c LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m12 ON c.id = m12.refid LEFT JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid WHERE c.age BETWEEN 31 AND 36 AND c.educationnum >= 13 AND d.income_k > 477.12 GROUP BY c.id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status ), sales_aggregates AS ( SELECT s.refid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_events, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, MIN(s.event_date) AS first_sale_date, MAX(s.event_date) AS last_sale_date FROM sales s WHERE s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.amount > '0' GROUP BY s.refid ), mailings3_aggregates AS ( SELECT m3.refid, COUNT(*) AS mailings3_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings3_yes_responses, MIN(m3.ref_date) AS first_mailing3_date, MAX(m3.ref_date) AS last_mailing3_date FROM mailings3 m3 WHERE m3.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' GROUP BY m3.refid ), combined_metrics AS ( SELECT ca.customer_id, ca.geoid, ca.age, ca.educationnum, ca.sex, ca.marital_status, ca.mailings_count, ca.mailings_yes_responses, ca.avg_demog_var1, ca.avg_demog_var2, COALESCE(sa.sales_events, 0) AS sales_events, COALESCE(sa.total_sales_amount, 0) AS total_sales_amount, COALESCE(sa.avg_sale_amount, 0) AS avg_sale_amount, sa.first_sale_date, sa.last_sale_date, COALESCE(m3a.mailings3_count, 0) AS mailings3_count, COALESCE(m3a.mailings3_yes_responses, 0) AS mailings3_yes_responses, m3a.first_mailing3_date, m3a.last_mailing3_date, CASE WHEN sa.refid IS NULL THEN 'NO_SALES' WHEN m3a.refid IS NULL THEN 'NO_MAILINGS3' ELSE 'HAS_ALL' END AS data_completeness FROM customer_aggregates ca LEFT JOIN sales_aggregates sa ON ca.customer_id = sa.refid LEFT JOIN mailings3_aggregates m3a ON ca.customer_id = m3a.refid ) SELECT data_completeness, COUNT(*) AS customer_count, AVG(age) AS avg_age, AVG(educationnum) AS avg_education, SUM(mailings_count) AS total_mailings, SUM(mailings_yes_responses) AS total_mailings_yes, SUM(sales_events) AS total_sales_events, SUM(total_sales_amount) AS grand_total_sales, AVG(avg_sale_amount) AS overall_avg_sale, SUM(mailings3_count) AS total_mailings3, SUM(mailings3_yes_responses) AS total_mailings3_yes, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY avg_demog_var1) AS median_demog_var1, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY avg_demog_var2) AS median_demog_var2 FROM combined_metrics WHERE total_sales_amount > '0' OR mailings3_count > 53 GROUP BY data_completeness HAVING COUNT(*) >= 58 AND AVG(age) > 40 ORDER BY grand_total_sales DESC, customer_count DESC;

WITH nested_subquery AS ( SELECT c.id, c.age, c.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid WHERE c.age BETWEEN 24 AND 22 GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) > 34 ) SELECT ns.geoid, AVG(ns.age) AS avg_age, SUM(ns.inhabitants_k) AS total_inhabitants_k, SUM(ns.income_k) AS total_income_k, SUM(ns.mailings_count) AS total_mailings, SUM(ns.positive_responses) AS total_positive, COUNT(*) AS customer_count, (SELECT AVG(amount) FROM sales s WHERE s.refid IN (SELECT id FROM nested_subquery WHERE geoid = ns.geoid) AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01') AS avg_sales_amount FROM nested_subquery ns GROUP BY ns.geoid HAVING SUM(ns.income_k) > 7428.2 ORDER BY total_positive DESC, avg_sales_amount DESC;

WITH ranked_sales AS ( SELECT s.eventid, s.refid, s.event_date, s.amount, c.id AS c_id, c.age, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, d.a_var1, d.a_var2, d.a_var3, d.a_var4, d.a_var5, d.a_var6, d.a_var7, d.a_var8, d.a_var9, d.a_var10, d.a_var11, d.a_var12, d.a_var13, d.a_var14, d.a_var15, d.a_var16, d.a_var17, d.a_var18, m1.ref_date AS mailing1_date, m1.response AS mailing1_response, m3.ref_date AS mailing3_date, m3.response AS mailing3_response, SUM(s.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY c.id ORDER BY s.event_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_total, AVG(s.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY c.geoid, c.marital_status) AS avg_amount_by_geo_marital, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.geoid ORDER BY s.amount DESC) AS sales_rank_in_geoid, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY c.id) AS total_transactions_per_customer FROM sales s INNER JOIN customers c ON s.refid = c.id INNER JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND s.event_date >= m1.ref_date LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND s.event_date >= m3.ref_date WHERE s.amount > '10' AND s.event_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' AND c.age BETWEEN 37 AND 19 AND d.income_k > 467.25 AND (m1.response = 'Y' OR m3.response = 'Y' OR (m1.response IS NULL AND m3.response IS NULL)) ), aggregated AS ( SELECT c_id, geoid, sex, marital_status, occupation, SUM(amount) AS total_spent, AVG(amount) AS avg_spent, MAX(amount) AS max_spent, MIN(amount) AS min_spent, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count, AVG(running_total) AS avg_running_total, MAX(sales_rank_in_geoid) AS max_sales_rank, AVG(avg_amount_by_geo_marital) AS avg_geo_marital_baseline, SUM(CASE WHEN mailing1_response = 'Y' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS spent_after_mailing1, SUM(CASE WHEN mailing3_response = 'Y' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS spent_after_mailing3, SUM(a_var1 + a_var2 + a_var3 + a_var4 + a_var5 + a_var6 + a_var7 + a_var8 + a_var9 + a_var10 + a_var11 + a_var12 + a_var13 + a_var14 + a_var15 + a_var16 + a_var17 + a_var18) AS sum_demog_vars FROM ranked_sales GROUP BY c_id, geoid, sex, marital_status, occupation HAVING SUM(amount) > '1000' AND COUNT(*) >= 28 AND AVG(avg_amount_by_geo_marital) < '50' ) SELECT geoid, sex, marital_status, occupation, COUNT(DISTINCT c_id) AS unique_customers, SUM(total_spent) AS grand_total_spent, AVG(avg_spent) AS overall_avg_spent, SUM(spent_after_mailing1) AS total_mailing1_spent, SUM(spent_after_mailing3) AS total_mailing3_spent, AVG(sum_demog_vars) AS avg_demog_sum, CORR(total_spent, sum_demog_vars) AS spending_demog_correlation FROM aggregated GROUP BY geoid, sex, marital_status, occupation ORDER BY grand_total_spent DESC LIMIT 816;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1 FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE c.age BETWEEN 57 AND 79 AND d.income_k > 396.57 AND (m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' OR m1.ref_date IS NULL) GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_amount DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_demog_var1 FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE (m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' OR m1.ref_date IS NULL) AND (s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' OR s.event_date IS NULL) AND c.age BETWEEN 19 AND 60 GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.income_k HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) > 0 AND SUM(s.amount) > '1000' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.income_k, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.ref_date) AS mailing_count FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid WHERE s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND d.income_k >= 166.59 GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '1000' INTERSECT SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.income_k, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.ref_date) AS mailing_count FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND d.income_k >= 146.52 GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '1000' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.income_k, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS distinct_sales_events, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE s.amount > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '100' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sale_amount, COUNT(s.eventid) AS sales_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 54 AND 68 AND c.educationnum > 2 AND d.income_k < 192.46 AND (c.marital_status = 'Married-civ-spouse' OR c.occupation = 'Exec-managerial') GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING COUNT(s.eventid) >= 136 AND AVG(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_sale_amount DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(SUM(s.amount)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.age, c.educationnum) AS avg_sales_by_age_edu FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND '2020-01-01 00:00:00' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 20 AND 84 AND c.educationnum >= 12 AND d.income_k > 167.29 GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS total_sales, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS total_mailings, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses, SUM(s.amount) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid), 0) AS revenue_per_mailing FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid WHERE s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.amount > '0' AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND d.income_k BETWEEN 167.63 AND 443.27 GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_amount DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-07-01' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE c.age > 50 AND c.educationnum >= 14 AND d.income_k > 52.86 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM mailings1_2 m2 WHERE m2.refid = c.id AND m2.kxindex > 9803 ) GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING AVG(s.amount) > '50' AND COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) >= 3 ORDER BY avg_sale_amount DESC, mailings_count DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2, AVG(d.a_var3) AS avg_a_var3, AVG(d.a_var4) AS avg_a_var4, AVG(d.a_var5) AS avg_a_var5, AVG(d.a_var6) AS avg_a_var6, AVG(d.a_var7) AS avg_a_var7, AVG(d.a_var8) AS avg_a_var8, AVG(d.a_var9) AS avg_a_var9, AVG(d.a_var10) AS avg_a_var10, AVG(d.a_var11) AS avg_a_var11, AVG(d.a_var12) AS avg_a_var12, AVG(d.a_var13) AS avg_a_var13, AVG(d.a_var14) AS avg_a_var14, AVG(d.a_var15) AS avg_a_var15, AVG(d.a_var16) AS avg_a_var16, AVG(d.a_var17) AS avg_a_var17, AVG(d.a_var18) AS avg_a_var18, COUNT(DISTINCT m12.refid) AS mailings1_2_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailings3_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m12.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS m12_yes_responses, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS m3_yes_responses, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, MAX(s.amount) AS max_sale_amount, MIN(s.amount) AS min_sale_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank, LAG(SUM(s.amount), 1) OVER (ORDER BY c.id) AS prev_customer_sales FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m12 ON c.id = m12.refid AND m12.ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 23 AND 96 AND d.income_k > 61.59 AND (c.educationnum > 13 OR c.marital_status = 'Married-civ-spouse') GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 92 AND (AVG(d.a_var1) < '-100' OR AVG(d.a_var2) > '-100') ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, c.id;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS unique_sales_events, COUNT(m12.refid) AS mailings1_2_count, COUNT(m3.refid) AS mailings3_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m12.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings1_2_yes_responses, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings3_yes_responses, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank, LAG(SUM(s.amount), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY d.income_k DESC) AS prev_sales_amount_by_demo FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m12 ON c.id = m12.refid AND m12.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 59 AND 52 AND c.educationnum >= 9 AND d.income_k > 86.65 AND c.id IN ( SELECT s2.refid FROM sales s2 WHERE s2.amount > '0' GROUP BY s2.refid HAVING COUNT(s2.eventid) >= 54 ) GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) <= 185 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, d.income_k ASC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, d.a_var1, d.a_var2, d.a_var3, d.a_var4, d.a_var5, d.a_var6, d.a_var7, d.a_var8, d.a_var9, d.a_var10, d.a_var11, d.a_var12, d.a_var13, d.a_var14, d.a_var15, d.a_var16, d.a_var17, d.a_var18, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count_m12, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailings_count_m3, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS response_count_m12, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS response_count_m3, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, MAX(s.event_date) AS last_sale_date, MIN(s.event_date) AS first_sale_date, SUM(SUM(s.amount)) OVER (PARTITION BY SELECT d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS customer_count, AVG(c.age) AS avg_age, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_event_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m12.refid) AS mailing_response_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailing3_yes_count, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY d.a_var2) AS median_a_var2, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m12 ON c.id = m12.refid LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date >= s.event_date WHERE d.income_k > 492.22 AND c.age BETWEEN 37 AND 87 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.amount > '0' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM mailings1_2 m12_sub WHERE m12_sub.refid = c.id AND m12_sub.response = 'YES' AND m12_sub.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' ) GROUP BY d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 589 AND SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, customer_count ASC;

WITH customer_agg AS ( SELECT c.id AS c_id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status, COUNT(DISTINCT m12.ref_date) AS m12_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.ref_date) AS m3_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m12.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS m12_yes, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS m3_yes, AVG(c.data1) AS avg_data1, AVG(c.data2) AS avg_data2 FROM customers c LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m12 ON c.id = m12.refid LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE c.age BETWEEN 59 AND 21 GROUP BY c.id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status ), sales_agg AS ( SELECT s.refid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_amount, MIN(s.event_date) AS first_sale, MAX(s.event_date) AS last_sale FROM sales s WHERE s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.event_date <= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY s.refid ), demog_agg AS ( SELECT d.geoid, SUM(d.inhabitants_k) AS total_inhabitants, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(d.a_var1 + d.a_var2 + d.a_var3 + d.a_var4 + d.a_var5 + d.a_var6 + d.a_var7 + d.a_var8 + d.a_var9 + d.a_var10 + d.a_var11 + d.a_var12 + d.a_var13 + d.a_var14 + d.a_var15 + d.a_var16 + d.a_var17 + d.a_var18) AS sum_all_vars FROM demog d WHERE d.income_k >= 282.16 GROUP BY d.geoid HAVING AVG(d.income_k) > 257.68 ) SELECT ca.c_id, ca.age, ca.educationnum, ca.sex, ca.marital_status, ca.m12_count, ca.m12_yes, ca.m3_count, ca.m3_yes, ca.avg_data1, ca.avg_data2, COALESCE(sa.sales_count, 0) AS sales_count, COALESCE(sa.total_amount, 0) AS total_amount, COALESCE(sa.avg_amount, 0) AS avg_amount, sa.first_sale, sa.last_sale, da.total_inhabitants, da.avg_income, da.sum_all_vars, (ca.m12_yes * 1.0 / NULLIF(ca.m12_count, 0)) AS m12_response_rate, (ca.m3_yes * 1.0 / NULLIF(ca.m3_count, 0)) AS m3_response_rate, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(sa.total_amount, 0) DESC) AS sales_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ca.sex ORDER BY ca.age DESC) AS age_rank_by_sex FROM customer_agg ca LEFT JOIN sales_agg sa ON ca.c_id = sa.refid LEFT JOIN demog_agg da ON ca.geoid = da.geoid WHERE ca.m12_count >= 90 OR ca.m3_count >= 67 ORDER BY total_amount DESC NULLS LAST, ca.c_id LIMIT 474;

d.inhabitants_k BETWEEN '10' AND '51' ), mailings3_agg AS ( SELECT de.customer_id, de.geoid, de.age, de.educationnum, de.sex, de.marital_status, de.occupation, de.mailings_count, de.avg_kxindex, de.positive_responses, de.sales_count, de.total_sales_amount, de.avg_sale_amount, de.last_sale_date, de.inhabitants_k, de.income_k, de.a_var1, de.a_var2, de.a_var3, de.a_var4, de.a_var5, de.a_var6, de.a_var7, de.a_var8, de.a_var9, de.a_var10, de.a_var11, de.a_var12, de.a_var13, de.a_var14, de.a_var15, de.a_var16, de.a_var17, de.a_var18, de.sales_rank_in_geoid, COUNT(m3.refid) AS mailings3_count, de.customer_id, de.geoid, de.age, de.educationnum, de.sex, de.marital_status, de.occupation, de.mailings_count, de.avg_kxindex, de.positive_responses, de.sales_count, de.total_sales_amount, de.avg_sale_amount, de.last_sale_date, de.inhabitants_k, de.income_k, de.a_var1, de.a_var2, de.a_var3, de.a_var4, de.a_var5, de.a_var6, de.a_var7, de.a_var8, de.a_var9, de.a_var10, de.a_var11, customer_count, AVG(age) AS avg_age, AVG(educationnum) AS avg_education, SUM(mailings_count) AS total_mailings, SUM(positive_responses) AS total_positive_responses, AVG(avg_kxindex) AS avg_kxindex_overall, SUM(sales_count) AS total_sales, SUM(total_sales_amount) AS grand_total_sales, AVG(avg_sale_amount) AS avg_sale_amount_overall, MAX(last_sale_date) AS latest_sale_date, AVG(inhabitants_k) AS avg_inhabitants_k, AVG(income_k) AS avg_income_k, SUM(mailings3_count) AS total_mailings3, SUM(mailings3_positive) AS total_mailings3_positive, CORR(total_sales_amount, income_k) AS sales_income_correlation, STDDEV(age) AS age_stddev, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY total_sales_amount) AS median_sales_amount FROM mailings3_agg GROUP BY geoid, sex, marital_status, occupation HAVING COUNT(customer_id) > 47 AND SUM(total_sales_amount) > '5000' ) SELECT fa.*, d.a_var1 AS demog_var1, d.a_var2 AS demog_var2, d.a_var3 AS demog_var3, d.a_var4 AS demog_var4, d.a_var5 AS demog_var5, d.a_var6 AS demog_var6, d.a_var7 AS demog_var7, d.a_var8 AS demog_var8, d.a_var9 AS demog_var9, d.a_var10 AS demog_var10, d.a_var11 AS demog_var11, d.a_var12 AS demog_var12, d.a_var13 AS demog_var13, d.a_var14 AS demog_var14, d.a_var15 AS demog_var15, d.a_var16 AS demog_var16, d.a_var17 AS demog_var17, d.a_var18 AS demog_var18, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY fa.grand_total_sales DESC) AS WITH customer_agg AS ( SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, d.a_var1, d.a_var2, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.ref_date) AS mailings_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.ref_date) AS mailings3_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS response_count_m1, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS response_count_m3, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_events, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sales_amount FROM customers c LEFT JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE c.age BETWEEN 48 AND 33 AND d.income_k >= 234.35 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, d.a_var1, d.a_var2 ) SELECT COALESCE(sex, 'ALL') AS sex, COALESCE(marital_status, 'ALL') AS marital_status, COALESCE(occupation, 'ALL') AS occupation, COUNT(customer_id) AS customer_count, AVG(age) AS avg_age, AVG(educationnum) AS avg_education, AVG(inhabitants_k) AS avg_inhabitants, AVG(income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(mailings_count) AS total_mailings, SUM(mailings3_count) AS total_mailings3, SUM(response_count_m1) AS total_responses_m1, SUM(response_count_m3) AS total_responses_m3, SUM(sales_events) AS total_sales_events, SUM(total_sales_amount) AS grand_total_sales, AVG(avg_sales_amount) AS overall_avg_sale FROM customer_agg GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (sex, marital_status, occupation), (sex, marital_status), (sex), (occupation), () ) HAVING SUM(total_sales_amount) > '0' ORDER BY sex, marital_status, occupation;

m3.ref_date) AS mailings_count_3, SUM(CASE WHEN m12.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS responses_12, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS responses_3, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2, AVG(d.a_var3) AS avg_a_var3, AVG(d.a_var4) AS avg_a_var4, AVG(d.a_var5) AS avg_a_var5, AVG(d.a_var6) AS avg_a_var6, AVG(d.a_var7) AS avg_a_var7, AVG(d.a_var8) AS avg_a_var8, AVG(d.a_var9) AS avg_a_var9, AVG(d.a_var10) AS avg_a_var10, AVG(d.a_var11) AS avg_a_var11, AVG(d.a_var12) AS avg_a_var12, AVG(d.a_var13) AS avg_a_var13, AVG(d.a_var14) AS avg_a_var14, AVG(d.a_var15) AS avg_a_var15, AVG(d.a_var16) AS avg_a_var16, AVG(d.a_var17) AS avg_a_var17, AVG(d.a_var18) AS avg_a_var18, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(s.eventid) AS sales_count, MIN(s.event_date) AS first_sale_date, MAX(s.event_date) AS last_sale_date FROM customers c LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m12 ON c.id = m12.refid AND m12.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' INNER JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid WHERE c.age BETWEEN 82 AND 93 AND c.educationnum >= 2 AND d.income_k >= 20.84 AND d.inhabitants_k <= '0.1' GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.geoid, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation ), windowed_stats AS ( SELECT ca.*, AVG(total_sales_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY ca.geoid, ca.occupation) AS avg_sales_by_geo_occ, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ca.geoid ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC) AS sales_rank_in_geo, SUM(responses_12 + responses_3) OVER (PARTITION BY ca.marital_status ORDER BY ca.age ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_responses_by_marital_age FROM customer_aggregates ca ) SELECT ws.geoid, ws.occupation, ws.marital_status, COUNT(ws.customer_id) AS customer_count, AVG(ws.age) AS avg_age, AVG(ws.educationnum) AS avg_education, SUM(ws.total_sales_amount) AS grand_total_sales, SUM(ws.sales_count) AS total_sales_count, SUM(ws.mailings_count_12 + ws.mailings_count_3) AS total_mailings, SUM(ws.responses_12 + ws.responses_3) AS total_responses, (SUM(ws.responses_12 + AVG(ws.avg_a_var3) AS demog_avg_var3, AVG(ws.avg_a_var4) AS demog_avg_var4, AVG(ws.avg_a_var5) AS demog_avg_var5, AVG(ws.avg_a_var6) AS demog_avg_var6, AVG(ws.avg_a_var7) AS demog_avg_var7, AVG(ws.avg_a_var8) AS demog_avg_var8, AVG(ws.avg_a_var9) AS demog_avg_var9, AVG(ws.avg_a_var10) AS demog_avg_var10, AVG(ws.avg_a_var11) AS demog_avg_var11, AVG(ws.avg_a_var12) AS demog_avg_var12, AVG(ws.avg_a_var13) AS demog_avg_var13, AVG(ws.avg_a_var14) AS demog_avg_var14, AVG(ws.avg_a_var15) AS demog_avg_var15, AVG(ws.avg_a_var16) AS demog_avg_var16, AVG(ws.avg_a_var17) AS demog_avg_var17, AVG(ws.avg_a_var18) AS demog_avg_var18 FROM windowed_stats ws WHERE ws.sales_rank_in_geo <= 39 AND ws.cumulative_responses_by_marital_age >= 83 GROUP BY ws.geoid, ws.occupation, ws.marital_status HAVING SUM(ws.total_sales_amount) > '1000.0' AND COUNT(ws.customer_id) >= 27 AND AVG(ws.avg_sales_by_geo_occ) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY grand_total_sales DESC, customer_count ASC LIMIT 58;

WITH customer_aggregates AS ( SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ca.mailings_count, ca.mailings_yes_responses, ca.avg_kxindex, COALESCE(sa.sales_events, 0) AS sales_events, COALESCE(sa.total_amount, 0) AS total_sales_amount, COALESCE(sa.avg_amount, 0) AS ca.customer_id = sa.refid LEFT JOIN mailings3_aggregates ma ON ca.customer_id = ma.refid INNER JOIN demog d ON ca.geoid = d.geoid WHERE ca.age BETWEEN 62 AND 30 AND ca.educationnum >= 11 AND WITH customer_aggregates AS ( SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_demog_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_demog_var2 FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid WHERE c.age BETWEEN 52 AND 73 AND d.income_k > 188.96 GROUP BY c.id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status ), sales_analysis AS ( SELECT s.refid, COUNT(s.eventid) AS total_transactions, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_transaction_value, MIN(s.event_date) AS first_purchase_date, MAX(s.event_date) AS last_purchase_date FROM sales s WHERE s.amount > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY s.refid ), mailings3_analysis AS ( SELECT m3.refid, COUNT(*) AS mailings3_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings3_positive FROM mailings3 m3 WHERE m3.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' GROUP BY m3.refid ), combined_metrics AS ( SELECT ca.customer_id, ca.geoid, ca.age, ca.educationnum, ca.sex, ca.marital_status, ca.mailings_count, ca.positive_responses, ca.avg_demog_var1, ca.avg_demog_var2, COALESCE(sa.total_transactions, 0) AS total_transactions, COALESCE(sa.total_amount, 0) AS total_amount, COALESCE(sa.avg_transaction_value, 0) AS avg_transaction_value, COALESCE(ma.mailings3_count, 0) AS mailings3_count, COALESCE(ma.mailings3_positive, 0) AS mailings3_positive, (ca.positive_responses * 1.0 / NULLIF(ca.mailings_count, 0)) AS response_rate, (COALESCE(sa.total_amount, 0) * COALESCE(ma.mailings3_positive, 0)) AS engagement_score FROM customer_aggregates ca LEFT JOIN sales_analysis sa ON ca.customer_id = sa.refid LEFT JOIN mailings3_analysis ma ON ca.customer_id = ma.refid WHERE ca.mailings_count > 15 AND (COALESCE(sa.total_amount, 0) > '0' OR COALESCE(ma.mailings3_positive, 0) > 20) ), windowed_analysis AS ( SELECT cm.*, AVG(cm.total_amount) OVER ( PARTITION BY cm.geoid, cm.marital_status ORDER BY cm.age ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_spend, SUM(cm.total_transactions) OVER ( PARTITION BY cm.sex, cm.educationnum ORDER BY cm.age ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS cumulative_transactions, RANK() OVER ( PARTITION BY cm.geoid ORDER BY cm.engagement_score DESC, cm.response_rate DESC ) AS engagement_rank FROM combined_metrics cm WHERE cm.avg_demog_var1 > '0' AND cm.avg_demog_var2 < '0' ) SELECT wa.geoid, wa.sex, wa.marital_status, COUNT(DISTINCT wa.customer_id) AS customer_count, AVG(wa.age) AS avg_age, AVG(wa.educationnum) AS avg_education, SUM(wa.total_amount) AS total_revenue, AVG(wa.moving_avg_spend) AS avg_moving_spend, MAX(wa.cumulative_transactions) AS max_cumulative_trans, AVG(wa.response_rate) AS avg_response_rate, AVG(wa.engagement_score) AS avg_engagement_score FROM windowed_analysis wa WHERE wa.engagement_rank <= 22 GROUP BY wa.geoid, wa.sex, wa.marital_status HAVING SUM(wa.total_amount) > '0' AND AVG(wa.response_rate) BETWEEN '0' AND '0' ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, avg_engagement_score DESC LIMIT 532;

WITH customer_aggregates AS ( SELECT c.id, c.age, c.geoid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS total_sales, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_amount FROM customers c LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.geoid ), demog_stats AS ( SELECT d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1 FROM demog d GROUP BY d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k ) SELECT ca.id, ca.age, ca.total_sales, ca.total_amount, ca.avg_amount, ds.inhabitants_k, ds.income_k, ds.avg_a_var1, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mailings1_2 m WHERE m.refid = ca.id AND m.response = 'Yes' AND m.ref_date BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-01-01') AS positive_mailings FROM customer_aggregates ca JOIN demog_stats ds ON ca.geoid = ds.geoid WHERE ca.total_amount > '1000' AND ca.age BETWEEN 26 AND 39 AND ds.income_k >= 148.52 ORDER BY ca.total_amount DESC LIMIT 100;

rank_in_geoid = 1 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS top_sale_per_geoid_sum, STDDEV(amount) AS stddev_sale_amount, CORR(age, amount) AS age_amount_correlation, CORR(educationnum, amount) AS edu_amount_correlation, SUM(a_var1 + a_var2 + a_var3 + a_var4 + a_var5 + a_var6 + a_var7 + a_var8 + a_var9 + a_var10 + a_var11 + a_var12 + a_var13 + a_var14 + a_var15 + a_var16 + a_var17 + a_var18) AS SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2, AVG(d.a_var3) AS avg_a_var3, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS unique_sales_events, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings1_2_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailings3_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings1_2_yes_responses, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings3_yes_responses, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_demographic FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND '2020-01-01 00:00:00' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 83 AND 43 AND c.educationnum >= 9 AND d.income_k > 197.28 AND (d.a_var4 > '0' OR d.a_var5 < '0') GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 456 AND (COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) > 722 OR COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) > 267) ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, sales_rank_by_demographic;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS distinct_mailings1_2_refs, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS distinct_mailings3_refs, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS distinct_sales_events, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_demog_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_demog_var2, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN m1.refid END) AS distinct_positive_m1_responses, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN m3.refid END) AS distinct_positive_m3_responses, COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(m1.kxindex::text, m1.ref_date::date::text)) AS distinct_m1_kx_date_combos, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_demo FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date BETWEEN '2021-01-01 00:00:00' AND '2021-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date >= '2019-01-01 00:00:00' WHERE c.age >= 70 AND c.educationnum >= 19 AND d.income_k >= 73.45 AND d.a_var1 <= '0' GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) > 32 AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 156 AND SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, sales_rank_by_demo ASC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings1_2_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailings3_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings1_2_yes_responses, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings3_yes_responses, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS distinct_sales_events, SUM(CASE WHEN s.amount > '1000' THEN s.amount ELSE 0 END) AS high_value_sales, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2, SUM(d.a_var3) AS sum_a_var3, SUM(d.a_var4) AS sum_a_var4, COUNT(DISTINCT c.nom1) FILTER (WHERE c.nom1 IS NOT NULL) AS distinct_nom1_count, SUM(CASE WHEN c.educationnum > 15 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_education_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank, LAG(SUM(s.amount), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex ORDER BY d.income_k DESC) AS prev_sales_by_sex_income FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 22 AND 51 AND d.income_k >= 38.97 AND (c.occupation = 'Prof-specialty' OR c.occupation IS NULL) GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) + COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) >= 11 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, d.income_k DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m12.refid) AS mailings_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailings3_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS distinct_sales_events, SUM(CASE WHEN m12.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses_m12, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses_m3, SUM(d.a_var1 * d.a_var2) AS demographic_interaction, CORR(d.a_var3, d.a_var4) OVER (PARTITION BY c.marital_status, c.sex) AS correlation_var3_var4, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank, LAG(SUM(s.amount), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.geoid ORDER BY MAX(s.event_date)) AS prev_total_sales_in_area FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m12 ON c.id = m12.refid AND m12.ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date BETWEEN '2021-01-01 00:00:00' AND '2021-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND s.amount > '0' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 56 AND 48 AND d.income_k >= 189.8 AND d.inhabitants_k <= '0' AND (c.educationnum > 3 OR c.nom1 = 'A') GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 1 AND SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND AVG(s.amount) BETWEEN '0' AND '0' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, mailings_count DESC LIMIT 201;

SELECT c.id, c.age, c.educationnum, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS unique_sales_events, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount FROM customers c JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE s.amount > '10' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.educationnum HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '100' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

SELECT c.id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.ref_date) AS distinct_mailings1_2_dates, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.ref_date) AS distinct_mailings3_dates, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'Yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses_m1, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'Yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses_m3, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s.amount) AS median_sale_amount, STDDEV(s.amount) AS stddev_sale_amount FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.kxindex > 37 LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 25 AND 39 AND d.income_k >= 348.55 AND d.inhabitants_k <= '1' GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '1000' AND COUNT(DISTINCT m1.ref_date) >= 2 AND AVG(d.a_var1) < '0' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, avg_a_var1 ASC LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings_yes, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sale_amount FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE (c.age > 64 AND c.educationnum < 8) OR (c.marital_status = 'Married-civ-spouse' AND c.occupation != 'Adm-clerical') AND NOT (d.income_k IS NULL OR d.inhabitants_k < 20.89) AND (m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' OR m1.ref_date IS NULL) GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) >= 91 AND SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_sale_amount DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS customer_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE s.eventid IN ( SELECT m3.refid FROM mailings3 m3 WHERE m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' ) AND s.amount > '0' GROUP BY d.geoid HAVING AVG(d.income_k) > 247.44 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(c.age) AS total_age_sum, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS unique_mailings_count, SUM(s.amount) FILTER (WHERE s.event_date >= m1.ref_date) AS sales_after_mailing, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank, AVG(d.a_var1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.marital_status) AS avg_var1_by_marital, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mailings3 m3 WHERE m3.refid = c.id AND m3.response = 'Yes') AS positive_mailings3_count FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE d.income_k > 541.05 AND c.age BETWEEN 77 AND 38 AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.amount >= '0' AND c.educationnum > 19 GROUP BY d.geoid, c.marital_status, c.id HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT m1.kxindex) >= 48 ORDER BY avg_income DESC, sales_rank;

SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailings3_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(d.inhabitants_k) AS avg_inhabitants, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(d.a_var1 + d.a_var2 + d.a_var3 + d.a_var4 + d.a_var5 + d.a_var6 + d.a_var7 + d.a_var8 + d.a_var9 + d.a_var10 + d.a_var11 + d.a_var12 + d.a_var13 + d.a_var14 + d.a_var15 + d.a_var16 + d.a_var17 + d.a_var18) AS sum_all_a_vars, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY d.geoid, c.sex ORDER BY c.marital_status) AS prev_sales_count_by_geo_sex FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.response = 'YES' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.response = 'YES' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE d.inhabitants_k > '0' AND d.income_k BETWEEN 272.84 AND 384.33 AND c.age >= 43 AND (m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' OR m1.ref_date IS NULL) AND (m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' OR m3.ref_date IS NULL) AND (s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' OR s.event_date IS NULL) GROUP BY d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) > 20 AND SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, sales_count DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, AVG(c.age) AS avg_age, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS unique_mailings_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' WHERE d.income_k > 877651.42 GROUP BY d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' UNION SELECT d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, AVG(c.age) AS avg_age, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS unique_mailings_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' WHERE d.income_k > 615010.98 GROUP BY d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(c.age) AS avg_age, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings_yes_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings3_yes_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS unique_sales_events, (SELECT AVG(sub_s.amount) FROM sales sub_s WHERE sub_s.refid IN (SELECT sub_c.id FROM customers sub_c WHERE sub_c.geoid = d.geoid) AND sub_s.event_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00') AS avg_sales_amount_for_geoid_after_date FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE d.income_k > 185.51 AND c.age BETWEEN 84 AND 40 GROUP BY d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) > 5328 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2, AVG(d.a_var3) AS avg_a_var3, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.refid) AS unique_sales_customers, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS unique_mailings1_2_customers, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS unique_mailings3_customers, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.geoid ORDER BY AVG(d.a_var1) DESC) AS a_var1_rank_in_geoid FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' WHERE d.income_k > 432.34 AND c.age BETWEEN 18 AND 43 GROUP BY d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.refid) >= 2299 UNION SELECT d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var4) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var5) AS avg_a_var2, AVG(d.a_var6) AS avg_a_var3, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.refid) AS unique_sales_customers, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS unique_mailings1_2_customers, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS unique_mailings3_customers, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.geoid ORDER BY AVG(d.a_var4) DESC) AS a_var1_rank_in_geoid FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' WHERE d.income_k > 941.34 AND c.age BETWEEN 49 AND 23 GROUP BY d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.refid) >= 4220 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

WITH customer_agg AS ( SELECT c.geoid, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS customer_count, AVG(c.age) AS avg_age, SUM(c.data1) AS total_data1 FROM customers c WHERE c.age BETWEEN 64 AND 38 GROUP BY c.geoid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 11 ) SELECT d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, ca.customer_count, ca.avg_age, ca.total_data1, COUNT(DISTINCT m.refid) AS mailing_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m.response = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount FROM demog d JOIN customer_agg ca ON d.geoid = ca.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m ON ca.geoid = m.kxindex LEFT JOIN sales s ON m.refid = s.refid WHERE d.income_k > 308.62 GROUP BY d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, ca.customer_count, ca.avg_age, ca.total_data1 ORDER BY d.income_k DESC, ca.customer_count DESC;

WITH customer_agg AS ( SELECT c.id AS c_id, c.geoid AS c_geoid, c.age AS c_age, c.educationnum AS c_educationnum, c.sex AS c_sex, c.marital_status AS c_marital_status, c.occupation AS c_occupation, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS m1_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS m3_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS m1_yes, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS m3_yes, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2, AVG(d.a_var3) AS avg_a_var3 FROM customers c LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' INNER JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid WHERE c.age BETWEEN 29 AND 54 GROUP BY c.id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation ), sales_agg AS ( SELECT s.refid AS s_refid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_amount, MIN(s.event_date) AS first_sale, MAX(s.event_date) AS last_sale FROM sales s WHERE s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY s.refid ), self_joined_sales AS ( SELECT s1.s_refid AS s1_refid, s2.s_refid AS s2_refid, s1.total_amount AS s1_total, s2.total_amount AS s2_total, s1.avg_amount AS s1_avg, s2.avg_amount AS s2_avg, ABS(s1.total_amount - s2.total_amount) AS total_diff FROM sales_agg s1 INNER JOIN sales_agg s2 ON s1.s_refid < s2.s_refid AND s1.total_amount > '1000' AND s2.total_amount > '1000' WHERE s1.total_amount + s2.total_amount > '5000' ) SELECT ca.c_id, ca.c_age, ca.c_sex, ca.c_occupation, ca.m1_count, ca.m3_count, ca.m1_yes, ca.m3_yes, ca.avg_a_var1, ca.avg_a_var2, ca.avg_a_var3, COALESCE(sa.sales_count, 0) AS sales_count, COALESCE(sa.total_amount, 0) AS total_amount, COALESCE(sa.avg_amount, 0) AS avg_amount, COUNT(sjs.s1_refid) AS comparable_customers_count, AVG(sjs.total_diff) AS avg_total_diff_vs_others FROM customer_agg ca LEFT JOIN sales_agg sa ON ca.c_id = sa.s_refid LEFT JOIN self_joined_sales sjs ON ca.c_id = sjs.s1_refid OR ca.c_id = sjs.s2_refid WHERE ca.c_educationnum > 10 AND ca.avg_a_var1 < '0.0' GROUP BY ca.c_id, ca.c_age, ca.c_sex, ca.c_occupation, ca.m1_count, ca.m3_count, ca.m1_yes, ca.m3_yes, ca.avg_a_var1, ca.avg_a_var2, ca.avg_a_var3, sa.sales_count, sa.total_amount, sa.avg_amount HAVING COUNT(sjs.s1_refid) > 3 AND COALESCE(sa.total_amount, 0) > '0' ORDER BY avg_total_diff_vs_others DESC, total_amount DESC LIMIT 1000;

WITH ranked_sales AS ( SELECT s.eventid, s.refid, s.event_date, s.amount, c.id AS c_id, c.age, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid AS d_geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, d.a_var1, d.a_var2, d.a_var3, d.a_var4, d.a_var5, d.a_var6, d.a_var7, d.a_var8, d.a_var9, d.a_var10, d.a_var11, d.a_var12, d.a_var13, d.a_var14, d.a_var15, d.a_var16, d.a_var17, d.a_var18, m1.ref_date AS m1_date, m1.response AS m1_response, m3.ref_date AS m3_date, m3.response AS m3_response, SUM(s.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY c.id ORDER BY s.event_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_total, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.geoid, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date) ORDER BY s.amount DESC) AS sale_rank_in_geo_year, AVG(s.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY c.geoid, c.marital_status) AS avg_amount_by_geo_marital, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY d.geoid ORDER BY s.event_date RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '30 days' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS sales_count_30d_geo FROM sales s INNER JOIN customers c ON s.refid = c.id INNER JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON s.refid = m1.refid AND s.event_date >= m1.ref_date LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON s.refid = m3.refid AND s.event_date >= m3.ref_date WHERE s.amount > '10' AND s.event_date >= '2010-01-01' AND c.age BETWEEN 20 AND 44 AND d.income_k > 92.82 AND (m1.response = 'YES' OR m1.response IS NULL) AND (m3.response = 'YES' OR m3.response IS NULL) ), aggregated AS ( SELECT d_geoid, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM event_date) AS sale_year, c.marital_status, c.occupation, COUNT(DISTINCT c_id) AS unique_customers, SUM(amount) AS total_sales, AVG(amount) AS avg_sale_amount, MAX(running_total) AS max_running_total, SUM(CASE WHEN sale_rank_in_geo_year = 1 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS top_sale_amount, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY amount) AS median_sale_amount, STDDEV(amount) AS sale_amount_stddev FROM ranked_sales rs INNER JOIN customers c ON rs.c_id = c.id GROUP BY d_geoid, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM event_date), c.marital_status, c.occupation HAVING SUM(amount) > '10000' AND COUNT(DISTINCT c_id) >= 86 ) SELECT a.d_geoid, a.sale_year, a.marital_status, a.occupation, a.unique_customers, a.total_sales, a.avg_sale_amount, a.max_running_total, a.top_sale_amount, a.median_sale_amount, a.sale_amount_stddev, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, d.a_var1, d.a_var2, d.a_var3, d.a_var4, d.a_var5, d.a_var6, d.a_var7, d.a_var8, d.a_var9, d.a_var10, d.a_var11, d.a_var12, d.a_var13, d.a_var14, d.a_var15, d.a_var16, d.a_var17, d.a_var18, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY a.total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank, LAG(a.total_sales, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY a.d_geoid, a.marital_status ORDER BY a.sale_year) AS prev_year_sales FROM aggregated a INNER JOIN demog d ON a.d_geoid = d.geoid WHERE d.inhabitants_k > '1' ORDER BY a.total_sales DESC, a.d_geoid, a.sale_year LIMIT 3457;

WITH ranked_sales AS ( SELECT s.eventid, s.refid, s.event_date, s.amount, c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid AS demog_geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, d.a_var1, d.a_var2, d.a_var3, d.a_var4, d.a_var5, d.a_var6, d.a_var7, d.a_var8, d.a_var9, d.a_var10, d.a_var11, d.a_var12, d.a_var13, d.a_var14, d.a_var15, d.a_var16, d.a_var17, d.a_var18, m1.ref_date AS mailing1_date, m1.response AS mailing1_response, m3.ref_date AS mailing3_date, m3.response AS mailing3_response, SUM(s.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY c.id ORDER BY s.event_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_total, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.marital_status, c.occupation ORDER BY s.amount DESC) AS sale_rank_by_demo, AVG(s.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY d.geoid, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date)) AS avg_amount_by_geoid_year, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY c.id, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM s.event_date)) AS monthly_transactions FROM sales s INNER JOIN customers c ON s.refid = c.id INNER JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND s.event_date >= m1.ref_date LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND s.event_date >= m3.ref_date WHERE s.amount > '10' AND s.event_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2024-01-01' AND c.age BETWEEN 22 AND 57 AND d.income_k > 368.95 AND (m1.response = 'Y' OR m3.response = 'Y' OR (m1.response IS NULL AND m3.response IS NULL)) ), aggregated AS ( SELECT customer_id, sex, marital_status, occupation, demog_geoid, inhabitants_k, income_k, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM MIN(event_date)) AS first_sale_year, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM MAX(event_date)) AS last_sale_year, COUNT(DISTINCT event_date) AS unique_sale_days, SUM(amount) AS total_spent, AVG(amount) AS avg_sale_amount, MAX(running_total) AS max_running_total, MAX(sale_rank_by_demo) AS max_rank, AVG(avg_amount_by_geoid_year) AS avg_geoid_year_amount, SUM(monthly_transactions) AS total_monthly_transactions, SUM(CASE WHEN mailing1_response = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_mailing1_responses, SUM(CASE WHEN mailing3_response = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_mailing3_responses, CORR(a_var1, amount) AS corr_var1_amount, CORR(a_var2, amount) AS corr_var2_amount, STDDEV(amount) AS stddev_amount FROM ranked_sales GROUP BY customer_id, sex, marital_status, occupation, demog_geoid, inhabitants_k, income_k HAVING SUM(amount) > '1000' AND COUNT(DISTINCT event_date) >= 54 AND AVG(avg_amount_by_geoid_year) > '50' ) SELECT sex, marital_status, occupation, demog_geoid, AVG(total_spent) AS avg_total_spent_per_group, SUM(total_spent) AS grand_total_spent, COUNT(customer_id) AS customer_count, AVG(avg_sale_amount) AS avg_sale_amount_per_group, MAX(max_running_total) AS max_running_total_per_group, AVG(max_rank) AS avg_max_rank, SUM(total_monthly_transactions) AS total_transactions, SUM(positive_mailing1_responses) AS total_positive_mailing1, SUM(positive_mailing3_responses) AS total_positive_mailing3, AVG(corr_var1_amount) AS avg_corr_var1_amount, AVG(corr_var2_amount) AS avg_corr_var2_amount, AVG(stddev_amount) AS avg_stddev_amount, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY total_spent) AS median_total_spent FROM aggregated GROUP BY sex, marital_status, occupation, demog_geoid ORDER BY grand_total_spent DESC, customer_count DESC LIMIT 540;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.income_k, d.inhabitants_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2 FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE c.age BETWEEN 23 AND 42 AND d.income_k > 158.28 AND (m1.response = 'YES' OR m3.response = 'YES') AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.income_k, d.inhabitants_k HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) > 6 AND SUM(s.amount) < '1000' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.marital_status, c.occupation ORDER BY c.age RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS avg_a_var1_window, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.ref_date) AS distinct_mailing_dates, MAX(m3.ref_date) AS latest_mailing3_date, CORR(d.a_var2, d.a_var3) AS correlation_a_var2_a_var3 FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE c.age > 60 AND d.income_k BETWEEN 475.96 AND 929.32 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m1.ref_date <= '2019-01-01' AND m3.response = 'Yes' AND s.amount > '0' GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, c.marital_status, c.occupation HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '100' AND COUNT(DISTINCT m1.kxindex) >= 18 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, latest_mailing3_date DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) OVER(PARTITION BY c.geoid ORDER BY s.event_date ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_a_var1, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings1_2_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailings3_count, MAX(m1.ref_date) AS latest_mailing1_2_date, MAX(m3.ref_date) AS latest_mailing3_date FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE s.amount > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND d.income_k BETWEEN 171.11 AND 412.1 GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, s.event_date HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) > 58 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS total_mailings, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid), 0) AS response_rate, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS total_sales_events, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN s.amount > '100' THEN s.amount ELSE 0 END) AS high_value_sales, COUNT(CASE WHEN s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' THEN 1 END) AS recent_sales_count FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE c.age BETWEEN 45 AND 68 AND d.income_k >= 165.68 AND m1.ref_date >= '2019-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) > 96 AND SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date) AS sale_year, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM s.event_date) AS sale_quarter, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS total_sales, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM s.event_date) ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS quarterly_spend_rank FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date BETWEEN s.event_date - INTERVAL '30 days' AND s.event_date + INTERVAL '30 days' WHERE s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.amount > '10' AND c.age BETWEEN 25 AND 47 GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM s.event_date) HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '100' ORDER BY sale_year, sale_quarter, quarterly_spend_rank;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2, AVG(d.a_var3) AS avg_a_var3, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings1_2_yes_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings3_yes_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS distinct_sales_events, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, MAX(s.event_date) AS last_sale_date, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.marital_status ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_marital_status, AVG(SUM(s.amount)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.occupation) AS avg_sales_by_occupation FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date BETWEEN '2021-01-01 00:00:00' AND '2021-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND s.amount > '0' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 37 AND 37 AND c.educationnum >= 10 AND d.income_k > 117.11 AND (d.a_var4 > '-100' OR d.a_var5 < '-100') AND (c.nom1 IN ('A', 'A', 'A') OR c.nom2 IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 48 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, last_sale_date DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS unique_sales_events, COUNT(DISTINCT m12.refid) AS mailings1_2_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailings3_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mailings1_2 m12_sub WHERE m12_sub.refid = c.id AND m12_sub.response = 'YES' AND m12_sub.ref_date >= '2020-01-01') AS recent_positive_responses, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.marital_status ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_marital, LAG(SUM(s.amount), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.geoid ORDER BY c.age) AS prev_sales_in_geo_by_age FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m12 ON c.id = m12.refid AND m12.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' WHERE c.age >= 43 AND c.age <= 93 AND d.income_k >= 150.92 GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 95 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, c.age ASC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, d.a_var1, d.a_var2, d.a_var3, d.a_var4, d.a_var5, d.a_var6, d.a_var7, d.a_var8, d.a_var9, d.a_var10, d.a_var11, d.a_var12, d.a_var13, d.a_var14, d.a_var15, d.a_var16, d.a_var17, d.a_var18, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings1_2_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailings3_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings1_2_yes, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings3_yes, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, MAX(s.event_date) AS last_sale_date, MIN(s.event_date) AS first_sale_date, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s.amount) AS median_sale_amount, STDDEV(s.amount) AS stddev_sale_amount, (SUM(s.amount) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid), 0)) AS revenue_per_mailing1_2, (SUM(s.amount) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid), 0)) AS revenue_per_mailing3, CORR(d.income_k, s.amount) AS income_sales_correlation, CORR(d.inhabitants_k, s.amount) AS pop_sales_correlation, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank, LAG(SUM(s.amount), 1) OVER (ORDER BY MAX(s.event_date)) AS prev_period_sales FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM m1.ref_date) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - 1 AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM m1.ref_date) BETWEEN 9 AND 1 LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date BETWEEN (CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '32 months') AND (CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '39 days') LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date >= DATE_TRUNC('year', CURRENT_DATE) -
