SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date) AS sale_year, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM s.event_date) AS sale_quarter, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS total_sales, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM s.event_date) ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS revenue_rank_per_quarter FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date BETWEEN s.event_date - INTERVAL '30 days' AND s.event_date WHERE s.amount > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.event_date < '2020-01-01' AND c.age BETWEEN 70 AND 23 GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM s.event_date) HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '100' ORDER BY sale_year DESC, sale_quarter DESC, total_amount DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailing_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sale_amount FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE c.age >= 33 AND d.income_k >= 266.53 AND s.event_date >= (SELECT MIN(ref_date) FROM mailings3 WHERE response = 'YES' AND ref_date >= '2020-01-01') GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_sale_amount DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailing_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sale_amount FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE c.age >= 47 AND d.income_k >= 242.78 AND s.event_date >= (SELECT MIN(ref_date) FROM mailings3 WHERE response = 'YES' AND ref_date >= '2020-01-01') GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_sale_amount DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND '2020-01-01 00:00:00' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 40 AND 97 AND d.income_k > 216.65 AND (c.marital_status = 'Divorced' OR c.occupation = 'Adm-clerical') GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.income_k HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) > 37 AND SUM(s.amount) >= '0' ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS total_mailings, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses, SUM(CASE WHEN s.amount IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_demog_var1 FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 36 AND 60 AND d.income_k > 137.13 GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.income_k HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) > 44 AND SUM(s.amount) < '0' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS unique_sales_events, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings1_2_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailings3_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_sex, LAG(SUM(s.amount), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.id ORDER BY MIN(s.event_date)) AS prev_total_sales FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND s.event_date >= m1.ref_date LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND s.event_date >= m3.ref_date WHERE c.age >= 33 AND c.educationnum >= 4 AND d.income_k >= 131.26 AND s.amount > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2000-01-01' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM mailings1_2 m2 WHERE m2.refid = c.id AND m2.response = 'Yes' AND m2.ref_date >= '2000-01-01' ORDER BY m2.ref_date DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 59 ) GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '100' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 56 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, customer_id;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE c.age >= 26 AND c.age <= 31 AND d.income_k >= 393.82 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) > 1 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date) AS sale_year, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM s.event_date) AS sale_quarter, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS total_sales, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_geoid_income, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date), c.sex ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS spending_rank_by_sex_year FROM customers c JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid WHERE s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.amount > '0' AND d.income_k BETWEEN 432.45 AND 145.94 GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM s.event_date) HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY sale_year DESC, sale_quarter, total_amount DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS unique_sales_events, COUNT(m1.response) FILTER (WHERE m1.response = 'YES') AS mailings1_2_yes_responses, COUNT(m3.response) FILTER (WHERE m3.response = 'YES') AS mailings3_yes_responses, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_demographic, LAG(SUM(s.amount), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.id ORDER BY MIN(s.event_date)) AS prev_sales_amount FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND s.event_date >= m1.ref_date JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND s.event_date >= m3.ref_date WHERE s.amount > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.event_date <= '2020-01-01' AND d.income_k BETWEEN 15.28 AND 87.03 AND c.age >= 24 GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 69 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, sales_rank_by_demographic;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, SUM(d.a_var2) AS sum_a_var2, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS distinct_mailings1_2_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS distinct_mailings3_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(s.eventid) AS total_sales_count, AVG(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS mailing1_2_response_rate, AVG(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS mailing3_response_rate, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY d.a_var3) AS median_a_var3, MAX(d.a_var4) - MIN(d.a_var4) AS range_a_var4, SUM(d.a_var5 * d.a_var6) / NULLIF(SUM(d.a_var7), 0) AS weighted_ratio, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank, LAG(SUM(s.amount), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY d.income_k DESC) AS prev_sales_by_demo FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.amount > '0' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 85 AND 97 AND c.educationnum >= 8 AND d.income_k > 371.63 AND d.a_var8 < '0' GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) >= 38 AND AVG(d.a_var9) < '0' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, sales_rank ASC LIMIT 211;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date) AS sale_year, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM s.event_date) AS sale_quarter, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS total_sales, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM s.event_date) ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS revenue_rank_per_quarter FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date BETWEEN s.event_date - INTERVAL '30 days' AND s.event_date + INTERVAL '30 days' WHERE s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.amount > '10' AND d.income_k BETWEEN 194.38 AND 167.77 GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM s.event_date) HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '100' ORDER BY sale_year DESC, sale_quarter DESC, revenue_rank_per_quarter ASC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT m1.response, ', ' ORDER BY m1.response) AS mailing_responses, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sales_amount FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE c.age >= 61 AND c.age <= 42 AND d.income_k >= 470.72 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) > 56 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date) AS sale_year, COUNT(DISTINCT s.refid) AS unique_customers, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, SUM(d.income_k) AS total_income_in_area FROM sales s JOIN customers c ON s.refid = c.id JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid WHERE s.amount > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND d.income_k BETWEEN 243.77 AND 3.43 GROUP BY CUBE(c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date)) HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT c1.id AS customer_id, c1.age AS age, c1.sex AS sex, c2.marital_status AS marital_status, AVG(c1.data1) AS avg_data1, SUM(c2.data2) AS sum_data2, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS distinct_sales_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(c2.data2) DESC) AS data2_rank FROM customers c1 JOIN customers c2 ON c1.geoid = c2.geoid AND c1.id != c2.id LEFT JOIN sales s ON c1.id = s.refid LEFT JOIN demog d ON c1.geoid = d.geoid WHERE c1.age > 97 AND c1.educationnum >= 13 GROUP BY c1.id, c1.age, c1.sex, c2.marital_status HAVING AVG(c1.data1) < '0' ORDER BY sum_data2 DESC LIMIT 100;

WITH customer_agg AS ( SELECT c.id AS c_id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, COUNT(DISTINCT m12.ref_date) AS m12_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.ref_date) AS m3_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m12.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS m12_yes, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS m3_yes, AVG(c.data1) AS avg_data1, AVG(c.data2) AS avg_data2, AVG(c.data3) AS avg_data3 FROM customers c LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m12 ON c.id = m12.refid AND m12.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 35 AND 69 AND c.educationnum >= 9 GROUP BY c.id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation ), sales_agg AS ( SELECT s.refid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_amount, MIN(s.event_date) AS first_sale, MAX(s.event_date) AS last_sale FROM sales s WHERE s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.amount > '10.0' GROUP BY s.refid ), demog_agg AS ( SELECT d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, SUM(d.a_var1 + d.a_var2 + d.a_var3 + d.a_var4 + d.a_var5 + d.a_var6 + d.a_var7 + d.a_var8 + d.a_var9 + d.a_var10 + d.a_var11 + d.a_var12 + d.a_var13 + d.a_var14 + d.a_var15 + d.a_var16 + d.a_var17 + d.a_var18) AS total_a_var, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, STDDEV(d.a_var1) AS std_a_var1 FROM demog d WHERE d.income_k >= 140.84 AND d.inhabitants_k <= '1.0' GROUP BY d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(d.a_var1 + d.a_var2 + d.a_var3 + d.a_var4 + d.a_var5 + d.a_var6 + d.a_var7 + d.a_var8 + d.a_var9 + d.a_var10 + d.a_var11 + d.a_var12 + d.a_var13 + d.a_var14 + d.a_var15 + d.a_var16 + d.a_var17 + d.a_var18) > '1000.0' ) SELECT ca.c_id, ca.age, ca.educationnum, ca.sex, ca.marital_status, ca.occupation, ca.m12_count, ca.m3_count, ca.m12_yes, ca.m3_yes, ca.avg_data1, ca.avg_data2, ca.avg_data3, sa.sales_count, sa.total_amount, sa.avg_amount, sa.first_sale, sa.last_sale, da.inhabitants_k, da.income_k, da.total_a_var, da.avg_a_var1, da.std_a_var1, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ca.sex, ca.marital_status ORDER BY sa.total_amount DESC NULLS LAST) AS sales_rank_by_demog, LAG(sa.total_amount, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY ca.geoid ORDER BY ca.age) AS prev_amount_in_geoid FROM customer_agg ca LEFT JOIN sales_agg sa ON ca.c_id = sa.refid LEFT JOIN demog_agg da ON ca.geoid = da.geoid WHERE (ca.m12_yes + ca.m3_yes) >= 7 AND (sa.total_amount IS NULL OR sa.total_amount >= '100.0') ORDER BY sa.total_amount DESC NULLS LAST, ca.age ASC LIMIT 888;

WITH customer_agg AS ( SELECT c.id AS c_id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, d.a_var1, d.a_var2, d.a_var3, d.a_var4, d.a_var5, d.a_var6, d.a_var7, d.a_var8, d.a_var9, d.a_var10, d.a_var11, d.a_var12, d.a_var13, d.a_var14, d.a_var15, d.a_var16, d.a_var17, d.a_var18, COUNT(DISTINCT m12.ref_date) AS m12_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.ref_date) AS m3_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m12.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS m12_yes, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS m3_yes, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sale_amount, COUNT(s.eventid) AS sale_count FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m12 ON c.id = m12.refid LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE c.age BETWEEN 20 AND 23 AND d.income_k >= 56.19 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, d.a_var1, d.a_var2, d.a_var3, d.a_var4, d.a_var5, d.a_var6, d.a_var7, d.a_var8, d.a_var9, d.a_var10, d.a_var11, d.a_var12, d.a_var13, d.a_var14, d.a_var15, d.a_var16, d.a_var17, d.a_var18 HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' ), windowed_stats AS ( SELECT c_id, geoid, age, educationnum, sex, marital_status, occupation, inhabitants_k, income_k, m12_count, m3_count, m12_yes, m3_yes, avg_sale_amount, total_sale_amount, sale_count, AVG(total_sale_amount) OVER ( PARTITION BY geoid, marital_status ORDER BY income_k ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_sales_by_geo_marital, SUM(m12_yes) OVER ( PARTITION BY occupation ORDER BY age ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS cumulative_m12_yes_by_occupation, RANK() OVER ( PARTITION BY geoid ORDER BY total_sale_amount DESC, age DESC ) AS sales_rank_in_geoid FROM customer_agg WHERE income_k <= 86.26 ) SELECT geoid, marital_status, occupation, COUNT(c_id) AS customer_count, AVG(age) AS avg_age, AVG(educationnum) AS avg_education, SUM(inhabitants_k) AS total_inhabitants_k, AVG(income_k) AS avg_income_k, SUM(m12_count) AS total_m12_count, SUM(m3_count) AS total_m3_count, SUM(m12_yes) AS total_m12_yes, SUM(m3_yes) AS total_m3_yes, AVG(avg_sale_amount) AS overall_avg_sale_amount, SUM(total_sale_amount) AS grand_total_sales, SUM(sale_count) AS total_sale_events, AVG(moving_avg_sales_by_geo_marital) AS avg_moving_avg_sales, MAX(cumulative_m12_yes_by_occupation) AS max_cumulative_m12_yes, MIN(sales_rank_in_geoid) AS best_sales_rank FROM windowed_stats WHERE moving_avg_sales_by_geo_marital >= '0' AND cumulative_m12_yes_by_occupation > 70 GROUP BY geoid, marital_status, occupation HAVING AVG(income_k) > 6.28 AND SUM(total_sale_amount) < '0' ORDER BY grand_total_sales DESC, avg_income_k DESC LIMIT 100;

WITH customer_agg AS ( SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.geoid, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.ref_date::date) AS distinct_mailing_days, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_demog_var1 FROM customers c LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid WHERE m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01'::timestamp - INTERVAL '261 days' GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.geoid, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status ), sales_agg AS ( SELECT s.refid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.event_date::date) AS distinct_sales_days, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount FROM sales s WHERE s.event_date >= '2020-01-01'::timestamp - INTERVAL '293 days' GROUP BY s.refid ) SELECT ca.customer_id, ca.age, ca.educationnum, ca.sex, ca.marital_status, ca.distinct_mailing_days, ca.positive_responses, ca.avg_demog_var1, COALESCE(sa.distinct_sales_days, 0) AS distinct_sales_days, COALESCE(sa.total_sales_amount, 0) AS total_sales_amount, COALESCE(sa.avg_sale_amount, 0) AS avg_sale_amount, (ca.positive_responses * 1.0 / NULLIF(ca.distinct_mailing_days, 0)) AS response_rate FROM customer_agg ca LEFT JOIN sales_agg sa ON ca.customer_id = sa.refid WHERE ca.distinct_mailing_days >= 4 AND (sa.total_sales_amount >= '1000' OR sa.total_sales_amount IS NULL) ORDER BY ca.age DESC, total_sales_amount DESC LIMIT 934;

WITH ranked_sales AS ( SELECT s.eventid, s.refid, s.event_date, s.amount, c.id AS c_id, c.age, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, d.a_var1, d.a_var2, d.a_var3, d.a_var4, d.a_var5, d.a_var6, d.a_var7, d.a_var8, d.a_var9, d.a_var10, d.a_var11, d.a_var12, d.a_var13, d.a_var14, d.a_var15, d.a_var16, d.a_var17, d.a_var18, m1.ref_date AS mailing1_date, m1.response AS mailing1_response, m3.ref_date AS mailing3_date, m3.response AS mailing3_response, SUM(s.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY c.id ORDER BY s.event_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_total, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.geoid, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date) ORDER BY s.amount DESC) AS sales_rank_in_geo_year, AVG(s.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY c.occupation, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM s.event_date)) AS avg_amount_by_occupation_month, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY d.geoid ORDER BY s.event_date RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '30 days' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS sales_count_last_30_days FROM sales s JOIN customers c ON s.refid = c.id JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND s.event_date >= m1.ref_date LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND s.event_date >= m3.ref_date WHERE s.amount > '10' AND s.event_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2024-01-01' AND c.age BETWEEN 23 AND 98 AND d.income_k > 182.51 AND (m1.response = 'Y' OR m3.response = 'Y' OR (m1.response IS NULL AND m3.response IS NULL)) ) SELECT c_id, geoid, age, educationnum, sex, marital_status, occupation, inhabitants_k, income_k, SUM(amount) AS total_sales, AVG(amount) AS avg_sale_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT eventid) AS unique_sales_events, MAX(running_total) AS max_running_total, MIN(sales_rank_in_geo_year) AS best_sales_rank, AVG(avg_amount_by_occupation_month) AS overall_avg_by_occupation_month, MAX(sales_count_last_30_days) AS peak_sales_last_30_days, CORR(a_var1, amount) AS corr_var1_sales, CORR(a_var2, amount) AS corr_var2_sales, CORR(a_var3, amount) AS corr_var3_sales, CORR(a_var4, amount) AS corr_var4_sales, CORR(a_var5, amount) AS corr_var5_sales FROM ranked_sales GROUP BY c_id, geoid, age, educationnum, sex, marital_status, occupation, inhabitants_k, income_k HAVING SUM(amount) > '1000' AND COUNT(DISTINCT eventid) >= 4 AND AVG(amount) BETWEEN '50' AND '501' ORDER BY total_sales DESC, max_running_total DESC LIMIT 623;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-07-01' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE c.age > 37 AND c.educationnum >= 13 AND d.income_k > 75.01 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM mailings1_2 m2 WHERE m2.refid = c.id AND m2.kxindex > 2085 ) GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING AVG(s.amount) > '50' AND COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) >= 20 ORDER BY avg_sale_amount DESC, mailings_count DESC;

AS avg_a_var8, AVG(d.a_var9) AS avg_a_var9, AVG(d.a_var10) AS avg_a_var10, AVG(d.a_var11) AS avg_a_var11, AVG(d.a_var12) AS avg_a_var12, AVG(d.a_var13) AS avg_a_var13, AVG(d.a_var14) AS avg_a_var14, (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m12 ON c.id = m12.refid AND m12.ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT m1.response, ', ' ORDER BY m1.response) AS mailing_responses, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE c.age >= 43 AND c.age <= 47 AND d.income_k > 399.92 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) > 50 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT m1.response, ', ' ORDER BY m1.response) AS mailing_responses, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE c.age >= 90 AND c.age <= 75 AND d.income_k > 78.36 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) > 66 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

SELECT c1.id AS customer_id, c1.age AS age, c1.sex AS sex, c2.marital_status AS marital_status, AVG(c1.data1) AS avg_data1, SUM(c2.data2) AS sum_data2, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS distinct_sales_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(c2.data2) DESC) AS data2_rank FROM customers c1 JOIN customers c2 ON c1.geoid = c2.geoid AND c1.id != c2.id LEFT JOIN sales s ON c1.id = s.refid LEFT JOIN demog d ON c1.geoid = d.geoid WHERE c1.age > 57 AND c1.educationnum >= 1 GROUP BY c1.id, c1.age, c1.sex, c2.marital_status HAVING AVG(c1.data1) < '0' ORDER BY sum_data2 DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT d.geoid, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS customer_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(d.income_k) DESC) AS income_rank FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid WHERE d.income_k > 999.2 GROUP BY d.geoid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 4 ORDER BY avg_income DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(c.data1) AS total_data1, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM mailings1_2 m WHERE m.refid = c.id AND m.response = 'Yes' AND m.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' ) AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.amount > '0' GROUP BY d.geoid HAVING AVG(d.income_k) > 103.56 ORDER BY avg_income DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM m.ref_date) AS mailing_year, COUNT(DISTINCT m.refid) AS total_mailings, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) FILTER (WHERE s.eventid IS NOT NULL) AS total_sales, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN mailings1_2 m ON c.id = m.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON m.refid = s.refid AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM m.ref_date) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date) WHERE d.income_k > 32.58 AND m.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND c.age BETWEEN 26 AND 82 GROUP BY CUBE(d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM m.ref_date)) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m.refid) > 897 ORDER BY total_amount DESC NULLS LAST;

WITH customer_agg AS ( SELECT c.id AS c_id, c.age, c.geoid, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2 FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid WHERE c.age BETWEEN 54 AND 26 AND d.income_k > 325.65 GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.geoid, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) > 47 ), sales_agg AS ( SELECT s.refid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, MAX(s.event_date) AS last_sale_date, MIN(s.event_date) AS first_sale_date, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount FROM sales s WHERE s.amount > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY s.refid HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '100' ), mailings3_agg AS ( SELECT m3.refid, COUNT(*) AS m3_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS m3_positive FROM mailings3 m3 WHERE m3.ref_date >= '2023-01-01' GROUP BY m3.refid HAVING COUNT(*) > 34 ) SELECT ca.c_id, ca.age, ca.educationnum, ca.sex, ca.marital_status, ca.mailings_count, ca.positive_responses, ca.avg_a_var1, ca.avg_a_var2, COALESCE(sa.sales_count, 0) AS sales_count, COALESCE(sa.total_amount, 0) AS total_sales_amount, COALESCE(sa.avg_sale_amount, 0) AS avg_sale_amount, COALESCE(ma.m3_count, 0) AS m3_mailings_count, COALESCE(ma.m3_positive, 0) AS m3_positive_responses, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(sa.total_amount, 0) DESC) AS sales_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ca.sex ORDER BY ca.positive_responses DESC) AS response_rank_by_sex FROM customer_agg ca LEFT JOIN sales_agg sa ON ca.c_id = sa.refid LEFT JOIN mailings3_agg ma ON ca.c_id = ma.refid WHERE COALESCE(sa.total_amount, 0) > '0' OR COALESCE(ma.m3_count, 0) > 29 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, ca.positive_responses DESC LIMIT 70;

WITH customer_agg AS ( SELECT c.id AS c_id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2 FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid WHERE c.age BETWEEN 52 AND 59 AND d.income_k > 355.86 GROUP BY c.id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) > 78 ), sales_agg AS ( SELECT s.refid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_amount, MIN(s.event_date) AS first_sale_date, MAX(s.event_date) AS last_sale_date FROM sales s WHERE s.amount > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY s.refid ), mailings3_agg AS ( SELECT m3.refid, COUNT(*) AS m3_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS m3_positive FROM mailings3 m3 WHERE m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY m3.refid ) SELECT ca.c_id, ca.age, ca.educationnum, ca.mailings_count, ca.positive_responses, ca.avg_a_var1, ca.avg_a_var2, COALESCE(sa.sales_count, 0) AS sales_count, COALESCE(sa.total_amount, 0) AS total_sales_amount, COALESCE(sa.avg_amount, 0) AS avg_sale_amount, COALESCE(ma.m3_count, 0) AS m3_mailings_count, COALESCE(ma.m3_positive, 0) AS m3_positive_responses, (ca.positive_responses * 1.0 / NULLIF(ca.mailings_count, 0)) AS response_rate, (COALESCE(sa.total_amount, 0) * 1.0 / NULLIF(ca.mailings_count, 0)) AS revenue_per_mailing FROM customer_agg ca LEFT JOIN sales_agg sa ON ca.c_id = sa.refid LEFT JOIN mailings3_agg ma ON ca.c_id = ma.refid WHERE COALESCE(sa.total_amount, 0) > '0' OR COALESCE(ma.m3_count, 0) > 38 ORDER BY ca.age DESC, total_sales_amount DESC LIMIT 697;

WITH customer_metrics AS ( SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(s.eventid) AS sales_count FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE c.age BETWEEN 92 AND 73 AND d.income_k >= 105.58 GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k ) SELECT customer_id, age, educationnum, geoid, inhabitants_k, income_k, mailings_count, positive_responses, total_sales_amount, sales_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY geoid ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC NULLS LAST) AS sales_rank_in_geo, AVG(total_sales_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY geoid) AS avg_sales_in_geo, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY income_k DESC) AS income_percentile FROM customer_metrics WHERE total_sales_amount > '0' AND mailings_count >= 39 ORDER BY sales_rank_in_geo, income_percentile DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS unique_sales_events, COUNT(DISTINCT m12.refid) AS mailings1_2_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailings3_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m12.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses_m12, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses_m3, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank, LAG(SUM(s.amount), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.geoid ORDER BY AVG(d.income_k) DESC) AS prev_sales_in_geoid FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m12 ON c.id = m12.refid AND s.event_date >= m12.ref_date JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND s.event_date >= m3.ref_date WHERE c.age BETWEEN 83 AND 40 AND d.income_k > 39.22 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sales s2 WHERE s2.refid = c.id AND s2.amount > '0' ORDER BY s2.amount DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 44 ) GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 11 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, avg_a_var1 ASC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) OVER(PARTITION BY c.marital_status, c.occupation ORDER BY d.a_var2 ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_avg_var1, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, MAX(m3.ref_date) AS last_mailing3_date, CORR(d.a_var3, d.a_var4) AS correlation_var3_var4, STDDEV(d.a_var5) AS stddev_var5 FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE c.age BETWEEN 36 AND 84 AND d.income_k > 686.42 AND s.event_date >= '2000-01-01' AND m1.ref_date >= '2000-01-01' AND m3.response = 'Yes' AND s.amount > '0' GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.a_var2 HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) >= 60 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, rolling_avg_var1 ASC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS total_sales, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM mailings1_2 m WHERE m.refid = c.id AND m.response = 'YES' AND m.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' ) AND s.event_date BETWEEN '2021-01-01' AND '2021-01-01' AND d.income_k > 53.8 GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '1000' ORDER BY total_amount DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, d.a_var1, d.a_var2, d.a_var3, d.a_var4, d.a_var5, d.a_var6, d.a_var7, d.a_var8, d.a_var9, d.a_var10, d.a_var11, d.a_var12, d.a_var13, d.a_var14, d.a_var15, d.a_var16, d.a_var17, d.a_var18, COUNT(DISTINCT m12.refid) AS mailings_count_12, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailings_count_3, SUM(CASE WHEN m12.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS responses_12, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS responses_3, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, MAX(s.event_date) AS last_sale_date, MIN(s.event_date) AS first_sale_date, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s.amount) AS median_sale_amount, STDDEV(s.amount) AS stddev_sale_amount, SUM(c.data1) AS sum_data1, SUM(c.data2) AS sum_data2, SUM(c.data3) AS sum_data3, AVG(c.data1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.occupation, c.marital_status) AS avg_data1_by_occ_marital, AVG(c.data2) OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, d.geoid) AS avg_data2_by_sex_geo, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.occupation ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) DESC) AS sales_count_rank_by_occupation FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m12 ON c.id = m12.refid AND m12.ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date BETWEEN '2019-01-01 00:00:00' AND '2019-01-01 00:00:00' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 72 AND 62 AND d.income_k > 318.73 AND d.inhabitants_k < '0' AND (c.educationnum > 6 OR c.nom1 = 'A') GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, d.a_var1, d.a_var2, d.a_var3, d.a_var4, d.a_var5, d.a_var6, d.a_var7, d.a_var8, d.a_var9, d.a_var10, d.a_var11, d.a_var12, d.a_var13, d.a_var14, d.a_var15, d.a_var16, d.a_var17, d.a_var18 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) > 58 AND SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, sales_count DESC LIMIT 139;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, d.a_var1, d.a_var2, d.a_var3, d.a_var4, d.a_var5, d.a_var6, d.a_var7, d.a_var8, d.a_var9, d.a_var10, d.a_var11, d.a_var12, d.a_var13, d.a_var14, d.a_var15, d.a_var16, d.a_var17, d.a_var18, COUNT(DISTINCT m12.refid) AS total_mailings_12, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS total_mailings_3, SUM(CASE WHEN m12.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses_12, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses_3, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS total_sales_events, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC NULLS LAST) AS sales_rank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) DESC) AS sales_event_rank_by_demographic FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m12 ON c.id = m12.refid AND m12.ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND '2020-01-01 00:00:00' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 98 AND 60 AND c.educationnum >= 13 AND d.income_k > 684.16 AND d.a_var1 < '-1000' AND d.a_var2 > '-1000' GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, d.a_var1, d.a_var2, d.a_var3, d.a_var4, d.a_var5, d.a_var6, d.a_var7, d.a_var8, d.a_var9, d.a_var10, d.a_var11, d.a_var12, d.a_var13, d.a_var14, d.a_var15, d.a_var16, d.a_var17, d.a_var18 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) > 225 AND SUM(s.amount) >= '0' AND AVG(s.amount) BETWEEN '0' AND '0' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, sales_rank;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s.amount) AS median_sale_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, COUNT(s.eventid) AS total_sales, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses_m1, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses_m3 FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 32 AND 71 AND d.income_k > 220.13 GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k HAVING COUNT(s.eventid) > 610 ORDER BY total_sales DESC, avg_sale_amount DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, COUNT(s.eventid) AS sales_count FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE (c.age BETWEEN 34 AND 35) AND (d.income_k > 378.24 OR d.inhabitants_k < '0') AND (c.marital_status = 'Married-civ-spouse' OR c.occupation = 'Adm-clerical') AND NOT (c.educationnum < 13) AND (m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' OR m1.ref_date IS NULL) AND (s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' OR s.event_date IS NULL) GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) >= 29 AND SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, COUNT(s.eventid) AS sales_count, MAX(m3.ref_date) AS last_mailing_date FROM customers c INNER JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE c.age >= 44 AND d.income_k >= 16.32 AND (m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' OR m1.ref_date IS NULL) AND (s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' OR s.event_date IS NULL) GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) > 61 AND SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_sales DESC, avg_sale_amount DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m12.refid) AS mailings_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailings3_count, SUM(d.a_var1 + d.a_var2 + d.a_var3) AS demographic_sum FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m12 ON c.id = m12.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE c.age >= 50 AND c.age <= 56 AND d.income_k >= 497.17 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m12.refid) > 3 AND SUM(s.amount) >= '0' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date) AS sale_year, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM s.event_date) AS sale_quarter, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS total_sales, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_geoid_income, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date), c.sex ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS spending_rank_by_year_sex FROM customers c JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid WHERE s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.amount > '0' AND d.income_k BETWEEN 38.92 AND 275.32 GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM s.event_date) HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY sale_year DESC, sale_quarter, total_amount DESC;

c.educationnum HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 7 AND SUM(s.amount) >= '0' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, sales_count DESC LIMIT 7447;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m12.refid) AS mailings_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(d.a_var1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.marital_status) AS avg_a_var1_by_marital, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN mailings1_2 m12 ON c.id = m12.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date >= m12.ref_date LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date >= m12.ref_date WHERE c.occupation LIKE '%' AND c.nom1 LIKE '%' AND d.income_k BETWEEN 257.87 AND 337.06 AND m12.ref_date >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.income_k HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m12.refid) > 21 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC NULLS LAST;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) OVER(PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid) AS avg_a_var1_by_demo, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT m12.refid) AS mailings_count_12, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailings_count_3, MAX(s.event_date) AS latest_sale_date FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m12 ON c.id = m12.refid AND m12.response = 'YES' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.response = 'YES' WHERE c.age >= 26 AND c.age <= 53 AND d.income_k > 435.72 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' OR SUM(s.amount) IS NULL ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC NULLS LAST, latest_sale_date DESC NULLS LAST;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings_yes_responses, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS unique_sales_events, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_demog_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_demog_var2, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC NULLS LAST) AS sales_rank_by_demographic, LAG(SUM(s.amount), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY d.income_k DESC) AS prev_sales_by_income FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' WHERE c.age >= 59 AND c.age <= 37 AND c.educationnum >= 2 AND d.income_k >= 229.95 AND d.inhabitants_k <= '0' GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) >= 402 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, sales_rank_by_demographic;

SELECT c.id, c.age, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_demog_var FROM customers c JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid WHERE s.amount > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.age ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid WHERE s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.amount > '0' AND d.income_k BETWEEN 266.5 AND 362.79 GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) >= 61 INTERSECT SELECT c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailings_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.amount > '0' AND d.income_k BETWEEN 368.19 AND 413.38 GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) >= 67 ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS unique_customers, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS unique_mailings1_2_refs, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS unique_mailings3_refs, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE d.income_k > 59.63 AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY d.geoid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 61 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE s.amount > '0' AND d.income_k BETWEEN 215.5 AND 467.23 GROUP BY d.geoid HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS unique_events, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses_m1, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses_m3, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY d.a_var1) AS median_a_var1, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY d.a_var2) AS median_a_var2, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY d.a_var3) AS median_a_var3 FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE s.amount > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.event_date <= '2020-01-01' AND d.inhabitants_k BETWEEN '0' AND '0' AND c.age >= 44 AND c.id IN ( SELECT s2.refid FROM sales s2 WHERE s2.amount > '0' AND s2.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY s2.refid HAVING COUNT(s2.eventid) > 46 ) GROUP BY d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND AVG(d.income_k) BETWEEN 170.93 AND 203.6 ORDER BY total_sales DESC, avg_income DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(c.age) AS avg_age, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS unique_mailings, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank, LAG(SUM(s.amount), 1) OVER (ORDER BY d.geoid) AS prev_geoid_sales FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE s.event_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND s.amount > '0' AND d.income_k BETWEEN 394.21 AND 52.33 AND c.id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT s2.refid FROM sales s2 WHERE s2.event_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND '2020-01-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY s2.refid HAVING COUNT(s2.eventid) > 69 AND AVG(s2.amount) < '0' ) GROUP BY d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING COUNT(s.eventid) >= 807 AND AVG(c.educationnum) > 7 ORDER BY total_sales DESC, d.geoid;

SELECT d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS unique_mailings1_2_refs, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS unique_mailings3_refs, (SELECT AVG(c2.age) FROM customers c2 WHERE c2.geoid = d.geoid AND c2.age > 90) AS avg_age_above_threshold, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE d.income_k >= 256.58 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND c.age BETWEEN 63 AND 81 GROUP BY d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) > 401 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

WITH customer_agg AS ( SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.educationnum, c.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, COUNT(DISTINCT m12.ref_date) AS mailings_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.ref_date) AS mailings3_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m12.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS response_count_m12, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS response_count_m3, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2, AVG(d.a_var3) AS avg_a_var3 FROM customers c LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m12 ON c.id = m12.refid LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid LEFT JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid WHERE c.age BETWEEN 60 AND 39 AND m12.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.educationnum, c.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation ), sales_agg AS ( SELECT s.refid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_amount, MIN(s.event_date) AS first_sale_date, MAX(s.event_date) AS last_sale_date FROM sales s WHERE s.amount > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY s.refid ), combined AS ( SELECT ca.customer_id, ca.age, ca.educationnum, ca.sex, ca.marital_status, ca.occupation, ca.mailings_count, ca.mailings3_count, ca.response_count_m12, ca.response_count_m3, ca.avg_a_var1, ca.avg_a_var2, ca.avg_a_var3, COALESCE(sa.sales_count, 0) AS sales_count, COALESCE(sa.total_amount, 0) AS total_amount, COALESCE(sa.avg_amount, 0) AS avg_amount, sa.first_sale_date, sa.last_sale_date, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, d.a_var4, d.a_var5, d.a_var6 FROM customer_agg ca LEFT JOIN sales_agg sa ON ca.customer_id = sa.refid LEFT JOIN demog d ON ca.geoid = d.geoid WHERE d.income_k > 4.7 AND d.inhabitants_k BETWEEN '0' AND '0' ) SELECT sex, marital_status, occupation, COUNT(*) AS customer_count, AVG(age) AS avg_age, AVG(educationnum) AS avg_education, SUM(mailings_count) AS total_mailings, SUM(mailings3_count) AS total_mailings3, SUM(response_count_m12) AS total_responses_m12, SUM(response_count_m3) AS total_responses_m3, AVG(avg_a_var1) AS overall_avg_a_var1, AVG(avg_a_var2) AS overall_avg_a_var2, AVG(avg_a_var3) AS overall_avg_a_var3, SUM(sales_count) AS total_sales, SUM(total_amount) AS grand_total_amount, AVG(avg_amount) AS overall_avg_sale_amount, MIN(first_sale_date) AS earliest_sale, MAX(last_sale_date) AS latest_sale, AVG(inhabitants_k) AS avg_inhabitants, AVG(income_k) AS avg_income, AVG(a_var4) AS avg_a_var4, AVG(a_var5) AS avg_a_var5, AVG(a_var6) AS avg_a_var6 FROM combined GROUP BY sex, marital_status, occupation HAVING COUNT(*) > 971 AND SUM(total_amount) > '0' AND AVG(income_k) BETWEEN 135.88 AND 44.98 ORDER BY grand_total_amount DESC, customer_count DESC;

WITH customer_agg AS ( SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.geoid, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) FILTER (WHERE s.amount > 0) AS positive_sales, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_geoid_income FROM customers c LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid LEFT JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.geoid, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status ), windowed_stats AS ( SELECT ca.customer_id, ca.age, ca.geoid, ca.educationnum, ca.sex, ca.marital_status, ca.mailings_count, ca.positive_sales, ca.total_amount, ca.avg_geoid_income, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ca.geoid ORDER BY ca.total_amount DESC NULLS LAST) AS rank_in_geoid, AVG(ca.total_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY ca.geoid) AS avg_amount_in_geoid, SUM(ca.positive_sales) OVER (ORDER BY ca.customer_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_positive_sales FROM customer_agg ca WHERE ca.age BETWEEN 63 AND 51 AND ca.total_amount >= '0' ) SELECT ws.customer_id, ws.age, ws.geoid, ws.educationnum, ws.sex, ws.marital_status, ws.mailings_count, ws.positive_sales, ws.total_amount, ws.avg_geoid_income, ws.rank_in_geoid, ws.avg_amount_in_geoid, ws.cumulative_positive_sales, d.inhabitants_k, d.a_var1, d.a_var2 FROM windowed_stats ws LEFT JOIN demog d ON ws.geoid = d.geoid WHERE ws.rank_in_geoid <= 34 AND d.inhabitants_k > '0' ORDER BY ws.total_amount DESC, ws.rank_in_geoid;

WITH customer_aggregates AS ( SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status, COUNT(DISTINCT m12.ref_date) AS mailings_count, AVG(m12.kxindex) AS avg_kxindex, SUM(CASE WHEN m12.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses FROM customers c LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m12 ON c.id = m12.refid WHERE c.age BETWEEN 85 AND 19 AND c.educationnum >= 10 GROUP BY c.id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status ), sales_analysis AS ( SELECT s.refid, COUNT(s.eventid) AS total_transactions, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_transaction, MIN(s.event_date) AS first_purchase, MAX(s.event_date) AS last_purchase FROM sales s WHERE s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.amount > '0' GROUP BY s.refid ), demographic_metrics AS ( SELECT d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_var2, AVG(d.a_var3) AS avg_var3, AVG(d.a_var4) AS avg_var4, AVG(d.a_var5) AS avg_var5, AVG(d.a_var6) AS avg_var6, AVG(d.a_var7) AS avg_var7, AVG(d.a_var8) AS avg_var8, AVG(d.a_var9) AS avg_var9, AVG(d.a_var10) AS avg_var10, AVG(d.a_var11) AS avg_var11, AVG(d.a_var12) AS avg_var12, AVG(d.a_var13) AS avg_var13, AVG(d.a_var14) AS avg_var14, AVG(d.a_var15) AS avg_var15, AVG(d.a_var16) AS avg_var16, AVG(d.a_var17) AS avg_var17, AVG(d.a_var18) AS avg_var18 FROM demog d WHERE d.income_k >= 483.93 AND d.inhabitants_k <= '0' GROUP BY d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k ), mailings3_summary AS ( SELECT m3.refid, COUNT(*) AS m3_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS m3_positive FROM mailings3 m3 WHERE m3.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' GROUP BY m3.refid ) SELECT ca.customer_id, ca.age, ca.educationnum, ca.sex, ca.marital_status, ca.mailings_count, ca.avg_kxindex, ca.positive_responses, COALESCE(sa.total_transactions, 0) AS total_transactions, COALESCE(sa.total_amount, 0) AS total_amount, COALESCE(sa.avg_transaction, 0) AS avg_transaction, sa.first_purchase, sa.last_purchase, dm.inhabitants_k, dm.income_k, dm.avg_var1, dm.avg_var2, dm.avg_var3, dm.avg_var4, dm.avg_var5, dm.avg_var6, dm.avg_var7, dm.avg_var8, dm.avg_var9, dm.avg_var10, (PARTITION BY ca.geoid) AS avg_sales_by_geoid, SUM(COALESCE(sa.total_amount, 0)) OVER (ORDER BY ca.customer_id) AS running_total_sales FROM customer_aggregates ca LEFT JOIN sales_analysis sa ON ca.customer_id = sa.refid LEFT JOIN demographic_metrics dm ON ca.geoid = dm.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings3_summary m3s ON ca.customer_id = m3s.refid WHERE COALESCE(sa.total_amount, 0) >= '0' AND dm.income_k <= 465.98 AND (ca.positive_responses > 55 OR COALESCE(m3s.m3_positive, 0) > 80) ORDER BY total_amount DESC, ca.customer_id LIMIT 1556;

WITH customer_aggregates AS ( SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.ref_date) AS mailings_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(s.eventid) AS sales_count, MAX(s.event_date) AS mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE c.age BETWEEN 47 AND 79 AND d.income_k > 70.56 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m3.ref_date <= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum, ON c.id = s.refid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid WHERE d.inhabitants_k > '0' AND d.a_var7 > '0' AND s.event_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' GROUP BY d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 203 AND SUM(s.amount) > '10000' ) SELECT customer_id, geoid, age, educationnum, inhabitants_k, income_k, mailings_count, positive_responses, avg_a_var1, ca.educationnum, ca.inhabitants_k, ca.income_k, ca.mailings_count, ca.positive_responses, ca.avg_a_var1, ca.avg_a_var2, ca.total_sales_amount, ca.sales_count, ca.last_sale_date, ca.first_mailing3_date SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS unique_sales_events, COUNT(m1.response) FILTER (WHERE m1.response = 'YES') AS mailings1_2_yes_responses, COUNT(m3.response) FILTER (WHERE m3.response = 'YES') AS mailings3_yes_responses, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_demographic, LAG(SUM(s.amount), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.id ORDER BY MIN(s.event_date)) AS prev_sales_amount FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND s.event_date >= m1.ref_date JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND s.event_date >= m3.ref_date WHERE s.amount > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.event_date <= '2020-01-01' AND d.income_k BETWEEN 367.84 AND 702.48 AND c.age >= 34 GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 62 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, sales_rank_by_demographic;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status) AS avg_a_var1_by_demo, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT m12.refid) AS mailings1_2_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailings3_count, MAX(s.event_date) AS latest_sale_date, MIN(m12.ref_date) AS first_mailing1_2_date FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m12 ON c.id = m12.refid LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE c.age >= 32 AND c.age <= 76 AND d.income_k > 393.94 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m12.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT m12.refid) >= 157 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, COUNT(DISTINCT m12.refid) AS mailings_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m12.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m12 ON c.id = m12.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE c.occupation LIKE '%' AND c.marital_status LIKE '%' AND d.income_k >= 974.72 AND m12.ref_date >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m12.refid) > 37 AND SUM(s.amount) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS distinct_mailings1_2_refs, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS distinct_mailings3_refs, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS distinct_sales_events, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_demog_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_demog_var2, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN m1.refid END) AS distinct_positive_mailings1_2, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN m3.refid END) AS distinct_positive_mailings3, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_sex, LAG(SUM(s.amount), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.id ORDER BY MIN(s.event_date)) AS prev_sales_amount FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND '2020-01-01 00:00:00' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 60 AND 89 AND d.income_k > 25.24 AND (m1.kxindex > 942 OR m1.kxindex IS NULL) GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) > 86 AND SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND (COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) + COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid)) > 691 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, d.inhabitants_k ASC;

SELECT c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.income_k, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s.amount) AS median_sale_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, COUNT(s.eventid) AS total_sales FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.amount > '0' GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.income_k HAVING COUNT(s.eventid) >= 26 ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS customer_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date BETWEEN (m1.ref_date - INTERVAL '30 days') AND (m1.ref_date + INTERVAL '30 days') WHERE m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM m1.ref_date) = 2023 AND d.inhabitants_k > '0' GROUP BY d.geoid HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT d.geoid, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY d.a_var1) AS median_a_var1, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS customer_count FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN mailings1_2 m ON c.id = m.refid WHERE d.income_k > 293.52 AND m.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY d.geoid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 231 ORDER BY avg_income DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS unique_events, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 '2000-01-01' GROUP BY d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) > 995 UNION SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS unique_events, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses_m1, SUM(CASE WHEN s.refid = m1.refid AND s.event_date >= m1.ref_date WHERE d.income_k > 728989.59 AND s.amount > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2000-01-01' AND m3.ref_date >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) > 734 ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, AVG(d.inhabitants_k) AS avg_inhabitants, SUM(d.income_k) AS total_income, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS total_sales_events, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS total_mailings1_2, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS total_mailings3, AVG(c.educationnum) AS avg_education, SUM(d.a_var1 + d.a_var2 + d.a_var3 + d.a_var4 + d.a_var5 + d.a_var6 + d.a_var7 + d.a_var8 + d.a_var9 + d.a_var10 + d.a_var11 + d.a_var12 + d.a_var13 + d.a_var14 + d.a_var15 + d.a_var16 + d.a_var17 + d.a_var18) AS sum_all_a_vars, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_demographic FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND '2020-01-01 00:00:00' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 72 AND 79 AND d.income_k > 539444.54 AND (c.nom1 = 'A' OR c.nom2 = 'A' OR c.nom3 = 'A') GROUP BY d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) > 22975 AND SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND AVG(c.educationnum) BETWEEN 3 AND 2 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, avg_inhabitants ASC;

SELECT d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(c.age) AS avg_age, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS unique_mailings, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT refid FROM mailings3 WHERE ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND ref_date <= '2020-01-01 00:00:00') AS sub_sub) AS recent_mailings3_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE c.age >= 37 AND c.age <= 35 AND s.event_date >= '2019-01-01 00:00:00' AND s.event_date <= '2019-01-01 00:00:00' AND d.income_k >= 122.61 AND d.income_k <= 499.12 GROUP BY d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) >= 54 ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS customer_count, AVG(c.age) AS avg_age, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_event_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m12.refid) AS mailing_response_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailing3_yes_count, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY d.a_var2) AS median_a_var2, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m12 ON c.id = m12.refid LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date >= s.event_date WHERE d.income_k > 373.83 AND c.age BETWEEN 96 AND 42 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.amount > '0' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM mailings1_2 m12_sub WHERE m12_sub.refid = c.id AND m12_sub.response = 'YES' AND m12_sub.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' ) GROUP BY d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 476 AND SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, customer_count ASC;

WITH customer_agg AS ( SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, d.a_var1, d.a_var2, d.a_var3, d.a_var4, d.a_var5, d.a_var6, d.a_var7, d.a_var8, d.a_var9, d.a_var10, d.a_var11, d.a_var12, d.a_var13, d.a_var14, d.a_var15, d.a_var16, d.a_var17, d.a_var18, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.ref_date) AS mailings_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings_yes, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'NO' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings_no, AVG(m1.kxindex) AS avg_kxindex, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, MAX(s.event_date) AS last_sale_date, MIN(s.event_date) AS first_sale_date FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE c.age BETWEEN 86 AND 89 AND d.income_k >= 267.15 AND s.event_date >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, d.a_var1, d.a_var2, d.a_var3, d.a_var4, d.a_var5, d.a_var6, d.a_var7, d.a_var8, d.a_var9, d.a_var10, d.a_var11, d.a_var12, d.a_var13, d.a_var14, d.a_var15, d.a_var16, d.a_var17, d.a_var18 HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '1000' AND COUNT(DISTINCT m1.ref_date) >= 6 ), mailings3_agg AS ( SELECT m3.refid AS customer_id, COUNT(*) AS mailings3_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings3_yes, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'NO' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings3_no, AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (m3.ref_date - '2000-01-01'::timestamp))) AS avg_days_since_epoch FROM mailings3 m3 WHERE m3.ref_date BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2000-01-01' GROUP BY m3.refid HAVING COUNT(*) > 8 ) SELECT ca.customer_id, ca.age, ca.educationnum, ca.sex, ca.marital_status, ca.occupation, ca.inhabitants_k, ca.income_k, ca.total_sales_amount, ca.sales_count, ca.mailings_count, ca.mailings_yes, ca.mailings_no, ca.avg_kxindex, ca.last_sale_date, ca.first_sale_date, ma.mailings3_count, ma.mailings3_yes, ma.mailings3_no, ma.avg_days_since_epoch, (ca.total_sales_amount / NULLIF(ca.mailings_count, 0)) AS sales_per_mailing, (ca.mailings_yes / NULLIF(ca.mailings_count, 0.0)) AS mailing_response_rate, (ca.total_sales_amount / NULLIF(ca.sales_count, 0)) AS avg_sale_amount, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ca.total_sales_amount DESC) AS sales_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ca.sex ORDER BY ca.income_k DESC) AS income_rank_by_sex FROM customer_agg ca LEFT JOIN mailings3_agg ma ON ca.customer_id = ma.customer_id WHERE ca.income_k >= 260.24 AND (ma.mailings3_count IS NULL OR ma.mailings3_count <= 95) UNION ALL SELECT ca.customer_id, ca.age, ca.educationnum, ca.sex, ca.marital_status, ca.occupation, ca.inhabitants_k, ca.income_k, ca.total_sales_amount, ca.sales_count, ca.mailings_count, ca.mailings_yes, ca.mailings_no, ca.avg_kxindex, ca.last_sale_date, ca.first_sale_date, NULL AS mailings3_count, NULL AS mailings3_yes, NULL AS mailings3_no, NULL AS avg_days_since_epoch, (ca.total_sales_amount / NULLIF(ca.mailings_count, 0)) AS sales_per_mailing, (ca.mailings_yes / NULLIF(ca.mailings_count, 0.0)) AS mailing_response_rate, (ca.total_sales_amount / NULLIF(ca.sales_count, 0)) AS avg_sale_amount, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ca.total_sales_amount DESC) AS sales_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ca.sex ORDER BY ca.income_k DESC) AS income_rank_by_sex FROM customer_agg ca WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mailings3_agg ma WHERE ma.customer_id = ca.customer_id) AND ca.mailings_count > 0 ORDER BY sales_rank, income_rank_by_sex LIMIT 5837;

WITH customer_aggregates AS ( SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses, AVG(c.data1) AS avg_data1, AVG(c.data2) AS avg_data2 FROM customers c LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid WHERE c.age BETWEEN 32 AND 58 GROUP BY c.id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) > 67 ), sales_aggregates AS ( SELECT s.refid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_events, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_amount, MIN(s.event_date) AS first_sale, MAX(s.event_date) AS last_sale FROM sales s WHERE s.amount > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY s.refid ), mailings3_aggregates AS ( SELECT m3.refid, COUNT(*) AS mailings3_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings3_positive FROM mailings3 m3 WHERE m3.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' GROUP BY m3.refid ) SELECT ca.customer_id, ca.age, ca.educationnum, ca.mailings_count, ca.positive_responses, ca.avg_data1, ca.avg_data2, COALESCE(sa.sales_events, 0) AS sales_events, COALESCE(sa.total_amount, 0) AS total_sales_amount, COALESCE(sa.avg_amount, 0) AS avg_sale_amount, COALESCE(sa.first_sale, '1900-01-01'::timestamp) AS first_sale_date, COALESCE(sa.last_sale, '1900-01-01'::timestamp) AS last_sale_date, COALESCE(m3a.mailings3_count, 0) AS mailings3_count, COALESCE(m3a.mailings3_positive, 0) AS mailings3_positive, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) OVER (PARTITION BY ca.geoid) AS avg_a_var1_by_geoid, AVG(d.a_var2) OVER (PARTITION BY ca.geoid) AS avg_a_var2_by_geoid, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(sa.total_amount, 0) DESC) AS sales_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ca.age ORDER BY ca.educationnum DESC) AS education_rank_in_age FROM customer_aggregates ca LEFT JOIN sales_aggregates sa ON ca.customer_id = sa.refid LEFT JOIN mailings3_aggregates m3a ON ca.customer_id = m3a.refid INNER JOIN demog d ON ca.geoid = d.geoid WHERE d.income_k > 211.98 AND d.inhabitants_k BETWEEN '0' AND '0' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, ca.age ASC LIMIT 185;

WITH ranked_sales AS ( SELECT s.eventid, s.refid, s.event_date, s.amount, c.id AS c_id, c.age, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, d.a_var1, d.a_var2, d.a_var3, d.a_var4, d.a_var5, d.a_var6, d.a_var7, d.a_var8, d.a_var9, d.a_var10, d.a_var11, d.a_var12, d.a_var13, d.a_var14, d.a_var15, d.a_var16, d.a_var17, d.a_var18, m1.ref_date AS mailing1_date, m1.response AS mailing1_response, m3.ref_date AS mailing3_date, m3.response AS mailing3_response, SUM(s.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY c.id ORDER BY s.event_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_total, AVG(s.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY c.geoid, c.marital_status) AS avg_amount_by_geo_marital, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.geoid ORDER BY s.amount DESC) AS sales_rank_in_geoid, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY c.id) AS total_transactions_per_customer FROM sales s INNER JOIN customers c ON s.refid = c.id INNER JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND s.event_date >= m1.ref_date LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND s.event_date >= m3.ref_date WHERE s.amount > '10' AND s.event_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' AND c.age BETWEEN 74 AND 93 AND d.income_k > 31.66 AND (m1.response = 'Y' OR m3.response = 'Y' OR (m1.response IS NULL AND m3.response IS NULL)) ), aggregated AS ( SELECT c_id, geoid, sex, marital_status, occupation, SUM(amount) AS total_spent, AVG(amount) AS avg_spent, MAX(amount) AS max_spent, MIN(amount) AS min_spent, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count, AVG(running_total) AS avg_running_total, MAX(sales_rank_in_geoid) AS max_sales_rank, AVG(avg_amount_by_geo_marital) AS avg_geo_marital_baseline, SUM(CASE WHEN mailing1_response = 'Y' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS unique_sales_events, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings1_2_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailings3_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings1_2_yes_responses, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings3_yes_responses, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank, LAG(SUM(s.amount), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY d.income_k DESC) AS prev_sales_amount_by_demo FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE s.event_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND s.amount > '0.0' AND d.income_k BETWEEN 460.11 AND 28.31 AND c.age >= 82 AND (m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' OR m1.ref_date IS NULL) AND (m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' OR m3.ref_date IS NULL) GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0.0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 88 AND AVG(d.a_var1) < '-100.0' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, d.income_k DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE s.amount > '0' AND d.income_k BETWEEN 34.94 AND 232.86 GROUP BY d.geoid HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

d.a_var12 + d.a_var13 + d.a_var14 + d.a_var15 + d.a_var16 + d.a_var17 + d.a_var18) AS total_a_var, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, STDDEV(d.a_var1) AS std_a_var1 FROM demog d WHERE d.income_k >= 153.36 total_sales_amount, COUNT(s.eventid) AS sales_count, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, MIN(s.event_date) AS first_sale_date, MAX(s.event_date) AS last_sale_date FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON s.refid AND s.event_date BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 24 AND 49 AND c.educationnum >= 10 AND d.income_k > 43.3 AND d.inhabitants_k < '1' GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.educationnum, c.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, d.a_var1, d.a_var2, d.a_var3, d.a_var4, d.a_var5, d.a_var6, d.a_var7, d.a_var8, d.a_var9, d.a_var10, d.a_var11, d.a_var12, d.a_var13, d.a_var14, WITH customer_aggregates AS ( SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS
