SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS distinct_mailings1_2_refs, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS distinct_mailings3_refs, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS distinct_sales_events, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_demog_var1 FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE c.age >= 25 AND d.income_k >= 345.6 AND (m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' OR m1.ref_date IS NULL) AND (m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' OR m3.ref_date IS NULL) GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' OR SUM(s.amount) IS NULL ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC NULLS LAST;

SELECT c.id, c.age, d.geoid, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE s.amount > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.age, d.geoid HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '100' INTERSECT SELECT c.id, c.age, d.geoid, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN mailings1_2 m ON c.id = m.refid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE m.response = 'Yes' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.age, d.geoid ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailings3_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, AVG(d.inhabitants_k) AS avg_inhabitants, SUM(d.a_var1 + d.a_var2 + d.a_var3 + d.a_var4 + d.a_var5 + d.a_var6 + d.a_var7 + d.a_var8 + d.a_var9 + d.a_var10 + d.a_var11 + d.a_var12 + d.a_var13 + d.a_var14 + d.a_var15 + d.a_var16 + d.a_var17 + d.a_var18) AS sum_all_vars, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC NULLS LAST) AS sales_rank_by_demog, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY d.geoid, c.sex ORDER BY c.marital_status, c.occupation) AS prev_sales_count FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.response = 'YES' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.response = 'YES' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE d.income_k > 74.96 AND d.inhabitants_k BETWEEN '0' AND '10' AND c.age >= 51 AND c.educationnum >= 10 AND (m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' OR m1.ref_date IS NULL) AND (m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' OR m3.ref_date IS NULL) AND (s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' OR s.event_date IS NULL) GROUP BY d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) > 86 AND SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND AVG(d.income_k) < 668.34 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, avg_income ASC LIMIT 772;

SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailings3_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(d.inhabitants_k) AS avg_inhabitants, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(d.a_var1 + d.a_var2 + d.a_var3 + d.a_var4 + d.a_var5 + d.a_var6 + d.a_var7 + d.a_var8 + d.a_var9 + d.a_var10 + d.a_var11 + d.a_var12 + d.a_var13 + d.a_var14 + d.a_var15 + d.a_var16 + d.a_var17 + d.a_var18) AS sum_all_a_vars, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC NULLS LAST) AS sales_rank_by_demographic, AVG(c.educationnum) FILTER (WHERE c.age >= 51) AS avg_education_above_age, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE m1.response = 'Yes' AND m3.response = 'Yes') AS double_positive_response_count FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date BETWEEN '2019-01-01 00:00:00' AND '2019-01-01 00:00:00' WHERE d.inhabitants_k > '0.0' AND d.income_k BETWEEN 326.11 AND 165.27 AND c.age BETWEEN 57 AND 35 AND (c.nom1 = 'A' OR c.nom2 = 'A' OR c.nom3 = 'A') GROUP BY d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) > 329 AND SUM(s.amount) > '0.0' AND AVG(d.income_k) < 230.41 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, sales_count ASC, mailings_count DESC LIMIT 372;

SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS total_sales_events, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT m12.refid) AS mailings1_2_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailings3_count, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT m12.response, ', ' ORDER BY m12.response) AS mailing1_2_responses, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT m3.response, ', ' ORDER BY m3.response) AS mailing3_responses, SUM(d.inhabitants_k) AS total_inhabitants_k, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income_k, SUM(d.a_var1 + d.a_var2 + d.a_var3 + d.a_var4 + d.a_var5 + d.a_var6 + d.a_var7 + d.a_var8 + d.a_var9 + d.a_var10 + d.a_var11 + d.a_var12 + d.a_var13 + d.a_var14 + d.a_var15 + d.a_var16 + d.a_var17 + d.a_var18) AS sum_all_a_vars, MAX(s.event_date) AS latest_sale_date, MIN(m12.ref_date) AS earliest_mailing1_2_date, MIN(m3.ref_date) AS earliest_mailing3_date, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s.amount) AS median_sale_amount, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_amount_rank FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.amount > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m12 ON c.id = m12.refid AND m12.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' WHERE d.income_k > 372.41 AND c.age BETWEEN 69 AND 30 GROUP BY d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) > 679 AND SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, total_sales_events DESC LIMIT 643;

SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date) AS sale_year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM s.event_date) AS sale_month, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS total_sales, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings1_2_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailings3_count, SUM(d.inhabitants_k) AS total_inhabitants, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(d.a_var1 * d.a_var2) AS demographic_score, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_demographic FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date BETWEEN s.event_date - INTERVAL '30 days' AND s.event_date + INTERVAL '30 days' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date BETWEEN s.event_date - INTERVAL '30 days' AND s.event_date + INTERVAL '30 days' WHERE s.amount > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.event_date <= '2020-01-01' AND c.age BETWEEN 73 AND 22 AND d.income_k > 127.79 GROUP BY CUBE(d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM s.event_date)) HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 270 ORDER BY total_amount DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date) AS sale_year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM s.event_date) AS sale_month, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS total_sales, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses, SUM(d.inhabitants_k) AS total_inhabitants, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(d.a_var1 + d.a_var2 + d.a_var3 + d.a_var4 + d.a_var5 + d.a_var6 + d.a_var7 + d.a_var8 + d.a_var9 + d.a_var10 + d.a_var11 + d.a_var12 + d.a_var13 + d.a_var14 + d.a_var15 + d.a_var16 + d.a_var17 + d.a_var18) AS sum_all_vars, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS rank_by_group FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE s.amount > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.event_date <= '2020-01-01' AND c.age BETWEEN 94 AND 54 AND d.income_k > 68.65 AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, sale_year, sale_month), (d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, sale_year), (d.geoid, c.sex, sale_year), (d.geoid, sale_year), (c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation), (c.sex, c.marital_status), (c.sex), () ) HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 874 ORDER BY total_amount DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(c.age) AS avg_age, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mailings3 m3 WHERE m3.refid IN (SELECT s2.refid FROM sales s2 WHERE s2.event_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND s2.amount > '0')) AS complex_subquery_count FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON s.refid = m1.refid WHERE d.income_k > 62.05 AND c.age BETWEEN 79 AND 37 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

WITH customer_agg AS ( SELECT c.id AS c_id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings_yes, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2 FROM customers c LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid WHERE c.age BETWEEN 81 AND 82 AND d.income_k > 448.69 GROUP BY c.id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) > 8 ), sales_agg AS ( SELECT s.refid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_amount, MIN(s.event_date) AS first_sale, MAX(s.event_date) AS last_sale FROM sales s WHERE s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.amount > '0' GROUP BY s.refid ), mailings3_agg AS ( SELECT m3.refid, COUNT(*) AS m3_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS m3_yes FROM mailings3 m3 WHERE m3.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' GROUP BY m3.refid ) SELECT ca.c_id, ca.age, ca.educationnum, ca.sex, ca.marital_status, ca.mailings_count, ca.mailings_yes, ca.avg_a_var1, ca.avg_a_var2, COALESCE(sa.sales_count, 0) AS sales_count, COALESCE(sa.total_amount, 0) AS total_sales_amount, COALESCE(sa.avg_amount, 0) AS avg_sale_amount, sa.first_sale, sa.last_sale, COALESCE(ma.m3_count, 0) AS m3_mailings_count, COALESCE(ma.m3_yes, 0) AS m3_yes_count, (ca.mailings_yes * 1.0 / NULLIF(ca.mailings_count, 0)) AS m1_response_rate, (COALESCE(ma.m3_yes, 0) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COALESCE(ma.m3_count, 0), 0)) AS m3_response_rate, (COALESCE(sa.total_amount, 0) / NULLIF(ca.mailings_count, 0)) AS revenue_per_mailing FROM customer_agg ca LEFT JOIN sales_agg sa ON ca.c_id = sa.refid LEFT JOIN mailings3_agg ma ON ca.c_id = ma.refid WHERE COALESCE(sa.total_amount, 0) > '0' OR COALESCE(ma.m3_yes, 0) > 14 ORDER BY ca.age DESC, total_sales_amount DESC LIMIT 483;

WITH customer_agg AS ( SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.geoid, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.ref_date) AS distinct_mailing_dates, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.kxindex) AS distinct_kxindex, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.ref_date) AS distinct_mailing3_dates, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS 292.35 GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.geoid, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status ), sales_agg AS ( SELECT s.refid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.event_date) AS distinct_sale_dates, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS distinct_events, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_amount FROM sales s WHERE s.amount > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY s.refid ) SELECT ca.customer_id, ca.age, ca.geoid, ca.educationnum, ca.sex, ca.marital_status, ca.distinct_mailing_dates, ca.distinct_kxindex, ca.distinct_mailing3_dates, ca.positive_responses, ca.avg_a_var1, ca.avg_a_var2, COALESCE(sa.distinct_sale_dates, 0) AS distinct_sale_dates, COALESCE(sa.distinct_events, 0) AS distinct_events, COALESCE(sa.total_amount, 0) AS total_amount, COALESCE(sa.avg_amount, 0) AS avg_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT d2.a_var3) AS distinct_a_var3_values, COUNT(DISTINCT d2.a_var4) AS distinct_a_var4_values, COUNT(DISTINCT d2.a_var5) AS distinct_a_var5_values FROM customer_agg ca LEFT JOIN sales_agg sa ON ca.customer_id = sa.refid LEFT JOIN demog d2 ON ca.geoid = d2.geoid WHERE ca.distinct_mailing_dates > 84 AND ca.positive_responses >= 40 GROUP BY ca.customer_id, ca.age, ca.geoid, ca.educationnum, ca.sex, ca.marital_status, ca.distinct_mailing_dates, ca.distinct_kxindex, ca.distinct_mailing3_dates, ca.positive_responses, ca.avg_a_var1, ca.avg_a_var2, sa.distinct_sale_dates, sa.distinct_events, sa.total_amount, sa.avg_amount HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT d2.a_var3) > 5 AND COUNT(DISTINCT d2.a_var4) < 654 ORDER BY total_amount DESC, ca.distinct_mailing_dates DESC LIMIT 1000;

WITH customer_agg AS ( SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.geoid, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sales_amount FROM customers c LEFT JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' OR s.event_date IS NULL GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.geoid, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k ) SELECT COALESCE(sex, 'ALL') AS sex, COALESCE(marital_status, 'ALL') AS marital_status, COALESCE(occupation, 'ALL') AS occupation, COUNT(customer_id) AS customer_count, AVG(age) AS avg_age, AVG(educationnum) AS avg_education, SUM(inhabitants_k) AS total_inhabitants, AVG(income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(mailings_count) AS total_mailings, SUM(sales_count) AS total_sales, SUM(total_sales_amount) AS grand_total_sales, AVG(avg_sales_amount) AS overall_avg_sale FROM customer_agg WHERE age BETWEEN 27 AND 63 AND income_k >= 139.99 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (sex, marital_status, occupation), (sex, marital_status), (sex), (occupation), () ) ORDER BY sex, marital_status, occupation;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE c.age BETWEEN 21 AND 38 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM mailings3 m3 WHERE m3.refid = c.id AND m3.response = 'YES' AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' ) GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS unique_sales_events, COUNT(m12.response) FILTER (WHERE m12.response = 'YES') AS mailings12_yes_count, COUNT(m3.response) FILTER (WHERE m3.response = 'YES') AS mailings3_yes_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_sex, LAG(SUM(s.amount), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.id ORDER BY MIN(s.event_date)) AS prev_sales_amount FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m12 ON c.id = m12.refid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE s.amount > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m12.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND d.income_k BETWEEN 49.98 AND 48.45 AND c.age >= 99 GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) > 38 EXCEPT SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS unique_sales_events, COUNT(m12.response) FILTER (WHERE m12.response = 'YES') AS mailings12_yes_count, COUNT(m3.response) FILTER (WHERE m3.response = 'YES') AS mailings3_yes_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_sex, LAG(SUM(s.amount), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.id ORDER BY MIN(s.event_date)) AS prev_sales_amount FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m12 ON c.id = m12.refid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE s.amount <= '0' AND s.event_date < '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING AVG(d.a_var1) < '0' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_percentile FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE d.inhabitants_k > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2000-01-01' AND s.event_date <= '2000-01-01' AND m1.ref_date >= '2000-01-01' AND m1.ref_date <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status HAVING AVG(d.income_k) > 216.09 AND SUM(s.amount) > '0' INTERSECT SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailings_count, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_percentile FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE d.inhabitants_k > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2000-01-01' AND s.event_date <= '2000-01-01' AND m3.ref_date >= '2000-01-01' AND m3.ref_date <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status HAVING AVG(d.income_k) > 209.22 AND SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS distinct_mailings1_2_refid, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS distinct_mailings3_refid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS distinct_sales_eventid, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(d.inhabitants_k) AS total_inhabitants, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank, LAG(SUM(s.amount), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY d.geoid) AS prev_geoid_sales FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE d.income_k > 856.14 AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND c.age BETWEEN 57 AND 58 GROUP BY d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) > 419 AND COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) > 69 AND SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(c.age) AS avg_age, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS unique_mailings_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE d.income_k > 218.67 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.event_date <= '2020-01-01' AND c.id IN ( SELECT s2.refid FROM sales s2 WHERE s2.amount > '0' GROUP BY s2.refid HAVING COUNT(s2.eventid) >= 98 ) GROUP BY d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2, AVG(d.a_var3) AS avg_a_var3, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS unique_sales_events, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS unique_mailings1_2_refs, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS unique_mailings3_refs, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT c.occupation, ', ' ORDER BY c.occupation) AS occupation_list, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT c.marital_status, ', ' ORDER BY c.marital_status) AS marital_status_list, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings1_2_yes_responses, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings3_yes_responses, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_amount_rank, LAG(SUM(s.amount), 1) OVER (ORDER BY d.geoid) AS prev_geoid_sales_amount FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE d.income_k > 913.86 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.amount BETWEEN '0' AND '10000' AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 76 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, d.geoid;

mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid LEFT JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid WHERE c.age BETWEEN 77 AND 90 AND (c.educationnum > 11 OR c.marital_status NOT IN SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS unique_sales_events, COUNT(m1.response) FILTER (WHERE m1.response = 'YES') AS mailings1_yes_count, COUNT(m3.response) FILTER (WHERE m3.response = 'YES') AS mailings3_yes_count, SUM(d.a_var1 * d.a_var2) / NULLIF(SUM(d.a_var3), 0) AS complex_demog_ratio, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_demo FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND s.event_date >= m1.ref_date JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND s.event_date >= m3.ref_date WHERE s.amount > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND d.income_k BETWEEN 463.22 AND 855.24 AND c.age >= 60 AND d.inhabitants_k > '0' GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '100' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 52 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS unique_sales_events, COUNT(m12.refid) FILTER (WHERE m12.response = 'YES') AS mailings1_2_yes_responses, COUNT(m3.refid) FILTER (WHERE m3.response = 'YES') AS mailings3_yes_responses, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_demographic, LAG(SUM(s.amount), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.id ORDER BY MIN(s.event_date)) AS prev_sales_amount FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m12 ON c.id = m12.refid AND m12.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND '2020-01-01 00:00:00' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 98 AND 43 AND c.educationnum >= 1 AND d.income_k > 870.84 AND (d.a_var3 > '0' OR d.a_var4 < '0') GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 12 AND (AVG(d.a_var1) < '0' OR AVG(d.a_var2) > '0') ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, sales_rank_by_demographic LIMIT 366;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS unique_sales_events, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT m1.response, ', ' ORDER BY m1.response) AS mailing_responses FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid WHERE s.amount > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND d.income_k BETWEEN 135.71 AND 52.43 GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_sales DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, COUNT(DISTINCT m12.refid) AS mailing_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(d.inhabitants_k) AS total_inhabitants, AVG(c.age) AS avg_age, AVG(c.educationnum) AS avg_education, SUM(d.a_var1 + d.a_var2 + d.a_var3 + d.a_var4 + d.a_var5 + d.a_var6 + d.a_var7 + d.a_var8 + d.a_var9 + d.a_var10 + d.a_var11 + d.a_var12 + d.a_var13 + d.a_var14 + d.a_var15 + d.a_var16 + d.a_var17 + d.a_var18) AS sum_all_vars, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC NULLS LAST) AS sales_rank, LAG(SUM(s.amount), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY d.geoid) AS prev_geoid_sales FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m12 ON c.id = m12.refid AND m12.response = 'YES' AND m12.ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date BETWEEN '2021-01-01 00:00:00' AND '2021-07-01 00:00:00' AND s.amount > '0' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date < '2019-01-01 00:00:00' AND m3.response IS NOT NULL WHERE d.income_k >= 482.89 AND d.inhabitants_k <= '0' AND c.age BETWEEN 32 AND 80 AND c.educationnum > 17 AND (d.a_var1 > '-100' OR d.a_var2 < '-100') AND (c.sex IN ('MALE', 'FEMALE') AND c.marital_status NOT IN ('Unknown')) AND (s.amount IS NULL OR s.amount < '5000') GROUP BY d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m12.refid) > 32 AND SUM(s.amount) >= '0' AND AVG(d.income_k) BETWEEN 95.78 AND 327.18 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, avg_income ASC LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS total_mailings, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS total_mailings3, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS responses_m1, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS responses_m3, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS total_sales_events, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN s.amount > '1000' THEN s.amount ELSE 0 END) AS high_value_sales, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2, STDDEV(d.a_var3) AS stddev_a_var3, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY d.a_var4) AS median_a_var4, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank, LAG(SUM(s.amount), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex ORDER BY d.income_k DESC) AS prev_sales_by_sex_income FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m1.ref_date < '2021-01-01' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m3.ref_date < '2021-01-01' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.event_date < '2021-01-01' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 90 AND 49 AND d.income_k > 274.79 AND (c.educationnum > 8 OR c.nom1 = 'A') GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) > 84 AND SUM(s.amount) >= '0' AND AVG(d.a_var1) < '-1000' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, sales_rank ASC LIMIT 242;

SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS total_mailings, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) FILTER (WHERE s.amount > '1000') AS high_value_sales_count, SUM(s.amount) FILTER (WHERE s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.event_date < '2023-01-01') AS recent_sales_sum, AVG(d.income_k) OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY d.geoid ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_avg_income, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_sex, CORR(d.a_var1, d.a_var2) AS demographic_correlation FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.response = 'YES' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2023-01-01' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 48 AND 72 AND d.inhabitants_k > '1' AND c.educationnum >= 19 GROUP BY d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) > 90 AND SUM(s.amount) > '0' UNION ALL SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS total_mailings, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) FILTER (WHERE s.amount > '1000') AS high_value_sales_count, SUM(s.amount) FILTER (WHERE s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.event_date < '2023-01-01') AS recent_sales_sum, AVG(d.income_k) OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY d.geoid ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_avg_income, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_sex, CORR(d.a_var3, d.a_var4) AS demographic_correlation FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.response = 'YES' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2023-01-01' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 65 AND 52 AND d.inhabitants_k > '1' AND c.educationnum >= 17 GROUP BY d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) > 25 AND SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY geoid, sales_rank_by_sex;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.income_k, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS distinct_sales_events, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE s.amount > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND d.income_k BETWEEN 484.15 AND 242.34 GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.educationnum) AS avg_a_var1_by_education, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.ref_date) AS distinct_mailing_days, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mailings3 m3 WHERE m3.refid = c.id AND m3.response = 'YES') AS mailings3_yes_count FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid WHERE c.age BETWEEN 48 AND 71 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND d.income_k > 25.21 AND s.amount > (SELECT AVG(amount) FROM sales WHERE event_date >= '2020-01-01') GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, c.educationnum HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT m1.ref_date) >= 68 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) FILTER (WHERE s.amount > '100.0') AS high_value_sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(d.a_var1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.educationnum) AS avg_a_var1_by_education, MAX(m3.ref_date) AS latest_mailing3_date FROM customers c LEFT JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.response = 'YES' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE c.age BETWEEN 50 AND 58 AND d.income_k >= 98.39 AND (m1.ref_date IS NULL OR m1.ref_date < '2019-01-01 00:00:00') GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, c.educationnum HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) > 1 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC NULLS LAST;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings1_2_yes_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings3_yes_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS distinct_sales_events, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, MAX(s.event_date) AS last_sale_date, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_demographic FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date BETWEEN '2021-01-01 00:00:00' AND '2021-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND s.amount > '0' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 62 AND 59 AND c.educationnum >= 2 AND d.income_k > 309.66 AND (d.a_var3 > '0' OR d.a_var4 < '0') AND (c.nom1 = 'A' OR c.nom2 = 'A') GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 16 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, last_sale_date DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS unique_sales_events, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings1_2_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailings3_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings1_2_yes_responses, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings3_yes_responses, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_demographic, LAG(SUM(s.amount), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.id ORDER BY DATE_TRUNC('month', s.event_date)) AS prev_month_sales FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND s.event_date BETWEEN m1.ref_date - INTERVAL '30 days' AND m1.ref_date + INTERVAL '30 days' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND s.event_date BETWEEN m3.ref_date - INTERVAL '30 days' AND m3.ref_date + INTERVAL '30 days' WHERE c.occupation LIKE '%' AND c.marital_status ~ '^.*$' AND s.amount > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND d.income_k BETWEEN 474.19 AND 295.66 GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, DATE_TRUNC('month', s.event_date) HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 83 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, sales_rank_by_demographic;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(s.eventid) AS sales_count FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.response = 'YES' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE c.age >= 32 AND c.educationnum >= 18 GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(s.eventid) >= 8 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(m.refid) AS mailing_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m ON c.id = m.refid WHERE c.age >= 80 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND d.income_k BETWEEN 497.3 AND 478.6 GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS distinct_mailings1_2_refs, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS distinct_mailings3_refs, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS distinct_sales_events, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_demog_var1 FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE c.age >= 76 AND c.age <= 36 AND d.income_k > 163.62 AND (m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' OR m1.ref_date IS NULL) AND (m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' OR m3.ref_date IS NULL) AND (s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' OR s.event_date IS NULL) GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.income_k HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) > 65 AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) < 17 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m12.refid) AS mailings_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(d.a_var1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.marital_status) AS avg_a_var1_by_marital, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN mailings1_2 m12 ON c.id = m12.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date >= m12.ref_date LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date >= m12.ref_date WHERE c.occupation LIKE '%' AND c.nom1 LIKE '%' AND d.income_k BETWEEN 207.63 AND 190.61 AND m12.ref_date >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.income_k HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m12.refid) > 68 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC NULLS LAST;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status) AS avg_a_var1_by_demo, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT m12.ref_date) AS mailing_campaigns_count, (SELECT MAX(m3.ref_date) FROM mailings3 m3 WHERE m3.refid = c.id AND m3.response = 'YES') AS last_positive_mailing3_date FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m12 ON c.id = m12.refid WHERE c.age >= 61 AND c.educationnum >= 18 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.amount > '0' AND d.income_k BETWEEN 100.06 AND 178.2 AND m12.kxindex > 946 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mailings3 m3sub WHERE m3sub.refid = c.id AND m3sub.response = 'YES') GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 4 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, mailing_campaigns_count DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s.amount) AS median_sale_amount, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s.amount) AS percentile_75_sale_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS total_sales, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_mailings_1_2, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_mailings_3, SUM(d.a_var1 + d.a_var2 + d.a_var3 + d.a_var4 + d.a_var5 + d.a_var6 + d.a_var7 + d.a_var8 + d.a_var9 + d.a_var10 + d.a_var11 + d.a_var12 + d.a_var13 + d.a_var14 + d.a_var15 + d.a_var16 + d.a_var17 + d.a_var18) AS sum_demog_vars, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(s.amount) DESC) AS avg_sale_rank FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE s.event_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND s.event_date <= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND c.age BETWEEN 49 AND 58 AND d.income_k > 395.74 AND s.amount > '0' AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND m1.ref_date <= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND m3.ref_date <= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) > 76 AND AVG(s.amount) > '0' AND PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY avg_sale_amount DESC, total_sales DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT m1.response, ', ' ORDER BY m1.response) AS mailing_responses, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, MAX(s.event_date) AS last_sale_date FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE c.age >= 100 AND c.age <= 77 AND d.income_k > 284.54 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) > 30 AND SUM(s.amount) < '0' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailings3_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(d.inhabitants_k) AS avg_inhabitants, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(d.a_var1 + d.a_var2 + d.a_var3 + d.a_var4 + d.a_var5 + d.a_var6 + d.a_var7 + d.a_var8 + d.a_var9 + d.a_var10 + d.a_var11 + d.a_var12 + d.a_var13 + d.a_var14 + d.a_var15 + d.a_var16 + d.a_var17 + d.a_var18) AS sum_all_a_vars, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY d.geoid) AS prev_sales_count_by_demo FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND '2020-01-01 00:00:00' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 60 AND 65 AND c.educationnum >= 20 AND d.income_k > 151.58 AND (m1.response = 'YES' OR m1.response IS NULL) AND (m3.response = 'YES' OR m3.response IS NULL) GROUP BY d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) > 809 AND SUM(s.amount) >= '0' AND AVG(d.inhabitants_k) < '0' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, sales_count ASC;

SELECT d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(c.age) AS avg_age, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailing_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mailings3 m3 WHERE m3.refid IN (SELECT s2.refid FROM sales s2 WHERE s2.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s2.amount > '0') AND m3.response = 'Y') AS nested_mailing_response_count FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON s.refid = m1.refid WHERE d.income_k > 239.54 AND c.age BETWEEN 88 AND 89 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) >= 24 ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2, AVG(d.a_var3) AS avg_a_var3, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS unique_customers, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings1_2_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailings3_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank, LAG(SUM(s.amount), 1) OVER (ORDER BY d.geoid) AS prev_geoid_sales FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE d.income_k > 885.93 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.amount < '0' AND m1.ref_date <= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '1000' AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) >= 65 UNION SELECT d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var4) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var5) AS avg_a_var2, AVG(d.a_var6) AS avg_a_var3, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS unique_customers, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings1_2_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailings3_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank, LAG(SUM(s.amount), 1) OVER (ORDER BY d.geoid) AS prev_geoid_sales FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE d.income_k <= 34.45 AND s.event_date < '2020-01-01' AND s.amount >= '0' AND m1.ref_date > '2020-01-01' GROUP BY d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) <= '1000' AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) < 92 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

WITH customer_agg AS ( SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS total_sales, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount FROM customers c LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum ), demog_stats AS ( SELECT d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2 FROM demog d WHERE d.income_k >= 55.6 GROUP BY d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k ), mailing_response AS ( SELECT m.refid, COUNT(*) AS total_mailings, SUM(CASE WHEN m.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses FROM mailings1_2 m WHERE m.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' GROUP BY m.refid ) SELECT ca.customer_id, ca.age, ca.educationnum, ca.total_sales, ca.total_amount, ca.avg_sale_amount, ds.inhabitants_k, ds.income_k, ds.avg_a_var1, ds.avg_a_var2, mr.total_mailings, mr.positive_responses, AVG(ca.total_amount) OVER ( PARTITION BY ca.geoid ORDER BY ca.customer_id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_amount_by_geoid FROM customer_agg ca JOIN demog_stats ds ON ca.geoid = ds.geoid LEFT JOIN mailing_response mr ON ca.customer_id = mr.refid WHERE ca.total_sales > 6 ORDER BY ca.total_amount DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s.amount) AS median_sale_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, COUNT(s.eventid) AS total_sales FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.amount > '0.0' GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k HAVING COUNT(s.eventid) >= 7 ORDER BY total_sales DESC, avg_sale_amount DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, SUM(d.a_var2) AS sum_a_var2, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS distinct_mailings1_2_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS distinct_mailings3_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(s.eventid) AS sales_event_count, AVG(SUM(s.amount)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY d.income_k ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_avg_sales_by_demo, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank FROM customers c INNER JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.response = 'YES' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.response = 'YES' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE c.age >= 91 AND c.educationnum >= 10 AND d.income_k >= 367.58 AND (s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' OR s.event_date IS NULL) AND (m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' OR m1.ref_date IS NULL) GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(s.eventid) >= 860 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, sales_rank ASC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date) AS sale_year, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM s.event_date) AS sale_quarter, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS total_sales, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings1_2_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailings3_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings1_2_yes, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings3_yes, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2, AVG(d.a_var3) AS avg_a_var3, AVG(d.a_var4) AS avg_a_var4, AVG(d.a_var5) AS avg_a_var5, AVG(d.a_var6) AS avg_a_var6, AVG(d.a_var7) AS avg_a_var7, AVG(d.a_var8) AS avg_a_var8, AVG(d.a_var9) AS avg_a_var9, AVG(d.a_var10) AS avg_a_var10, AVG(d.a_var11) AS avg_a_var11, AVG(d.a_var12) AS avg_a_var12, AVG(d.a_var13) AS avg_a_var13, AVG(d.a_var14) AS avg_a_var14, AVG(d.a_var15) AS avg_a_var15, AVG(d.a_var16) AS avg_a_var16, AVG(d.a_var17) AS avg_a_var17, AVG(d.a_var18) AS avg_a_var18, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS spending_rank_by_demographic FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date BETWEEN s.event_date - INTERVAL '30 days' AND s.event_date + INTERVAL '30 days' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date BETWEEN s.event_date - INTERVAL '30 days' AND s.event_date + INTERVAL '30 days' WHERE s.amount > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2010-01-01' AND s.event_date <= '2010-01-01' AND c.age BETWEEN 89 AND 45 AND d.income_k > 483.46 AND d.inhabitants_k > '0' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM s.event_date)), (c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM s.event_date)), (c.sex, c.marital_status, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date)), (c.sex, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date)), (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM s.event_date)), (d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k), () ) HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 12 ORDER BY sale_year DESC, sale_quarter DESC, total_amount DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.income_k, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date) AS sale_year, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM s.event_date) AS sale_quarter, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS total_sales, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings1_2_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailings3_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings1_2_yes_responses, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings3_yes_responses, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM s.event_date) ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_amount_percentile_by_quarter FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date BETWEEN s.event_date - INTERVAL '30 days' AND s.event_date + INTERVAL '30 days' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date BETWEEN s.event_date - INTERVAL '30 days' AND s.event_date + INTERVAL '30 days' WHERE s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.amount > '0' AND d.income_k BETWEEN 391.15 AND 80.92 AND c.age >= 97 GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.income_k, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM s.event_date) HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY sale_year DESC, sale_quarter DESC, total_amount DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT m1.response, ', ' ORDER BY m1.response) AS mailing_responses, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE c.age >= 37 AND c.age <= 23 AND d.income_k >= 343.9 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) > 58 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

SELECT c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.age, c.sex) AS avg_a_var1_by_demo, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings1_2_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailings3_count, MAX(m1.ref_date) AS latest_mailing1_2_date, MAX(m3.ref_date) AS latest_mailing3_date FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE s.amount > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND c.age BETWEEN 57 AND 58 AND d.income_k > 542.35 GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) >= 91 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, c.id;

SELECT c1.id AS customer_id1, c2.id AS customer_id2, AVG(d1.a_var1) AS avg_demog_var1, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailing_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount FROM customers c1 JOIN customers c2 ON c1.geoid = c2.geoid AND c1.id < c2.id JOIN demog d1 ON c1.geoid = d1.geoid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c1.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c1.id = s.refid WHERE c1.age > 39 AND d1.income_k BETWEEN 28.81 AND 272.67 AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c1.id, c2.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) > 3 AND SUM(s.amount) < '1000' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, COUNT(DISTINCT m12.refid) AS mailing_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(d.inhabitants_k) AS total_inhabitants, AVG(c.age) AS avg_age, AVG(c.educationnum) AS avg_education, SUM(d.a_var1 + d.a_var2 + d.a_var3 + d.a_var4 + d.a_var5 + d.a_var6 + d.a_var7 + d.a_var8 + d.a_var9 + d.a_var10 + d.a_var11 + d.a_var12 + d.a_var13 + d.a_var14 + d.a_var15 + d.a_var16 + d.a_var17 + d.a_var18) AS sum_all_vars, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC NULLS LAST) AS sales_rank, LAG(SUM(s.amount), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY d.geoid) AS prev_geoid_sales FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m12 ON c.id = m12.refid AND m12.response = 'YES' AND m12.ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date BETWEEN '2021-01-01 00:00:00' AND '2021-07-01 00:00:00' AND s.amount > '0' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date < '2019-01-01 00:00:00' AND m3.response IS NOT NULL WHERE d.income_k >= 224.89 AND d.inhabitants_k <= '0' AND c.age BETWEEN 28 AND 57 AND c.educationnum > 1 AND (d.a_var1 > '-100' OR d.a_var2 < '-100') AND (c.sex IN ('MALE', 'FEMALE') AND c.marital_status NOT IN ('Unknown')) AND (s.amount IS NULL OR s.amount < '5000') GROUP BY d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m12.refid) > 90 AND SUM(s.amount) >= '0' AND AVG(d.income_k) BETWEEN 34.93 AND 306.33 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, avg_income ASC LIMIT 1000;

SELECT d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS unique_customers, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m12 ON c.id = m12.refid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE s.event_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND s.amount > '0.0' AND d.income_k BETWEEN 101.71 AND 242.63 AND c.age IN (SELECT age FROM customers WHERE educationnum > 1 AND data1 < '0.0') AND m12.response = 'Yes' AND m3.response = 'Yes' GROUP BY d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0.0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 843 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

SELECT d1.geoid AS geoid1, d2.geoid AS geoid2, AVG(d1.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1_d1, AVG(d2.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2_d2, SUM(CASE WHEN c1.sex = 'Male' THEN c1.data1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_data1_sum, SUM(CASE WHEN c2.sex = 'Female' THEN c2.data2 ELSE 0 END) AS female_data2_sum, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS distinct_mailings1_2_refs, MAX(s.amount) AS max_sale_amount, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank, LAG(SUM(s.amount), 1) OVER (ORDER BY d1.geoid) AS prev_geoid_sales FROM demog d1 JOIN demog d2 ON d1.geoid < d2.geoid AND d1.inhabitants_k > '0' JOIN customers c1 ON d1.geoid = c1.geoid AND c1.age BETWEEN 57 AND 49 JOIN customers c2 ON d2.geoid = c2.geoid AND c2.educationnum > 16 JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c1.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c2.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date <= '2020-01-01' JOIN sales s ON m1.refid = s.refid AND s.event_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' WHERE d1.income_k > 83.91 AND d2.income_k < 934.03 GROUP BY d1.geoid, d2.geoid HAVING COUNT(s.eventid) > 4323 AND AVG(d1.a_var3) < '-100' ORDER BY sales_rank, d1.geoid, d2.geoid;

SELECT d1.geoid, AVG(d1.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(d2.inhabitants_k) AS total_inhabitants, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS customer_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(d1.income_k) DESC) AS income_rank FROM demog d1 JOIN demog d2 ON d1.geoid = d2.geoid JOIN customers c ON d1.geoid = c.geoid JOIN mailings1_2 m ON c.id = m.refid JOIN sales s ON m.refid = s.refid WHERE d1.income_k > 441.09 AND d2.inhabitants_k < '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY d1.geoid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 63 ORDER BY avg_income DESC;

WITH customer_agg AS ( SELECT c.geoid, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS customer_count, AVG(c.age) AS avg_age, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(s.eventid) AS sales_count FROM customers c LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE c.age BETWEEN 51 AND 33 GROUP BY c.geoid HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '1000' ), demog_agg AS ( SELECT d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2 FROM demog d WHERE d.income_k > 40.15 GROUP BY d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k ) SELECT da.geoid, da.inhabitants_k, da.income_k, COALESCE(ca.customer_count, 0) AS customer_count, COALESCE(ca.avg_age, 0) AS avg_age, COALESCE(ca.total_sales_amount, 0) AS total_sales_amount, COALESCE(ca.sales_count, 0) AS sales_count, da.avg_a_var1, da.avg_a_var2, 'demog_customer' AS source_label FROM demog_agg da LEFT JOIN customer_agg ca ON da.geoid = ca.geoid WHERE da.inhabitants_k > '1' UNION ALL SELECT ca.geoid, NULL AS inhabitants_k, NULL AS income_k, ca.customer_count, ca.avg_age, ca.total_sales_amount, ca.sales_count, NULL AS avg_a_var1, NULL AS avg_a_var2, 'customer_only' AS source_label FROM customer_agg ca WHERE ca.customer_count > 254 ORDER BY geoid, source_label;

WITH customer_agg AS ( SELECT c.id AS c_id, c.geoid AS c_geoid, c.age AS c_age, c.educationnum AS c_educationnum, c.sex AS c_sex, c.marital_status AS c_marital_status, c.occupation AS c_occupation, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS m1_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS m3_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS m1_yes, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS m3_yes, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2, AVG(d.a_var3) AS avg_a_var3 FROM customers c LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' INNER JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid WHERE c.age BETWEEN 23 AND 75 GROUP BY c.id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation ), sales_agg AS ( SELECT s.refid AS s_refid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_amount, MIN(s.event_date) AS first_sale, MAX(s.event_date) AS last_sale FROM sales s WHERE s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY s.refid ), self_joined_sales AS ( SELECT s1.s_refid AS s1_refid, s2.s_refid AS s2_refid, s1.total_amount AS s1_total, s2.total_amount AS s2_total, s1.avg_amount AS s1_avg, s2.avg_amount AS s2_avg, ABS(s1.total_amount - s2.total_amount) AS total_diff FROM sales_agg s1 INNER JOIN sales_agg s2 ON s1.s_refid < s2.s_refid AND s1.total_amount > '1000' AND s2.total_amount > '1000' WHERE s1.total_amount + s2.total_amount > '5000' ) SELECT ca.c_id, ca.c_age, ca.c_sex, ca.c_occupation, ca.m1_count, ca.m3_count, ca.m1_yes, ca.m3_yes, ca.avg_a_var1, ca.avg_a_var2, ca.avg_a_var3, COALESCE(sa.sales_count, 0) AS sales_count, COALESCE(sa.total_amount, 0) AS total_amount, COALESCE(sa.avg_amount, 0) AS avg_amount, COUNT(sjs.s1_refid) AS comparable_customers_count, AVG(sjs.total_diff) AS avg_total_diff_vs_others FROM customer_agg ca LEFT JOIN sales_agg sa ON ca.c_id = sa.s_refid LEFT JOIN self_joined_sales sjs ON ca.c_id = sjs.s1_refid OR ca.c_id = sjs.s2_refid WHERE ca.c_educationnum > 10 AND ca.avg_a_var1 < '0.0' GROUP BY ca.c_id, ca.c_age, ca.c_sex, ca.c_occupation, ca.m1_count, ca.m3_count, ca.m1_yes, ca.m3_yes, ca.avg_a_var1, ca.avg_a_var2, ca.avg_a_var3, sa.sales_count, sa.total_amount, sa.avg_amount HAVING COUNT(sjs.s1_refid) > 39 AND COALESCE(sa.total_amount, 0) > '0' ORDER BY avg_total_diff_vs_others DESC, total_amount DESC LIMIT 1000;

WITH customer_agg AS ( SELECT c.id AS c_id, c.geoid AS c_geoid, c.age AS c_age, c.educationnum AS c_educationnum, c.sex AS c_sex, c.marital_status AS c_marital_status, c.occupation AS c_occupation, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS m1_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS m3_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS m1_yes, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS m3_yes, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2, AVG(d.a_var3) AS avg_a_var3 FROM customers c LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' INNER JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid WHERE c.age BETWEEN 90 AND 52 GROUP BY c.id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation ), sales_agg AS ( SELECT s.refid AS s_refid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_amount, MIN(s.event_date) AS first_sale, MAX(s.event_date) AS last_sale FROM sales s WHERE s.event_date BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2019-01-01' GROUP BY s.refid ), self_joined_customers AS ( SELECT ca1.c_id AS cust1_id, ca1.c_age AS cust1_age, ca1.c_educationnum AS cust1_edu, ca1.c_sex AS cust1_sex, ca1.c_occupation AS cust1_occ, ca1.m1_count AS cust1_m1_cnt, ca1.m3_yes AS cust1_m3_yes, ca1.avg_a_var1 AS cust1_avg_var1, ca2.c_id AS cust2_id, ca2.c_age AS cust2_age, ca2.c_educationnum AS cust2_edu, ca2.c_sex AS cust2_sex, ca2.c_occupation AS cust2_occ, ca2.m1_count AS cust2_m1_cnt, ca2.m3_yes AS cust2_m3_yes, ca2.avg_a_var1 AS cust2_avg_var1, ABS(ca1.c_age - ca2.c_age) AS age_diff, ABS(ca1.c_educationnum - ca2.c_educationnum) AS edu_diff FROM customer_agg ca1 INNER JOIN customer_agg ca2 ON ca1.c_geoid = ca2.c_geoid AND ca1.c_id < ca2.c_id WHERE ca1.c_marital_status = ca2.c_marital_status AND ca1.c_sex = ca2.c_sex AND ca1.avg_a_var1 > '0.0' AND ca2.avg_a_var1 > '0.0' ) SELECT sjc.cust1_id, sjc.cust2_id, sjc.age_diff, sjc.edu_diff, sjc.cust1_avg_var1, sjc.cust2_avg_var1, sa1.sales_count AS cust1_sales_cnt, sa1.total_amount AS cust1_total_amt, sa1.avg_amount AS cust1_avg_amt, sa2.sales_count AS cust2_sales_cnt, sa2.total_amount AS cust2_total_amt, sa2.avg_amount AS cust2_avg_amt, d1.inhabitants_k AS cust1_inhabitants, d1.income_k AS cust1_income, d2.inhabitants_k AS cust2_inhabitants, d2.income_k AS cust2_income, (sa1.total_amount + sa2.total_amount) AS combined_sales, (sjc.cust1_m1_cnt + sjc.cust2_m1_cnt) AS combined_m1_cnt, (sjc.cust1_m3_yes + sjc.cust2_m3_yes) AS combined_m3_yes FROM self_joined_customers sjc LEFT JOIN sales_agg sa1 ON sjc.cust1_id = sa1.s_refid LEFT JOIN sales_agg sa2 ON sjc.cust2_id = sa2.s_refid INNER JOIN demog d1 ON sjc.cust1_id = d1.geoid INNER JOIN demog d2 ON sjc.cust2_id = d2.geoid WHERE (sa1.total_amount > '1000.0' OR sa2.total_amount > '1000.0') AND (d1.income_k BETWEEN 54.34 AND 190.22) AND (d2.income_k BETWEEN 385.77 AND 193.32) AND sjc.age_diff <= 18 AND sjc.edu_diff <= 15 ORDER BY combined_sales DESC, age_diff ASC, edu_diff ASC LIMIT 8898;

WITH customer_agg AS ( SELECT c.id AS c_id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS distinct_mailings1_2, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS distinct_mailings3, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS distinct_sales_events, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2 FROM customers c LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.response = 'YES' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.response = 'YES' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid INNER JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid WHERE c.age BETWEEN 79 AND 28 AND d.income_k > 92.89 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) > 34 AND COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) > 13 AND SUM(s.amount) > '1000' ), demog_stats AS ( SELECT geoid, AVG(inhabitants_k) AS avg_inhabitants, SUM(a_var3 + a_var4 + a_var5) AS sum_vars_345, COUNT(*) AS total_geos FROM demog WHERE a_var6 > '0' AND a_var7 < '0' GROUP BY geoid HAVING AVG(inhabitants_k) > '1' ) SELECT ca.c_id, ca.geoid, ca.age, ca.educationnum, ca.distinct_mailings1_2, ca.distinct_mailings3, ca.distinct_sales_events, ca.total_sales_amount, ca.avg_a_var1, ca.avg_a_var2, ds.avg_inhabitants, ds.sum_vars_345, ds.total_geos, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ca.total_sales_amount DESC) AS sales_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ca.geoid ORDER BY ca.distinct_sales_events DESC) AS event_rank_in_geo FROM customer_agg ca INNER JOIN demog_stats ds ON ca.geoid = ds.geoid WHERE ca.total_sales_amount > '5000' AND ca.distinct_mailings1_2 + ca.distinct_mailings3 > 39 ORDER BY ca.total_sales_amount DESC, ca.distinct_sales_events DESC LIMIT 374;

sa.last_sale, ds.inhabitants_k, ds.income_k, ds.median_var1, ds.median_var2, ds.sum_var3, ds.avg_var4, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(sa.total_amount, 0) DESC) AS sales_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ca.sex ORDER BY ca.age DESC) AS age_rank_by_sex, AVG(COALESCE(sa.total_amount, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY ca.geoid) AS avg_sales_by_geoid FROM customer_agg ca INNER JOIN demog_stats ds ON
