SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, d.a_var1, d.a_var2, d.a_var3, d.a_var4, d.a_var5, d.a_var6, d.a_var7, d.a_var8, d.a_var9, d.a_var10, d.a_var11, d.a_var12, d.a_var13, d.a_var14, d.a_var15, d.a_var16, d.a_var17, d.a_var18, COUNT(DISTINCT m12.refid) AS mailings_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailings3_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, MAX(s.event_date) AS last_sale_date, MIN(m12.ref_date) AS first_mailing_date, SUM(CASE WHEN m12.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses, SUM(CASE WHEN m12.response = 'NO' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS negative_responses, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s.amount) AS median_sale_amount, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank, LAG(SUM(s.amount), 1) OVER (ORDER BY d.geoid) AS prev_geoid_sales FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m12 ON c.id = m12.refid AND m12.ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' WHERE c.age >= 64 AND c.age <= 45 AND c.educationnum >= 6 AND d.income_k >= 459.79 GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, d.a_var1, d.a_var2, d.a_var3, d.a_var4, d.a_var5, d.a_var6, d.a_var7, d.a_var8, d.a_var9, d.a_var10, d.a_var11, d.a_var12, d.a_var13, d.a_var14, d.a_var15, d.a_var16, d.a_var17, d.a_var18 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 2 AND SUM(s.amount) >= '0' AND AVG(s.amount) <= '0' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, sales_count DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) FILTER (WHERE s.amount > '100') AS high_value_sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(d.a_var1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.marital_status) AS avg_a_var1_by_marital FROM customers c LEFT JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE c.age BETWEEN 19 AND 40 AND c.educationnum >= 20 AND (m1.response = 'Y' OR m1.response IS NULL) AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, COUNT(s.eventid) AS sales_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.response = 'YES' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE c.age >= 45 AND c.age <= 18 AND d.income_k >= 105.99 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(s.eventid) >= 56 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(m1.kxindex) AS avg_kxindex, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mailings3 m3 WHERE m3.refid = c.id AND m3.response = 'YES' AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01') AS recent_mailing_responses FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE c.age BETWEEN 72 AND 19 AND d.income_k >= 461.27 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings_yes_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(s.eventid) AS sales_count, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, MAX(s.event_date) AS last_sale_date FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE c.age >= 89 AND c.age <= 29 AND d.income_k >= 443.74 AND (s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' OR s.event_date IS NULL) GROUP BY c.id, c.age, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING COUNT(s.eventid) > 69 AND SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date) AS sale_year, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM s.event_date) AS sale_quarter, m1.response AS mailing1_response, m3.response AS mailing3_response, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS total_sales, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, SUM(d.inhabitants_k) AS total_inhabitants_k, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income_k, SUM(d.a_var1 + d.a_var2 + d.a_var3 + d.a_var4 + d.a_var5 + d.a_var6 + d.a_var7 + d.a_var8 + d.a_var9 + d.a_var10 + d.a_var11 + d.a_var12 + d.a_var13 + d.a_var14 + d.a_var15 + d.a_var16 + d.a_var17 + d.a_var18) AS sum_all_a_vars, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS spending_rank_by_demographic FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND s.event_date >= m1.ref_date JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND s.event_date >= m3.ref_date WHERE s.amount > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.event_date <= '2020-01-01' AND c.age BETWEEN 28 AND 100 AND d.income_k > 142.71 AND m1.kxindex > 544 GROUP BY CUBE ( c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM s.event_date), m1.response, m3.response ) HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 43 ORDER BY total_amount DESC, sale_year, sale_quarter;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT m1.response, ', ' ORDER BY m1.response) AS mailing_responses, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE c.age >= 100 AND c.age <= 100 AND d.income_k > 452.16 AND (m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' OR m1.ref_date IS NULL) GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) > 65 AND SUM(s.amount) < '0' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

SELECT c.id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.income_k, d.inhabitants_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m12.refid) AS mailings_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(SUM(s.amount)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.age) AS avg_amount_by_age FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m12 ON c.id = m12.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE c.age BETWEEN 64 AND 58 AND d.income_k > 187.41 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.income_k, d.inhabitants_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '100' ORDER BY total_amount DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.income_k, d.inhabitants_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m12.refid) AS mailings_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(SUM(s.amount)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.age) AS avg_amount_by_age FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m12 ON c.id = m12.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE c.age BETWEEN 77 AND 55 AND d.income_k > 160.83 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.income_k, d.inhabitants_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '100' ORDER BY total_amount DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT d.geoid, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(c.educationnum) AS total_education FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid WHERE d.inhabitants_k > '0' GROUP BY d.geoid HAVING AVG(d.income_k) < 437.38 EXCEPT SELECT d.geoid, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(c.educationnum) AS total_education FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN mailings1_2 m ON c.id = m.refid WHERE m.response = 'Yes' AND m.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY d.geoid ORDER BY avg_income DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS customer_count, AVG(c.age) AS avg_age, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_event_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailing_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY c.educationnum) AS median_education, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE s.amount > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND d.income_k BETWEEN 196.06 AND 465.07 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM mailings1_2 m2 WHERE m2.refid = c.id AND m2.response = 'YES' AND m2.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' ) GROUP BY d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 99 AND SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, d.geoid;

WITH ranked_sales AS ( SELECT s.eventid, s.refid, s.event_date, s.amount, c.id AS c_id, c.age, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid AS d_geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, d.a_var1, d.a_var2, d.a_var3, d.a_var4, d.a_var5, d.a_var6, d.a_var7, d.a_var8, d.a_var9, d.a_var10, d.a_var11, d.a_var12, d.a_var13, d.a_var14, d.a_var15, d.a_var16, d.a_var17, d.a_var18, m1.ref_date AS m1_date, m1.response AS m1_response, m3.ref_date AS m3_date, m3.response AS m3_response, SUM(s.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY c.id ORDER BY s.event_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_total, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.geoid, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date) ORDER BY s.amount DESC) AS sale_rank_in_geo_year, AVG(s.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY c.geoid, c.marital_status) AS avg_amount_by_geo_marital, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY d.geoid ORDER BY s.event_date RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '30 days' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS sales_count_30d_geo FROM sales s INNER JOIN customers c ON s.refid = c.id INNER JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON s.refid = m1.refid AND s.event_date >= m1.ref_date LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON s.refid = m3.refid AND s.event_date >= m3.ref_date WHERE s.amount > '10' AND s.event_date >= '2010-01-01' AND c.age BETWEEN 28 AND 83 AND d.income_k > 191.75 AND (m1.response = 'YES' OR m1.response IS NULL) AND (m3.response = 'YES' OR m3.response IS NULL) ), aggregated AS ( SELECT d_geoid, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM event_date) AS sale_year, c.marital_status, c.occupation, COUNT(DISTINCT c_id) AS unique_customers, SUM(amount) AS total_sales, AVG(amount) AS avg_sale_amount, MAX(running_total) AS max_running_total, SUM(CASE WHEN sale_rank_in_geo_year = 1 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS top_sale_amount, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY amount) AS median_sale_amount, STDDEV(amount) AS sale_amount_stddev FROM ranked_sales rs INNER JOIN customers c ON rs.c_id = c.id GROUP BY d_geoid, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM event_date), c.marital_status, c.occupation HAVING SUM(amount) > '10000' AND COUNT(DISTINCT c_id) >= 37 ) SELECT a.d_geoid, a.sale_year, a.marital_status, a.occupation, a.unique_customers, a.total_sales, a.avg_sale_amount, a.max_running_total, a.top_sale_amount, a.median_sale_amount, a.sale_amount_stddev, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, d.a_var1, d.a_var2, d.a_var3, d.a_var4, d.a_var5, d.a_var6, d.a_var7, d.a_var8, d.a_var9, d.a_var10, d.a_var11, d.a_var12, d.a_var13, d.a_var14, d.a_var15, d.a_var16, d.a_var17, d.a_var18, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY a.total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank, LAG(a.total_sales, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY a.d_geoid, a.marital_status ORDER BY a.sale_year) AS prev_year_sales FROM aggregated a INNER JOIN demog d ON a.d_geoid = d.geoid WHERE d.inhabitants_k > '1' ORDER BY a.total_sales DESC, a.d_geoid, a.sale_year LIMIT 6034;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2, AVG(d.a_var3) AS avg_a_var3, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT m12.ref_date) AS mailings1_2_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.ref_date) AS mailings3_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m12.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings1_2_yes_responses, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings3_yes_responses, CORR(d.a_var4, s.amount) AS corr_a_var4_sales, CORR(d.a_var5, s.amount) AS corr_a_var5_sales, STDDEV(d.a_var6) AS stddev_a_var6, STDDEV(d.a_var7) AS stddev_a_var7, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY d.a_var8) AS median_a_var8, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY d.a_var9) AS median_a_var9 FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m12 ON c.id = m12.refid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE s.amount > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.event_date < '2023-01-01' AND m12.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m12.ref_date < '2023-01-01' AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m3.ref_date < '2023-01-01' AND d.income_k BETWEEN 135.55 AND 671.03 AND d.a_var10 > '0' AND d.a_var11 < '0' GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '1000' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 60 AND AVG(d.a_var12) < '0' AND STDDEV(d.a_var13) > '0' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, mailings1_2_count DESC LIMIT 90;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, d.a_var1, d.a_var2, d.a_var3, d.a_var4, d.a_var5, d.a_var6, d.a_var7, d.a_var8, d.a_var9, d.a_var10, d.a_var11, d.a_var12, d.a_var13, d.a_var14, d.a_var15, d.a_var16, d.a_var17, d.a_var18, COUNT(DISTINCT m12.refid) AS total_mailings_12, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS total_mailings_3, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS total_sales_events, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, MAX(s.event_date) AS last_sale_date, MIN(m12.ref_date) AS first_mailing_date_12, MIN(m3.ref_date) AS first_mailing_date_3, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mailings1_2 m12_sub WHERE m12_sub.refid = c.id AND m12_sub.response = 'YES' AND m12_sub.ref_date >= '2020-01-01') AS recent_positive_responses_12, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mailings3 m3_sub WHERE m3_sub.refid = c.id AND m3_sub.response = 'YES' AND m3_sub.ref_date >= '2020-01-01') AS recent_positive_responses_3, (SELECT SUM(s_sub.amount) FROM sales s_sub WHERE s_sub.refid = c.id AND s_sub.event_date >= '2020-01-01') AS recent_sales_amount, (SELECT AVG(d_sub.income_k) FROM demog d_sub WHERE d_sub.geoid IN (SELECT c_sub.geoid FROM customers c_sub WHERE c_sub.age BETWEEN 25 AND 90 AND c_sub.sex = c.sex)) AS avg_income_by_sex_and_age_group, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_sex_marital, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount)) AS sales_percentile, LEAD(SUM(s.amount), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex ORDER BY c.age) AS next_age_group_sales FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m12 ON c.id = m12.refid LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE c.age >= 48 AND c.age <= 67 AND d.income_k >= 366.58 AND (m12.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' OR m12.ref_date IS NULL) AND (m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' OR m3.ref_date IS NULL) AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, d.a_var1, d.a_var2, d.a_var3, d.a_var4, d.a_var5, d.a_var6, d.a_var7, d.a_var8, d.a_var9, d.a_var10, d.a_var11, d.a_var12, d.a_var13, d.a_var14, d.a_var15, d.a_var16, d.a_var17, d.a_var18 HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 474 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, sales_rank_by_sex_marital ASC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m.refid) AS mailing_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN mailings1_2 m ON c.id = m.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE c.age >= 81 AND d.income_k >= 461.57 AND m.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.income_k HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m.refid) > 13 AND SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS unique_sales_events, AVG(m1.kxindex) AS avg_mailing_index, COUNT(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 END) AS positive_responses_m3, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank, LAG(SUM(s.amount), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex ORDER BY d.income_k DESC) AS prev_sales_by_sex_income FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE (s.amount > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01') OR (c.age BETWEEN 79 AND 59 AND c.educationnum > 20) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM mailings1_2 m1_sub WHERE m1_sub.refid = c.id AND m1_sub.kxindex > 519 AND m1_sub.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' ) OR c.id IN ( SELECT s_sub.refid FROM sales s_sub WHERE s_sub.amount > (SELECT AVG(amount) * 1.5 FROM sales WHERE event_date >= '2020-01-01') GROUP BY s_sub.refid HAVING COUNT(*) > 3 ) GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 9 AND AVG(m1.kxindex) BETWEEN 710 AND 918 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, avg_mailing_index ASC;

SELECT d.geoid, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS unique_customers FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM mailings1_2 m WHERE m.refid = c.id AND m.response = 'YES' AND m.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' ) AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.amount > '0' GROUP BY d.geoid HAVING AVG(d.income_k) > 32.26 ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS distinct_mailings1_2_refid, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS distinct_mailings3_refid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS distinct_sales_eventid, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(d.inhabitants_k) AS total_inhabitants, AVG(c.age) AS avg_customer_age, SUM(d.a_var1 + d.a_var2 + d.a_var3 + d.a_var4 + d.a_var5 + d.a_var6 + d.a_var7 + d.a_var8 + d.a_var9 + d.a_var10 + d.a_var11 + d.a_var12 + d.a_var13 + d.a_var14 + d.a_var15 + d.a_var16 + d.a_var17 + d.a_var18) AS sum_all_a_vars, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_demographic FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE d.income_k > 730.42 AND c.age BETWEEN 94 AND 63 AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.amount > '0' GROUP BY d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) > 36 AND COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) > 64 AND SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, avg_income DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM m1.ref_date) AS mailing_year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM m1.ref_date) AS mailing_month, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date) AS sales_year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM s.event_date) AS sales_month, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS total_mailings, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS total_sales, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, AVG(d.inhabitants_k) AS avg_inhabitants, SUM(d.a_var1 + d.a_var2 + d.a_var3 + d.a_var4 + d.a_var5 + d.a_var6 + d.a_var7 + d.a_var8 + d.a_var9 + d.a_var10 + d.a_var11 + d.a_var12 + d.a_var13 + d.a_var14 + d.a_var15 + d.a_var16 + d.a_var17 + d.a_var18) AS sum_all_a_vars, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_demog FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid JOIN sales s ON m1.refid = s.refid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON s.refid = m3.refid AND m1.ref_date <= m3.ref_date WHERE c.age >= 62 AND c.educationnum >= 17 AND d.income_k >= 414.78 AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.amount > '0' AND m1.response = 'Yes' AND m3.response = 'Yes' GROUP BY CUBE(d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM m1.ref_date), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM m1.ref_date), EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM s.event_date)) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) > 393 AND SUM(s.amount) > '100' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, mailing_year, sales_year;

SELECT d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(c.age) AS avg_age, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS unique_mailings, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mailings3 m3 WHERE m3.refid IN (SELECT s2.refid FROM sales s2 WHERE s2.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s2.amount > '100') AND m3.response = 'Yes') AS high_value_mailings_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON s.refid = m1.refid WHERE d.income_k > 62.05 AND c.age BETWEEN 21 AND 44 AND s.event_date >= '2019-01-01' GROUP BY d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '5000' AND COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) >= 26 ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

WITH customer_agg AS ( SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS total_sales, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount FROM customers c LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum ), demog_stats AS ( SELECT d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2 FROM demog d WHERE d.income_k >= 110.14 GROUP BY d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k ), mailing_response AS ( SELECT m.refid, COUNT(*) AS total_mailings, SUM(CASE WHEN m.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses FROM mailings1_2 m WHERE m.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' GROUP BY m.refid ) SELECT ca.customer_id, ca.age, ca.educationnum, ca.total_sales, ca.total_amount, ca.avg_sale_amount, ds.inhabitants_k, ds.income_k, ds.avg_a_var1, ds.avg_a_var2, mr.total_mailings, mr.positive_responses, AVG(ca.total_amount) OVER ( PARTITION BY ca.geoid ORDER BY ca.customer_id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_amount_by_geoid FROM customer_agg ca JOIN demog_stats ds ON ca.geoid = ds.geoid LEFT JOIN mailing_response mr ON ca.customer_id = mr.refid WHERE ca.total_sales > 1 ORDER BY ca.total_amount DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.geoid, c.sex, c.occupation, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date) AS sale_year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM s.event_date) AS sale_month, COUNT(DISTINCT s.refid) AS unique_customers, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_amount, GROUPING(c.geoid, c.sex, c.occupation, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM s.event_date)) AS grouping_id FROM sales s JOIN customers c ON s.refid = c.id JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid WHERE s.amount > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND d.income_k BETWEEN 285.75 AND 363.61 GROUP BY CUBE(c.geoid, c.sex, c.occupation, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM s.event_date)) HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY sale_year, sale_month, total_amount DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS unique_sales_events, COUNT(m12.response) FILTER (WHERE m12.response = 'YES') AS positive_mailings1_2_count FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m12 ON c.id = m12.refid WHERE s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.amount > '10' AND c.age BETWEEN 23 AND 58 AND d.income_k >= 90.68 GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '100' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.income_k, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT m1.response, ', ' ORDER BY m1.response) AS mailing_responses, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS total_sales, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE c.age >= 38 AND c.educationnum >= 19 AND d.income_k >= 161.27 AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' OR SUM(s.amount) IS NULL ORDER BY total_amount DESC NULLS LAST, d.income_k DESC;

SELECT c.id, c.age, d.geoid, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.amount > '0' GROUP BY c.id, c.age, d.geoid HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '1000' INTERSECT SELECT c.id, c.age, d.geoid, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN mailings1_2 m ON c.id = m.refid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE m.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m.response = 'Yes' GROUP BY c.id, c.age, d.geoid HAVING COUNT(m.refid) >= 84 ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM m1.ref_date) AS mailing_year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM m1.ref_date) AS mailing_month, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date) AS sales_year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM s.event_date) AS sales_month, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS total_mailings, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS total_sales, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, AVG(d.inhabitants_k) AS avg_inhabitants, SUM(d.a_var1 + d.a_var2 + d.a_var3 + d.a_var4 + d.a_var5 + d.a_var6 + d.a_var7 + d.a_var8 + d.a_var9 + d.a_var10 + d.a_var11 + d.a_var12 + d.a_var13 + d.a_var14 + d.a_var15 + d.a_var16 + d.a_var17 + d.a_var18) AS sum_all_a_vars, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_demog FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid JOIN sales s ON m1.refid = s.refid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON s.refid = m3.refid AND m1.ref_date <= m3.ref_date WHERE c.age >= 53 AND c.educationnum >= 3 AND d.income_k >= 38.5 AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.amount > '0' AND m1.response = 'Yes' AND m3.response = 'Yes' GROUP BY CUBE(d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM m1.ref_date), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM m1.ref_date), EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM s.event_date)) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) > 876 AND SUM(s.amount) > '100' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, mailing_year, sales_year;

WITH customer_agg AS ( SELECT c.id AS c_id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, COUNT(DISTINCT m12.ref_date) AS mailings_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m12.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings_yes, AVG(m12.kxindex) AS avg_kxindex FROM customers c LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m12 ON c.id = m12.refid WHERE c.age BETWEEN 82 AND 18 AND c.educationnum >= 12 GROUP BY c.id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m12.ref_date) > 73 ), sales_agg AS ( SELECT s.refid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.event_date) AS sales_days, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_amount, MIN(s.event_date) AS first_sale, MAX(s.event_date) AS last_sale FROM sales s WHERE s.amount >= '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY s.refid HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '100' ), mailings3_agg AS ( SELECT m3.refid, COUNT(*) AS m3_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS m3_yes FROM mailings3 m3 WHERE m3.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' GROUP BY m3.refid HAVING COUNT(*) >= 28 ), demog_agg AS ( SELECT d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_var2, AVG(d.a_var3) AS avg_var3, AVG(d.a_var4) AS avg_var4, AVG(d.a_var5) AS avg_var5, AVG(d.a_var6) AS avg_var6, AVG(d.a_var7) AS avg_var7, AVG(d.a_var8) AS avg_var8, AVG(d.a_var9) AS avg_var9, AVG(d.a_var10) AS avg_var10, AVG(d.a_var11) AS avg_var11, AVG(d.a_var12) AS avg_var12, AVG(d.a_var13) AS avg_var13, AVG(d.a_var14) AS avg_var14, AVG(d.a_var15) AS avg_var15, AVG(d.a_var16) AS avg_var16, AVG(d.a_var17) AS avg_var17, AVG(d.a_var18) AS avg_var18 FROM demog d WHERE d.income_k >= 300.74 AND d.inhabitants_k <= '0' GROUP BY d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING AVG(d.a_var1) > '-100' AND AVG(d.a_var2) < '-100' ) SELECT ca.c_id, ca.age, ca.educationnum, ca.sex, ca.marital_status, ca.occupation, ca.mailings_count, ca.mailings_yes, ca.avg_kxindex, COALESCE(sa.sales_days, 0) AS sales_days, COALESCE(sa.total_amount, 0) AS total_amount, COALESCE(sa.avg_amount, 0) AS avg_amount, COALESCE(sa.first_sale, NULL) AS first_sale, COALESCE(sa.last_sale, NULL) AS last_sale, COALESCE(ma.m3_count, 0) AS m3_count, COALESCE(ma.m3_yes, 0) AS m3_yes, da.inhabitants_k, da.income_k, da.avg_var1, da.avg_var2, da.avg_var3, da.avg_var4, da.avg_var5, da.avg_var6, da.avg_var7, da.avg_var8, da.avg_var9, da.avg_var10, da.avg_var11, da.avg_var12, da.avg_var13, da.avg_var14, da.avg_var15, da.avg_var16, da.avg_var17, da.avg_var18, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(sa.total_amount, 0) DESC) AS sales_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ca.sex ORDER BY ca.educationnum DESC) AS edu_rank_by_sex, LAG(COALESCE(sa.total_amount, 0), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY ca.geoid ORDER BY COALESCE(sa.total_amount, 0) DESC) AS prev_amount_in_geoid FROM customer_agg ca INNER JOIN demog_agg da ON ca.geoid = da.geoid LEFT JOIN sales_agg sa ON ca.c_id = sa.refid LEFT JOIN mailings3_agg ma ON ca.c_id = ma.refid WHERE COALESCE(sa.total_amount, 0) > '0' OR COALESCE(ma.m3_yes, 0) >= 8 ORDER BY total_amount DESC NULLS LAST, ca.age ASC LIMIT 6422;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.marital_status, c.occupation ORDER BY c.age RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS avg_a_var1_window, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings1_2_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailings3_count, MAX(d.a_var2) AS max_a_var2, MIN(d.a_var3) AS min_a_var3 FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.response = 'YES' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.response = 'YES' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE c.age > 43 AND d.income_k BETWEEN 294.38 AND 427.9 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m1.ref_date < '2019-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, c.marital_status, c.occupation HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '1000' AND COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) >= 39 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, avg_a_var1_window ASC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m12.refid) AS mailings_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_demog_var1, MAX(m3.ref_date) AS last_mailing3_date FROM customers c INNER JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m12 ON c.id = m12.refid AND m12.response = 'YES' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE c.age BETWEEN 23 AND 38 AND d.income_k > 180.24 GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '1000' OR SUM(s.amount) IS NULL ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC NULLS LAST, mailings_count DESC LIMIT 161;

SELECT c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid WHERE s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.amount > '0' AND d.income_k BETWEEN 193.17 AND 61.24 GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) >= 69 INTERSECT SELECT c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailings_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.amount > '0' AND d.income_k BETWEEN 25.29 AND 200.48 GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) >= 5 ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

WITH customer_agg AS ( SELECT c.geoid, COUNT(*) AS customer_count, AVG(c.age) AS avg_age, AVG(c.educationnum) AS avg_education, SUM(c.data1) AS total_data1 FROM customers c WHERE c.age >= 67 AND c.educationnum <= 9 GROUP BY c.geoid ) SELECT d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, ca.customer_count, ca.avg_age, ca.avg_education, ca.total_data1, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, SUM(d.a_var2) AS sum_a_var2 FROM demog d JOIN customer_agg ca ON d.geoid = ca.geoid WHERE d.income_k > 152.62 AND d.inhabitants_k < '1' GROUP BY d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, ca.customer_count, ca.avg_age, ca.avg_education, ca.total_data1 HAVING SUM(d.a_var2) > '0' ORDER BY d.income_k DESC;

SELECT c.geoid, c.age, c.sex, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS total_sales_events, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS total_mailings, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_demog_var1 FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid WHERE c.age >= 34 AND d.income_k >= 293.25 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (c.geoid, c.age, c.sex, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k), (c.geoid, c.sex), (c.age, c.sex), () ) HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS unique_sales_events, COUNT(DISTINCT m12.refid) AS mailings1_2_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailings3_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m12.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses_m12, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses_m3, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank, LAG(SUM(s.amount), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.geoid ORDER BY AVG(d.income_k) DESC) AS prev_sales_in_geoid FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m12 ON c.id = m12.refid AND s.event_date >= m12.ref_date JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND s.event_date >= m3.ref_date WHERE c.age BETWEEN 95 AND 91 AND d.income_k > 236.57 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sales s2 WHERE s2.refid = c.id AND s2.amount > '0' ORDER BY s2.amount DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 63 ) GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 3 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, avg_a_var1 ASC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses, AVG(s.amount) FILTER (WHERE s.event_date >= '2020-01-01') AS avg_recent_sale_amount, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE (c.age BETWEEN 42 AND 66) AND (c.educationnum > 11 OR c.marital_status = 'Married-civ-spouse') AND NOT (d.income_k < 37.41) AND (d.a_var1 > '0.0' OR d.a_var2 < '0.0') GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) >= 9 AND SUM(s.amount) > '1000' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS total_mailings, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses_m1, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses_m3, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS total_sales, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN s.amount > '100' THEN s.amount ELSE 0 END) AS high_value_sales_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 51 AND 86 AND d.income_k >= 193.45 GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) > 45 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date) AS sale_year, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM s.event_date) AS sale_quarter, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS total_sales_events, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings1_2_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailings3_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings1_2_yes_responses, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings3_yes_responses, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2, AVG(d.a_var3) AS avg_a_var3, AVG(d.a_var4) AS avg_a_var4, AVG(d.a_var5) AS avg_a_var5, AVG(d.a_var6) AS avg_a_var6, AVG(d.a_var7) AS avg_a_var7, AVG(d.a_var8) AS avg_a_var8, AVG(d.a_var9) AS avg_a_var9, AVG(d.a_var10) AS avg_a_var10, AVG(d.a_var11) AS avg_a_var11, AVG(d.a_var12) AS avg_a_var12, AVG(d.a_var13) AS avg_a_var13, AVG(d.a_var14) AS avg_a_var14, AVG(d.a_var15) AS avg_a_var15, AVG(d.a_var16) AS avg_a_var16, AVG(d.a_var17) AS avg_a_var17, AVG(d.a_var18) AS avg_a_var18, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s.amount) AS median_sale_amount, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM s.event_date) ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_quarter FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date BETWEEN s.event_date - INTERVAL '30 days' AND s.event_date + INTERVAL '30 days' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date BETWEEN s.event_date - INTERVAL '30 days' AND s.event_date + INTERVAL '30 days' WHERE s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.event_date <= '2020-01-01' AND s.amount > '0' AND c.age BETWEEN 92 AND 58 AND d.income_k > 497.2 GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM s.event_date) HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 46 ORDER BY sale_year, sale_quarter, sales_rank_by_quarter;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS unique_sales_events, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings1_2_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailings3_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings1_2_yes_responses, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings3_yes_responses, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_demographic FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND '2020-01-01 00:00:00' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 75 AND 55 AND c.educationnum >= 3 AND d.income_k > 360.84 AND d.inhabitants_k < '0' GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 14 AND (COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) > 0 OR COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) > 0) ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, sales_rank_by_demographic;

SELECT c.id, c.age, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income FROM customers c JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid WHERE s.amount > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.age ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.amount > '10' GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '100' INTERSECT SELECT c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN mailings1_2 m ON c.id = m.refid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE m.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m.response = 'Yes' GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid HAVING COUNT(m.refid) >= 4 ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS customer_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailing_yes_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE d.income_k > 406.37 AND c.age BETWEEN 31 AND 72 GROUP BY d.geoid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 512 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS customer_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.amount > '10' AND d.geoid IN ( SELECT geoid FROM demog WHERE inhabitants_k > '50' AND geoid IN ( SELECT geoid FROM customers WHERE age BETWEEN 19 AND 38 ) ) GROUP BY d.geoid HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '1000' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses, AVG(d.a_var1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY d.geoid) AS rolling_var1_avg, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE d.income_k > 253.47 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.event_date <= '2020-01-01' AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND c.age BETWEEN 29 AND 62 AND d.inhabitants_k > '0' GROUP BY d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) >= 20 ORDER BY total_sales DESC, avg_income DESC;

WITH customer_agg AS ( SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.geoid, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, COUNT(DISTINCT m12.ref_date) AS mailings_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m12.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings_yes_responses, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2 FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m12 ON c.id = m12.refid WHERE c.age BETWEEN 94 AND 58 AND d.income_k > 224.46 AND m12.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.geoid, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m12.ref_date) > 13 ), sales_agg AS ( SELECT s.refid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.event_date) AS sales_days, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, MAX(s.event_date) AS last_sale_date FROM sales s WHERE s.amount > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY s.refid ), mailings3_agg AS ( SELECT m3.refid, COUNT(*) AS mailings3_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings3_yes FROM mailings3 m3 WHERE m3.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' GROUP BY m3.refid ) SELECT ca.customer_id, ca.age, ca.educationnum, ca.sex, ca.marital_status, ca.occupation, ca.mailings_count, ca.mailings_yes_responses, ca.avg_a_var1, ca.avg_a_var2, COALESCE(sa.sales_days, 0) AS sales_days, COALESCE(sa.total_sales_amount, 0) AS total_sales_amount, COALESCE(sa.avg_sale_amount, 0) AS avg_sale_amount, COALESCE(m3a.mailings3_count, 0) AS mailings3_count, COALESCE(m3a.mailings3_yes, 0) AS mailings3_yes, (COALESCE(sa.total_sales_amount, 0) / NULLIF(ca.mailings_count, 0)) AS sales_per_mailing, (COALESCE(m3a.mailings3_yes, 0) * 1.0 / NULLIF(m3a.mailings3_count, 0)) AS mailings3_response_rate FROM customer_agg ca LEFT JOIN sales_agg sa ON ca.customer_id = sa.refid LEFT JOIN mailings3_agg m3a ON ca.customer_id = m3a.refid WHERE COALESCE(sa.total_sales_amount, 0) > '0' AND COALESCE(m3a.mailings3_count, 0) >= 46 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, ca.mailings_count DESC LIMIT 265;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, d.a_var1, d.a_var2, d.a_var3, d.a_var4, d.a_var5, d.a_var6, d.a_var7, d.a_var8, d.a_var9, d.a_var10, d.a_var11, d.a_var12, d.a_var13, d.a_var14, d.a_var15, d.a_var16, d.a_var17, d.a_var18, COUNT(DISTINCT m12.refid) AS mailings_count_12, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailings_count_3, SUM(CASE WHEN m12.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS response_count_12, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS response_count_3, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sales_amount, MIN(s.event_date) AS first_sale_date, MAX(s.event_date) AS last_sale_date, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s.amount) AS median_sales_amount, STDDEV(s.amount) AS stddev_sales_amount, SUM(d.a_var1 * d.a_var2) / NULLIF(SUM(d.a_var3), 0) AS complex_demog_ratio, CORR(d.income_k, s.amount) AS income_sales_correlation, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank, LAG(SUM(s.amount), 1) OVER (ORDER BY MAX(s.event_date)) AS prev_period_sales FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m12 ON c.id = m12.refid AND m12.ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND '2020-01-01 00:00:00' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 48 AND 80 AND c.educationnum >= 18 AND d.income_k > 733.66 AND d.inhabitants_k BETWEEN '0' AND '0' AND (d.a_var1 > '-100' OR d.a_var2 < '-100') GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, d.a_var1, d.a_var2, d.a_var3, d.a_var4, d.a_var5, d.a_var6, d.a_var7, d.a_var8, d.a_var9, d.a_var10, d.a_var11, d.a_var12, d.a_var13, d.a_var14, d.a_var15, d.a_var16, d.a_var17, d.a_var18 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) > 377 AND SUM(s.amount) >= '0' AND AVG(s.amount) BETWEEN '0' AND '0' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, sales_rank ASC LIMIT 202;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(m1.kxindex) AS avg_kxindex, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mailings3 m3 WHERE m3.refid = c.id AND m3.response = 'YES' AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01') AS recent_m3_yes_count FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE c.age BETWEEN 58 AND 61 AND d.income_k > 42.67 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, SUM(d.a_var2) AS sum_a_var2, COUNT(DISTINCT m12.kxindex) AS distinct_mailings, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS yes_responses_m3, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(s.eventid) AS sales_count, AVG(SUM(s.amount)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status) AS avg_sales_by_demo, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN mailings1_2 m12 ON c.id = m12.refid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m12.ref_date < m3.ref_date LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date BETWEEN m12.ref_date AND m3.ref_date WHERE c.nom1 LIKE 'A%' AND c.nom2 LIKE 'B%' AND c.age BETWEEN 66 AND 33 AND d.income_k > 469.61 AND m12.response IN ('YES', 'NO') AND s.amount IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING COUNT(s.eventid) >= 44 AND SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, sales_count ASC LIMIT 1000;

WITH customer_agg AS ( SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, d.a_var1, d.a_var2, d.a_var3, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings_yes, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'NO' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS mailings_other, AVG(m1.kxindex) AS avg_kxindex, MAX(m1.ref_date) AS last_mailing_date FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid WHERE c.age BETWEEN 34 AND 36 AND d.income_k >= 169.13 AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, d.a_var1, d.a_var2, d.a_var3 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) > 100 ), sales_agg AS ( SELECT s.refid AS customer_id, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_amount, MAX(s.event_date) AS last_sale_date, MIN(s.event_date) AS first_sale_date, COUNT(DISTINCT DATE_TRUNC('month', s.event_date)) AS active_months, STDDEV(s.amount) AS amount_stddev FROM sales s JOIN customers c ON s.refid = c.id JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid WHERE s.amount >= '0' AND s.event_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' AND d.a_var4 >= '0' GROUP BY s.refid HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '100' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 20 ), mailings3_agg AS ( SELECT m3.refid AS customer_id, COUNT(*) AS mailings3_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings3_yes, MAX(m3.ref_date) AS last_mailing3_date FROM mailings3 m3 JOIN customers c ON m3.refid = c.id WHERE m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY m3.refid HAVING COUNT(*) > 29 ) SELECT ca.customer_id, ca.age, ca.educationnum, ca.sex, ca.marital_status, ca.occupation, ca.inhabitants_k, ca.income_k, ca.a_var1, ca.a_var2, ca.a_var3, ca.mailings_count, ca.mailings_yes, ca.mailings_other, ca.avg_kxindex, ca.last_mailing_date, sa.sales_count, sa.total_amount, sa.avg_amount, sa.last_sale_date, sa.first_sale_date, sa.active_months, sa.amount_stddev, ma.mailings3_count, ma.mailings3_yes, ma.last_mailing3_date, (ca.mailings_yes * 1.0 / NULLIF(ca.mailings_count, 0)) AS mailing_response_rate, (sa.total_amount / NULLIF(sa.sales_count, 0)) AS avg_sale_value, (sa.total_amount * 1.0 / NULLIF(ca.mailings_count, 0)) AS revenue_per_mailing, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sa.total_amount DESC) AS revenue_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ca.sex ORDER BY sa.total_amount DESC) AS revenue_rank_by_sex, LAG(sa.total_amount, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY ca.geoid ORDER BY sa.total_amount DESC) AS prev_revenue_in_geoid FROM customer_agg ca JOIN sales_agg sa ON ca.customer_id = sa.customer_id LEFT JOIN mailings3_agg ma ON ca.customer_id = ma.customer_id WHERE ca.income_k >= 18.84 AND sa.total_amount >= '0' AND (ca.mailings_yes * 1.0 / NULLIF(ca.mailings_count, 0)) >= '0' UNION ALL SELECT ca.customer_id, ca.age, ca.educationnum, ca.sex, ca.marital_status, ca.occupation, ca.inhabitants_k, ca.income_k, ca.a_var1, ca.a_var2, ca.a_var3, ca.mailings_count, ca.mailings_yes, ca.mailings_other, ca.avg_kxindex, ca.last_mailing_date, NULL AS sales_count, NULL AS total_amount, NULL AS avg_amount, NULL AS last_sale_date, NULL AS first_sale_date, NULL AS active_months, NULL AS amount_stddev, ma.mailings3_count, ma.mailings3_yes, ma.last_mailing3_date, (ca.mailings_yes * 1.0 / NULLIF(ca.mailings_count, 0)) AS mailing_response_rate, NULL AS avg_sale_value, NULL AS revenue_per_mailing, NULL AS revenue_rank, SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT m1.response, ', ' ORDER BY m1.response) AS mailing_responses_1_2, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT m3.response, ', ' ORDER BY m3.response) AS mailing_responses_3, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_1_2_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailings_3_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_event_count, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, MIN(s.event_date) AS first_sale_date, MAX(s.event_date) AS last_sale_date, SUM(d.a_var1 + d.a_var2 + d.a_var3 + d.a_var4 + d.a_var5 + d.a_var6 + d.a_var7 + d.a_var8 + d.a_var9 + d.a_var10 + d.a_var11 + d.a_var12 + d.a_var13 + d.a_var14 + d.a_var15 + d.a_var16 + d.a_var17 + d.a_var18) AS sum_all_demog_vars, (SUM(s.amount) / NULLIF(d.income_k, 0)) AS sales_to_income_ratio, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank, LAG(SUM(s.amount), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS prev_sales_amount_by_demo FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND '2020-01-01 00:00:00' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 91 AND 47 AND c.educationnum >= 5 AND d.inhabitants_k > '0.0' AND d.income_k BETWEEN 18.8 AND 821.24 GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0.0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 64 AND COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) + COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) > 343 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, sales_rank;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS total_mailings, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'Y' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid), 0) AS response_rate, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS total_sales_events, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND '2020-01-01 00:00:00' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 59 AND 91 AND d.income_k > 463.34 GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) > 700 AND SUM(s.amount) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, response_rate DESC LIMIT 100;

WITH customer_agg AS ( SELECT c.id AS c_id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status, COUNT(DISTINCT m12.ref_date) AS m12_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.ref_date) AS m3_count, SUM(CASE WHEN SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS unique_sales_events, COUNT(m1.response) FILTER (WHERE m1.response = 'YES') AS mailings1_yes_count, COUNT(m3.response) FILTER (WHERE m3.response = 'YES') AS mailings3_yes_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_sex, LAG(SUM(s.amount), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.id ORDER BY MIN(s.event_date)) AS prev_sales_amount FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND '2020-01-01 00:00:00' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 99 AND 94 AND d.income_k > 52.86 AND (d.a_var3 > '0' OR d.a_var4 < '0') GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 26 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, sales_rank_by_sex LIMIT 460;

SELECT c1.id AS customer_id_1, c2.id AS customer_id_2, d1.geoid, AVG(d1.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, SUM(s1.amount) AS total_sales_customer1, SUM(s2.amount) AS total_sales_customer2, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailing_count_1, COUNT(DISTINCT m2.refid) AS mailing_count_2, CORR(d1.a_var2, d1.a_var3) OVER (PARTITION BY d1.geoid) AS demographic_correlation, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s1.amount) + SUM(s2.amount) DESC) AS combined_sales_rank FROM customers c1 JOIN customers c2 ON c1.geoid = c2.geoid AND c1.id < c2.id JOIN demog d1 ON c1.geoid = d1.geoid JOIN sales s1 ON c1.id = s1.refid JOIN sales s2 ON c2.id = s2.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c1.id = m1.refid JOIN mailings3 m2 ON c2.id = m2.refid WHERE c1.age > 34 AND c2.age > 64 AND s1.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s2.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND d1.income_k BETWEEN 789.25 AND 820.38 GROUP BY c1.id, c2.id, d1.geoid HAVING SUM(s1.amount) > '0' AND SUM(s2.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) >= 42 ORDER BY combined_sales_rank;

SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS total_sales_events, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_geoid_income, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY d.a_var1) AS median_a_var1, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY d.a_var2) AS p75_a_var2, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) FILTER (WHERE m1.response = 'YES') AS mailings1_yes_responses, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) FILTER (WHERE m3.response = 'YES') AS mailings3_yes_responses, SUM(d.a_var3 * d.a_var4) / NULLIF(SUM(d.a_var5), 0) AS weighted_demog_ratio FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE s.amount > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND d.income_k BETWEEN 462.08 AND 99.79 AND c.age >= 65 GROUP BY d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 545 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

WITH customer_agg AS ( SELECT c.geoid, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS customer_count, AVG(c.age) AS avg_age, SUM(c.data1) AS total_data1 FROM customers c WHERE c.age BETWEEN 89 AND 63 GROUP BY c.geoid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 26 ) SELECT d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, ca.customer_count, ca.avg_age, ca.total_data1, COUNT(DISTINCT m.refid) AS mailing_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m.response = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount FROM demog d JOIN customer_agg ca ON d.geoid = ca.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m ON ca.geoid = m.kxindex LEFT JOIN sales s ON m.refid = s.refid WHERE d.income_k > 39.52 GROUP BY d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, ca.customer_count, ca.avg_age, ca.total_data1 ORDER BY d.income_k DESC, ca.customer_count DESC;

WITH customer_agg AS ( SELECT c.id AS c_id, c.geoid AS c_geoid, c.age AS c_age, c.educationnum AS c_educationnum, c.sex AS c_sex, c.marital_status AS c_marital_status, c.occupation AS c_occupation, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS m1_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS m3_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS m1_yes, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS m3_yes, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2, AVG(d.a_var3) AS avg_a_var3 FROM customers c LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' INNER JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid WHERE c.age BETWEEN 88 AND 40 GROUP BY c.id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation ), sales_agg AS ( SELECT s.refid AS s_refid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_amount, MIN(s.event_date) AS first_sale, MAX(s.event_date) AS last_sale FROM sales s WHERE s.event_date BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2019-01-01' GROUP BY s.refid ), self_joined_customers AS ( SELECT ca1.c_id AS cust1_id, ca1.c_age AS cust1_age, ca1.c_educationnum AS cust1_edu, ca1.c_sex AS cust1_sex, ca1.c_occupation AS cust1_occ, ca1.m1_count AS cust1_m1_cnt, ca1.m3_yes AS cust1_m3_yes, ca1.avg_a_var1 AS cust1_avg_var1, ca2.c_id AS cust2_id, ca2.c_age AS cust2_age, ca2.c_educationnum AS cust2_edu, ca2.c_sex AS cust2_sex, ca2.c_occupation AS cust2_occ, ca2.m1_count AS cust2_m1_cnt, ca2.m3_yes AS cust2_m3_yes, ca2.avg_a_var1 AS cust2_avg_var1, ABS(ca1.c_age - ca2.c_age) AS age_diff, ABS(ca1.c_educationnum - ca2.c_educationnum) AS edu_diff FROM customer_agg ca1 INNER JOIN customer_agg ca2 ON ca1.c_geoid = ca2.c_geoid AND ca1.c_id < ca2.c_id WHERE ca1.c_marital_status = ca2.c_marital_status AND ca1.c_sex = ca2.c_sex AND ca1.avg_a_var1 > '0.0' AND ca2.avg_a_var1 > '0.0' ) SELECT sjc.cust1_id, sjc.cust2_id, sjc.age_diff, sjc.edu_diff, sjc.cust1_avg_var1, sjc.cust2_avg_var1, sa1.sales_count AS cust1_sales_cnt, sa1.total_amount AS cust1_total_amt, sa1.avg_amount AS cust1_avg_amt, sa2.sales_count AS cust2_sales_cnt, sa2.total_amount AS cust2_total_amt, sa2.avg_amount AS cust2_avg_amt, d1.inhabitants_k AS cust1_inhabitants, d1.income_k AS cust1_income, d2.inhabitants_k AS cust2_inhabitants, d2.income_k AS cust2_income, (sa1.total_amount + sa2.total_amount) AS combined_sales, (sjc.cust1_m1_cnt + sjc.cust2_m1_cnt) AS combined_m1_cnt, (sjc.cust1_m3_yes + sjc.cust2_m3_yes) AS combined_m3_yes FROM self_joined_customers sjc LEFT JOIN sales_agg sa1 ON sjc.cust1_id = sa1.s_refid LEFT JOIN sales_agg sa2 ON sjc.cust2_id = sa2.s_refid INNER JOIN demog d1 ON sjc.cust1_id = d1.geoid INNER JOIN demog d2 ON sjc.cust2_id = d2.geoid WHERE (sa1.total_amount > '1000.0' OR sa2.total_amount > '1000.0') AND (d1.income_k BETWEEN 386.29 AND 449.2) AND (d2.income_k BETWEEN 73.95 AND 347.24) AND sjc.age_diff <= 14 AND sjc.edu_diff <= 7 ORDER BY combined_sales DESC, age_diff ASC, edu_diff ASC LIMIT 9741;

WITH customer_agg AS ( SELECT c.id AS c_id, c.geoid AS c_geoid, c.age, c.educationnum, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, AVG(m1.kxindex) AS avg_kxindex, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS m1_yes_responses FROM customers c LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid WHERE m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum ), sales_agg AS ( SELECT s.refid AS s_refid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_events, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_amount, MAX(s.event_date) AS last_sale_date FROM sales s WHERE s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY s.refid ), demog_agg AS ( SELECT d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1 + d.a_var2 + d.a_var3 + d.a_var4 + d.a_var5) AS avg_a_vars, SUM(d.a_var6 + d.a_var7 + d.a_var8 + d.a_var9 + d.a_var10) AS sum_a_vars FROM demog d WHERE d.income_k >= 171.82 GROUP BY d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k ), mailings3_agg AS ( SELECT m3.refid, COUNT(*) AS m3_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS m3_yes_responses FROM mailings3 m3 WHERE m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY m3.refid ) SELECT ca.c_id, ca.age, ca.educationnum, ca.mailings_count, ca.avg_kxindex, ca.m1_yes_responses, COALESCE(sa.sales_events, 0) AS sales_events, COALESCE(sa.total_amount, 0) AS total_amount, COALESCE(sa.avg_amount, 0) AS avg_amount, da.inhabitants_k, da.income_k, da.avg_a_vars, da.sum_a_vars, COALESCE(m3a.m3_count, 0) AS m3_count, COALESCE(m3a.m3_yes_responses, 0) AS m3_yes_responses, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(sa.total_amount, 0) DESC) AS sales_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ca.mailings_count DESC) AS mailings_rank FROM customer_agg ca INNER JOIN demog_agg da ON ca.c_geoid = da.geoid LEFT JOIN sales_agg sa ON ca.c_id = sa.s_refid LEFT JOIN mailings3_agg m3a ON ca.c_id = m3a.refid WHERE ca.mailings_count > 4 AND COALESCE(sa.total_amount, 0) >= '1000' AND da.income_k <= 235.43 ORDER BY total_amount DESC, mailings_count DESC LIMIT 8547;

WITH customer_aggregates AS ( SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.ref_date) AS mailings_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_demog_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_demog_var2 FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid WHERE c.age BETWEEN 56 AND 61 AND d.income_k > 28.31 GROUP BY c.id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m1.ref_date) > 2 ), sales_analysis AS ( SELECT s.refid, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date) AS sale_year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM s.event_date) AS sale_month, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_transaction FROM sales s WHERE s.event_date >= DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '48 months') AND s.amount > '10' GROUP BY s.refid, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM s.event_date) ), mailings_consolidated AS ( SELECT m3.refid, COUNT(*) AS mailings3_count, MAX(m3.ref_date) AS last_mailing_date, MIN(m3.ref_date) AS first_mailing_date FROM mailings3 m3 WHERE m3.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2021-01-01' GROUP BY m3.refid HAVING COUNT(*) >= 16 ) SELECT ca.customer_id, ca.age, ca.educationnum, ca.sex, ca.marital_status, ca.mailings_count, ca.positive_responses, ca.avg_demog_var1, ca.avg_demog_var2, COALESCE(SUM(sa.total_amount), 0) AS lifetime_spend, COALESCE(SUM(sa.transaction_count), 0) AS total_transactions, COALESCE(AVG(sa.avg_transaction), 0) AS overall_avg_transaction, mc.mailings3_count, mc.last_mailing_date, mc.first_mailing_date, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(sa.total_amount), 0) DESC) AS spend_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(sa.total_amount), 0)) AS spend_percentile FROM customer_aggregates ca LEFT JOIN sales_analysis sa ON ca.customer_id = sa.refid LEFT JOIN mailings_consolidated mc ON ca.customer_id = mc.refid WHERE ca.avg_demog_var1 > '0' AND (mc.last_mailing_date IS NULL OR mc.last_mailing_date >= '2023-01-01') GROUP BY ca.customer_id, ca.age, ca.educationnum, ca.sex, ca.marital_status, ca.mailings_count, ca.positive_responses, ca.avg_demog_var1, ca.avg_demog_var2, mc.mailings3_count, mc.last_mailing_date, mc.first_mailing_date HAVING COALESCE(SUM(sa.total_amount), 0) > '100' AND COUNT(DISTINCT sa.sale_year) >= 4 ORDER BY lifetime_spend DESC, spend_rank ASC LIMIT 947;
