SELECT d.geoid, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE s.amount > '0' AND d.income_k BETWEEN 74.6 AND 397.49 GROUP BY d.geoid HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS unique_mailings, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY AVG(d.income_k) DESC) AS income_rank_within_demo FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE d.income_k > 44.58 AND s.event_date >= '2000-01-01' AND s.event_date <= '2000-01-01' AND m1.ref_date >= '2000-01-01' AND m3.ref_date <= '2000-01-01' AND c.age BETWEEN 48 AND 22 GROUP BY d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) >= 240 ORDER BY total_sales DESC, avg_income DESC;

WITH customer_agg AS ( SELECT c.id AS c_id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2 FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid WHERE c.age BETWEEN 74 AND 53 AND d.income_k > 423.75 GROUP BY c.id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) > 82 ), sales_agg AS ( SELECT s.refid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_amount, MIN(s.event_date) AS first_sale_date, MAX(s.event_date) AS last_sale_date FROM sales s WHERE s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY s.refid HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '1000' ), mailings3_agg AS ( SELECT m3.refid, COUNT(*) AS m3_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS m3_positive FROM mailings3 m3 WHERE m3.ref_date BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-01-01' GROUP BY m3.refid ) SELECT ca.c_id, ca.age, ca.educationnum, ca.sex, ca.marital_status, ca.mailings_count, ca.positive_responses, ca.avg_a_var1, ca.avg_a_var2, COALESCE(sa.sales_count, 0) AS sales_count, COALESCE(sa.total_amount, 0) AS total_sales_amount, COALESCE(sa.avg_amount, 0) AS avg_sale_amount, COALESCE(ma.m3_count, 0) AS m3_mailings_count, COALESCE(ma.m3_positive, 0) AS m3_positive_responses, (ca.positive_responses * 1.0 / NULLIF(ca.mailings_count, 0)) AS response_rate, (COALESCE(sa.total_amount, 0) * 1.0 / NULLIF(ca.mailings_count, 0)) AS revenue_per_mailing, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(sa.total_amount, 0) DESC) AS sales_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ca.sex ORDER BY ca.age DESC) AS age_rank_by_sex FROM customer_agg ca LEFT JOIN sales_agg sa ON ca.c_id = sa.refid LEFT JOIN mailings3_agg ma ON ca.c_id = ma.refid WHERE ca.avg_a_var1 > '0' AND (ca.positive_responses > 18 OR COALESCE(sa.total_amount, 0) > '5000') ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, ca.age ASC LIMIT 564;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) OVER(PARTITION BY c.marital_status, c.occupation ORDER BY d.a_var2 ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_avg_var1, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, MAX(m3.ref_date) AS last_mailing3_date, CORR(d.a_var3, d.a_var4) AS correlation_var3_var4, STDDEV(d.a_var5) AS stddev_var5 FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE c.age BETWEEN 30 AND 32 AND d.income_k > 227.68 AND s.event_date >= '2000-01-01' AND m1.ref_date >= '2000-01-01' AND m3.response = 'Yes' AND s.amount > '0' GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.a_var2 HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) >= 6 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, rolling_avg_var1 ASC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sale_amount, MAX(s.event_date) AS last_sale_date FROM customers c INNER JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE c.age >= 58 AND c.age <= 31 AND d.income_k > 189.49 AND (s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' OR s.event_date IS NULL) GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) > 22 AND SUM(s.amount) > '100' ORDER BY total_sale_amount DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM m1.ref_date) AS mailing_year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM m1.ref_date) AS mailing_month, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS total_mailings, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN m1.refid END) AS positive_responses, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS total_sales, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(d.a_var1 + d.a_var2 + d.a_var3 + d.a_var4 + d.a_var5 + d.a_var6 + d.a_var7 + d.a_var8 + d.a_var9 + d.a_var10 + d.a_var11 + d.a_var12 + d.a_var13 + d.a_var14 + d.a_var15 + d.a_var16 + d.a_var17 + d.a_var18) AS sum_demog_vars, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_demog FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON m1.refid = s.refid AND s.event_date BETWEEN m1.ref_date AND (m1.ref_date + INTERVAL '30 days') LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date BETWEEN m1.ref_date AND (m1.ref_date + INTERVAL '90 days') WHERE d.inhabitants_k > '1.0' AND d.income_k BETWEEN 210.11 AND 470.7 AND c.age >= 43 AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m1.kxindex > 1902 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM m1.ref_date), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM m1.ref_date)), (d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status), (c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation), (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM m1.ref_date), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM m1.ref_date)), () ) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) > 9 AND SUM(s.amount) > '0.0' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1000;

WITH customer_agg AS ( SELECT c.geoid, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS customer_count, AVG(c.age) AS avg_age, SUM(CASE WHEN c.sex = 'Male' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_count FROM customers c WHERE c.age BETWEEN 25 AND 96 GROUP BY c.geoid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 43 ) SELECT d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, ca.customer_count, ca.avg_age, ca.male_count, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, SUM(d.a_var2) AS sum_a_var2 FROM demog d JOIN customer_agg ca ON d.geoid = ca.geoid WHERE d.income_k > 188.56 GROUP BY d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, ca.customer_count, ca.avg_age, ca.male_count ORDER BY d.income_k DESC LIMIT 89;

SELECT c.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date) AS sale_year, COUNT(DISTINCT s.refid) AS unique_customers, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, SUM(d.inhabitants_k) AS total_inhabitants, SUM(d.income_k) AS total_income, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date) ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_sex_year FROM customers c JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m ON c.id = m.refid AND m.response = 'YES' WHERE s.amount > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND c.age BETWEEN 24 AND 28 AND d.income_k >= 142.92 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (c.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, sale_year), (c.sex, sale_year), (sale_year), () ) HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '1000' ORDER BY sale_year DESC, total_sales DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.income_k, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s.amount) AS median_sale_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, COUNT(s.eventid) AS total_sales, SUM(s.amount) AS total_spent FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.amount > '0' AND d.income_k BETWEEN 7.22 AND 479.63 GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.income_k HAVING COUNT(s.eventid) >= 24 ORDER BY total_spent DESC;

WITH customer_agg AS ( SELECT c.geoid, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS customer_count, AVG(c.age) AS avg_age, SUM(CASE WHEN c.sex = 'Male' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_count FROM customers c WHERE c.age BETWEEN 84 AND 58 GROUP BY c.geoid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 13 ) SELECT d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, ca.customer_count, ca.avg_age, ca.male_count, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, SUM(d.a_var2) AS sum_a_var2 FROM demog d JOIN customer_agg ca ON d.geoid = ca.geoid WHERE d.income_k > 142.13 GROUP BY d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, ca.customer_count, ca.avg_age, ca.male_count ORDER BY d.income_k DESC LIMIT 51;

WITH customer_agg AS ( SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.ref_date) AS mailings_count, AVG(m1.kxindex) AS avg_kxindex, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses FROM customers c LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid WHERE m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m1.ref_date <= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m1.ref_date) >= 32 ) SELECT d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, ca.sex, ca.marital_status, COUNT(ca.customer_id) AS customer_count, AVG(ca.age) AS avg_age, AVG(ca.educationnum) AS avg_education, SUM(ca.mailings_count) AS total_mailings, AVG(ca.avg_kxindex) AS overall_avg_kxindex, SUM(ca.positive_responses) AS total_positive_responses, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_events, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.ref_date) AS mailings3_count FROM demog d INNER JOIN customer_agg ca ON d.geoid = ca.geoid LEFT JOIN sales s ON ca.customer_id = s.refid LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON ca.customer_id = m3.refid WHERE d.income_k >= 24.96 AND d.inhabitants_k <= '1' GROUP BY d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, ca.sex, ca.marital_status HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '1000' AND AVG(ca.avg_kxindex) BETWEEN '0' AND '0' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, customer_count DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sale_amount FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE c.age >= 53 AND c.age <= 77 AND d.income_k >= 78.81 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.income_k HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) > 30 AND SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_sale_amount DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS customer_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailing_response_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_last_30_days FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date >= ('2020-01-01'::timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days') WHERE d.income_k > 471.94 AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY d.geoid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 11 ORDER BY total_sales_last_30_days DESC NULLS LAST;

SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM m1.ref_date) AS mailing_year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM m1.ref_date) AS mailing_month, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS total_mailings, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN m1.refid END) AS positive_responses, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS total_sales, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(d.inhabitants_k) AS total_inhabitants, AVG(d.a_var1 + d.a_var2 + d.a_var3 + d.a_var4 + d.a_var5 + d.a_var6 + d.a_var7 + d.a_var8 + d.a_var9 + d.a_var10 + d.a_var11 + d.a_var12 + d.a_var13 + d.a_var14 + d.a_var15 + d.a_var16 + d.a_var17 + d.a_var18) AS avg_demog_index, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_demographic FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON m1.refid = s.refid AND s.event_date BETWEEN m1.ref_date AND m1.ref_date + INTERVAL '30 days' JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date >= m1.ref_date - INTERVAL '90 days' AND m3.ref_date <= m1.ref_date WHERE c.age >= 25 AND c.age <= 99 AND d.income_k >= 253.03 AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m1.ref_date <= '2020-01-01' AND (s.amount >= '0' OR s.amount IS NULL) GROUP BY CUBE(d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM m1.ref_date), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM m1.ref_date)) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) > 672 AND (SUM(s.amount) >= '0' OR SUM(s.amount) IS NULL) ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC NULLS LAST, total_mailings DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM m1.ref_date) AS mailing_year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM m1.ref_date) AS mailing_month, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date) AS sale_year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM s.event_date) AS sale_month, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS total_mailings, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) FILTER (WHERE s.amount > '100') AS high_value_sales_count, SUM(s.amount) FILTER (WHERE s.amount > '500') AS high_value_sales_sum, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(d.inhabitants_k) AS total_inhabitants, SUM(d.a_var1 + d.a_var2 + d.a_var3 + d.a_var4 + d.a_var5 + d.a_var6 + d.a_var7 + d.a_var8 + d.a_var9 + d.a_var10 + d.a_var11 + d.a_var12 + d.a_var13 + d.a_var14 + d.a_var15 + d.a_var16 + d.a_var17 + d.a_var18) AS sum_all_a_vars, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) FILTER (WHERE c.age BETWEEN 51 AND 63 AND c.educationnum > 15) AS target_customers_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_demographic, LAG(SUM(s.amount), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY d.geoid, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date) ORDER BY EXTRACT(MONTH FROM s.event_date)) AS prev_month_sales FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON m1.refid = s.refid AND s.event_date >= m1.ref_date LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date >= m1.ref_date WHERE d.income_k > 139.34 AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND (s.event_date IS NULL OR s.event_date <= '2020-01-01') AND c.sex IN ('Male', 'Female') GROUP BY CUBE ( d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM m1.ref_date), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM m1.ref_date), EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM s.event_date) ) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) > 4 AND (SUM(s.amount) IS NULL OR SUM(s.amount) > '0') ORDER BY total_mailings DESC, high_value_sales_sum DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 8587;

WITH customer_aggregates AS ( SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.ref_date) AS mailings_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2 FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid WHERE c.age BETWEEN 79 AND 95 AND d.income_k > 469.34 GROUP BY c.id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m1.ref_date) > 7 ), sales_analysis AS ( SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.geoid, c.marital_status, c.occupation, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS distinct_sales, SUM(s.amount) AS total_spent, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, MAX(s.event_date) AS last_sale_date, MIN(s.event_date) AS first_sale_date, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.ref_date) AS mailings3_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings3_positive FROM customers c JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE s.amount > '10' AND s.event_date >= '2010-01-01' AND c.educationnum > 11 GROUP BY c.id, c.geoid, c.marital_status, c.occupation HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '100' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 3 ) SELECT ca.customer_id, ca.geoid, ca.age, ca.educationnum, ca.inhabitants_k, ca.income_k, ca.mailings_count, ca.positive_responses, ca.avg_a_var1, ca.avg_a_var2, sa.marital_status, sa.occupation, sa.distinct_sales, sa.total_spent, sa.avg_sale_amount, sa.last_sale_date, sa.first_sale_date, sa.mailings3_count, sa.mailings3_positive, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sa.total_spent DESC) AS spending_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sa.marital_status ORDER BY ca.income_k DESC) AS income_rank_by_marital FROM customer_aggregates ca INNER JOIN sales_analysis sa ON ca.customer_id = sa.customer_id WHERE ca.avg_a_var1 > '0' AND sa.avg_sale_amount BETWEEN '0' AND '0' INTERSECT SELECT ca.customer_id, ca.geoid, ca.age, ca.educationnum, ca.inhabitants_k, ca.income_k, ca.mailings_count, ca.positive_responses, ca.avg_a_var1, ca.avg_a_var2, sa.marital_status, sa.occupation, sa.distinct_sales, sa.total_spent, sa.avg_sale_amount, sa.last_sale_date, sa.first_sale_date, sa.mailings3_count, sa.mailings3_positive, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sa.total_spent DESC) AS spending_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sa.marital_status ORDER BY ca.income_k DESC) AS income_rank_by_marital FROM customer_aggregates ca INNER JOIN sales_analysis sa ON ca.customer_id = sa.customer_id WHERE ca.avg_a_var2 < '0' AND sa.mailings3_positive > 14 ORDER BY total_spent DESC, income_k DESC LIMIT 2480;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1 FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE c.age >= 21 AND c.educationnum >= 15 AND d.income_k >= 14.22 GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '100' AND COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) >= 49 ORDER BY total_amount DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS unique_sales_events, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings1_2_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailings3_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings1_2_yes_responses, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings3_yes_responses, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_demographic FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE s.amount > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.event_date <= '2020-01-01' AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND d.income_k BETWEEN 145.68 AND 452.41 AND c.age BETWEEN 64 AND 99 AND c.educationnum >= 4 GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 1 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, sales_rank_by_demographic;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m12.refid) AS mailing_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_demog_var1, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC NULLS LAST) AS sales_rank FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m12 ON c.id = m12.refid AND m12.ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND '2020-01-01 00:00:00' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 53 AND 88 AND d.income_k > 17.47 GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.income_k HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) > 0 AND SUM(s.amount) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC LIMIT 79;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, COUNT(s.eventid) AS sales_count FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE (c.age BETWEEN 76 AND 43) AND (d.income_k > 53.39 OR d.inhabitants_k < '0') AND (c.marital_status = 'Married-civ-spouse' OR c.occupation = 'Adm-clerical') AND NOT (c.educationnum < 12) AND (m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' OR m1.ref_date IS NULL) AND (s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' OR s.event_date IS NULL) GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) >= 61 AND SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(c.age) AS avg_age, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses_m1, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses_m3, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS unique_sales_events, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, (SELECT AVG(sub_s.amount) FROM sales sub_s WHERE sub_s.refid IN (SELECT sub_c.id FROM customers sub_c WHERE sub_c.geoid = d.geoid) AND sub_s.event_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00') AS avg_sales_amount_for_geoid_after_date FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE d.income_k > 949.09 AND c.age BETWEEN 41 AND 59 GROUP BY d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 927 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

SELECT d1.geoid, d1.inhabitants_k AS inhabitants_k_1, d2.inhabitants_k AS inhabitants_k_2, AVG(d1.income_k) AS avg_income_1, AVG(d2.income_k) AS avg_income_2, SUM(s1.amount) AS total_sales_amount_1, SUM(s2.amount) AS total_sales_amount_2, COUNT(DISTINCT c1.id) AS unique_customers_1, COUNT(DISTINCT c2.id) AS unique_customers_2 FROM demog d1 JOIN demog d2 ON d1.geoid = d2.geoid JOIN customers c1 ON d1.geoid = c1.geoid JOIN customers c2 ON d2.geoid = c2.geoid JOIN sales s1 ON c1.id = s1.refid JOIN sales s2 ON c2.id = s2.refid WHERE d1.inhabitants_k > '0' AND d2.inhabitants_k < '0' AND s1.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s2.event_date <= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY d1.geoid, d1.inhabitants_k, d2.inhabitants_k HAVING AVG(d1.income_k) > 395.99 AND AVG(d2.income_k) < 124.2 ORDER BY d1.geoid;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, d.a_var1, d.a_var2, d.a_var3, d.a_var4, d.a_var5, d.a_var6, d.a_var7, d.a_var8, d.a_var9, d.a_var10, d.a_var11, d.a_var12, d.a_var13, d.a_var14, d.a_var15, d.a_var16, d.a_var17, d.a_var18, m1.ref_date AS first_mailing_date, m1.response AS first_mailing_response, m3.ref_date AS third_mailing_date, m3.response AS third_mailing_response, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS total_sales_events, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, MAX(s.event_date) AS last_sale_date, MIN(s.event_date) AS first_sale_date, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY c.age, c.educationnum ORDER BY m1.ref_date) AS cumulative_positive_responses_by_demo, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.geoid ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_in_region, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount)) AS sales_percentile_overall FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE c.age >= 67 AND c.age <= 81 AND d.income_k >= 301.94 AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND (s.amount >= '0' OR s.amount IS NULL) GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, d.a_var1, d.a_var2, d.a_var3, d.a_var4, d.a_var5, d.a_var6, d.a_var7, d.a_var8, d.a_var9, d.a_var10, d.a_var11, d.a_var12, d.a_var13, d.a_var14, d.a_var15, d.a_var16, d.a_var17, d.a_var18, m1.ref_date, m1.response, m3.ref_date, m3.response HAVING SUM(s.amount) >= '0' OR SUM(s.amount) IS NULL ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC NULLS LAST, sales_rank_in_region;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date) AS sale_year, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM s.event_date) AS sale_quarter, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS total_sales, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_geoid_income, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date), c.sex ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS spending_rank_by_sex_year FROM customers c JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid WHERE s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.amount > '0' AND d.income_k BETWEEN 482.26 AND 406.48 GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM s.event_date) HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY sale_year, sale_quarter, spending_rank_by_sex_year;

SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m1.response = 'Y' THEN m1.refid END) AS positive_responses, SUM(SUM(s.amount)) OVER (PARTITION BY d.geoid, c.sex ORDER BY c.marital_status) AS cumulative_sales_by_demog, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid JOIN sales s ON m1.refid = s.refid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON s.refid = m3.refid WHERE d.income_k > 935.29 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.event_date <= '2020-01-01' AND c.age BETWEEN 32 AND 85 AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) >= 671 ORDER BY total_sales DESC, avg_income ASC;

WITH customer_agg AS ( SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings_response_count, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_demog_var1, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(s.eventid) AS sales_count FROM customers c LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.amount > '0' AND c.age BETWEEN 28 AND 55 GROUP BY c.id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum ) SELECT COALESCE(CAST(customer_id AS TEXT), 'All Customers') AS customer, COALESCE(CAST(geoid AS TEXT), 'All Regions') AS region, COALESCE(CAST(age_group AS TEXT), 'All Ages') AS age_group, SUM(total_sales_amount) AS total_sales, AVG(avg_demog_var1) AS avg_demographic_var, SUM(mailings_count) AS total_mailings, SUM(mailings_response_count) AS total_responses FROM ( SELECT customer_id, geoid, CASE WHEN age < 30 THEN 'Under 30' WHEN age BETWEEN 30 AND 50 THEN '30-50' ELSE 'Over 50' END AS age_group, mailings_count, mailings_response_count, avg_demog_var1, total_sales_amount FROM customer_agg ) sub GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (customer_id, geoid, age_group), (customer_id, geoid), (customer_id, age_group), (geoid, age_group), (customer_id), (geoid), (age_group), () ) HAVING SUM(total_sales_amount) > '1000' ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS distinct_mailings1_2_refs, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS distinct_mailings3_refs, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS distinct_sales_events, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_demog_var1, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.response = 'YES' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.response = 'YES' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE c.age >= 24 AND c.age <= 46 AND d.income_k > 402.29 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) > 51 AND SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

WITH customer_agg AS ( SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.educationnum, c.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, COUNT(DISTINCT m12.ref_date) AS mailings_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.ref_date) AS mailings3_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m12.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS response_count_m12, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS response_count_m3, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2, AVG(d.a_var3) AS avg_a_var3 FROM customers c LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m12 ON c.id = m12.refid LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid LEFT JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid WHERE c.age BETWEEN 86 AND 84 AND m12.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.educationnum, c.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation ), sales_agg AS ( SELECT s.refid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_amount, MIN(s.event_date) AS first_sale_date, MAX(s.event_date) AS last_sale_date FROM sales s WHERE s.amount > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY s.refid ), combined AS ( SELECT ca.customer_id, ca.age, ca.educationnum, ca.sex, ca.marital_status, ca.occupation, ca.mailings_count, ca.mailings3_count, ca.response_count_m12, ca.response_count_m3, ca.avg_a_var1, ca.avg_a_var2, ca.avg_a_var3, COALESCE(sa.sales_count, 0) AS sales_count, COALESCE(sa.total_amount, 0) AS total_amount, COALESCE(sa.avg_amount, 0) AS avg_amount, sa.first_sale_date, sa.last_sale_date, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, d.a_var4, d.a_var5, d.a_var6 FROM customer_agg ca LEFT JOIN sales_agg sa ON ca.customer_id = sa.refid LEFT JOIN demog d ON ca.geoid = d.geoid WHERE d.income_k > 213.98 AND d.inhabitants_k BETWEEN '0' AND '0' ) SELECT sex, marital_status, occupation, COUNT(*) AS customer_count, AVG(age) AS avg_age, AVG(educationnum) AS avg_education, SUM(mailings_count) AS total_mailings, SUM(mailings3_count) AS total_mailings3, SUM(response_count_m12) AS total_responses_m12, SUM(response_count_m3) AS total_responses_m3, AVG(avg_a_var1) AS overall_avg_a_var1, AVG(avg_a_var2) AS overall_avg_a_var2, AVG(avg_a_var3) AS overall_avg_a_var3, SUM(sales_count) AS total_sales, SUM(total_amount) AS grand_total_amount, AVG(avg_amount) AS overall_avg_sale_amount, MIN(first_sale_date) AS earliest_sale, MAX(last_sale_date) AS latest_sale, AVG(inhabitants_k) AS avg_inhabitants, AVG(income_k) AS avg_income, AVG(a_var4) AS avg_a_var4, AVG(a_var5) AS avg_a_var5, AVG(a_var6) AS avg_a_var6 FROM combined GROUP BY sex, marital_status, occupation HAVING COUNT(*) > 532 AND SUM(total_amount) > '0' AND AVG(income_k) BETWEEN 468.07 AND 53.73 ORDER BY grand_total_amount DESC, customer_count DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, d.a_var1, d.a_var2, d.a_var3, d.a_var4, d.a_var5, d.a_var6, d.a_var7, d.a_var8, d.a_var9, d.a_var10, d.a_var11, d.a_var12, d.a_var13, d.a_var14, d.a_var15, d.a_var16, d.a_var17, d.a_var18, COUNT(DISTINCT m12.refid) AS mailings_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, MAX(s.event_date) AS last_sale_date, MIN(m12.ref_date) AS first_mailing_date, SUM(CASE WHEN m12.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s.amount) AS median_sale_amount, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank, LAG(SUM(s.amount), 1) OVER (ORDER BY MAX(s.event_date)) AS prev_period_sales FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m12 ON c.id = m12.refid AND m12.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 32 AND 23 AND c.educationnum >= 5 AND d.income_k > 146.02 AND c.id IN ( SELECT s2.refid FROM sales s2 WHERE s2.amount > '0' GROUP BY s2.refid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s2.eventid) >= 35 AND SUM(s2.amount) > '0' ) GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, d.a_var1, d.a_var2, d.a_var3, d.a_var4, d.a_var5, d.a_var6, d.a_var7, d.a_var8, d.a_var9, d.a_var10, d.a_var11, d.a_var12, d.a_var13, d.a_var14, d.a_var15, d.a_var16, d.a_var17, d.a_var18 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) > 34 AND SUM(s.amount) >= '0' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, sales_count DESC LIMIT 11;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, d.geoid, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(s.eventid) AS sales_count FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE c.age >= 20 AND c.age <= 74 AND d.income_k > 0.2 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.age, d.geoid HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(s.eventid) >= 30 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

SELECT c.id, c.age, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, d.a_var1, d.a_var2, d.a_var3, d.a_var4, d.a_var5, d.a_var6, d.a_var7, d.a_var8, d.a_var9, d.a_var10, d.a_var11, d.a_var12, d.a_var13, d.a_var14, d.a_var15, d.a_var16, d.a_var17, d.a_var18, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count_m12, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailings_count_m3, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS distinct_sales_events, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s.amount) AS median_sale_amount, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s.amount) AS percentile_75_sale_amount, AVG(d.a_var1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.marital_status, c.occupation) AS avg_a_var1_by_demo, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank, (SELECT AVG(sub_s.amount) FROM sales sub_s WHERE sub_s.refid IN (SELECT sub_m.refid FROM mailings1_2 sub_m WHERE sub_m.response = 'Yes') AND sub_s.amount > '0') AS avg_sales_from_responders_above_threshold FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 74 AND 64 AND c.educationnum > 18 AND d.income_k > 287.82 AND d.a_var1 < '-1000' GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, d.a_var1, d.a_var2, d.a_var3, d.a_var4, d.a_var5, d.a_var6, d.a_var7, d.a_var8, d.a_var9, d.a_var10, d.a_var11, d.a_var12, d.a_var13, d.a_var14, d.a_var15, d.a_var16, d.a_var17, d.a_var18 HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 56 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, sales_rank;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS unique_sales_events, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings1_2_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailings3_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank, LAG(SUM(s.amount), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.geoid ORDER BY c.id) AS prev_customer_sales_in_geoid FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE c.age > 56 AND d.income_k BETWEEN 73.64 AND 362.77 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > (SELECT AVG(amount) * 1.58 FROM sales WHERE event_date >= '2020-01-01') ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

WITH customer_agg AS ( SELECT c.id AS c_id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2 FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid WHERE c.age BETWEEN 83 AND 52 AND d.income_k > 379.16 GROUP BY c.id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) > 12 ), sales_agg AS ( SELECT s.refid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_amount, MIN(s.event_date) AS first_sale_date, MAX(s.event_date) AS last_sale_date FROM sales s WHERE s.amount > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY s.refid ), mailings3_agg AS ( SELECT m3.refid, COUNT(*) AS m3_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS m3_positive FROM mailings3 m3 WHERE m3.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' GROUP BY m3.refid ) SELECT ca.c_id, ca.age, ca.educationnum, ca.sex, ca.marital_status, ca.mailings_count, ca.positive_responses, ca.avg_a_var1, ca.avg_a_var2, COALESCE(sa.sales_count, 0) AS sales_count, COALESCE(sa.total_amount, 0) AS total_sales_amount, COALESCE(sa.avg_amount, 0) AS avg_sale_amount, COALESCE(ma.m3_count, 0) AS m3_mailings_count, COALESCE(ma.m3_positive, 0) AS m3_positive_responses, (ca.positive_responses * 1.0 / NULLIF(ca.mailings_count, 0)) AS response_rate, (COALESCE(sa.total_amount, 0) * 1.0 / NULLIF(ca.mailings_count, 0)) AS revenue_per_mailing FROM customer_agg ca LEFT JOIN sales_agg sa ON ca.c_id = sa.refid LEFT JOIN mailings3_agg ma ON ca.c_id = ma.refid WHERE ca.avg_a_var1 > '0' AND (ca.avg_a_var2 < '0' OR ca.avg_a_var2 IS NULL) AND (COALESCE(sa.total_amount, 0) > '0' OR sa.total_amount IS NULL) ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, response_rate DESC LIMIT 144;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, d.a_var1, d.a_var2, d.a_var3, d.a_var4, d.a_var5, d.a_var6, d.a_var7, d.a_var8, d.a_var9, d.a_var10, d.a_var11, d.a_var12, d.a_var13, d.a_var14, d.a_var15, d.a_var16, d.a_var17, d.a_var18, COUNT(DISTINCT m12.refid) AS total_mailings_12, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS total_mailings_3, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS total_sales, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, MIN(s.event_date) AS first_sale_date, MAX(s.event_date) AS last_sale_date, SUM(CASE WHEN m12.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses_12, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses_3, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC NULLS LAST) AS sales_rank_by_demographic, AVG(d.income_k) OVER (PARTITION BY d.geoid) AS avg_income_in_geoid, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.occupation ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_sales_count_by_occupation FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m12 ON c.id = m12.refid AND m12.ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND '2020-01-01 00:00:00' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 38 AND 46 AND c.educationnum >= 2 AND d.income_k > 631.33 AND d.inhabitants_k < '0' GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, d.a_var1, d.a_var2, d.a_var3, d.a_var4, d.a_var5, d.a_var6, d.a_var7, d.a_var8, d.a_var9, d.a_var10, d.a_var11, d.a_var12, d.a_var13, d.a_var14, d.a_var15, d.a_var16, d.a_var17, d.a_var18 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) > 15 AND SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, sales_rank_by_demographic;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS unique_sales_events, COUNT(m1.response) FILTER (WHERE m1.response = 'YES') AS mailings1_2_yes_responses, COUNT(m3.response) FILTER (WHERE m3.response = 'YES') AS mailings3_yes_responses, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank, LAG(SUM(s.amount), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY d.income_k DESC) AS prev_sales_by_demo FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND '2020-01-01 00:00:00' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 30 AND 91 AND d.income_k > 541.69 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM mailings1_2 m1_sub WHERE m1_sub.refid = c.id AND m1_sub.response = 'YES' AND m1_sub.kxindex IN (SELECT kxindex FROM mailings1_2 WHERE ref_date < '2020-01-01 00:00:00' ORDER BY ref_date DESC LIMIT 47 OFFSET 414) ) GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 75 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, d.income_k DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, COUNT(s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE c.age BETWEEN 30 AND 29 AND d.income_k > 68.64 GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(s.eventid) >= 22 ORDER BY total_amount DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(d.a_var1 + d.a_var2 + d.a_var3 + d.a_var4 + d.a_var5 + d.a_var6 + d.a_var7 + d.a_var8 + d.a_var9 + d.a_var10 + d.a_var11 + d.a_var12 + d.a_var13 + d.a_var14 + d.a_var15 + d.a_var16 + d.a_var17 + d.a_var18) AS sum_all_vars, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_demo FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid JOIN sales s ON m1.refid = s.refid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON s.refid = m3.refid WHERE d.inhabitants_k > '0' AND c.age BETWEEN 43 AND 65 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.amount > '0' GROUP BY d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) > 42 AND SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

WITH customer_agg AS ( SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS total_sales_events, SUM(s.amount) AS total_spent, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT m12.ref_date) AS mailings_count_12, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.ref_date) AS mailings_count_3, MAX(s.event_date) AS last_sale_date, MIN(m12.ref_date) AS first_mailing_date_12 FROM customers c LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m12 ON c.id = m12.refid LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid GROUP BY c.id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation ), demog_stats AS ( SELECT d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2, AVG(d.a_var3) AS avg_a_var3, AVG(d.a_var4) AS avg_a_var4, AVG(d.a_var5) AS avg_a_var5, AVG(d.a_var6) AS avg_a_var6, AVG(d.a_var7) AS avg_a_var7, AVG(d.a_var8) AS avg_a_var8, AVG(d.a_var9) AS avg_a_var9, AVG(d.a_var10) AS avg_a_var10, AVG(d.a_var11) AS avg_a_var11, AVG(d.a_var12) AS avg_a_var12, AVG(d.a_var13) AS avg_a_var13, AVG(d.a_var14) AS avg_a_var14, AVG(d.a_var15) AS avg_a_var15, AVG(d.a_var16) AS avg_a_var16, AVG(d.a_var17) AS avg_a_var17, AVG(d.a_var18) AS avg_a_var18, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY d.geoid) AS demog_row_count FROM demog d GROUP BY d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k ), windowed_customers AS ( SELECT ca.customer_id, ca.geoid, ca.age, ca.educationnum, ca.sex, ca.marital_status, ca.occupation, ca.total_sales_events, ca.total_spent, ca.avg_sale_amount, ca.mailings_count_12, ca.mailings_count_3, ca.last_sale_date, ca.first_mailing_date_12, ds.inhabitants_k, ds.income_k, ds.avg_a_var1, ds.avg_a_var2, ds.avg_a_var3, ds.avg_a_var4, ds.avg_a_var5, ds.avg_a_var6, ds.avg_a_var7, ds.avg_a_var8, ds.avg_a_var9, ds.avg_a_var10, ds.avg_a_var11, ds.avg_a_var12, ds.avg_a_var13, ds.avg_a_var14, ds.avg_a_var15, ds.avg_a_var16, ds.avg_a_var17, ds.avg_a_var18, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ca.geoid ORDER BY ca.total_spent DESC) AS spending_rank_in_geoid, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ca.total_sales_events DESC) AS sales_events_rank, LAG(ca.total_spent, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY ca.geoid ORDER BY ca.last_sale_date) AS prev_spent_in_geoid, LEAD(ca.avg_sale_amount, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY ca.geoid ORDER BY ca.last_sale_date) AS next_avg_sale_in_geoid, AVG(ca.total_spent) OVER (PARTITION BY ca.geoid) AS avg_spent_in_geoid, SUM(ca.total_sales_events) OVER (PARTITION BY ca.geoid) AS total_events_in_geoid FROM customer_agg ca INNER JOIN demog_stats ds ON ca.geoid = ds.geoid WHERE ca.total_spent > '1000' AND ca.age BETWEEN 65 AND 39 ) SELECT wc.geoid, wc.inhabitants_k, wc.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT wc.customer_id) AS high_value_customers, SUM(wc.total_spent) AS total_high_value_spent, AVG(wc.total_spent) AS avg_high_value_spent, MAX(wc.spending_rank_in_geoid) AS max_spending_rank, MIN(wc.sales_events_rank) AS min_sales_events_rank, SUM(wc.total_events_in_geoid) AS total_geoid_events, CORR(wc.total_spent, wc.income_k) AS spending_income_correlation, REGR_SLOPE(wc.total_spent, wc.age) AS spending_age_slope, STDDEV(wc.avg_sale_amount) AS stddev_avg_sale_amount, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY wc.total_spent) AS median_high_value_spent FROM windowed_customers wc WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sales s WHERE s.refid = wc.customer_id AND s.amount > '50' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' ) AND wc.mailings_count_12 > 36 AND wc.mailings_count_3 > 19 GROUP BY wc.geoid, wc.inhabitants_k, wc.income_k HAVING SUM(wc.total_spent) > '50000' AND COUNT(DISTINCT wc.customer_id) >= 86 AND AVG(wc.total_spent) > '2000' ORDER BY total_high_value_spent DESC LIMIT 438;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT m12.kxindex) AS distinct_mailings_count, COUNT(m3.refid) AS mailings3_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.marital_status ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_marital FROM customers c INNER JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m12 ON c.id = m12.refid AND m12.response = 'YES' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.response = 'YES' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 44 AND 67 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND c.id IN ( SELECT s2.refid FROM sales s2 WHERE s2.amount > '100.0' GROUP BY s2.refid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s2.eventid) >= 3 ) GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, c.marital_status HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '5000.0' AND AVG(d.a_var1) < '0.0' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, avg_a_var1 ASC LIMIT 61;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, COUNT(DISTINCT m.refid) AS mailings_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m ON c.id = m.refid AND m.response LIKE '%Y%' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' WHERE c.occupation LIKE '%Tech%' AND c.age BETWEEN 71 AND 79 GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) OVER(PARTITION BY c.marital_status, c.occupation ORDER BY d.income_k ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_avg_var1, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, MAX(m3.ref_date) AS latest_mailing_date, CORR(d.a_var2, d.a_var3) AS correlation_var2_var3, STDDEV(d.a_var4) AS stddev_var4 FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.response = 'YES' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 92 AND 48 AND d.income_k > 226.54 AND c.educationnum >= 19 AND (d.a_var5 < '-1000' OR d.a_var6 > '-1000') GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.a_var2, d.a_var3, d.a_var4 HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) < 699 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, latest_mailing_date ASC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m12.refid) AS mailings_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2 FROM customers c INNER JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m12 ON c.id = m12.refid AND m12.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 82 AND 43 AND d.income_k > 180.0 GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) > 2 AND SUM(s.amount) < '1000' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, d.a_var1, d.a_var2, d.a_var3, d.a_var4, d.a_var5, d.a_var6, d.a_var7, d.a_var8, d.a_var9, d.a_var10, d.a_var11, d.a_var12, d.a_var13, d.a_var14, d.a_var15, d.a_var16, d.a_var17, d.a_var18, COUNT(DISTINCT m12.refid) AS mailing_count_12, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailing_count_3, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_event_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sales_amount, MAX(s.amount) AS max_sales_amount, MIN(s.amount) AS min_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m12.response = 'Y' THEN m12.refid END) AS positive_response_count_12, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m3.response = 'Y' THEN m3.refid END) AS positive_response_count_3, (SUM(s.amount) / NULLIF(d.income_k, 0)) AS sales_to_income_ratio, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank, LAG(SUM(s.amount), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.geoid ORDER BY MAX(s.event_date) DESC) AS prev_geoid_sales FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m12 ON c.id = m12.refid AND m12.ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND s.amount > '0.0' WHERE c.age BETWEEN 87 AND 82 AND d.income_k > 613.33 AND d.inhabitants_k BETWEEN '0.0' AND '0.0' GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, d.a_var1, d.a_var2, d.a_var3, d.a_var4, d.a_var5, d.a_var6, d.a_var7, d.a_var8, d.a_var9, d.a_var10, d.a_var11, d.a_var12, d.a_var13, d.a_var14, d.a_var15, d.a_var16, d.a_var17, d.a_var18 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) > 85 AND SUM(s.amount) > '0.0' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, sales_rank ASC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE c.age BETWEEN 51 AND 32 AND d.income_k > 136.26 AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND (s.event_date IS NULL OR s.event_date < '2020-01-01') GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.income_k HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) > 62 AND SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS unique_sales_events, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings1_2_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailings3_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings1_2_yes_responses, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings3_yes_responses, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_demographic, AVG(SUM(s.amount)) OVER (PARTITION BY d.geoid) AS avg_sales_per_geoid FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE s.event_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND s.event_date <= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date) = 2020 AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM s.event_date) BETWEEN 8 AND 6 AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND m1.ref_date <= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND m3.ref_date <= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND c.age BETWEEN 93 AND 84 AND c.educationnum >= 3 AND d.income_k > 554.93 GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 371 AND (COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) > 0 OR COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) > 0) ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, avg_a_var1 ASC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS unique_sales_events, COUNT(m1.response) FILTER (WHERE m1.response = 'YES') AS mailings1_yes_count, COUNT(m3.response) FILTER (WHERE m3.response = 'YES') AS mailings3_yes_count, SUM(d.a_var1 * d.a_var2) / NULLIF(SUM(d.a_var3), 0) AS complex_demog_ratio, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_demo FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND s.event_date >= m1.ref_date JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND s.event_date >= m3.ref_date WHERE s.amount > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.event_date <= '2020-01-01' AND d.income_k BETWEEN 396.08 AND 190.54 AND c.age >= 61 GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, d.geoid HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 51 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, sales_rank_by_demo;

SELECT d.geoid, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS unique_customers, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY d.a_var1) AS median_a_var1 FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON s.refid = m1.refid AND s.event_date >= m1.ref_date WHERE d.inhabitants_k > '0' AND s.amount > '0' AND c.age BETWEEN 65 AND 21 GROUP BY d.geoid HAVING AVG(d.income_k) > 73.06 AND SUM(s.amount) > '0' INTERSECT SELECT d.geoid, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS unique_customers, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY d.a_var2) AS median_a_var2 FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON s.refid = m3.refid AND s.event_date >= m3.ref_date WHERE d.inhabitants_k > '0' AND s.amount > '0' AND c.age BETWEEN 38 AND 52 GROUP BY d.geoid HAVING AVG(d.income_k) > 426.19 AND SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY avg_income DESC, total_sales DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.income_k, d.inhabitants_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailings3_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses_m3, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY d.a_var1) AS median_a_var1, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY d.a_var2) AS median_a_var2 FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE c.age BETWEEN 32 AND 88 AND d.income_k >= 64.58 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.income_k, d.inhabitants_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 35 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, mailings_count DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, d.a_var1, d.a_var2, d.a_var3, d.a_var4, d.a_var5, d.a_var6, d.a_var7, d.a_var8, d.a_var9, d.a_var10, d.a_var11, d.a_var12, d.a_var13, d.a_var14, d.a_var15, d.a_var16, d.a_var17, d.a_var18, COUNT(DISTINCT m12.refid) AS mailings_count_12, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailings_count_3, SUM(CASE WHEN m12.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS response_count_12, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS response_count_3, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_event_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sales_amount, MAX(s.event_date) AS last_sale_date, MIN(s.event_date) AS first_sale_date, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s.amount) AS median_sales_amount, STDDEV(s.amount) AS stddev_sales_amount, SUM(c.data1) AS sum_data1, SUM(c.data2) AS sum_data2, SUM(c.data3) AS sum_data3, AVG(c.data1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.occupation, c.marital_status) AS avg_data1_by_occ_marital, AVG(c.data2) OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, d.geoid) AS avg_data2_by_sex_geo, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank, LAG(SUM(s.amount), 1) OVER (ORDER BY MAX(s.event_date)) AS prev_total_sales FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m12 ON c.id = m12.refid LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE c.age >= 76 AND c.age <= 36 AND d.income_k > 393.48 AND (m12.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' OR m12.ref_date IS NULL) AND (m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' OR m3.ref_date IS NULL) AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.amount > '0' GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, d.a_var1, d.a_var2, d.a_var3, d.a_var4, d.a_var5, d.a_var6, d.a_var7, d.a_var8, d.a_var9, d.a_var10, d.a_var11, d.a_var12, d.a_var13, d.a_var14, d.a_var15, d.a_var16, d.a_var17, d.a_var18 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) > 92 AND SUM(s.amount) < '0' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, sales_rank ASC;

SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date) AS sale_year, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS total_sales, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(d.inhabitants_k) AS total_inhabitants FROM demog d JOIN customers c ON d.geoid = c.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE s.amount > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND c.age BETWEEN 79 AND 35 GROUP BY CUBE(d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date)) HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '100' ORDER BY total_amount DESC;

SELECT d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailings3_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS sales_count, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(d.inhabitants_k) AS avg_inhabitants, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(d.a_var1 + d.a_var2 + d.a_var3 + d.a_var4 + d.a_var5 + d.a_var6 + d.a_var7 + d.a_var8 + d.a_var9 + d.a_var10 + d.a_var11 + d.a_var12 + d.a_var13 + d.a_var14 + d.a_var15 + d.a_var16 + d.a_var17 + d.a_var18) AS sum_all_a_vars, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_demographic FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid AND s.event_date BETWEEN m1.ref_date AND m3.ref_date WHERE c.age > 31 AND d.income_k BETWEEN 133.44 AND 196.26 AND (c.nom1 LIKE 'A%' OR c.nom2 LIKE 'A%' OR c.nom3 LIKE 'A%') AND m1.response = 'Yes' AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' AND m3.ref_date <= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY d.geoid, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) > 29 AND SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, avg_income DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.marital_status, c.occupation ORDER BY c.age RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS avg_a_var1_window, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings1_2_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailings3_count, MAX(d.a_var2) AS max_a_var2, MIN(d.a_var3) AS min_a_var3 FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND m1.response = 'YES' LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND m3.response = 'YES' LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE c.age > 54 AND d.income_k BETWEEN 490.91 AND 993.03 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m1.ref_date < '2019-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, c.marital_status, c.occupation HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '1000' AND COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) >= 32 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, avg_a_var1_window ASC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS unique_sales_events, COUNT(m1.response) FILTER (WHERE m1.response = 'YES') AS mailings1_yes_responses, COUNT(m3.response) FILTER (WHERE m3.response = 'YES') AS mailings3_yes_responses, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank_by_demographic, LAG(SUM(s.amount), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.id ORDER BY DATE_TRUNC('month', s.event_date)) AS prev_month_sales FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE s.amount > '0' AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.event_date <= '2020-01-01' AND d.income_k BETWEEN 175.35 AND 139.5 AND c.age >= 32 AND m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, DATE_TRUNC('month', s.event_date) HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 79 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, sales_rank_by_demographic;

WITH ranked_sales AS ( SELECT s.eventid, s.refid, s.event_date, s.amount, c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, d.a_var1, d.a_var2, d.a_var3, d.a_var4, d.a_var5, d.a_var6, d.a_var7, d.a_var8, d.a_var9, d.a_var10, d.a_var11, d.a_var12, d.a_var13, d.a_var14, d.a_var15, d.a_var16, d.a_var17, d.a_var18, m1.ref_date AS mailing1_date, m1.response AS mailing1_response, m3.ref_date AS mailing3_date, m3.response AS mailing3_response, SUM(s.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY c.id ORDER BY s.event_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_total, AVG(s.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY c.geoid, c.marital_status) AS avg_amount_by_region_marital, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.geoid ORDER BY s.amount DESC) AS sales_rank_in_region, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY c.occupation, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date)) AS sales_count_by_occupation_year FROM sales s INNER JOIN customers c ON s.refid = c.id INNER JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid AND s.event_date >= m1.ref_date LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid AND s.event_date >= m3.ref_date WHERE s.amount > '10' AND s.event_date >= '2010-01-01' AND c.age BETWEEN 22 AND 40 AND d.income_k >= 163.3 AND (m1.response = 'Y' OR m1.response IS NULL) AND (m3.response = 'Y' OR m3.response IS NULL) ), aggregated AS ( SELECT customer_id, geoid, sex, marital_status, occupation, SUM(amount) AS total_spent, AVG(amount) AS avg_spent, MAX(amount) AS max_spent, MIN(amount) AS min_spent, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count, AVG(avg_amount_by_region_marital) AS region_marital_avg, MAX(sales_rank_in_region) AS best_rank, MAX(sales_count_by_occupation_year) AS max_occupation_year_count, AVG(running_total) AS avg_running_total, SUM(CASE WHEN mailing1_response = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_mailing1_responses, SUM(CASE WHEN mailing3_response = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_mailing3_responses, AVG(a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(a_var2) AS avg_a_var2, AVG(a_var3) AS avg_a_var3, AVG(a_var4) AS avg_a_var4, AVG(a_var5) AS avg_a_var5, AVG(a_var6) AS avg_a_var6, AVG(a_var7) AS avg_a_var7, AVG(a_var8) AS avg_a_var8, AVG(a_var9) AS avg_a_var9, AVG(a_var10) AS avg_a_var10, AVG(a_var11) AS avg_a_var11, AVG(a_var12) AS avg_a_var12, AVG(a_var13) AS avg_a_var13, AVG(a_var14) AS avg_a_var14, AVG(a_var15) AS avg_a_var15, AVG(a_var16) AS avg_a_var16, AVG(a_var17) AS avg_a_var17, AVG(a_var18) AS avg_a_var18 FROM ranked_sales GROUP BY customer_id, geoid, sex, marital_status, occupation HAVING SUM(amount) > '1000' AND COUNT(*) >= 80 AND AVG(avg_amount_by_region_marital) > '50' ) SELECT a.*, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY a.total_spent DESC) AS overall_spent_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a.sex ORDER BY a.transaction_count DESC) AS transaction_rank_by_sex, SUM(a.total_spent) OVER (PARTITION BY a.geoid) AS total_spent_in_region, AVG(a.total_spent) OVER (PARTITION BY a.occupation) AS avg_spent_by_occupation FROM aggregated a INNER JOIN demog d ON a.geoid = d.geoid WHERE d.inhabitants_k > '1' AND d.income_k BETWEEN 48.3 AND 171.18 ORDER BY a.total_spent DESC, overall_spent_rank LIMIT 9270;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2, AVG(d.a_var3) AS avg_a_var3, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS unique_sales_events, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings1_2_count, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS mailings3_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings1_2_yes_responses, SUM(CASE WHEN m3.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mailings3_yes_responses, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC) AS sales_rank, LAG(SUM(s.amount), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.sex, c.marital_status ORDER BY d.income_k DESC) AS prev_sales_amount_by_demo FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.event_date) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM m1.ref_date) OR s.event_date IS NULL OR m1.ref_date IS NULL) AND (EXTRACT(MONTH FROM s.event_date) BETWEEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM m3.ref_date) - 1 AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM m3.ref_date) + 1 OR s.event_date IS NULL OR m3.ref_date IS NULL) AND (s.event_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' OR s.event_date IS NULL) AND (m1.ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' OR m1.ref_date IS NULL) AND (m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' OR m3.ref_date IS NULL) AND c.age BETWEEN 41 AND 69 AND d.income_k > 149.36 GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, c.marital_status, c.occupation, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) >= 81 ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC, d.income_k DESC;

WITH customer_aggregates AS ( SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status, COUNT(DISTINCT m12.ref_date) AS mailings_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m12.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses, AVG(d.a_var1) AS avg_a_var1, AVG(d.a_var2) AS avg_a_var2 FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m12 ON c.id = m12.refid WHERE c.age BETWEEN 73 AND 64 AND d.income_k > 370.6 AND (c.educationnum > 2 OR c.marital_status IN ('Married-civ-spouse', 'Married-AF-spouse')) GROUP BY c.id, c.geoid, c.age, c.educationnum, c.sex, c.marital_status HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m12.ref_date) >= 29 ), sales_analysis AS ( SELECT s.refid, COUNT(DISTINCT s.event_date) AS sales_days, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_amount, MAX(s.amount) AS max_amount FROM sales s JOIN mailings3 m3 ON s.refid = m3.refid WHERE s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND m3.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' AND (s.amount > '0' OR m3.response = 'YES') GROUP BY s.refid HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.event_date) < 221 ), window_calcs AS ( SELECT ca.*, sa.sales_days, sa.total_amount, sa.avg_amount, sa.max_amount, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ca.geoid ORDER BY sa.total_amount DESC) AS sales_rank_in_geo, AVG(sa.total_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY ca.sex, ca.marital_status) AS avg_sales_by_demo, SUM(sa.total_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY ca.geoid ORDER BY ca.age ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_sales_by_age FROM customer_aggregates ca LEFT JOIN sales_analysis sa ON ca.customer_id = sa.refid WHERE ca.avg_a_var1 IS NOT NULL AND ca.avg_a_var2 < '-100' AND (sa.max_amount > '0' OR sa.max_amount IS NULL) ) SELECT wc.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, wc.sex, wc.marital_status, COUNT(DISTINCT wc.customer_id) AS customer_count, AVG(wc.age) AS avg_age, AVG(wc.educationnum) AS avg_education, SUM(wc.mailings_count) AS total_mailings, SUM(wc.positive_responses) AS total_positive_responses, SUM(wc.total_amount) AS grand_total_sales, AVG(wc.avg_amount) AS overall_avg_sale, MAX(wc.sales_rank_in_geo) AS max_sales_rank, MIN(wc.avg_sales_by_demo) AS min_avg_sales_by_demo, SUM(wc.cumulative_sales_by_age) AS total_cumulative_sales FROM window_calcs wc JOIN demog d ON wc.geoid = d.geoid WHERE d.inhabitants_k > '0' AND (d.a_var3 BETWEEN '-100' AND SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS mailings_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m1.response = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_responses, AVG(s.amount) AS avg_sale_amount, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid WHERE c.age >= 19 AND c.age <= 61 AND d.income_k >= 82.19 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.sex, d.geoid, d.income_k HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) > 6 AND SUM(s.amount) > '1000' ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS total_sales, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount, (SELECT AVG(m3.response::integer) FROM mailings3 m3 WHERE m3.refid = c.id AND m3.ref_date >= '2020-01-01') AS avg_mailing3_response_rate FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid JOIN mailings1_2 m12 ON c.id = m12.refid WHERE s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND s.amount > '10' AND m12.ref_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-01-01' AND c.age BETWEEN 96 AND 58 GROUP BY c.id, c.age, c.educationnum, d.geoid, d.inhabitants_k, d.income_k HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '100' ORDER BY total_amount DESC;

SELECT c.id, COUNT(DISTINCT s.eventid) AS distinct_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT m1.refid) AS distinct_mailings1_2, COUNT(DISTINCT m3.refid) AS distinct_mailings3, AVG(d.income_k) AS avg_income, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount FROM customers c JOIN demog d ON c.geoid = d.geoid LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.id = s.refid LEFT JOIN mailings1_2 m1 ON c.id = m1.refid LEFT JOIN mailings3 m3 ON c.id = m3.refid WHERE c.age > 60 AND d.income_k < 474.07 AND s.event_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY c.id HAVING SUM(s.amount) > '0' ORDER BY total_amount DESC LIMIT 100;
